title: Ottocraft
welcome: Welcome to Ottocraft. You start in a normal Overworld with a torch, a coffee and a slice of toast. This guide covers the whole pack: SkyFactory 3's progression rebuilt for a normal world, Hexxit II's dungeons, creatures and gear, plus Create, the Twilight Forest and the Aether.
Do the next unticked goal: nothing in the recommended order needs something from further down.

Click a goal for its hints: why, steps, what to bring, portal and multiblock pictures and every recipe. Left-click any item for its recipes in JEI, right-click for its uses. Close the hints with x or by clicking the goal again.
At a crafting table, press G (or the book button) to open the guide over it. The + beside a recipe fills the grid; shift-click + for as many as you can make.

Most goals tick themselves when you craft, find, place or defeat what they ask; tick the rest with their box. Progress is shared by everyone on the server and saved with the world; hover a ticked box to see who did it.

goals.text: Gather wood and make a Crafting Table
goals.hint: Punch a tree for logs, turn them into planks, then put 4 planks in a 2x2 square.
goals.why: Almost every recipe needs the 3x3 crafting grid.
goals.tip: Press G with a crafting table open, then click + beside a recipe to fill the grid.
steps: Hold left-click on a tree trunk to break logs. Get 4 or more.
Open your inventory (E): 1 log in the 2x2 grid makes 4 planks.
Fill the 2x2 grid with planks for a Crafting Table. Place it and right-click it.
Make sticks (2 planks stacked) for tools. Plant the saplings that fall from leaves.

goals.text: Make a stone pickaxe and a furnace
goals.hint: Mine cobblestone with a wooden pickaxe. 8 cobblestone in a ring makes a furnace.
goals.why: Stone tools outlast wood. The furnace cooks food, smelts ore and makes charcoal for torches.
steps: Make a wooden pickaxe (3 planks over 2 sticks).
Dig down a few blocks anywhere to reach stone; mining it gives cobblestone.
Make a stone pickaxe, axe and sword with cobblestone.
Put 8 cobblestone in a ring for a furnace. Smelt logs into charcoal and make torches (charcoal over a stick).

goals.text: Make a bucket and carry water and lava
goals.hint: Three iron ingots in a V make a bucket.
goals.why: For farms, Nether and Aether portals, cobblestone generators, Ex Nihilo barrels and escaping lava. Water puts out fires and makes farmland; a lava bucket smelts 100 items.
steps: Smelt 3 raw iron into ingots (from caves, the next goals or village chests).
Craft a bucket: iron ingots in a V.
Fill it at any water. Fill a second bucket from a lava pool (careful).
Infinite water: dig a 2x2 hole and pour water into two opposite corners.

goals.hint: Bow: sticks and string.
goals.why: Ranged damage for skeletons and creepers.
steps: Craft the bow in a crafting table.

goals.text: Sleep through your first night in a bed
goals.hint: Three wool (from sheep) above three planks makes a bed. Sleeping also sets your respawn point.
goals.why: A bed skips the night (zombies, skeletons, creepers) and makes you respawn at home, not at world spawn.
steps: Collect three wool of the same color and three planks.
Craft a bed and place it in a lit, enclosed shelter with room above it.
Use the bed at night to sleep and set your respawn point.

mobs.where: Spawns in most grassy Overworld biomes (Bamboo Jungle, Birch Forest, Cherry Grove, Dark Forest and 13 more). Lead them home with wheat and breed two for more.

goals.text: Hang a Hammock to rest during the day
goals.hint: Comforts hammocks hang between two ropes on facing walls; right-click a rope with Hammock Cloth to string it up.
goals.why: Sleep through the day without moving your bed spawn: handy before night-only mob hunts.
steps: Craft Hammock Cloth and two ropes.
Place one rope on each of two facing walls with a two-block gap, then right-click a rope with the cloth to hang the hammock.
Use the hammock during the day to rest until night. Keep a bed for your home respawn point.

goals.hint: 3 white wool in a row.
goals.why: Sleep through the night anywhere.
steps: Place 3 white wool in a row.
Place the bag and right-click to sleep.

goals.hint: 4 string + 1 iron ingot (rope shape): makes 2 rope.
goals.why: Rope is its own placeable block.
steps: Place 4 string and 1 iron ingot in the rope shape.

goals.hint: 6 string + 2 sticks around 1 white wool.
goals.why: A hammock sleeps through the day.
steps: Put 1 white wool in the middle.
Put 2 sticks above and below it.
Fill the other 6 slots with string.

goals.text: Dye a hammock any of 16 colors
goals.hint: White hammock + any dye (shapeless).
goals.why: Colored hammocks match each room in your base.
steps: Put the white hammock and a dye in the grid.

goals.text: Dye a sleeping bag any of 16 colors
goals.hint: White sleeping bag + any dye (shapeless).
goals.why: Colored bags tell travelers apart on a shared camp.
steps: Put the white sleeping bag and a dye in the grid.

goals.text: Recover your items from a Gravestone after dying
goals.hint: When you die, a gravestone keeps your items where you fell. Right-click or break it to get them back.
goals.why: The gravestone holds everything you dropped at death until you break it.
goals.tip: Some modded hazards can still destroy a grave: don't test it with valuable gear.
steps: Find where you died: the obituary or the JourneyMap death marker.
Bring food and tools, clear the area, then break the gravestone.
Check you got all your equipment back.

goals.text: Open your own grave, not someone else's
goals.hint: A grave belongs to the player who died; others are told who owns it.
goals.why: Your items stay safe from other players.
steps: Open the grave as its owner.

goals.hint: A grave holds your items where you died.
goals.why: The grave you recover your items from.
steps: Die once to create a grave.
Break the grave as its owner to pick up the block.

goals.text: Open your map and save a waypoint at home
goals.hint: Press J for the JourneyMap map. Press B to create a waypoint where you stand.
goals.why: Villages, structures and portals are far apart. A home waypoint always leads you back.
goals.tip: Several mods use B: fix key conflicts in Controls.
steps: Press J to open JourneyMap, or find its fullscreen-map binding in Controls.
Open Waypoints, create a waypoint at your base and name it Home.
Check its dimension and visibility settings.

goals.text: Claim your base chunks so they are protected
goals.hint: Open the FTB Chunks map (M) and drag across chunks to claim them for your team.
goals.why: Claimed chunks are safe from other players and explosions. You can force-load them later so machines keep running.
steps: Press M to open the FTB Chunks claim map.
Left-click and drag over the chunks around your base to claim them.
Invite friends to your team (FTB Teams) so they can build there too.

goals.text: Go limp as a ragdoll and get back up
goals.hint: Press H to flop over as a physics ragdoll; press Shift to stand up again.
goals.why: Sable Ragdolls turns you into a physics body for laughs, airship falls and screenshots. You keep your items.
goals.tip: Hard impacts hurt like falling: not near cliffs or lava. Blood Magic's Sigil of Holding also uses H: rebind one in Controls.
steps: Press H (rebind in Options > Controls > Sable Ragdolls). You keep your momentum.
Hold W, A, S or D to roll while limp.
Press Shift to stand up (after about 3 seconds).
Friends can grab and drag your ragdoll with the mouse buttons shown on screen.

goals.hint: Craft a Bounty Board (6 planks + 3 paper) and place it; decrees are applied to it.
goals.why: Every decree is used on a board.

goals.hint: Settler's Charter: handed out when Age 1 opens; with paper, an ink sac and a gold nugget it crafts the Settler Decree.
goals.why: Keeps the Settler Decree craftable, and one right-click pays the Age 1 reward.
steps: Open First Days by defeating its boss.
Right-click the Settler's Charter once for the reward.
Craft the Settler Decree: Settler's Charter + paper + ink sac + gold nugget.

goals.text: Apply the Settler Decree to a Bounty Board
goals.hint: Open a Bounty Board, click the Settler tab on the left and place the decree in the empty slot: the page opens for good with Age 1 jobs.
goals.why: Opens the Settler page: Age 1 jobs (items and kills) that pay one notch ahead. Optional: bounties never gate progression.
goals.tip: Right-clicking the board with the decree also works. Breaking the board returns it and every decree on it. The goal ticks when anyone opens the page.
steps: Craft the Settler Decree: a Bounty Board (kept), 2 paper, 2 ink sacs, a feather and a gold nugget (shape: ink, feather, ink / paper, board, paper / gold nugget).
Right-click a Bounty Board to open it and click the Settler tab (left edge).
Place the Settler Decree in the empty slot on that page. The page opens for good and gets 3 jobs at once, then a new one about every 3 minutes (up to 9).

goals.hint: Bounties are side jobs, never a gate. Apply the Settler Decree to its page on a Bounty Board and hand in three jobs.
goals.why: Craft the Settler Decree (Bounty Board, kept, + 2 paper, 2 ink sacs, a feather and a gold nugget); later decrees arrive when the next age opens. Its page offers Age 1 jobs (items and kills from every strand) that pay one notch ahead, never a skip. Skip a job you don't like and the board offers a new one.
steps: For the Settler page, craft a Bounty Board (6 planks + 3 paper) or use one in a village, and place it. The Bounty Boards page explains how jobs work.
Apply the Settler Decree to its page on the board (the goal before this one).
Hand in three Settler bounties; this goal counts them for you.
goals.tip: Lost your decree? Craft a copy: decree + paper (you keep the original). Old capstones still make their decree.

goals.hint: Raw meat, fish or vegetables on a skewer.
goals.why: The raw skewers are the inputs for every cooked skewer.

goals.hint: Two pieces of raw meat on a stick make a skewer; cook it in a furnace or on a campfire.
goals.why: Cooks two pieces of meat at once and fills more hunger than one: a cheap travel meal.
steps: Put two raw meat (or fish) above a stick in the crafting grid.
Cook the skewer in a furnace or on a campfire.

goals.hint: Cod or salmon skewers cook on a campfire.
goals.why: Fish skewers use fish you catch while exploring.
steps: Cooked Fish Skewer: Smoke Raw Fish Skewer
Cooked Salmon Skewer: Smoke Raw Salmon Skewer

goals.hint: Vegetables on a skewer cook like meat.
goals.why: A meat-free hot meal that uses the same cooking spots as the meat skewers.
steps: Roasted Veggie Skewer: Smoke Veggie Skewer

goals.hint: Caramel is the coating for the sweet skewers.
goals.why: Needed for the caramel apple skewer.

goals.hint: Caramel apple and cookie skewers are the sweet ones.
goals.why: Sweet skewers use apples and cookies as food.

goals.hint: Breaking leaves sometimes drops a Bird's Nest; right-click it for seeds, saplings and small treasures.
goals.why: Free seeds and saplings while you clear trees, before you have a sieve.
steps: Break leaves (or let them decay) around your base.
Right-click a Bird's Nest to open it.

obtain.birdsnests:birdsnest: Breaking leaves (and leaves that decay) sometimes drops a Bird's Nest.

goals.hint: Every nest rolls sticks and feathers, and string half the time.
goals.why: Early feathers and string without hunting.
steps: Break leaves until a nest drops.

goals.text: Find eggs, bones, flint and seeds
goals.hint: Nests also hold eggs (33%), bones, flint, wheat seeds and rarely melon seeds.
goals.why: A small chance of food and crop seeds.
steps: Open nests until the extras show up.

goals.text: Find and read a Lost Book
goals.hint: Lost Books turn up in ruins, villages and dungeon chests and tell the story of each age.
goals.why: Each age has a short lore page: together they are the pack's story.
steps: Loot chests in ruins, villages and Battle Towers.
Read the book to learn where the next ring of the world starts.

obtain.lostbooks:random_book: Lost Books appear in dungeon, ruin and village chests and in the reward bag each player gets when an age opens.

goals.hint: Right-click a Dusty Book to dust it off.
goals.why: Dusting a Dusty Book reveals the lore it holds.
steps: Right-click it to dust it off and read it.

goals.text: Find a biome with a Nature's Compass
goals.hint: Craft a Nature's Compass, choose a biome from its list and follow the needle.
goals.why: Villages, Battle Towers and the first ring of ruins need certain biomes. The compass points to the nearest biome you pick.
steps: Craft it: a compass ringed by saplings and logs.

goals.text: Break a Tumbleweed for a surprise
goals.hint: Tumbleweeds roll out of dead bushes in deserts and badlands; break one for a random item.
goals.why: Drops seeds, saplings, saddles, Lost Books, Hexxit trinkets and the odd diamond.
steps: Walk through a desert or badlands where dead bushes grow.
Hit a rolling tumbleweed to break it and pick up what it drops.

mobs.where: Tumbleweeds break loose from dead bushes in deserts and badlands and roll with the wind; at most one per player at a time.

goals.text: Tame a wild horse from Mo' Creatures
goals.hint: Mount a wild horse again and again until it stops bucking you off, then saddle it.
goals.why: Horses are the first travel upgrade: much faster than walking across the first ring, and a quick escape.
steps: Find a herd of wild horses on plains or savannas.
Right-click to mount one. It throws you off at first: keep remounting until hearts appear.
Put a saddle on it (saddles come from chests, fishing and tumbleweeds) and ride. Sneak-right-click a tamed horse to open its options.

mobs.where: Wild horses roam plains and savannas in herds. Mount one again and again until it stops throwing you off; hearts mean it is tamed.

goals.text: Collect big cat claws and hide
goals.hint: Panthers, lions, tigers and other big cats drop claws and hide.
goals.why: Claws and hide feed the first armor and weapons.
steps: Big Cat Claw: Dropped by Dark Manticore, Fire Manticore, Frost Manticore, Leoger and more
Hide: Dropped by Black Bear, Dark Manticore, Fire Manticore, Frost Manticore and more

goals.text: Wear Mo' Creatures hide or fur armor
goals.hint: Bears and big cats drop hide, foxes and goats drop fur: both make early armor.
goals.why: Leather-tier armor from hunting. Hide or fur also replaces leather in the basic Iron Backpack.
steps: Hunt bears, lions, tigers or panthers for hide; foxes, goats or raccoons for fur. They fight back.
Craft the pieces like leather armor.

goals.hint: Fur from wolves, foxes and other mobs makes armor.
goals.why: Warm early armor from common mobs.

goals.text: Craft a Stone Bow from More Bows
goals.hint: Stone bow: the first More Bows bow.
goals.why: A cheap early ranged weapon. Better bows (iron, gold, diamond, elemental) come with the same ages as armor.

goals.hint: Press the Dodge key with a direction to roll away from an attack.
goals.why: A dodge makes you invulnerable for a moment: use it on creepers, skeleton volleys and boss slams.
steps: Bind the Dodge key in Options > Controls > Elenai Dodge if it has no key.
Hold a direction and press Dodge: you roll and take no damage for a moment.
Dodging needs some food in the hunger bar and has a short cooldown.

goals.text: Craft Wolf Armor for your dog
goals.hint: Craft leather wolf armor for a tamed wolf.
goals.why: Armor keeps your dog alive in caves, and dogs follow you through every age.
steps: Craft leather wolf armor and put it on from the dog inventory.

goals.hint: Craft: 1 Cobblestones + 2 Wooden Rod.
goals.why: The cheapest wand: it places short runs of blocks.
steps: Craft a cobblestone on two sticks.

goals.text: Build faster with a Builder's Wand
goals.hint: A Builder's Wand extends the face of a wall or floor using blocks from your inventory.
goals.why: Builds walls, floors and bridges a whole row at a time.
steps: Craft a stone wand (cobblestone on two sticks); iron and diamond wands place more blocks.
Right-click the face of a block: matching blocks from your inventory extend that surface.
Press the Change Mode key (Controls > Better Builders Wands) to switch between row and surface modes.

goals.hint: Craft: 1 Iron Ingot + 2 Wooden Rod.
goals.why: A bigger build radius than stone.
steps: Craft an iron ingot on two sticks.

goals.text: Hide a doorway with Camouflage Paste
goals.hint: Camouflage Paste copies the look of a block onto a secret door or wall switch.
goals.why: Hides entrances and chests from other players.
steps: Right-click a secret door or switch with it while facing the block to copy.

goals.hint: Stronger paste for camouflage.
goals.why: Camouflages powered blocks.

goals.hint: Lever disguised as a torch.
goals.why: A switch that looks like decor.

goals.hint: Plant the seeds on farmland.
goals.why: Gysahl is the chocobo's food and the taming lure.

goals.hint: Grow the crop and pick the carrots.
goals.why: Feeding carrots is how a wild chocobo is tamed.

goals.hint: Trim is 4 sticks + 5 wooden slabs, one batch per wood type.
goals.why: Trim is the base of the Framing Table, framed trim and the drawers.
steps: Craft trim from 4 sticks + 5 wooden slabs.
Make a batch for each wood type you want.

goals.hint: 5 trims make a Framing Table.
goals.why: The table builds framed drawers that show the block you choose.
steps: Craft 5 trims into a Framing Table.
Place it and open it to make framed drawers.

goals.hint: 2 wools + 2 sticks.
goals.why: Repaints chests, barrels and shulker boxes in your base colors.
steps: Craft the brush from 2 wool + 2 sticks.
Use it on a Sophisticated Storage block.

goals.hint: Craft the four Chocobo pieces from chocobo feathers.
goals.why: A light armor set before the first dungeons.

goals.hint: Any wooden slab crafts a Spice Rack.
goals.why: The cheapest kitchen block, and a quick way to see how the network works.

goals.hint: 8 dirt around a wooden chest.
goals.why: A dirt-filled special chest from the Iron Chests mod.
steps: Craft it from 8 dirt + 1 wooden chest.

goals.hint: Craft: 8 White (any) + 1 Apple.
goals.why: The base of the white apple shield.
steps: Craft 8 white dye around an apple.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 White (any) + 4 Redstone Dust + 1 Apple.
goals.why: The base of the RF apple shield.
steps: Craft 4 white dye and 4 redstone dust around an apple.

goals.hint: Weta and Avaton drop weta jaws; Raven and Penghoul drop black feathers; Ghouls drop claws.
goals.why: Sharptooth, weta jaws, claws and feathers are the base of the early crafts.
steps: Sharptooth: Ghouls, Foglets and Flame Imps drop it.

goals.text: Gather Cactus Thorns and Scythe Claws
goals.hint: Two cactus make 3 thorns; Scarecrows drop scythe claws.
goals.why: Thorns feed the thorn shooter; claws feed scythes and armor.
steps: Kill a Scarecrow for Scythe Claws.

goals.text: Harvest Cactus Fruit and Diseased Wheat
goals.hint: Cactoids and Cactyrants drop cactus fruit; Scarecrows drop diseased wheat.
goals.why: Cheap starter ingredients.
steps: Kill a Cactoid or Cactyrant for cactus fruit (it makes magenta dye).
Kill a Scarecrow for diseased wheat.

goals.hint: Mummies drop Ushabti; Frigids, Mycosis and the Sludge Lord drop Undying Hearts.
goals.why: The hearts and Ushabti feed later crafts.
steps: Acidic Heart: Amber Lord, Osvermis, Mummy or desert tombs.
Undying Heart: Frigid, Mycosis, Sludge Lord or desert tombs.
Base King's Crown: Osvermis, Forsaken or Osvermis Spiritus.

goals.hint: The Masonry Guild structure holds the carved, cube, pillar, scale and square stone sets.
goals.why: Decorative stone for your own builds.
steps: Break the stone blocks you want.

goals.hint: Kill Sandmonsters and Sandy to take their scales.
goals.why: Scales are the only material for the desert armor.
steps: Find a Sandmonster or Sandy in the desert.
Kill it and pick up the scale.

goals.text: Take a Shield Book from a Zealot
goals.hint: Zealots drop the Shield Book.
goals.why: The book starts the shield line.
steps: Kill it and pick up the book.

goals.hint: Thatch is 4 wheat; a stick wall is 9 sticks.
goals.why: Basic building blocks of the beast camps.

goals.hint: Sickles come in wood, stone, iron, gold and diamond.
goals.why: The cheap first tool of the mod; the better sickles keep the same shape.
steps: Iron Sickle: 5 iron ingot + wooden rod.

goals.why: Sickles: Diamond Sickle, Golden Sickle, Iron Sickle and 3 more.

goals.hint: 4 redstone dust around 4 wooden rods and a string.
goals.why: Filters are required for the pipe and node line below.
steps: Filter: 4 redstone dust + 4 wooden rod + string.
Fluid Filter: 4 lapis + 4 wooden rod + string.

goals.why: Filters and utility machines: Analog Crafter, Contract, Fluid Filter and 8 more.

goals.hint: 4 Wooden Chest + 4 Plank + 1 Wood Casing.
goals.why: A larger chest that you can upgrade to medium and large later.
steps: Gather 4 Wooden Chest, 4 Plank, 1 Wood Casing.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Wooden Chest | Plank | Wooden Chest; Middle row: Plank | Wood Casing | Plank; Bottom row: Wooden Chest | Plank | Wooden Chest.
Place it and use crate upgrades to grow it.

goals.text: Craft a Tiny Pile of Redstone
goals.hint: One redstone dust makes one Tiny Pile of Redstone.
goals.why: Piles are the loose material for sticks, bundled wire and Red Alloy Wire.
steps: Craft a Tiny Pile of Redstone: redstone dust.
Craft a Redstone-Impregnated Stick: Tiny Pile of Redstone + stick.

goals.hint: Flower pots around a crafting table make the plant-themed Chipped bench.
goals.why: Turns logs, leaves and flowers into their decorative variants.
steps: Craft the Botanist's Workbench from flower pots and a crafting table.
Put a plant block in the input to see its variants.

goals.hint: 2 sticks over 3 oak fences make the improved fence.
goals.why: Fences that connect smoothly to walls and each other.
steps: Craft the fence from 3 oak fences and 2 sticks.

goals.hint: An iron ingot and a stick make the pattern-picking Chisel.
goals.why: Switches any block to one of its pattern variants.
steps: Craft the Chisel: iron ingot and stick.
Right-click a block with it and pick a pattern.

goals.hint: 2 iron ingots and 2 sticks make the hammer that starts a statue.
goals.why: Turns placed blocks into a statue you can pose.
steps: Craft the Hammer: 2 iron ingots and 2 sticks in a diagonal.
Use it on a block to start a statue.

goals.hint: Penguins spawn in snowy and frozen biomes in groups of 1-4.
goals.why: Penguins drop 0-2 cod when killed.
steps: Travel to snowy plains, ice spikes, a frozen ocean or snowy slopes.

goals.hint: Wool and sticks around a crafting table make the wool-variant bench.
goals.why: Gives patterned wool and carpet variants for beds and floors.
steps: Craft the Loom Table from wool, sticks and a crafting table.
Place it and put wool in the input.

goals.hint: A green, blue and red dye with a plank make the painting palette.
goals.why: Colors statues after you shape them.
steps: Craft the Palette: green dye and blue dye over red dye and a plank.
Use it on a statue to open the colors.

goals.hint: Redstone torches and redstone dust around a crafting table.
goals.why: Opens the machine and redstone-themed block variants.
steps: Place it and open it with a metal or redstone block in the input.

goals.hint: Craft: 3 Gold Ingot + 3 Strings + 1 Bows.
goals.why: A step up from the stone bow and the base for later bows.
steps: Craft the gold bow with 3 gold ingots, 3 string and a bow.

goals.hint: Secret door: place it, then camouflage it with paste.
goals.why: A door that looks like wall.
steps: Place it and right-click with camouflage paste.

goals.hint: Secret chest: hides a chest inside a wall block.
goals.why: Storage that no one else sees in your wall.
steps: Find a secret chest in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the chest where a wall block would be.
Open it with right-click on that wall block.

goals.hint: Lever that hides in a wall block.
goals.why: Switches that no one sees.
steps: Place it on a wall, then camouflage it.

goals.hint: Plate that takes the look of the block you put it on.
goals.why: A trigger that blends into the floor.
steps: Find a secret pressure plate in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the Secret Pressure Plate on the floor.
Right-click the Secret Pressure Plate with camouflage paste to disguise it as the block it touches.

goals.hint: Stairs that copy a block of your choice.
goals.why: Stairs that look like part of the wall around them.
steps: Find secret stairs in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the stairs against the wall.
Right-click them with camouflage paste to copy the neighboring block.

goals.hint: Button that hides in a wall.
goals.why: A hidden trigger for doors.
steps: Find a secret wooden button in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the Secret Wooden Button on a wall.
Right-click the Secret Wooden Button with camouflage paste to disguise it as the block it touches.

goals.hint: Trapdoor that hides in a floor.
goals.why: A floor hatch that looks like the floor around it.
steps: Find a secret wooden trapdoor in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the trapdoor in the floor.
Right-click the Secret Wooden Trapdoor with camouflage paste to disguise it as the block it touches.

goals.hint: Ghost block: place it where a wall should be passable.
goals.why: Walk-through walls for hidden rooms.

goals.hint: Redstone wire that hides in a block.
goals.why: Hidden wiring behind a wall.
steps: Find secret redstone in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the Secret Redstone where the wire must run.
Right-click the Secret Redstone with camouflage paste to disguise it as the block it touches.

goals.hint: Probe that toggles hidden switches.
goals.why: Find or flip your own secret switches.
steps: Right-click a hidden switch with it.

goals.text: Twerk a Sapling into a Tree
goals.hint: Crouch repeatedly next to saplings and crops to make them grow (TS2K16).
goals.why: Free bonemeal while you wait for wood or food.
goals.tip: It can take a while. Saplings need light and clear space.
steps: Stand next to a sapling or crop.
Tap Shift quickly and repeatedly; green particles show it works.

goals.text: Use a Crook on leaves to get saplings and a Silkworm
goals.hint: Break leaves with a crook (sticks) for extra saplings and the odd silkworm.
goals.why: More saplings, and silkworms for renewable string.
steps: Break leaves with it: more saplings drop, and about 1 in 100 leaves drops a silkworm.

goals.text: Infest leaves with a Silkworm and crook them for string
goals.hint: Use a silkworm on leaves, wait until they turn white with webs, then break them with a crook.
goals.why: String for the sieve's String Mesh, wool, bows and fishing rods, without hunting spiders.
steps: Right-click a leaf block with a silkworm.
Wait until the leaves turn fully white (the infestation spreads).
Break the white leaves with a crook for string and sometimes more silkworms.

mobs.where: Spawns in the dark or at night in most Overworld biomes, The Beneath and the Twilight Forest (Highlands Underground, Spooky Forest, Underground). Spawners in dungeons and other structures.
Spawns in the dark in Sulfur Caves (Overworld) and The Beneath. Spawners in dungeons and other structures.

goals.text: Compost leaves or saplings in a Wooden Barrel to make Dirt
goals.hint: Right-click a wooden barrel with leaves, saplings or food. When full it slowly becomes dirt.
goals.why: Renewable dirt for farms and for sieving into seeds and pebbles.
steps: Right-click it with leaves, saplings, seeds, food or rotten flesh until full.
The compost turns into dirt. Right-click to take it out.

goals.text: Collect rain water in a Wooden Barrel
goals.hint: An empty wooden barrel left out in the rain slowly fills with water.
goals.why: Water before you have a permanent supply.
steps: Place an empty wooden barrel outdoors where rain reaches the ground (open sky above).
Wait for rain, then take the water with a bucket. In dry biomes or dimensions, fill it from a bucket.

goals.text: Craft a Sieve and a String Mesh
goals.hint: Sieve + String Mesh (9 string): right-click with gravel, sand or dust to sift.
goals.why: The heart of SkyFactory resources: gravel, sand, dust and dirt become ores, gems, seeds and pebbles.
steps: Craft the sieve and a string mesh (9 string).
Right-click the sieve with the mesh to insert it.
Right-click with gravel (or sand, dust, dirt), then keep right-clicking until it is sifted.
Sieves side by side all sift with one click.

goals.text: Craft a Hammer to turn Cobblestone into Gravel, Sand and Dust
goals.hint: Hammer cobblestone into gravel, gravel into sand, sand into dust.
goals.why: Turns endless cobblestone into everything the sieve needs.
steps: Place cobblestone and break it with the hammer: gravel drops.
Hammer gravel for sand, then sand for dust.

goals.text: Sift Gravel, Sand and Dust in a Sieve for ore pieces
goals.hint: Sift gravel for ore pieces. 4 pieces = 1 ore chunk; smelt the chunk into an ingot.
goals.why: Renewable iron, copper, gold, lead, silver, nickel and aluminum, plus coal, diamonds, emeralds and lapis from gravel.
goals.tip: Press U on gravel, sand or dust in JEI for every drop and its chance.
steps: Sift gravel with a String Mesh or better.
Ore pieces drop by chance: iron, copper, gold, lead, silver, nickel, aluminum.
Craft 4 pieces of one metal into an ore chunk; smelt it into an ingot (or crush it for more).
Sand: more pieces and cactus seeds. Dust: redstone, glowstone, gunpowder, blaze powder. Dirt: seeds and pebbles. Crushed netherrack: cobalt and ardite.

goals.hint: Four Stone Pebbles in a 2x2 make one cobblestone.
goals.why: Pebbles from the hammer and sieve feed back into building and hammer blocks.
steps: Collect Stone Pebbles from the sieve.

goals.text: Make Clay by putting Dust into a water-filled Barrel
goals.hint: Fill a barrel with water first, then right-click it with dust.
goals.why: Clay for bricks, Tinkers grout, porcelain and the crucible, without finding a river.
steps: Fill a wooden barrel with water (bucket or rain).
Right-click it with dust from the hammer: it becomes a clay block. Right-click to take it.

goals.text: Explore a cave and return with coal, iron and copper
goals.hint: Mine coal, raw iron and raw copper in caves; smelt the raw metals.
goals.why: Iron makes tools, buckets, armor, hoppers and most machines. Coal fuels furnaces and torches.
goals.tip: Fortune gives extra raw ore. Iron is common at Y 16 to 64; deep caves also have diamonds.
steps: Bring torches, food, a stone pickaxe and spare blocks.
Light the cave paths you use.
Mine coal, raw iron and raw copper. Head back before supplies run low.
Smelt the raw metals in a furnace.

goals.text: Mine a whole ore vein at once with OreExcavation
goals.hint: Hold the Excavate key (default `, under Esc) and break one ore to mine the whole vein.
goals.why: Saves time and pickaxe swings on every ore vein and tree.
steps: Find an ore vein or a tree.
Hold the Excavate key and break one block.
Every connected block of the same kind breaks too. Each costs durability and a little hunger.

goals.text: Smelt iron and make a full set of iron tools
goals.hint: Iron pickaxe, axe, shovel and sword.
goals.why: An iron pickaxe mines diamonds, gold, redstone and many modded ores. Iron tools are fast and durable.
steps: Smelt about 10 raw iron into ingots.
Craft the pickaxe first (3 iron over 2 sticks), then the sword, axe and shovel.

goals.text: Wear a full set of iron armor and carry a shield
goals.hint: Helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots from 24 iron, plus a shield (planks and one iron).
goals.why: Armor more than halves the damage you take; a shield blocks arrows, creeper blasts and melee hits. You need both for caves and the Nether.
steps: Smelt 24 iron ingots (and 1 more for the shield).
Craft helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.
Craft a shield and hold it in your off-hand (F swaps hands). Right-click to block.

goals.text: Upgrade your Sieve mesh and enchant it
goals.hint: Iron and diamond meshes give rarer drops; Fortune and Efficiency work on meshes.
goals.why: More and rarer drops (more diamonds, golden items). Fortune adds rolls; Efficiency sifts faster.
steps: Craft a flint mesh, then an iron, golden or diamond mesh.
Enchant it at an enchanting table or with books on an anvil.
Swap meshes for what you want: JEI lists the drops per mesh.

goals.hint: A clay ball + bone meal makes one Porcelain Clay.
goals.why: Porcelain Clay is the material for the Crucible and the dolls.
steps: Craft a clay ball + bone meal: shapeless.
Craft 7 porcelain clay in a bowl shape (x x / x x / xxx) for an Unfired Crucible.
Smelt the Unfired Crucible in a furnace to get a Crucible.

goals.text: Turn coal or charcoal into Mini Coal
goals.hint: 1 coal = 8 mini coal; each smelts exactly 1 item.
goals.why: A coal smelts 8 items; mini coal wastes nothing on small jobs.
steps: Put one coal (or charcoal) in the crafting grid for 8 mini coal.
Use one mini coal per item you smelt.

goals.text: Find a village and trade with a villager
goals.hint: Find a village (plains, desert, savanna, taiga, snowy plains) and right-click a villager with a job.
goals.why: Villages have food, beds and loot chests. Villagers trade books, tools and food for emeralds; emeralds also buy seeds at the Market.
goals.tip: Zombies kill or convert villagers (depends on difficulty): light and fence the village before night.
steps: Search plains, deserts, savannas, taigas or snowy plains.
Right-click an adult villager with a profession to see its trades.
Sell a crop or material it asks for to get emeralds. Protect villagers and their workstations.

mobs.where: Villagers live in villages (plains, desert, savanna, taiga and snowy plains). Get more by giving them beds and food (bread, carrots) so they breed, or cure a zombie villager with a splash potion of weakness and a golden apple.

goals.text: Set up a crop plot and bring animals back to your base
goals.hint: Hoe dirt next to water and plant seeds from grass. Hold wheat to lead cows and sheep home.
goals.why: Endless food, plus leather, wool and meat from breeding. Many mods also use wheat, carrots and potatoes.
steps: Break tall grass for wheat seeds.
Make a hoe and till dirt near water (water hydrates 4 blocks in every direction).
Plant the seeds; crops need light.
Hold wheat to lead cows and sheep. Fence them in and breed them (wheat on two adults).

mobs.where: Spawns in most grassy Overworld biomes (Bamboo Jungle, Birch Forest, Dark Forest, Forest and 11 more). Lead them home with wheat and breed two for more.

goals.text: Catch a fish or axolotl in a bucket
goals.hint: Use a water bucket on a fish or axolotl.
goals.why: Carry mobs home for farms and ponds.

goals.hint: Furnace + 5 iron ingots + 3 smooth stone.
goals.why: Smelts ores and metal gear faster.
steps: Smelt stone twice for smooth stone.

goals.text: Build a piston and hopper line
goals.hint: Craft a piston and a hopper, then feed a chest from a hopper chain.
goals.why: Hoppers and pistons move items and blocks for every later farm.
steps: Craft a hopper from iron ingots and a chest.
Craft a piston with wood, cobblestone, iron and redstone.
Run a hopper into a chest below it.

goals.hint: Hold right-click on crops to grow them faster. The reinforced can covers more.
goals.why: Speeds up crops and saplings around you.
steps: Craft a watering can and fill it at water.
Hold right-click while looking at crops or saplings.

goals.text: Flint, bone, stone and clay gear
goals.family: Flint, bone, stone and clay gear

goals.text: Speed up sugar cane with Snad
goals.hint: Plant sugar cane on Snad beside water: it grows faster than on dirt or sand.
goals.why: Snad speeds up sugar cane (plain sand does not).
steps: Place it beside water and plant sugar cane on it.
Keep the farm loaded with room above. Harvest the upper cane so it keeps growing.

goals.hint: Red Sand alone in the grid gives Red Snad.
goals.why: The same speed-up on red sand terrain.
steps: Put Red Sand in the crafting grid.

goals.text: Harvest a wide area with a Scythe
goals.hint: A scythe cuts crops and grass in a large area per swing.
goals.why: Big fields in a few swings instead of one block at a time.
steps: Swing at grown crops or tall grass: everything around breaks at once.

goals.text: Make a Cutting Board and a Pot from Pam's HarvestCraft
goals.hint: Pam's tools stay in the grid and cook hundreds of foods: press U on a tool in JEI.
goals.why: Pam's foods restore far more hunger and saturation than plain crops, and the tools are never used up.
steps: Craft the Cutting Board and the Pot. Also useful: Skillet, Saucepan, Bakeware, Mixing Bowl, Juicer.
Put the tool in the grid with the ingredients; the tool stays.
Press U on a tool in JEI for every food it makes.

goals.text: Cook a meal with Pam's HarvestCraft
goals.hint: Cook a meal with your Pam tools: apple pie, grilled cheese, noodle soup and more.
goals.why: Big meals keep you full for a long time.
steps: Gather ingredients from your farm, village gardens and Pam crops (wild gardens drop seeds).
Search the meal in JEI and press R for what it needs.
Craft it with the right tool in the grid.

goals.hint: Planks, red wool, planks on top; then 2 logs; then 3 logs.
goals.why: One block sells every seed and sapling in the pack.
steps: Top row: planks, red wool, planks.

goals.text: Trade at the Market for seeds and saplings
goals.hint: The Market sells seeds, saplings and Natura trees for emeralds.
goals.why: Seeds and saplings that are hard to find: Natura trees, Pam's crops, flowers.
steps: Craft the Market and place it.
Right-click it, browse the categories and pay with emeralds.

goals.hint: Wheat, beetroot, melon and pumpkin seeds cost 1 emerald each.
goals.why: Seeds for the base crops without searching for them.
steps: Open the Market and switch to the Seeds tab.
Pick wheat, beetroot, melon or pumpkin seeds.

goals.hint: Oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia and dark oak saplings cost 1 emerald each.
goals.why: Any wood type without finding its biome.
steps: Switch the Market to the Saplings tab.
Pick the wood type you need.

goals.hint: Bone meal costs 1 emerald on the Other tab.
goals.why: Speeds up crops and saplings without skeleton farming.
steps: Switch the Market to the Other tab.

goals.text: Buy a Natura sapling from the Market
goals.hint: Natura's Overworld trees don't generate here: buy their saplings at the Market.
goals.why: Natura woods (maple, silverbell, amaranth, tiger) give unique planks and decorations.
steps: Open the Market and find the Natura saplings.
Buy one with emeralds and plant it like a normal sapling.

goals.text: Sift Topiary Grass to collect Natura saplings
goals.hint: Sift Topiary Grass for Natura Overworld saplings (Nether species: sift soul sand).
goals.why: Saplings for trees that don't generate in this pack.
steps: Sift it with a mesh its JEI sieve recipe accepts.

goals.text: Break grass to find Natura barley and cotton seeds
goals.hint: Break tall grass: Natura barley and cotton seeds drop at a low chance.
goals.why: Barley makes flour and bread; cotton makes string and wool.
steps: Break tall grass until barley and cotton seeds drop.
Plant them on farmland like wheat.

goals.hint: Chop a Natura tree grown from a sapling or found in the world.
goals.why: Logs make planks and the whole furniture set.
steps: Plant a sapling on dirt and wait for it to grow.

goals.hint: Break a ripe berry bush to pick its berries.
goals.why: Berries are food and craft into medleys.
steps: Find a berry bush or craft one.

goals.text: Shear a sheep with Wooden Shears
goals.hint: Shears made from planks.
goals.why: Wool, leaves and vines before you have iron to spare.
steps: Right-click a sheep for 1-3 wool without killing it.

goals.text: Craft flint, stone or clay shears
goals.hint: Flint, stone and clay shears are cheap early tools.
goals.why: Spare shears that need no iron.
steps: Stone Shears: 2 any stone tool materials

goals.text: Craft golden, diamond or emerald shears
goals.hint: Gold, diamond and emerald shears last longer.
goals.why: Shears that survive a whole sheep farm.

goals.text: Apply a block to a sheep with Shear Madness
goals.hint: Right-click a sheep with a full block to dress it in that block.
goals.why: Decoration: adult sheep wear the block, and shearing gives the block back.
goals.tip: No need to shear the sheep first. Some blocks have effects: TNT-covered sheep explode when killed.
steps: Find an adult sheep and hold a full, solid block.
Shear it to take the block back.

mobs.where: Spawns naturally in Bamboo Jungle, Birch Forest, Cherry Grove, Dark Forest and 13 more (the Overworld); Birch Forest, Cherry Grove, Dark Forest, Forest and 13 more (Fake Overworld); Birch Forest, Cherry Grove, Dark Forest, Forest and 13 more (Quarry). Lead them home with their favorite food and breed two of them to get more.

goals.text: Shear a block-covered sheep to restore its wool coat
goals.hint: Shear a block-dressed sheep to get the block back.
goals.why: The sheep then regrows normal wool for beds and banners.
steps: Right-click the dressed sheep with them: the block drops and the wool coat returns.

goals.hint: A cactus sheep pricks whoever hits it.
goals.why: A thorny guard animal for a pen.
steps: Use it on an adult sheep.

goals.text: Tame a Chocobo and saddle it
goals.hint: Feed a wild chocobo Gysahl Greens until hearts appear, then put on a Chocobo Saddle.
goals.why: Fast mounts that jump high; later colors swim, climb or fly. The Chocopedia explains breeding.
steps: Find wild chocobos in plains, savannas or forests, and Gysahl seeds in wild Gysahl gardens.
Grow Gysahl Greens and feed them to a chocobo until hearts appear.
Craft a Chocobo Saddle (saddle or leather + chocobo feather) and right-click to equip it.
Craft the Chocopedia (book, feathers, ink, lapis, gold) for colors and breeding.

goals.hint: Nuts and veggies are chocobo food.
goals.why: Each food has its own role; the Chocopedia lists them.

goals.hint: Each chocobo color has its own feather.
goals.why: Feathers are also crafting parts for the bags and the Chocopedia.

goals.hint: 3 leather and a chocobo feather.
goals.why: Carry items on your mount.
steps: Chocobo Saddle Bags: 3 Leather + chocobo feather (any color)

goals.hint: Oreberry bushes grow in dark caves; their berries smelt into metal nuggets.
goals.why: Extra iron, gold and copper on cave trips; essence berries give XP.
steps: Look for small leafy bushes with colored berries in dark caves.
Right-click a ripe bush to pick the berries.

obtain.oreberries:iron_oreberry: Oreberry bushes grow in dark caves underground. Right-click a ripe bush to pick its berries.

goals.hint: Bushes for aluminum, copper, essence, gold and tin grow in the world; iron has its own step.
goals.why: Bushes keep regrowing berries, so one find gives a steady metal supply.
steps: Look in caves and dark areas.
Right-click a ripe bush to pick its berries.

goals.text: Store bulk items in Storage Drawers
goals.hint: A drawer holds 32 stacks of one item; a Drawer Controller links drawers into one inventory.
goals.why: Keeps cobblestone, dirt and ores out of your chests, and shows what is inside.
steps: Craft a drawer and place it with the front reachable.
Right-click the front holding the item to deposit; double-right-click deposits every matching item you carry.
Left-click the front to take one item; sneak-left-click takes a stack.
Add a storage upgrade when it fills. Label or lock drawers as needed.

goals.hint: 8 sticks + 1 basic drawers.
goals.why: Storage, status, redstone and key recipes all start from a template.
steps: Craft 8 sticks + 1 basic drawer into a template.
Keep several; each upgrade uses one.

goals.why: Collect the drawer tape as you unlock them.

goals.hint: 5 wooden planks + 4 sticks (planks in a checker around the sticks).
goals.why: Framed trim goes into the framed drawers that the Framing Table makes.
steps: Place 5 wooden planks and 4 sticks in a checker pattern.
Use the trim with the Framing Table.

goals.text: Build a Sophisticated Storage barrel or chest
goals.hint: Craft a Sophisticated Storage chest or barrel (needs a Storage Drawer) and add upgrades.
goals.why: Bigger, upgradable storage. Its recipes use a drawer in place of the lever, so it comes after Storage Drawers.
steps: Craft the storage block and place it.
Store items and put storage upgrades in its upgrade slots.
Check each upgrade's tooltip and JEI recipe first; backpack upgrades are a separate set.

goals.hint: Stone, comparators and wooden planks: place it touching your chests.
goals.why: One place to reach every connected chest and barrel.
steps: Craft the controller (4 stones + 2 comparators + 2 wooden planks + 1 more part).
Place it touching a storage block.
Link far chests with storage connectors.

goals.why: Collect the storage connectors as you unlock them.

goals.hint: 8 copper ingots + 1 lever.
goals.why: More slots than a basic chest; the iron upgrade builds on it.
steps: Craft the upgrade from 8 copper ingots + 1 lever.
Use it on a basic chest or barrel.

goals.hint: 4 iron ingots + 1 basic-to-copper tier upgrade.
goals.why: Iron tier holds more again and takes extra upgrade slots.
steps: Craft it from 4 iron ingots + the copper tier upgrade.
Right-click a copper chest or barrel with it.

goals.text: Copper and iron chests and barrels
goals.family: Copper and iron chests and barrels
goals.why: Collect the copper and iron chests and barrels as you unlock them.

goals.hint: 7 crimson planks + 1 crimson slab + 1 lever.
goals.why: Limited barrels come in sizes 1 to 4 and every metal tier.
steps: Craft one from 7 planks + 1 slab + 1 lever.
Raise its tier by crafting with metal ingots around it.

goals.why: Collect the limited barrels as you unlock them.

goals.text: Craft a Charset Barrel and store items in it
goals.hint: A Charset barrel holds up to 4096 of one item and works with automation.
goals.why: A cheap bulk barrel for one item: cobblestone, seeds or wood.
steps: Right-click with an item to store it; left-click takes a stack.
Hoppers and pipes can insert and extract.

goals.hint: Kill Black Bears or Manticores (Mo' Creatures): they drop Hide.
goals.why: Link 1 of 3 of the Hide to Backpack route; next: basic Iron Backpack.

goals.hint: Wool and leather (or Mo' Creatures hide or fur) around a chest make the first backpack.
goals.why: More inventory for long trips. It is SkyFactory 3's backpack; the Sophisticated Backpack is crafted from it.
steps: Craft the backpack and right-click to open it.
Upgrades start from an Upgrade Core (string, paper, leather); JEI shows each upgrade.
Iron, gold and diamond tiers are crafted from the tier below.

goals.hint: 4 string + 4 papers + 1 leather.
goals.why: Most backpack upgrades are built around a core.
steps: Craft it from 4 strings + 4 paper + 1 leather.
Keep a stack for the upgrades below.

goals.hint: 2 oak buttons + 2 stone buttons + 1 paper.
goals.why: The Advanced Filter Upgrade needs two of them.
steps: Craft it from 2 oak buttons + 2 stone buttons + 1 paper.
Keep two for the advanced filter.

goals.hint: 4 bowls + 4 string + 1 paper.
goals.why: Adds a damage bar display to the backpack.
steps: Craft it from 4 bowls + 4 strings + 1 paper.
Slot it into a free upgrade space.

goals.hint: Craft a Sophisticated Backpack from an Iron Backpack; it holds more and takes upgrades.
goals.why: Pickup, feeding and other upgrades make it the main backpack after the SF3 ones.
goals.tip: Test pickup and feeding filters with cheap items before relying on them.
steps: Craft it and right-click it while held to open.
Store supplies and add upgrades in its upgrade slots.
Use the Open Backpack key while carrying or wearing it (fix conflicts in Controls).

goals.text: Move a full chest with Packing Tape
goals.hint: Tape a chest or machine to pick it up with everything inside.
goals.why: No emptying chests before a move.
steps: Craft Packing Tape and use it on a supported chest or storage block.
Break the wrapped block to pick up the package.
Place the package where you want it and unpack it. Unsure if a modded block works? Test it empty first.

goals.text: Carry a chest and its contents with a Chest Transporter
goals.hint: Right-click a chest with a Chest Transporter to carry it with its contents; right-click again to place it.
goals.why: No emptying chests before a move. Wood and iron transporters are enough.
goals.tip: Each move costs one use; better materials last longer.
steps: Craft a wooden Chest Transporter (planks + a stick), or an iron one for more uses.
Right-click a chest with it: chest and items go into the transporter.
Right-click a block to place the chest. Carrying slows you down.

goals.hint: 5 iron ingots + 1 stick.
goals.why: A stronger transporter that lifts more block types.
steps: Craft it from 5 iron ingots + 1 stick.
Right-click a chest to lift it.

goals.text: Climb with stepladders or Climbing Rope
goals.hint: Stepladders and climbing rope get you up walls.
goals.why: A cheap way up cliffs and into mines without building stairs.
steps: Place stepladders against a wall and walk up. Place rope from the top: it hangs down.

goals.hint: 3 strings in a V shape make a rope you can climb.
goals.why: Reaches high builds without ladders or scaffolding.
steps: Place it at the top and climb down or up.

goals.text: Build with Missing Pieces chairs, tables and wedges
goals.hint: Chairs, tables, wedges and corners for many blocks. Wood shapes come from the stonecutter.
goals.why: Detail plain blocks can't give, and you can sit on the chairs.
steps: Wood shapes: put planks in a stonecutter. Other shapes are crafted.
Place them like blocks; wedges and corners face you.

goals.hint: Oak planks in a stonecutter make a sloped wedge.
goals.why: The first Missing Pieces block, used for roofs and slopes.
steps: Put oak planks in a stonecutter.
Take the wedge from the result.

goals.hint: 2 charcoal in the grid = 2 graphite.
goals.why: Graphite is black dye from charcoal: no squid hunting for ink.
steps: Put 2 charcoal in the crafting grid for 2 graphite.

goals.text: Use Graphite to dye White Wool Black
goals.hint: Graphite works as a black dye.
goals.why: Black wool for builds and beds from charcoal alone.
steps: Put white wool and graphite in the crafting grid.
Graphite works in most recipes that take black dye.

goals.hint: Place 5 sticks and 4 planks of one wood in a ring.
goals.why: A wooden crate that keeps the wood of its planks.
steps: Craft a Crate: 5 sticks + 4 planks of one wood.

goals.hint: 4 redstone dusts + 4 cobblestones + redstone torch.
goals.why: A memory cell: one input sets it and the other resets it.
steps: Craft a Charset RS Latch Gate: 4 redstone dusts + 4 cobblestones + redstone torch.
Place it on a block and wire a set input and a reset input.

goals.text: Craft Magnetic Tape and a Tape Reel
goals.hint: 6 black dyes + 2 redstone dusts + iron ingot.
goals.why: Both are needed for the Tape Drive and the audio tape that records on it.
steps: Craft Charset Magnetic Tape: 6 black dyes + 2 redstone dusts + iron ingot.
Craft a Charset Tape Reel: 4 iron ingots + paper.

goals.text: Activate a Waystone in a village
goals.hint: Right-click a village Waystone to save it; any Waystone can then send you there.
goals.why: The second travel upgrade: instant trips to every village you have visited.
steps: Find the tall stone pillar with a glowing top in a village.
Right-click any activated waystone and pick a destination. Long trips cost up to 3 XP levels (1 per 500 blocks).

goals.hint: Monsters sometimes drop Loot Bags; right-click one for a random reward.
goals.why: Extra loot from fights; rarer bags hold better items.
steps: Fight monsters until one drops a bag.

obtain.lootbags:itemlootbag: Monsters sometimes drop Loot Bags; age rewards and bounties pay them too.

goals.hint: Defeat a monster variant (brute, ninja, sniper, fire creeper...): they hit harder and drop extra loot.
goals.why: Variants and Infernal elites get more common the farther you go from spawn. Learn their tricks early.
steps: Fight monsters at night or in caves; variants have different names and colors.
Defeat one: the goal ticks itself.

mobs.where: Special Mobs turns some ordinary monsters into variants (brutes, ninjas, snipers, fire creepers...). They get more common far from spawn.

goals.hint: Fallen stars land at night; they craft Nyx Celestial gear.
goals.why: Nyx night events (Blood Moons and more) start after the first week; fallen stars craft the Celestial gear.
steps: Stay outdoors at night, watch for a falling light and pick up the star where it lands.

obtain.nyx:fallen_star: Fallen stars drop from the sky at night: stay outdoors, watch for the falling light and collect the star where it lands.

goals.hint: Hexxit loot has amulets, charms and rings with abilities like arrow or explosion immunity.
goals.why: Wear them in the accessory (Curios) slots: Aero Amulet stops arrows, Blast Charm stops explosions, Convection Ring lets you hover over lava.
steps: Loot Hexxit World ruins, Battle Towers and tumbleweeds.
Read the tooltip and wear it in an accessory slot.

goals.hint: Find a Bomb, then craft the bag from 7 leathers and a Bomb.
goals.why: The bag carries bombs for walls and mobs.
steps: Find a Bomb in a Hexxit structure.
Craft the Bomb Bag: 7 leathers + 1 Bomb.

goals.text: Craft a Boomerang or Slime Sword
goals.hint: Craft the early weapons: boomerang, slime sword, bad bow and quiver.
goals.why: Ranged and melee options before the medallions.
steps: Slime Sword: 2 slime balls + 1 wooden rod.

goals.text: Craft Lawn blocks and a Beanstalk
goals.hint: Craft decoration and climbing blocks from sunflower bush seeds, vines and dirt.
goals.why: Beanstalks give a climbable column.
steps: Beanstalk: 1 vine + 1 sunflower bush seed makes 4.
Lawn: 1 dirt + 4 wheat seeds (or 2 dandelions, or 1 sunflower).

goals.text: Cut grass for Hearts and Mystic Seeds
goals.hint: Cut grass and kill mobs; they drop heart drops, and charged grass drops Mystic Seeds.
goals.why: Hearts heal you between fights.
steps: Cut tall grass with a sword.
Kill mobs for more heart drops.
Pick up Mystic Seeds from charged grass.

goals.text: Raise your health with a Heart Container
goals.hint: 4 Heart Pieces (or glass panes around an eye of ender) = Heart Container: +1 heart.
goals.why: Permanent extra hearts make every later dungeon safer.
steps: Collect Heart Pieces from Hexxit dungeons and tumbleweeds, or craft a container from glass panes and an eye of ender.
Right-click the Heart Container for a heart. There is a cap; the game tells you when you reach it.

goals.hint: One Hexbiscus crafts into one Hexical Essence.
goals.why: Hexical Essence is the base of the Hexical Diamond.
steps: Craft 1 Hexbiscus into 1 Hexical Essence; repeat for 3.

goals.hint: Craft: 1 Fallen Star + 3 Hexical Essence + 1 Diamond.
goals.why: Every Hexxit armor piece and the Master Sword hilt need one.
steps: Craft 3 Hexical Essence around a Diamond with a Fallen Star (Nyx) on top.
Craft 9 diamonds from a Hexical Diamond Block when you have one.

goals.text: Mine the rare ore it holds
goals.hint: Mine the ore your ore-dimlet dimension generates; this link ticks on a diamond.
goals.why: The end of the Dimlets to Custom Ore Worlds route.

goals.hint: Tribal armor needs a Hexical Diamond: fallen star + hexical essence + diamond.
goals.why: The first Hexxit Gear set, between iron and diamond.
steps: Get Hexical Essence from Battle Towers and bounty rewards, and a fallen star at night.
Craft a Hexical Diamond, then the armor pieces.

goals.hint: Use the Locate button and walk to the tower.
goals.why: The Golem at the top is the Age 2 boss.

goals.hint: The Golem guards the top floor.
goals.why: Defeating it opens Age 3.

goals.text: Age 2 boss: defeat the Battle Tower Golem
goals.hint: The Battle Tower Golem opens Age 3 (Iron & Tinkering) for everyone on the server.
goals.why: When anyone on the server defeats the Battle Tower Golem, Age 3 opens for every player at once: its guide chapter, the reward bag and the decree of the age you finished. Age 3 brings Tinkers' tools and smeltery alloys, Create's first machines, Botania's Pure Daisy, Roots, Hatchery and Mystical Agriculture seeds.
goals.tip: The killer, or anyone within 64 blocks when it dies, opens the age for the whole server. Nothing to craft or hand in. /sf3ages lists every gate.
steps: Where: the roof of any Battle Tower (tall stone towers in the Overworld; several within 1,500 blocks of spawn).
Bring: iron armor, an iron or Tinkers weapon, a bow and arrows, food and blocks. Every floor below has spawners and chests.
Defeat it. Chat announces the new age and this goal ticks itself (ages open in order).
Drops: diamonds and redstone, plus the tower chests.

goals.hint: 3 sticks + 3 strings in a net pattern.
goals.why: The net picks up a chicken to move it.
steps: Craft 3 sticks and 3 strings in the net pattern.

goals.hint: Smelt a Book in a furnace.
goals.why: The Recipe Book is the base of the Crafting Book and the No Filter Edition.
steps: Recipe Book: Smelt No Filter Edition

goals.hint: A chest and an iron door make a Fridge.
goals.why: Cold storage that the Cooking Table can read from.

goals.hint: 8 iron ingots around a wooden chest.
goals.why: The first step above a wooden chest.
steps: Craft it from 8 iron ingots + 1 wooden chest.
Or use a Wood to Iron Upgrade on a wooden chest.

goals.hint: 8 copper ingots around a wooden chest.
goals.why: Copper is the base for the silver chest.
steps: Craft it from 8 copper ingots + 1 wooden chest.
Or use a Wood to Copper Upgrade.

goals.hint: 8 wooden planks + 1 log.
goals.why: The shell of the structure.
steps: Craft it from 8 wooden planks + 1 log.
Build the shell out of walls.

goals.hint: 2 sticks + 1 chest wall wood.
goals.why: Upgrades a built chest or turns it back into plain blocks.
steps: Use it on a built chest to change its tier.

goals.why: Collect the uncolossal chest as you unlock them.

goals.hint: 4 cobblestones + 1 chest wall wood.
goals.why: Lets pipes and hoppers reach the inside of the chest.
Collect the metal chest interfaces as you unlock them.

goals.hint: Smelt an Unfired Clay Bucket in a furnace.
goals.why: A bucket that needs no iron, and the start of the clay barrels.

goals.hint: Craft: 6 Planks + 1 Leathers.
goals.why: The cheapest shield: it blocks hits from Age 2.
steps: Craft 6 planks and 1 leather into a shield.

goals.text: Craft Chitin, Foul Hide and Cloth
goals.hint: Chitin comes from vespa carapace or a mimic claw; hide from foul bristle.
goals.why: Chitin and hide are the armor base.
steps: Chitin: 1 vespa carapace or 1 mimic claw makes 2.

goals.text: Craft a Tooth Dagger or Bone Sword
goals.hint: Sharptooth makes both.
goals.why: Your first Lavacow weapons.
steps: Bone Sword: 4 sharptooth + 2 bone blocks + 1 wooden rod.

goals.hint: The Midnight Mourne is 3 hatred shards and 2 bones; Osvermis, the Forsaken and the Skeleton King drop shards.
goals.why: It starts the anvil upgrades for the Ankh Scepter, Frozen Grip and Fungal Rod.

goals.hint: Three diseased wheat make a loaf.
goals.why: A cheap food from the first mob drops.
steps: Hay block: 9 wheat; unpack with 1 block.

goals.hint: Castles, outposts and taverns spawn in plains, forest, swamp and savanna; snow castles and outposts in snowy biomes.
goals.why: Every dungeon has a boss and chests drawn from the equipment, treasure, material, food and clutter loot sets.
steps: Plains, forest, swamp, savanna: Castle, Outpost, Tavern, Randomized Castle.
Snowy: Snow Castle, Snow Outpost, Snow Stronghold.
Ocean: Ship Large, Ship Small, Island. Sandy: Desert Stronghold. Mountain: Volcano.
Nether: Nether City, Floating City, Nether Island.

goals.hint: Material chests hold slime balls, bull leather, spider leather and turtle scales.
goals.why: Crafting and trade materials for the armor sets.
steps: Open material and equipment chests in dungeons.
Take slime balls, leather and scales.

goals.hint: Equipment chests hold iron great swords, spears, iron armor and iron bullets.
goals.why: The first real weapons and armor from dungeons.
steps: Open equipment chests in a castle or outpost.
Take the iron great sword, spear and dyeable iron armor.

goals.text: Craft Scale armor and a Scale hood
goals.hint: Scale Armor is 8 sandmonster scales; the Scale Hood is 5.
goals.why: Desert armor from your first beast hunt.

goals.hint: Craft the Bestiary from a book and an Ancient Beasts item.
goals.why: The book lists the mod mobs you have met.

goals.hint: 4 Wooden Rod + 4 Cobblestone.
goals.why: The first Ender IO part; Machine Chassis and other recipes build on gears.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Wooden Rod | Cobblestone | Wooden Rod; Middle row: Cobblestone | empty | Cobblestone; Bottom row: Wooden Rod | Cobblestone | Wooden Rod.
Make a few before moving on.

goals.hint: 1 diamond in the crafting grid makes 9 diamond nuggets.
goals.why: Splits one diamond into nine small pieces from the Translocators mod.
steps: Put 1 diamond in the crafting grid.

goals.hint: 8 papers + 1 wooden slab.
goals.why: Shows what a chest or barrel holds.
steps: Craft it from 8 paper + 1 wooden slab.
Place it on the storage block.

goals.hint: 1 Obsidian + 3 Iron Ingot.
goals.why: Lets you draw liquid XP out of a tank into your own experience bar.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Obsidian | empty | empty; Middle row: Iron Ingot | Iron Ingot | empty; Bottom row: Iron Ingot | empty | empty.

goals.hint: Smelt soul sand in a furnace.
goals.why: Vile Dust goes into the Corrupted Ingot.
steps: Smelt 1 soul sand to get Vile Dust.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Leather + 2 Iron Ingot.
goals.why: Every jetpack and flux pack uses a strap.
steps: Craft the strap from leather and iron ingots.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Logs + 4 Red Dye + 1 Ender Pearl.
goals.why: The wooden and stone exchangers need a tier 1 core.
steps: Craft 4 logs, 4 red dye and an ender pearl into a core.

goals.hint: Craft a Drying Basin from logs, black dye and iron.
goals.why: Turns menril resin into crystal blocks.
steps: Craft a Drying Basin: 5 logs + black dye + 2 iron ingots.

goals.hint: Craft a lamp from 3 redstone lamps + 3 obsidians.
goals.why: The lamp a circuit lights once it is on a board.
steps: Craft a Miniature Lamp: 3 redstone lamps + 3 obsidians.

goals.hint: Flux Dust is the base material of every Flux Networks part.
goals.why: The Flux Core and Flux Block recipes both need it.

goals.hint: Scythes reap soul and blood essence from mobs.
goals.why: The first scythe for reaping essence, which every altar recipe needs.

goals.hint: Right-click reaped essence with a keeper to bottle it.
goals.why: Essence is the currency for altar recipes.
steps: Essence Keeper: Craft: 2 Soumberglass Ingot + 1 Basic Essence Keeper + 1 Ender pearls (any)
Soul Crucible: Craft: 7 Obsidians (any) + 1 Soumberglass Ingot

goals.text: Craft the iron frame, tubing and wiring
goals.hint: Iron Frame: 4 iron ingots. Tubing and Wiring are the other base parts.
goals.why: Every part below uses them.
steps: Iron Tubing: 2 iron ingot + wooden rod.
Iron Wiring: 2 iron ingot + 4 Redstone + wooden rod.

goals.why: Frame parts: Iron Carving Tool, Cobblestone Generator Tier 2, Iron Frame and 5 more.

goals.hint: A blade is 5 ingots of its metal.
goals.why: Blades set the turbine metal.
steps: Vibrant Turbine Blade: 5 vibrant alloy ingot.

goals.why: Turbine blades: Advanced Alloy Turbine Blade, Bronze Turbine Blade, Enderium Turbine Blade and 4 more.

goals.hint: Mine gravel patches until an ore-flecked block shows up.
goals.why: Early iron without caves.
steps: Break the ore: it drops itself.

goals.hint: Humans spawn in the Overworld in groups of 4.
goals.why: Humans are the mod's mobs and drop player heads.
steps: Explore the Overworld until a group of humans appears.

goals.hint: 6 of a metal ingot, gem or modded plank over a stick makes 3 signs of that material.
goals.why: Signs in the look of each material, for labeling storage and machines.
steps: Put 6 ingots (or gems, or treated wood / menril planks) in the top two rows and a stick below.
Collect each material's sign as you get the material.

goals.hint: Mine gravel patches for coal-flecked gravel.
goals.why: Fuel without a coal vein.

goals.hint: A loot modifier gives a 2% chance of a player head.
goals.why: Player heads are decoration blocks you can place anywhere.
steps: Kill mobs; a loot modifier adds a 2% chance.

goals.hint: Killing a pig, cow, blaze, enderman and others by hand gives a 1 in 200 chance of its head.
goals.why: Mob heads for decoration.

goals.hint: Iron ingots, glass and bricks around a crafting table.
goals.why: Unlocks the glass, ice and glowing-block variants.
steps: Craft the Glassblower from iron ingots, glass, bricks and a crafting table.
Place it and put a glass block in the input.

goals.hint: Bricks and iron around a crafting table.
goals.why: The largest Chipped bench: stone, brick, tuff and deepslate variants.
steps: Craft the Mason's Table from bricks, iron and a crafting table.
Place it and put a stone or brick block in the input.

goals.hint: An iron axe, iron ingots and planks around a crafting table.
goals.why: Gives every wood type its panel, crate and barrel variants.
steps: Craft the Carpenter's Table from an iron axe, iron ingots, planks and a crafting table.
Place it and put planks or logs in the input.

goals.hint: Homestead Seal: handed out when Age 2 opens; with paper, an ink sac and a gold nugget it crafts the Homestead Decree.
goals.why: Keeps the Homestead Decree craftable, and one right-click pays the Age 2 reward.
steps: Open Homestead by defeating its boss.
Right-click the Homestead Seal once for the reward.
Craft the Homestead Decree: Homestead Seal + paper + ink sac + gold nugget.

goals.hint: Deer, ostrich, turkey, duck, crab, rat and turtle give raw meat.
goals.why: More food sources for the early game.

goals.hint: Hide from big cats and bears makes tougher armor.
goals.why: A step up from fur armor.

goals.text: Make a kitty bed and litter
goals.hint: Beds come in 16 colors.
goals.why: Comfort and litter for pet cats.
steps: Red Kitty Bed: 3 planks (any wood) + 3 Red Wool + iron ingot
Litter Box: 8 planks (any wood) + any sands

goals.hint: Catch small fish alive.
goals.why: Move fish into an aquarium or bucket.

goals.hint: Silver skeletons and golems drop scrap that smelts into ingots.
goals.why: Scrap smelts into ingots for the silver gear.
steps: Ancient Silver Scrap: Dropped by Big Golem, Mini Golem, Silver Skeleton
Ancient Silver Ingot: Smelt Ancient Silver Scrap

goals.hint: Armor, bow and mattock from Ancient Silver.
goals.why: The first Mo' Creatures metal tier.
steps: Ancient Silver Chestplate: 8 Ancient Silver Ingots
Ancient Silver Bow: 2 Ancient Silver Ingots + iron ingot + 3 string

goals.hint: Refined silver in ingots, nuggets and blocks.
goals.why: Blocks and nuggets of fine silver.
steps: Fine Silver Ingot: 9 Fine Silver Nuggets
Block of Fine Silver: 9 Fine Silver Ingots

goals.text: Craft a silver sword or axe
goals.hint: Silver tools for fighting undead.
goals.why: Good against undead mobs.
steps: Ancient Silver Sword: 2 Ancient Silver Ingots + iron ingot
Ancient Silver Axe: 3 Ancient Silver Ingots + 2 iron ingots

goals.hint: Chitin and stings from dirt scorpions.
goals.why: Chitin and stings of dirt scorpions make armor, a sword, an axe and a mattock.
steps: Earth Scorpion Chestplate: 8 Earth Chitins + Golden Chestplate
Earth Scorpion Blade: Earth Scorpion Stinger + Golden Sword + Earth Chitin

goals.hint: Sharks drop teeth.
goals.why: Sword, axe and mattock from teeth.

goals.hint: Crocodiles and komodo dragons drop hide.
goals.why: Crocodile and komodo hide make an armor set and a whip.
steps: Reptile Hide: Dropped by Crocodile, Komodo Dragon

goals.hint: Katana, nunchaku, sai and bo.
goals.why: Alternative melee weapons.
steps: Ninja Katana: 3 Ancient Silver Ingots + 2 Hides
Ninja Nunchaku: 4 Ancient Silver Ingots + 2 Hides
Ninja Sai: 4 Ancient Silver Ingots + 2 Hides

goals.hint: 1 iron helmet + 2 iron boots + 2 iron ingots.
goals.why: Iron armor roughly matches your own iron set for the wolf.
steps: Put the iron helmet in the top slot.
Put one iron boot in the middle and one in the bottom slot.
Put the iron ingots on both sides of the middle boot.

goals.hint: 1 diamond helmet + 2 diamond boots + 2 diamonds.
goals.why: Diamond armor keeps your wolf alive in Nether and End fights.
steps: Put the diamond helmet in the top slot.
Put one diamond boot in the middle and one in the bottom slot.
Put the diamonds on both sides of the middle boot.

goals.hint: 1 golden helmet + 2 golden boots + 2 gold ingots.
goals.why: Gold armor gives the wolf a cheap upgrade from leather.
steps: Put the gold helmet in the top slot.
Put one gold boot in the middle and one in the bottom slot.
Put the gold ingots on both sides of the middle boot.

goals.hint: Craft: 1 Diamond + 2 Wooden Rod.
goals.why: The largest radius of the three crafted wands.
steps: Craft a diamond on two sticks.

goals.hint: Secret iron door: opens with a hidden switch.
goals.why: A door only you can open.
steps: Place a secret switch for it.

goals.text: Craft a Secret Player Pressure Plate
goals.hint: Plate that reacts to players only.
goals.why: Triggers doors without a visible plate.
steps: Find a secret player pressure plate in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the Secret Player Pressure Plate on the floor.
Right-click the Secret Player Pressure Plate with camouflage paste to disguise it as the block it touches.

goals.hint: Iron trapdoor that hides in a floor.
goals.why: A hatch only redstone opens.
steps: Wire it to a hidden switch.

goals.hint: Stone button that hides in a wall.
goals.why: A stone button no one sees on a stone wall.
steps: Find a secret stone button in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the Secret Stone Button on a wall.
Right-click the Secret Stone Button with camouflage paste to disguise it as the block it touches.

goals.hint: Gate that opens a hole in a wall.
goals.why: A wall that opens on a signal.
steps: Wire it to a hidden switch.

goals.hint: Dispenser hidden in a wall.
goals.why: A trap or supply no one can see.
steps: Find a secret dispenser in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the dispenser behind a wall block.
Right-click the Secret Dispenser with camouflage paste to disguise it as the block it touches.

goals.hint: Trapped chest that hides in a wall.
goals.why: A hidden chest that sends a signal when opened.
steps: Find a secret trapped chest in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the chest in the wall.
Right-click the Secret Trapped Chest with camouflage paste to disguise it as the block it touches.

goals.hint: Glass you see through from one side.
goals.why: Watch a room from outside.
steps: Place it with the clear side facing you.

goals.text: Craft a Secret Heavy Pressure Plate
goals.hint: Heavy plate that hides in the floor.
goals.why: A weighted plate that triggers redstone from the floor unseen.
steps: Find a secret heavy pressure plate in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the Secret Heavy Pressure Plate on the floor.
Right-click the Secret Heavy Pressure Plate with camouflage paste to disguise it as the block it touches.

goals.text: Craft a Secret Light Pressure Plate
goals.hint: Light plate that hides in the floor.
goals.why: A weighted plate for lighter loads that hides in the floor.
steps: Find a secret light pressure plate in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the Secret Light Pressure Plate on the floor.
Right-click the Secret Light Pressure Plate with camouflage paste to disguise it as the block it touches.

goals.hint: Helmet that reveals camouflaged blocks.
goals.why: See secret rooms when you wear it.
steps: Wear it near a suspect wall.

goals.hint: Diamond version of the exposing helmet.
goals.why: Reveals camouflaged blocks and protects better.
steps: Wear it near a suspect wall.

goals.text: Buy a seed at the Farming Market
goals.hint: Open a Farming Market, pick a Pam's HarvestCraft seed from the Seeds tab and trade for it.
goals.why: The Market lists all 60 Pam's HarvestCraft seeds, so no crop needs exploring for.
steps: Find or craft a Farming Market (see the Farming for Blockheads path).
Trade for any Pam's HarvestCraft seed.

goals.text: Grow your first Pam's HarvestCraft crop
goals.hint: Plant a bought seed on watered farmland and harvest the grown crop.
goals.why: Crops are the base of every dish, from salads to curry.
steps: Harvest the crop once it is fully grown.

goals.text: Turn a crop back into seeds
goals.hint: Craft one grown crop item to get its seed.
goals.why: Keeps a crop growing without a second Market trip.
steps: Craft a Tomato to get Tomato seeds.

goals.hint: Skillet, saucepan, pot, bakeware, mixing bowl, juicer and mortar.
goals.why: Nearly every dish lists one of these tools as an ingredient.

goals.hint: Craft a sapling from 3 fruit and any sapling, plant it on dirt and pick the fruit.
goals.why: Fruit and nuts make juice, jelly, smoothies, yogurt and pies.
steps: Pick the fruit from the grown tree.

goals.hint: A Juicer plus a fruit makes juice.
goals.why: Juice is the ingredient for drinks and smoothies.

goals.hint: A saucepan, fruit and sugar make jelly.
goals.why: Jelly is the filling for jelly sandwiches.
steps: Apple Jelly: Saucepan + Apple + any sugar

goals.hint: The Seeds tab also lists the Pam seeds.
goals.why: Pam's HarvestCraft crops start here, so this links the two mods.
steps: Find a Pam's HarvestCraft seed on the Seeds tab.
Trade for it and plant it.

goals.hint: The Saplings tab also lists the Pam fruit trees.
goals.why: Fruit trees without hunting wild ones for a sapling.
steps: Find a fruit tree on the Saplings tab.
Trade for it and plant it on dirt.

goals.hint: Plant a berry bush and harvest it for berries.
goals.why: Renewable berries for food.

goals.hint: The shears accept durability enchantments.
goals.why: Unbreaking and Mending make a cheap tool last.
steps: Put the shears in an enchanting table or on an anvil.

goals.hint: A TNT sheep explodes when it dies.
goals.why: A trap animal for mob farms.
steps: Use it on an adult sheep.

goals.hint: Obsidian, nether bricks and magma blocks protect the sheep from fire.
goals.why: A sheep that survives a Nether pen.
steps: Hold obsidian, nether bricks or a magma block.
Use it on an adult sheep.

goals.text: Shear a pig or polar bear for skin
goals.hint: Shears take skin from pigs and hide from polar bears.
goals.why: Skin and hide craft light armor.
steps: Use shears on a pig or a polar bear.

goals.hint: Pig skin crafts into a light armor set.
goals.why: A cheap early armor without leather or iron.

goals.hint: Polar bear hide crafts into armor.
goals.why: A warm set for snow trips.
steps: Polar Bear Chestplate: 8 Polar Bear Hides
Polar Bear Helmet: 5 Polar Bear Hides

goals.hint: Gold and shears make a Shaver.
goals.why: A gold shearing tool made from gold and a pair of shears.

goals.hint: A book, 4 chocobo feathers, 2 ink sacs, lapis and a gold nugget.
goals.why: The chocobo guidebook shows breeding and food info.
steps: Chocopedia: Book + 4 chocobo feathers (any color) + 2 Ink Sacs + Lapis Lazuli + Gold Nugget

goals.hint: 2 wool, leather, a feather and string.
goals.why: A bigger bag set for the mount.
steps: Chocobo Pack Bags: 2 wool (any color) + Leather + chocobo feather (any color) + 4 String

goals.hint: Smelt, smoke or campfire-cook a raw leg.
goals.why: Chocobos drop raw legs as food.
steps: Cooked Chocobo Leg: Smoke Raw Chocobo Leg

goals.hint: 5 stones + 2 comparators + 1 basic drawers + 1 diamond.
goals.why: One block that opens every drawer around it as a single inventory.
steps: Craft the controller from 5 stones + 2 comparators + 1 basic drawer + 1 diamond.
Place it next to your drawers.
Right-click it to reach all of them.

goals.hint: Put the filter upgrade in an upgrade slot and set the allowed items.
goals.why: Pipes and hoppers move only what you allow.
steps: Put it in an upgrade slot.

goals.hint: 8 gold ingots + 1 basic to iron tier upgrade (8 gold ingots + the iron upgrade).
goals.why: Gold tier is the next jump in slots.
steps: Craft it from 8 gold ingots + the iron tier upgrade.
Right-click an iron chest or barrel with it.

goals.hint: 1 ender pearl + 3 obsidian + 1 upgrade base + 2 redstone.
goals.why: Overflow of a chosen item is destroyed instead of filling the chest.
steps: Craft it from 1 ender pearl + 3 obsidian + 1 upgrade base + 2 redstone.
Put it in an upgrade slot and set the filter.

goals.hint: 7 iron ingots + 1 wooden chest + 1 basic backpack.
goals.why: More storage slots than the basic backpack; the upgrade-points version keeps slots for upgrades.
steps: Craft it from 7 iron ingots + 1 wooden chest + the basic backpack.
For more upgrade points craft the upgrade-points version with an Upgrade Core instead.

goals.hint: 4 papers + 1 upgrade core.
goals.why: Picks up only the items you pick.
steps: Craft it from 4 paper + 1 Upgrade Core.
Put it in the backpack and set the filter.

goals.hint: 4 emeralds + 1 upgrade core.
goals.why: More points to spend on upgrades.
steps: Craft it from 4 emeralds + 1 Upgrade Core.
Add it to unlock more upgrade points.

goals.hint: 4 redstone + 4 eggs + 1 upgrade core.
goals.why: Lets a backpack hold another backpack; the depth upgrade builds on it.
steps: Craft it from 4 redstone + 4 eggs + 1 Upgrade Core.
The advanced version puts 4 redstone + 4 eggs around it.

goals.hint: 4 diamonds + 4 emeralds + 1 upgrade core.
goals.why: Protects the backpack from being lost.
steps: Craft it from 4 diamonds + 4 emeralds + 1 Upgrade Core.
Keep it in the pack that you do not want to lose.

goals.hint: 1 black dye or ink sac + 3 papers + 1 upgrade core.
goals.why: Destroys picked-up items that match its filter.
steps: Craft it from 3 paper + 1 ink sac or black dye + 1 Upgrade Core.
Set the filter in the backpack.

goals.hint: 4 pistons + 1 paper.
goals.why: Moves backpack items into a nearby chest in one action.
steps: Stand at a chest and trigger the upgrade.

goals.hint: 1 feather + 1 glass bottle + 1 black dye or ink sac + 5 wooden slabs + 1 paper.
goals.why: Gives the backpack a name so you can tell several apart.
steps: Craft it from 5 wooden slabs, 1 paper, 1 feather, 1 glass bottle and 1 ink sac or black dye.
Add it to a free upgrade space.

goals.hint: 1 sticky piston + 2 string + 1 upgrade base + 3 redstone.
goals.why: Items you walk over go straight into the backpack.
steps: Craft it from 1 sticky piston + 2 strings + 3 redstone + 1 upgrade base.
Put it in an upgrade slot.

goals.hint: The Opener is 7 stone, 1 iron ingot and 1 chest.
goals.why: It stores bags and opens them for you.

goals.hint: The Recycler is 7 stone, 1 chest and 1 iron ingot.
goals.why: It turns stored bags into loot value.

goals.text: Trade bags up or down a rarity
goals.hint: Four bags of one rarity make one of the next; one high bag makes four of the next lower.
goals.why: Turns spare common bags into rare ones.
steps: Combine 4 Common bags into 1 Uncommon (and up to Legendary).
Break 1 Legendary into 4 Epic (and down to Common).

goals.text: Craft a Fire, Earth, Wind or Ender Medallion
goals.hint: Each medallion is 4 gold ingots + 4 bricks + one catalyst item.
goals.why: Medallions are the base of every amulet.

goals.hint: Turn medallions into the Titan Band, Valor Headband and Whirlwind Boots.
goals.why: Passive buffs that stack with armor.
steps: Titan Band: 4 gold ingots + 4 leathers + Earth Medallion.
Whirlwind Boots: 2 gold ingots + 2 wool + Wind Medallion.

goals.hint: Craft: 5 Bone + 1 Hexical Diamond.
goals.why: The first Hexxit set; each piece needs a Hexical Diamond.
