steps: Craft the helmet from 5 Bone and 1 Hexical Diamond.
Craft chest, legs and boots with Hexical Diamonds.

goals.hint: 4 mossy stone bricks + 3 clay blocks + a diamond + an iron block; it summons a Battle Tower Golem on open ground near you in the Overworld.
goals.why: Each tower's Golem fights once and the tower collapses: the effigy lets you take the Battle Tower Golem bounty (worth 140) again without a new tower.
steps: Craft it: mossy stone bricks in the corners, clay blocks top center, left and right, the diamond in the middle, the iron block bottom center.

In the Overworld, right-click it near open ground: it looks 4 to 8 blocks straight ahead first, then anywhere 3 to 8 blocks around you (up to 3 blocks up or down) for a 3x3 spot, 4 blocks high, on a solid floor. Grass, flowers, snow and torches count as open.
It works only once Age 3 is open (/sf3ages) and no summoned Golem is alive within 64 blocks; the effigy is used up.
The Golem sleeps until you come close, like on a tower roof. A summoned Golem drops 1 diamond, clay and paper, and no tower collapses.

goals.text: Apply the Homestead Decree to a Bounty Board
goals.hint: Open a Bounty Board, click the Homestead tab on the left and place the decree in the empty slot: the page opens for good with Age 2 jobs.
goals.why: Opens the Homestead page: Age 2 jobs (items and kills) that pay one notch ahead. Optional: bounties never gate progression.
goals.tip: Right-clicking the board with the decree also works. Breaking the board returns it and every decree on it. The goal ticks when anyone opens the page.
steps: You get the Homestead Decree when Age 3 opens (every player gets one).
Right-click a Bounty Board to open it and click the Homestead tab (left edge).
Place the Homestead Decree in the empty slot on that page. The page opens for good and gets 3 jobs at once, then a new one about every 3 minutes (up to 9).

goals.hint: Bounties are side jobs, never a gate. Use the Homestead Decree on a Bounty Board and hand in three jobs.
goals.why: Every player gets the Homestead Decree when Age 3 opens. On a board it offers Age 2 jobs (items and kills from every strand) that pay one notch ahead, never a skip. Skip a job you don't like and the board offers a new one. Bounties count for this decree until the next decree arrives.
steps: For the Homestead page, craft a Bounty Board (6 planks + 3 paper) or use one in a village, and place it. The Bounty Boards page explains how jobs work.
Apply the Homestead Decree to its page on the board (the goal before this one).
Hand in three Homestead bounties; this goal counts them for you.
goals.tip: Lost your decree? Craft a copy: decree + paper (you keep the original). Old capstones still make their decree.

goals.text: Mine diamonds and make a diamond pickaxe
goals.hint: Diamonds are most common near Y -58; mine them with an iron pickaxe or better.
goals.why: A diamond pickaxe mines obsidian (Nether portal). Diamonds also make enchanting tables, the Twilight Forest portal and many machines.
goals.tip: Sifting gravel with a better mesh also gives diamonds.
steps: Bring an iron pickaxe, torches, food and a water bucket (turns lava into obsidian).
Dig down to about Y -58 (F3 shows your height) and branch-mine: 1x2 tunnels 3 blocks apart.
Caves near lava also have diamonds.
Craft a diamond pickaxe: 3 diamonds over 2 sticks.

goals.text: Build an Enchanting Table and enchant a tool
goals.hint: Diamonds, obsidian and a book make the table; 15 bookshelves around it unlock level 30 enchantments.
goals.why: Efficiency, Unbreaking and Protection make everything faster and safer; Fortune multiplies ores, Looting multiplies mob drops.
steps: Get obsidian: pour water on still lava and mine it with a diamond pickaxe.
Craft the enchanting table: 2 diamonds, 4 obsidian, 1 book.
Craft up to 15 bookshelves (planks + 3 books each). Place them 1 block from the table, level with it or one higher.
Put a tool and lapis in the table and pick an enchantment.

diagram.title: Bookshelf layout
diagram.view: Top view: 15 bookshelves with a 1-block gap around the table
diagram.note: Leave the gap free (no torches or carpet). Stack a second layer of shelves if you run out of floor space.

goals.text: Repair and combine enchantments on an Anvil
goals.hint: An anvil repairs tools, combines enchantments and renames items.
goals.why: Fix enchanted tools without losing the enchantments, and add enchanted books from villagers or loot.
steps: Craft an anvil: 3 iron blocks over 4 iron ingots.
Repair: a damaged tool + its material (or a second tool).
Enchant: a tool + an enchanted book.

goals.text: Craft and fire a Crucible, then melt Cobblestone into Lava
goals.hint: Smelt the unfired crucible, put it over a torch or lava and feed it cobblestone.
goals.why: Endless lava from cobblestone: fuel for furnaces and generators, and obsidian with water.
steps: Craft porcelain clay (clay + bone meal), then an unfired crucible; smelt it.
Put the crucible on a heat source: torch (slow), lava or fire (faster).
Right-click it with cobblestone; it melts into lava. Take it with a bucket.

goals.text: Make Obsidian in a Stone Barrel
goals.hint: Fill a stone barrel with lava, then right-click it with a water bucket.
goals.why: Renewable obsidian for portals, enchanting tables and obsidian chests.
steps: Right-click with a water bucket: it becomes obsidian.

goals.text: Sift ore pieces into chunks and ingots
goals.hint: Four ore pieces in a 2x2 make a chunk; a furnace turns a chunk into an ingot.
goals.why: The first metal that does not come from a vein.
steps: Sift gravel, sand or dust for ore pieces.
Craft 4 pieces of one metal in a 2x2 into a chunk.
Smelt the chunk (copper chunk gives a copper ingot).

goals.text: Brew witch water in a barrel
goals.hint: A water barrel over mycelium turns into witch water after 10,000 ticks.
goals.why: Witch water turns sand into soul sand, a Nether block you can make at home.
steps: Set it on mycelium; red and brown mushrooms grow.

goals.text: Craft the Tiny Progressions Cobblestone Generator
goals.hint: Makes cobblestone by itself; pull it out with a hopper or pipe.
goals.why: Endless cobblestone without water or lava, for hammers (gravel, sand, dust), crucibles (lava) and compressors.
steps: Put a hopper or pipe under it into a chest or drawer.

goals.text: Automate your Cobblestone with an Iron Cobblestone Generator
goals.hint: Iron, diamond, blaze and emerald tiers make cobblestone faster.
goals.why: More cobblestone per second for big sieving and crushing setups.
steps: Craft the iron tier from the basic generator and iron.
Swap it in. Later tiers: diamond, blaze, emerald.

goals.hint: 6 oak logs and 1 wooden slab: p p / p p / psp.
goals.why: A crucible made of one wood melts blocks with a heat source below.
steps: Craft 6 oak logs and 1 wooden slab (p p / p p / psp).
Other woods have their own recipe.

goals.hint: Nine Diamond Hammers in a 3x3 make one.
goals.why: It breaks compressed blocks in one hit.
steps: Put them all in the crafting grid.

goals.hint: 5 oak logs + 2 sticks: p p / ppp / s s.
goals.why: A heavy sieve takes compressed blocks.
steps: Craft 5 oak logs and 2 sticks (p p / ppp / s s).

goals.text: Compress Gravel and sift it in a Heavy Sieve
goals.hint: Craft 9 Gravel into one Compressed Gravel and sift it in a Heavy Sieve: one block gives nearly nine sifts of drops.
goals.why: Heavy Sieves were how SkyFactory 3 players sped up sifting before they had machines.
steps: Craft a Heavy Sieve (press G on it to see the recipe) and put a mesh in it.
Craft 9 Gravel, Sand, Dust or Dirt into one compressed block.
Right-click the Heavy Sieve with the compressed block, then keep right-clicking to sift.
In Age 4 the Auto Heavy Sieve does this for you.

goals.hint: Two wheat make a Cow Bait; every animal has its own two-item bait.
goals.why: Baits lure the animal to a trap.

goals.text: Make Grout and fire it into Seared Bricks
goals.hint: Grout = sand + gravel + clay; smelt it into seared bricks.
goals.why: Seared bricks build every Tinkers melter and smeltery.
steps: Craft grout from sand, gravel and clay.
Count bricks with the smeltery diagram first: controller, tank, drain, casting blocks and walls.

goals.hint: Craft: 8 Seared Brick.
goals.why: The brain of the smeltery: it melts ore and metal into fluid.
steps: Craft the controller from 8 Seared Bricks.
Place it in a seared wall.

goals.text: Craft a Part Builder and a Tool Station
goals.hint: The Tinkers workshop: Blank Patterns, Stencil Table, Part Builder, Tool Station.
goals.why: Stencil Table: cuts patterns into part stencils. Part Builder: stencil + material = tool part. Tool Station: builds, repairs and upgrades tools.
goals.tip: SkyFactory 3's Tinkers with Tool Leveling: tools gain XP with use and get a free modifier slot each level.
steps: Craft Blank Patterns: 2 planks and 2 sticks in a checker = 4 patterns.
Pattern on planks = Stencil Table; on a log = Part Builder; on a Crafting Station = Tool Station.
Place them side by side: their screens share tabs. A Pattern Chest next to them stores stencils.

goals.text: Make a Tinkers' tool from a head, handle and binding
goals.hint: Make parts in the Part Builder from stencils, then build the tool in the Tool Station.
goals.why: Even a flint or copper Tinkers pickaxe repairs, levels up and can swap parts later.
goals.tip: Hover a part for its stats and traits. Metal parts are cast in the smeltery later.
steps: Stencil Table: pick a part (pick head, tool rod, binding) and take the stencil.
Part Builder: stencil + material (planks, cobblestone, flint, bone) = the part.
Tool Station: choose the tool, put the parts in the outlined slots, take the tool.

obtain.tconstruct:pickaxe: Tinker tools are assembled at a Tool Station from parts; the tool is not a fixed recipe.

goals.text: Build a Tinkers' Construct smeltery for processing ore
goals.hint: Seared bricks make the walls, controller, drain, tank and faucet. Melting ore gives extra metal.
goals.why: Melting raw ore gives more metal than smelting. The smeltery also casts tool parts and alloys bronze, rose gold and more.
goals.tip: The controller screen shows what is melting. There is no Tinkers book in this pack: hover the parts or use this guide.
steps: Build a floor of Seared Bricks, then walls one block high around the inside.
Put the Smeltery Controller (facing out), a Seared Drain and a Seared Tank in the walls.
Fill the tank with lava. The controller lights up when the structure is valid.
Put a Faucet on the outside of the drain and a Casting Table or Basin under it.
Put ores into the controller; right-click the faucet to pour metal into ingot casts.

diagram.title: Smallest smeltery
diagram.view: A 3x3 floor with a ring of walls on top; the middle stays empty.
diagram.note: Bigger smelteries (more walls, taller) melt more at once. The Faucet goes on the outside of the Drain.

goals.hint: Craft: 3 Seared Brick.
goals.why: Pours fluid from the smeltery onto casting tables and basins.
steps: Craft the faucet from 3 Seared Bricks.
Place it on the smeltery drain side with a casting table below.

goals.text: Cast a metal tool part and upgrade an existing tool with it
goals.hint: Pour molten metal from a faucet onto a Casting Table holding a cast.
goals.why: Metal parts (iron, cobalt, manyullyn) have far better stats. Gold casts are reusable.
steps: Put a part from the Part Builder (a wooden pick head works) on a Casting Table.
Pour 2 ingots of molten gold over it: the part becomes a reusable gold cast. Clay casts work once.
Melt the metal you want and pour it into the cast.
Swap that part of your tool for the metal part in the Tool Station.

obtain.tconstruct:clay_cast: Press a part or any item into a Casting Table with clay to make a cast.

goals.hint: Shovel + axe in one tool: clears land fast.
goals.why: Digs dirt and chops wood at full speed.
steps: Pick the mattock in the Tool Station: axe head + shovel head + tool rod.
Make the parts in the Part Builder (or cast metal ones) and assemble them.

obtain.tconstruct:mattock: Tinker tools are assembled at a Tool Station from parts; the tool is not a fixed recipe.

goals.text: Add a modifier to a Tinkers' tool
goals.hint: Tool + modifier item in the Tool Station: redstone = Haste, lapis = Luck, quartz = Sharpness.
goals.why: Modifiers add speed, damage, Fortune and more. Tools start with free slots; Tool Leveling adds one per level.
goals.tip: Each tool level gives another slot. Tick this goal after applying a modifier.
steps: Check the tool's tooltip for free modifier slots.
Put the tool and the modifier items in the Tool Station: redstone = Haste, lapis = Luck, quartz = Sharpness, diamond or emerald = durability, obsidian Reinforcement = Reinforced.
Take the tool and check the modifier in its tooltip.

goals.text: Build a Tinkers' Sledge Hammer for mining three-by-three
goals.hint: A Sledge Hammer mines 3x3 per swing.
goals.why: Fast rooms, tunnels and quarries.
steps: Craft a Tool Forge: seared bricks, the Tool Station and metal blocks.
Make the large parts: hammer head, tough tool rod, two large plates.
Assemble the hammer in the Tool Forge (large tools need the forge).

obtain.tconstruct:hammer: Tinker tools are assembled at a Tool Station from parts; the tool is not a fixed recipe.

goals.hint: Pig Iron is a smeltery alloy; the Alloy tab in JEI shows what to melt together.
goals.why: A cheap tool metal a step above iron.
steps: Melt the inputs in a smeltery.
Pour the metal into an ingot cast.

goals.hint: Melt copper and aluminum together in the smeltery; the alloy forms in the tank.
goals.why: A building and tool metal that needs only copper and aluminum.
steps: Melt copper and aluminum into the same smeltery.
Pour the result into an ingot cast.

goals.text: Prepare a farming space for several crops
goals.hint: Hydrated farmland, light and fences keep a farm growing day and night.
goals.why: Many mods need different crops; one big farm keeps them all stocked.
steps: Till soil around water (one water block hydrates a 9x9 square).
Light it so crops grow at night.

goals.text: Make Fertilized Farmland with Hatchery manure
goals.hint: 8 chicken manure around dirt = Fertilized Dirt; hoe it into Fertilized Farmland.
goals.why: Fertilized dirt and farmland bonemeal crops and saplings on them at random: faster fields and tree farms.
steps: Collect chicken manure: chickens drop it over time; Nesting Pens collect it.
Craft Fertilized Dirt: 8 manure around a dirt block.
Hoe it into farmland and plant, or grow saplings on the dirt.

goals.hint: 4 iron bars, 4 slime balls and a water bucket: B S B / S W S / B S B.
goals.why: The block that keeps nearby farmland wet.
steps: Craft 4 slime balls, 4 iron bars and a water bucket in the ring pattern.

goals.hint: HydroGel hydrates nearby farmland like water.
goals.why: No water holes in your field.
steps: Place it where the water would go.

goals.text: Collect Inferium Essence from Inferium Ore or mobs
goals.hint: Mine Inferium Ore underground or kill mobs for Inferium Essence.
goals.why: Mystical Agriculture grows resources (iron, gold, diamonds) as crops; Inferium essence is its base currency.
steps: Mine Inferium Ore (stone with green flecks).
Kill mobs: they sometimes drop essence.

goals.text: Craft an Inferium Seed and start an Inferium Essence farm
goals.hint: Plant Inferium seeds; the essence they give upgrades into better essence.
goals.why: Better essence makes the resource seeds.
goals.tip: Upgrade with an Infusion Crystal, not a prosperity shard. JEI shows the recipes and crystal durability.
steps: Plant them on farmland and harvest the essence.
4 Inferium Essence + an Infusion Crystal = Prudentium Essence; later tiers work the same way.

goals.hint: 4 inferium essence, 4 prosperity shards and a diamond: I S I / S D S / I S I.
goals.why: The crystal is the base of every higher essence.
steps: Smelt prosperity ore into prosperity shards.
Craft the crystal in a 3x3: essence in the corners, shards on the sides, a diamond in the middle.

goals.hint: 4 Inferium Essence around an Infusion Crystal.
goals.why: Tier 2 essence for tier 2 seeds and gear.
steps: Craft essence on the four sides of a crystal.

goals.hint: A Recipe Book between 2 crafting tables and 2 diamonds.
goals.why: The Cooking Table needs it as its center piece.
steps: Crafting Book: 2 Crafting Tables + 2 Diamonds + Recipe Book

goals.hint: A milk bucket in the center of 7 glass and a plank.
goals.why: A refillable milk supply for baking recipes.
steps: Milk Jar: 7 glass + planks (any wood) + Milk Bucket

goals.text: Capture a Cow in a Jar
goals.hint: Lead a cow onto a Milk Jar and drop an anvil on it: endless milk.
goals.why: Endless milk for cakes, cooking and curing potion effects.
steps: Lead a cow onto it (hold wheat).
Drop an anvil on the cow: it shrinks into the jar.

obtain.cookingforblockheads:cow_jar: Not crafted: lead a cow onto a Milk Jar and drop an anvil on it.

goals.text: Make a grass field away from your base for spawning animals
goals.hint: Animals spawn on lit grass: fence a large field.
goals.why: Animals to breed without hunting for them.
steps: Fence a lit grass field with open sky, in a biome where animals spawn.
Stay at a distance while the area is loaded (spawning also depends on mob caps).
No animals? Lead existing ones home and breed them.

goals.hint: Spawns in the Overworld in flocks of 3-5.
goals.why: Lays 1 bone meal; drops 1 bone when killed. Parent of Ghast Tear Chicken, Gray Chicken, Iron Chicken, Light Blue Chicken and more.
steps: Look for a Bone White Chicken in grassy Overworld biomes.
Lead the Bone White Chicken home with wheat seeds.

goals.hint: Spawns in the Overworld in flocks of 3-5. Or craft its spawn egg: 8 flint around an egg.
goals.why: Lays 1 flint; drops 1 flint when killed. Parent of Aluminium Chicken, Coal Chicken, Gunpowder Chicken, Iron Chicken.
steps: Look for a Flint Chicken in grassy Overworld biomes.
Lead the Flint Chicken home with wheat seeds.
Shortcut: 8 flint around an egg makes its spawn egg.

goals.hint: Spawns in the Overworld in flocks of 3-5. Or craft its spawn egg: 8 logs around an egg.
goals.why: Lays 1 oak log; drops 1 oak log when killed. Parent of Coal Chicken, Snowball Chicken, String Chicken.
steps: Look for a Log Chicken in grassy Overworld biomes.
Lead the Log Chicken home with wheat seeds.
Shortcut: 8 logs around an egg makes its spawn egg.

goals.hint: Spawns in the Overworld in flocks of 3-5. Or craft its spawn egg: 8 sand around an egg.
goals.why: Lays 1 sand; drops 1 sand when killed. Parent of Clay Chicken, Cyanite Chicken, Gunpowder Chicken, Redstone Chicken and more.
steps: Look for a Sand Chicken in grassy Overworld biomes.
Lead the Sand Chicken home with wheat seeds.
Shortcut: 8 sand around an egg makes its spawn egg.

goals.hint: 8 dyes of one color around an Egg (cocoa beans work for brown).
goals.why: Thrown, a Colored Egg can hatch the chicken of its color: all 16 dye chickens.
steps: Put an egg in the middle and 8 dyes of one color around it.
Throw it: it has a chance to hatch that color of chicken.

goals.text: Analyze your chickens with a Chicken Analyzer
goals.hint: Resource chickens lay ores and materials. Breed two kinds together for new ones and check their stats with the Analyzer.
goals.why: SkyFactory 3 players bred resource chickens for renewable ores long before they had machines.
steps: Craft a Chicken Analyzer (press G on it to see the recipe).
Right-click a chicken with it to see its growth, gain and strength.
Breed your best chickens together; their chicks can be stronger.
Put them in a Henhouse next to collect eggs automatically.

goals.hint: Breed two chickens of the same breed: the chick gets their average stats (weighted by Strength) +1 or +2.
goals.why: Growth makes it lay faster, Gain makes it lay more, Strength passes good stats on. 10 is the maximum.
steps: Analyze your chickens and keep the best pair.
Breed two of the same breed.
Keep the better chick, replace the weaker parent, repeat.

goals.hint: Throw a green Colored Egg (8 green dye around an egg); it has a chance to hatch.
goals.why: Lays 1 green dye; drops 1 green dye when killed. Parent of Cocoa Brown Chicken, Cyan Chicken, Emerald Chicken, Lime Chicken and more.
steps: Craft green Colored Eggs: 8 green dye around an egg.
Throw them until a Cactus Green Chicken hatches.

goals.hint: Throw a black Colored Egg (8 black dye or ink sac around an egg); it has a chance to hatch.
goals.why: Lays 1 ink sac; drops 1 ink sac when killed. Parent of Graphite Chicken, Gray Chicken, String Chicken.
steps: Craft black Colored Eggs: 8 black dye or ink sac around an egg.
Throw them until an Ink Black Chicken hatches.

goals.hint: Throw a blue Colored Egg (8 blue dye or lapis lazuli around an egg); it has a chance to hatch.
goals.why: Lays 1 lapis lazuli; drops 1 lapis lazuli when killed. Parent of Blue Slime Chicken, Cyan Chicken, Light Blue Chicken, Prismarine Shard Chicken and more.
steps: Craft blue Colored Eggs: 8 blue dye or lapis lazuli around an egg.
Throw them until a Lapis Blue Chicken hatches.

goals.hint: Throw a red Colored Egg (8 red dye around an egg); it has a chance to hatch.
goals.why: Lays 1 red dye; drops 1 red dye when killed. Parent of Blood Chicken, Cocoa Brown Chicken, Orange Chicken, Pink Chicken and more.
steps: Craft red Colored Eggs: 8 red dye around an egg.
Throw them until a Red Chicken hatches.

goals.hint: Right-click a vanilla chicken with a book.
goals.why: Lays 1 egg; drops 1 egg when killed.
steps: Find or breed a plain chicken.
Right-click it while holding a book.

goals.hint: Throw a yellow Colored Egg (8 yellow dye around an egg); it has a chance to hatch.
goals.why: Lays 1 yellow dye; drops 1 yellow dye when killed. Parent of Copper Chicken, Glowstone Chicken, Gold Chicken, Orange Chicken.
steps: Craft yellow Colored Eggs: 8 yellow dye around an egg.
Throw them until a Yellow Chicken hatches.

goals.hint: Parents: Flint Chicken + Log Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 coal; drops 1 coal when killed. Parent of Graphite Chicken, Lava Chicken.
steps: Pen a Flint Chicken and a Log Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Coal Chicken; keep trying.

goals.text: Breed or hatch a Cocoa Brown Chicken
goals.hint: Parents: Red Chicken + Cactus Green Chicken, or throw a brown Colored Egg (8 brown dye or cocoa beans around an egg).
goals.why: Lays 1 cocoa beans; drops 1 cocoa beans when killed. Parent of Copper Chicken, Leather Chicken, Nether Wart Chicken.
steps: Pen a Red Chicken and a Cactus Green Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
Or craft brown Colored Eggs (8 brown dye or cocoa beans around an egg) and throw them.

goals.text: Breed or hatch a Cyan Chicken
goals.hint: Parents: Lapis Blue Chicken + Cactus Green Chicken, or throw a cyan Colored Egg (8 cyan dye around an egg).
goals.why: Lays 1 cyan dye; drops 1 cyan dye when killed.
steps: Pen a Lapis Blue Chicken and a Cactus Green Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
Or craft cyan Colored Eggs (8 cyan dye around an egg) and throw them.

goals.text: Breed or hatch a Gray Chicken
goals.hint: Parents: Ink Black Chicken + Bone White Chicken, or throw a gray Colored Egg (8 gray dye around an egg).
goals.why: Lays 1 gray dye; drops 1 gray dye when killed. Parent of Light Gray Chicken.
steps: Pen an Ink Black Chicken and a Bone White Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
Or craft gray Colored Eggs (8 gray dye around an egg) and throw them.

goals.hint: Parents: Sand Chicken + Flint Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 gunpowder; drops 1 gunpowder when killed. Parent of Bullet Chicken, Sulfur Chicken, Water Chicken.
steps: Pen a Sand Chicken and a Flint Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Gunpowder Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Flint Chicken + Bone White Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 iron ingot; drops 1 iron ingot when killed. Parent of Conductive Iron Chicken, Dark Steel Chicken, Electrical Steel Chicken, Gold Chicken and more.
steps: Pen a Flint Chicken and a Bone White Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or an Iron Chicken; keep trying.

goals.text: Breed or hatch a Light Blue Chicken
goals.hint: Parents: Bone White Chicken + Lapis Blue Chicken, or throw a light blue Colored Egg (8 light blue dye around an egg).
goals.why: Lays 1 light blue dye; drops 1 light blue dye when killed.
steps: Pen a Bone White Chicken and a Lapis Blue Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
Or craft light blue Colored Eggs (8 light blue dye around an egg) and throw them.

goals.text: Breed or hatch a Lime Chicken
goals.hint: Parents: Cactus Green Chicken + Bone White Chicken, or throw a lime Colored Egg (8 lime dye around an egg).
goals.why: Lays 1 lime dye; drops 1 lime dye when killed.
steps: Pen a Cactus Green Chicken and a Bone White Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
Or craft lime Colored Eggs (8 lime dye around an egg) and throw them.

goals.hint: Parents: Bone White Chicken + Cactus Green Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 ingot nickel; drops 1 ingot nickel when killed. Parent of Constantan Chicken.
steps: Pen a Bone White Chicken and a Cactus Green Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Nickel Chicken; keep trying.

goals.text: Breed or hatch an Orange Chicken
goals.hint: Parents: Red Chicken + Yellow Chicken, or throw an orange Colored Egg (8 orange dye around an egg).
goals.why: Lays 1 orange dye; drops 1 orange dye when killed.
steps: Pen a Red Chicken and a Yellow Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
Or craft orange Colored Eggs (8 orange dye around an egg) and throw them.

goals.text: Breed or hatch a Pink Chicken
goals.hint: Parents: Red Chicken + Bone White Chicken, or throw a pink Colored Egg (8 pink dye around an egg).
goals.why: Lays 1 pink dye; drops 1 pink dye when killed. Parent of Magenta Chicken.
steps: Pen a Red Chicken and a Bone White Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
Or craft pink Colored Eggs (8 pink dye around an egg) and throw them.

goals.text: Breed or hatch a Purple Chicken
goals.hint: Parents: Lapis Blue Chicken + Red Chicken, or throw a purple Colored Egg (8 purple dye around an egg).
goals.why: Lays 1 purple dye; drops 1 purple dye when killed. Parent of Magenta Chicken.
steps: Pen a Lapis Blue Chicken and a Red Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
Or craft purple Colored Eggs (8 purple dye around an egg) and throw them.

goals.hint: Parents: Red Chicken + Sand Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 redstone; drops 1 redstone when killed. Parent of Conductive Iron Chicken, Glass Chicken, Redstone Alloy Chicken, Uranium Chicken.
steps: Pen a Red Chicken and a Sand Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Redstone Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Lapis Blue Chicken + Log Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 snowball; drops 1 snowball when killed. Parent of Clay Chicken, Water Chicken.
steps: Pen a Lapis Blue Chicken and a Log Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Snowball Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Ink Black Chicken + Log Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 string; drops 1 spider eye when killed. Parent of Leather Chicken.
steps: Pen an Ink Black Chicken and a Log Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a String Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Snowball Chicken + Sand Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 clay ball; drops 1 clay ball when killed. Parent of Silicon Chicken, Slime Chicken.
steps: Pen a Snowball Chicken and a Sand Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Clay Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Yellow Chicken + Cocoa Brown Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 copper ingot; drops 1 copper ingot when killed. Parent of Constantan Chicken.
steps: Pen a Yellow Chicken and a Cocoa Brown Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Copper Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Iron Chicken + Yellow Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 gold ingot; drops 1 gold ingot when killed. Parent of Blaze Rod Chicken, Diamond Chicken, Electrum Chicken, Energetic Alloy Chicken and more.
steps: Pen an Iron Chicken and a Yellow Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Gold Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Coal Chicken + Ink Black Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 graphite ingot; drops 1 graphite ingot when killed.
steps: Pen a Coal Chicken and an Ink Black Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Graphite Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: String Chicken + Cocoa Brown Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 leather; drops 1 leather when killed.
steps: Pen a String Chicken and a Cocoa Brown Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Leather Chicken; keep trying.

goals.text: Breed or hatch a Light Gray Chicken
goals.hint: Parents: Gray Chicken + Bone White Chicken, or throw a light gray Colored Egg (8 light gray dye around an egg).
goals.why: Lays 1 light gray dye; drops 1 light gray dye when killed.
steps: Pen a Gray Chicken and a Bone White Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
Or craft light gray Colored Eggs (8 light gray dye around an egg) and throw them.

goals.text: Breed or hatch a Magenta Chicken
goals.hint: Parents: Purple Chicken + Pink Chicken, or throw a magenta Colored Egg (8 magenta dye around an egg).
goals.why: Lays 1 magenta dye; drops 1 magenta dye when killed.
steps: Pen a Purple Chicken and a Pink Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
Or craft magenta Colored Eggs (8 magenta dye around an egg) and throw them.

goals.hint: Parents: Gunpowder Chicken + Snowball Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 liquid egg; drops 1 liquid egg when killed. Parent of Blutonium Chicken, Obsidian Chicken, Prismarine Crystal Chicken, Prismarine Shard Chicken.
steps: Pen a Gunpowder Chicken and a Snowball Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Water Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Water Chicken + Lapis Blue Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 prismarine shard; drops 1 prismarine shard when killed.
steps: Pen a Water Chicken and a Lapis Blue Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Prismarine Shard Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Clay Chicken + Cactus Green Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 slime ball; drops 1 slime ball when killed. Parent of Blood Chicken, Blue Slime Chicken, Magma Cream Chicken, Magma Slime Chicken.
steps: Pen a Clay Chicken and a Cactus Green Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Slime Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Slime Chicken + Red Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 blood slime ball; drops 1 blood slime ball when killed. Parent of Purple Slime Chicken.
steps: Pen a Slime Chicken and a Red Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Blood Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Slime Chicken + Lapis Blue Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 sky slime ball; drops 1 sky slime ball when killed.
steps: Pen a Slime Chicken and a Lapis Blue Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Blue Slime Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Blood Chicken + Lapis Blue Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 ender slime ball; drops 1 ender slime ball when killed.
steps: Pen a Blood Chicken and a Lapis Blue Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Purple Slime Chicken; keep trying.

goals.text: Collect eggs automatically with a Chickens Henhouse
goals.hint: Resource chickens lay items; a Henhouse with hay collects what chickens within 5 blocks lay.
goals.why: Chickens lay iron, gold, redstone, diamonds and more: renewable resources with no work.
steps: Breed two parent chickens for a new kind (JEI Breeding shows every pair). Throw colored eggs for dye chickens.
Craft a Henhouse (planks around a hay bale) and put hay bales in its top slot.
Chickens within 5 blocks lay into it; each hay bale lasts 100 items. Pull items out below with a hopper or pipe.
An Analyzer (egg + compass) shows growth, gain and strength: breed the best together.

goals.text: Build a chicken farm that fills a chest
goals.hint: Chickens within 5 blocks put what they lay into the nearest Henhouse with room; a hopper under it empties it.
goals.why: Every breed becomes a resource line: iron, gold, slime, alloys, all into storage without you.
steps: Craft a Henhouse: 8 planks around a hay bale (each wood gives its own look).
Put hay bales in it: each bale lets it take 100 items.
Keep the chickens within 5 blocks of it (a fenced pen or 1x1 cells).
Put a hopper under it into a chest or a Storage Drawer.
Add a Henhouse per 4-6 chickens; each chicken fills the nearest one first.

goals.hint: 6 iron ingots + a diamond sword + a redstone block.
goals.why: Shreds feathers into fiber and meal.
steps: Craft the shredder (I I / IDI / IRI).

goals.hint: 3 gold nuggets over 5 plastic and a green dye.
goals.why: Needed by the Chicken Machine.

goals.text: Hatch eggs in a Hatchery Nest and make a Lucky Egg
goals.hint: A Nest hatches eggs; the Lucky Egg Machine turns 24 eggs and 2 plastic into a Lucky Egg with a random prize.
goals.why: Nesting Pens collect eggs, feathers and manure; the Nest hatches eggs; Lucky Eggs roll a random prize.
steps: Craft a Nest (hay bales) and right-click it with an egg. A mob sitting on it or a powered block above speeds it up.
Put a chicken in a Nesting Pen with an Animal Net: it collects eggs, feathers and manure.
Craft the Lucky Egg Machine (planks, egg, iron blocks, circuit board), power it (40 RF/t) and feed it 24 eggs and 2 plastic.

goals.hint: A Nest ringed by 7 planks.
goals.why: The pen keeps hens next to a nest.
steps: Craft a Nest: 3 hay bales in two rows.
Surround it with 7 planks in the pen pattern.

goals.hint: 5 iron ingots, a piston and 3 wooden slabs: III / IPI / SSS.
goals.why: Hatches the eggs of a nest.
steps: Craft 5 iron ingots, 1 piston and 3 wooden slabs.

goals.hint: An iron ingot over an iron block with 5 wooden slabs: _I_ / SBS / SSS.
goals.why: Feeds the animals in range.

goals.hint: One Corn Cob in the grid gives 2 Kernels.
goals.why: Kernels pop into Popcorn.
steps: Grow corn and pick the cobs.
Put 1 cob in the crafting grid.

goals.hint: Plant kernels (from grass), harvest the cobs and cook them into roasted corn, popcorn or chowder.
goals.why: Another food crop used in many recipes.
steps: Break tall grass for corn kernels.
Plant them on farmland; corn grows two blocks tall.
Harvest the cobs and cook them.

obtain.sf3extras:corn_cob: Harvest grown corn. Plant kernels, which drop from tall grass.

goals.hint: Smelt or smoke a Corn Cob.
goals.why: A cooked food you can eat straight from the furnace.
steps: Put a Corn Cob in a furnace or smoker.

goals.hint: Bowl + milk bucket + 2 corn cobs: shapeless.
goals.why: A soup that fills more hunger than plain corn.
steps: Put a bowl, a milk bucket and 2 corn cobs in the grid.

goals.hint: Bowl + milk bucket + corn cob + cooked chicken: shapeless.
goals.why: A stronger soup that adds chicken to the corn.
steps: Put a bowl, a milk bucket, a corn cob and cooked chicken in the grid.

goals.hint: Paper + gunpowder + popcorn: shapeless, gives 3 Firework Rockets.
goals.why: A cheap way to make rockets.
steps: Put paper, gunpowder and popcorn in the grid.

goals.hint: The Cooking Table lists every meal you can make from connected counters, fridges and jars.
goals.why: Shows what your stored ingredients can make and crafts it in one click.
steps: Place counters, a fridge and cabinets touching it; it reads their contents.

goals.hint: A black terracotta over a chest makes a Counter.
goals.why: Counter storage joins the kitchen network.

goals.hint: 3 wooden slabs over 2 iron nuggets.
goals.why: Hangs kitchen tools next to the counters.
steps: Tool Rack: 3 wooden slabs (any wood) + 2 iron nuggets

goals.hint: A Recipe Book crafts into the unfiltered book.
goals.why: Shows every recipe with no ingredient filter.

goals.text: Build a dark mob-spawning room away from your base
goals.hint: Mobs spawn in the dark: funnel them into one kill spot.
goals.why: Bones, string, gunpowder, ender pearls and XP on tap.
steps: Build an enclosed dark room (light 0) at least 24 blocks from where you stand.
Push mobs into one corner with water streams.
Drop them 22 blocks (or into a kill chamber) so one hit kills them.

goals.text: Move and damage mobs with Dark Utilities plates
goals.hint: Vector plates push mobs; damage plates hurt them; filters choose which mobs.
goals.why: Move mobs without water and kill them while you're away.
steps: Craft vector plates and damage plates.
Steer mobs with vector plates; put damage plates at the kill spot.

goals.hint: Craft the charm and carry it.
goals.why: A charm that works while it is in your inventory.

goals.hint: Filters set which mobs a plate affects.
goals.why: Plates and hoppers can then target only animals, pets, undead and more.
steps: Put it in a plate or hopper.

goals.hint: 4 stones around 4 fence gates and a golden pickaxe.
goals.why: Filters let plates affect only chosen targets.
steps: Craft the filter (S G S / G P G / S G S).

goals.hint: An unstable or ender pearl over a hopper between 2 obsidian: _P_ / OHO.
goals.why: Collects drops from a distance without a hopper chain.

goals.text: Build an underground workshop connected to your home
goals.hint: Dig a lit, enclosed workshop next to or under your home.
goals.why: Later ages add many machines; keep mobs and creepers away from them.
goals.tip: Light stops normal spawns; spawners and some modded mobs ignore light.
steps: Dig a room under or beside your home with space for machines and cables.
Light the floor, seal the entrances and keep dangerous machines apart.
Connect it to your home with stairs or an elevator.

goals.hint: Stand on an elevator and jump to go up, sneak to go down.
goals.why: Instant travel between floors or down a mine shaft, no ladders or water.
steps: Craft two elevators (dye them any color).
Place them in one column, one per floor, with at least 2 air blocks above each.
Stand on one: jump to go up, sneak to go down.

goals.hint: 8 dyes around a white Elevator recolor it.
goals.why: Color-coded elevators let you pick which floor stop to ride to.
steps: Craft a white Elevator from 8 white wool and 1 ender pearl.
Surround it with 8 dyes of one color.

goals.text: Obtain Andesite Alloy for your first Create components
goals.hint: 2 andesite + 2 iron nuggets in a square = andesite alloy (or mix them in a Mechanical Mixer).
goals.why: Create is the pack's mechanical tech; andesite alloy makes shafts, cogwheels, casings, belts and most early machines.
goals.tip: Hold W over any Create item for a Ponder scene that shows how it works.
steps: Mine andesite (gray stone in caves and mountains).
Craft 2 andesite + 2 iron nuggets in a square, or mix them in a Mechanical Mixer.

goals.text: Make Shafts and Cogwheels to carry rotation
goals.hint: Shafts and cogwheels carry rotation to Create machines.
goals.why: Create machines run on rotation from a source.
steps: Craft shafts (andesite alloy) and cogwheels (shaft + planks).
Shafts connect end to end; cogwheels connect side by side and change direction.

goals.text: Build a Create water-wheel workshop and connect a machine to it
goals.hint: Flowing water over a water wheel makes rotation.
goals.why: Free, endless rotation for your first Create machines.
steps: Put it on a shaft with flowing water running over it (side or top).
Run shafts and cogwheels to a machine. More wheels add their stress capacity.

goals.hint: Right-click a stripped log with Andesite Alloy; apply the same way to shafts and cogwheels.
goals.why: Casing is the shell of the Press, Mixer, Fan and every later machine.
steps: Strip a log with an axe.
Right-click the log with Andesite Alloy.
Keep a few casings in your hotbar and apply them as you build.

goals.text: Use a Mechanical Press to make a metal sheet
goals.hint: An ingot on a depot under a turning press becomes a sheet.
goals.why: Many Create recipes need iron, copper and gold sheets. Over a basin, the press compacts items.
steps: Craft the press and a depot.
Put the press 2 blocks above the depot and give it rotation.
Drop an ingot on the depot.

goals.text: Connect two Shafts with a Mechanical Belt
goals.hint: Use a belt connector on two shafts; belts carry items and rotation.
goals.why: Belts move items between machines: the backbone of every Create line.
steps: Right-click one shaft, then another in line (up to 20 blocks apart).

goals.hint: 1 Cogwheel + 1 Andesite Casing + 1 Stone.
goals.why: Doubles raw ore into dust and grinds crops, the first ore multiplier before the Crushing Wheel.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Cogwheel; Middle row: Andesite Casing; Bottom row: Stone.
Power it with a shaft and drop items on top or feed it by belt.

goals.text: Wash gravel or crushed ore with an Encased Fan and water
goals.hint: A fan blowing through water washes items: gravel gives iron nuggets and flint.
goals.why: Crushed ore washes into extra nuggets; gravel into flint and iron nuggets (cheap renewable iron).
steps: Craft an encased fan and give it rotation.
Put water in front of it (flowing works).
Drop gravel or crushed ore into the air stream past the water.

goals.hint: 5 Andesite Alloy.
goals.why: Holds the items and fluids that Mixers and Presses work on, so recipes can run unattended.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Andesite Alloy | empty | Andesite Alloy; Bottom row: Andesite Alloy | Andesite Alloy | Andesite Alloy.
Place it under a Mechanical Mixer or Press and feed it by hand or belt.

goals.text: Combine ingredients with a Mechanical Mixer
goals.hint: A mixer above a basin combines items and fluids.
goals.why: Makes alloys, dough, chocolate and later brass.
steps: Place a basin, the mixer 2 blocks above it, and power the mixer.
Put ingredients in the basin; take outputs from it (or with a funnel).

goals.hint: 3 Andesite Alloy + 1 Iron Ingot + 1 Andesite Casing.
goals.why: Breaks blocks in front of it, so a stone or ore face mines itself.
steps: Gather 3 Andesite Alloy, 1 Iron Ingot, 1 Andesite Casing.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Andesite Alloy | empty; Middle row: Andesite Alloy | Iron Ingot | Andesite Alloy; Bottom row: empty | Andesite Casing | empty.
Power it and point it at stone; collect drops with a chute or belt.

goals.hint: 3 Iron Sheet + 1 Iron Ingot + 1 Andesite Casing.
goals.why: Cuts logs into planks and fells trees, an automatic wood supply for the base.
steps: Gather 3 Iron Sheet, 1 Iron Ingot, 1 Andesite Casing.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Iron Sheet | empty; Middle row: Iron Sheet | Iron Ingot | Iron Sheet; Bottom row: empty | Andesite Casing | empty.
Power it next to a tree or lay logs on a belt past the blade.

goals.hint: 1 Andesite Alloy + 1 Andesite Casing.
goals.why: Holds one item in place so a Deployer, Press or Spout can work on it.
steps: Combine them in the crafting grid to get Depot.
Put it at the end of a belt or beside a Deployer.

goals.hint: Right-click a Shaft or Cogwheel with Andesite Casing.
goals.why: Hides shafts and cogwheels inside walls so rotation can pass through a wall or floor.
steps: Right-click a placed Shaft, Cogwheel or Large Cogwheel.
Encase every shaft that crosses a wall of your workshop.

goals.hint: 1 Cogwheel + 2 Gold Sheet + 1 Wooden Chest + 1 Leather.
goals.why: Carries a bag of tools that opens with a key press near the box.
steps: Gather 1 Cogwheel, 2 Gold Sheet, 1 Wooden Chest, 1 Leather.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Cogwheel | empty; Middle row: Gold Sheet | Wooden Chest | Gold Sheet; Bottom row: empty | Leather | empty.
Dye it with any dye for the other 15 colors.

goals.hint: Copper Sheet, wooden Barrel, Copper Sheet in a column; tanks stack into one bigger tank.
goals.why: Stores fluids, and stacked tanks become the water tank of a steam boiler.
steps: Stack tanks to raise the capacity, then pipe into one.

goals.text: Automate a useful material with Create machinery
goals.hint: Build a Create line for a material you keep running out of.
goals.why: Teaches belts, funnels and machines, and saves hours later.
steps: Pick a target: iron sheets, cobblestone (mechanical drill on a cobble generator), gravel, bread.
Feed inputs with funnels or a mechanical arm; send outputs to a chest.

goals.hint: Cardboard Packages are made by a Packager and hold a stack of items.
goals.why: Cardboard Packages bundle stacks for the Create logistics network and for delivery by Postbox.
steps: Feed a Packager with items and an address to see packages come out.

goals.text: Run Fluid Pipes with a Mechanical Pump
goals.hint: Fluid Pipe: 2 Copper Sheets around a Copper Ingot; Mechanical Pump: Cogwheel + Fluid Pipe.
goals.why: Moves water, lava and honey between tanks, Spouts and Basins without buckets.
steps: Craft Fluid Pipes (2 Copper Sheets + 1 Copper Ingot make 4).
Craft a Mechanical Pump and power it with a shaft.
Pipe from a source to a Fluid Tank, Spout or Basin.

goals.hint: 1 Copper Casing + 1 Dried Kelp.
goals.why: Fills items and Basins with fluid, so buckets, bottles and honey for glue run without hands.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Copper Casing; Bottom row: Dried Kelp.
Place it above a Basin or Depot and feed it by pipe.

goals.hint: 1 Copper Casing + 1 Dried Kelp Block + 1 Copper Sheet.
goals.why: Pumps a whole pool of fluid or fills a pit with it from one block.
steps: Gather 1 Copper Casing, 1 Dried Kelp Block, 1 Copper Sheet.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Copper Casing; Middle row: Dried Kelp Block; Bottom row: Copper Sheet.
Hang it over water or lava and connect a pipe to it.

goals.text: Decorate with Create stone, glass and copper
goals.hint: Stonecut andesite and the other natural stones into cut, polished and brick sets.
goals.why: Windows, pillars and copper tiles for finished builds.
steps: Craft or stonecut cut stone blocks.
Craft windows and copper tiles from their recipes.
Wax copper blocks with honeycomb to stop them weathering.

goals.text: Capture a structure with a Capsule
goals.hint: A Capsule packs a build into an item and unpacks it anywhere.
goals.why: Move a base or outpost in one go. Higher tiers need steel and vibrant alloy.
steps: Use it on the block you want to capture.

goals.text: Place Redstone Paste on a wall or ceiling
goals.hint: Redstone Paste sticks to walls and ceilings where dust cannot.
goals.why: Run signals up walls and across ceilings, which dust can't. Circuits stay small and hidden.
steps: Right-click the side of a block or a ceiling: the paste sticks there.
It connects like dust to neighbors on the same face.

goals.text: Power a redstone device through a Redstone Paste connection
goals.hint: Run paste up a wall to a lamp or door.
goals.why: Tests wall wiring: a lever at the floor lights a lamp near the ceiling.
steps: Place a lever at the bottom of a wall.
Run paste from the lever up the wall to a redstone lamp.
Flip the lever: the lamp lights up.

goals.hint: Craft a repeater with a slime ball, then place it on any face.
goals.why: A repeater that holds on a wall or ceiling, so delay lines can run up and over.
steps: Craft a Sticky Repeater: repeater + slime ball.
Place it against a wall or ceiling.

goals.hint: Craft a comparator with a slime ball, then place it on any face.
goals.why: A comparator that holds on a wall or ceiling, for container readouts out of the floor plane.
steps: Craft a Sticky Comparator: comparator + slime ball.
Place it against a wall or ceiling.

goals.hint: A gate outputs at the front and reads its sides: NAND, NOR, XOR, RS latch and more.
goals.why: One small block replaces a redstone-torch contraption.
steps: Place it: front = output; the sides (and back) = inputs.

goals.text: Use a Charset NAND Gate in a powered redstone circuit
goals.hint: Wire two levers into a NAND gate's sides and a lamp to its front.
goals.why: NAND is ON unless both inputs are ON; every other gate can be built from NANDs.
steps: Place the gate; the front is the output.
Wire a lever to each side and a lamp to the front.
Both levers on: the lamp turns off. Any other combination keeps it on.

goals.text: Rotate a Charset Gate with the Charset Wrench
goals.hint: The wrench rotates any block with a facing.
goals.why: Fixes a gate or machine placed the wrong way without breaking it and losing its settings.
steps: Right-click the gate or machine to turn it.

goals.text: Craft XOR, NOR, Pulse Former and Multiplexer
goals.hint: Craft the four gates beside the NAND gate.
goals.why: With NAND, XOR and NOR gates plus a Pulse Former and a Multiplexer, circuits fit in a few wall tiles.
steps: Craft a Charset XOR Gate: 3 redstone dusts + 3 cobblestones + 2 stone slabs.
Craft a Charset NOR Gate: 7 stone slabs + redstone torch + cobblestone.
Craft a Charset Pulse Former Gate: 5 redstone dusts + 3 cobblestones + stone slab.
Craft a Charset Multiplexer Gate: 4 redstone dusts + 4 cobblestones + stone slab.

goals.hint: Craft a lock from 3 iron ingots, 3 chains and redstone dust.
goals.why: A lock fits a barrel; only the matching Charset Key opens it.
steps: Craft a Charset Lock: 3 iron ingots + 3 chains + redstone dust.
Pair a Charset Key with the barrel.

goals.text: Store items in a Simple Barrel
goals.hint: A wooden barrel holds lots of one item.
goals.why: Cheap bulk storage for seeds, cobblestone or dirt.
steps: Right-click with an item to store it; left-click takes a stack.

goals.hint: Comparator upgrade: 4 sticks + 1 comparator; the compressor marks use a piston.
goals.why: The upgrades give a Simple Barrel more abilities.
steps: Craft 4 sticks + 1 comparator for the comparator upgrade.
The Mark 1 compressor is 4 sticks + 1 piston.

goals.why: Collect the mark 5 compressor upgrade as you unlock them.
Collect the mark 2 to 4 compressor upgrades as you unlock them.

goals.text: Upgrade a drawer with a Storage Upgrade
goals.hint: Storage upgrades multiply a drawer's capacity.
goals.why: With upgrades one drawer holds thousands of items: a small wall stores a whole mine.
steps: Craft a storage upgrade (obsidian first, then iron, gold, diamond, emerald).
Open the drawer (sneak-right-click with an empty hand) and put the upgrade in an upgrade slot.

goals.hint: Status Upgrade 1: 2 redstone torchs + 4 sticks + 1 upgrade template + 2 redstone; upgrade 2 swaps the torches for comparators.
goals.why: Drawers can then show how full they are.
steps: Craft Status Upgrade 1 from 2 redstone torches + 4 sticks + 2 redstone + 1 template.
Put it in the drawer upgrade slot.

goals.why: Collect the redstone, one-stack and void upgrades as you unlock them.

goals.hint: 1 gold nugget + 2 gold ingots + 1 upgrade template.
goals.why: Locks drawers and controllers to what they hold.
steps: Craft the key from 2 gold ingots + 1 gold nugget + 1 template.
Use it on a drawer or controller to change its lock.

goals.why: Collect the quantify and shroud keys as you unlock them.

goals.hint: 5 stones + 2 comparators + 1 basic drawers + 1 gold ingot.
goals.why: A second access point for a drawer network that spreads out.
steps: Craft it from 5 stones + 2 comparators + 1 basic drawer + 1 gold ingot.
Place it near the far drawers next to the controller range.

goals.text: Pair a Charset Key with a Charset Barrel
goals.hint: Right-click an unlocked barrel with a key to pair them.
goals.why: Keys and locks keep storage private on a shared server.
steps: Right-click an unlocked Charset barrel with it.

goals.text: Lock a Charset Barrel and unlock it with the matching key
goals.hint: Use the paired key to lock and unlock the barrel; a Master Key can bypass its lock.
goals.why: The lock stops normal access; claimed chunks are the real base protection.
goals.tip: A Master Key opens any Charset barrel: the lock is not owner-only security.
steps: Pair a key with the barrel (previous goal).
Lock it with the key and check the barrel won't open.
Unlock it with the same key. Keep a spare key safe.

goals.hint: The Master Key unlocks any locked Charset barrel.
goals.why: Recovers a barrel when the paired key is lost.
goals.tip: It bypasses every lock: keep it safe and rely on claims for protection.
steps: Use it on a locked Charset barrel.

goals.text: Craft and place a Charset Shelf
goals.hint: A shelf shows and stores six item stacks.
goals.why: Books, potions and trophies on display and in storage at once.
steps: Craft a shelf and place it on a wall or floor.
Right-click a slot to put the item in your hand there.

goals.text: Craft, wear and open a Charset Backpack
goals.hint: Right-click to wear it, then press B to open its 27 slots.
goals.why: 27 extra slots on your back.
steps: Right-click to wear it; press B to open it.

goals.hint: 8 gold ingots around an iron chest.
goals.why: More slots than the iron chest.
steps: Craft it from 8 gold ingots + 1 iron chest.
Or use an Iron to Gold Upgrade.

goals.text: Craft a Gold to Diamond Upgrade
goals.hint: 6 legacy glass + 2 legacy diamonds + 1 legacy gold.
goals.why: Turns a gold chest into a diamond chest.
steps: Craft the upgrade from 6 glass blocks + 2 diamonds + 1 gold ingot.
Use it on a gold chest.

goals.text: Upgrade a chest to an Obsidian Chest
goals.hint: Upgrade chests in order: wood -> iron -> gold -> diamond -> obsidian.
goals.why: More space: an obsidian chest holds 108 stacks and resists explosions. Four Obsidian Chests go into the Quantum DSU.
steps: Craft the chest upgrades (wood to iron, iron to gold, gold to diamond, diamond to obsidian).
Right-click a placed chest with the upgrade; the contents stay.

goals.hint: 1 chest wall wood + 1 iron ingot.
goals.why: The core block that turns the shell into one huge chest.
steps: Craft it from 1 wall + 1 iron ingot.
Build a closed box of walls and place the chest on it.

goals.hint: Build a hollow cube of chest walls with a core in one wall; bigger cubes hold more.
goals.why: One giant chest: a 16x16x16 wooden one holds thousands of stacks.
goals.tip: Build a small one first to learn the structure.
steps: Get one Colossal Chest Core and wall blocks for a hollow 16x16x16 shell.
Build all six faces, floor and roof included; leave the inside empty.
Swap one wall block for the Core; add an Interface where automation connects.
Check the Core says the multiblock formed before filling it.

goals.hint: 1 chest wall diamond + 1 iron ingot.
goals.why: A higher tier chest holds more.
steps: Craft diamond walls and the diamond chest (1 wall + 1 iron ingot).
Build the box and place the chest.

goals.why: Collect the obsidian chest wall as you unlock them.

goals.text: Carry a Void Cup to delete junk
goals.hint: Items put in the Void Cup are destroyed.
goals.why: Delete cobblestone, dirt and junk instead of dropping it (dropped items lag the server).
steps: Right-click to open it and put the junk in.

goals.hint: Put blocks in the chisel and pick a design.
goals.why: Hundreds of decorative stone, wood and glass variants.
steps: Right-click to open it, put blocks in and click a design: the whole stack converts.

goals.hint: 5 glass blocks, a redstone dust and 3 iron ingots make the machine.
goals.why: Chisels whole stacks of blocks while you work on something else.
steps: Craft the Auto Chisel: 5 glass blocks, 1 redstone dust, 3 iron ingots.
Put a Chisel and the blocks to convert inside.

goals.text: Carve a block with Chisels & Bits
goals.hint: Left-click a block with a chisel to remove tiny bits; place bits with right-click.
goals.why: Details at 1/16 block: furniture, window frames, trims, statues.
steps: Place a chiselable block and hold a Chisels & Bits tool.
Pick its edit mode (tool tooltip or Controls).
Remove a small region, collect the bits, then place bits to build your design.
Keep bits in a Bit Bag or Bit Drawer.

goals.hint: Wool around a bit makes the bag that stores loose bits.
goals.why: Keeps the bits you chisel off instead of dropping them.
steps: Chisel a block to collect a bit.
Craft the Bit Bag from wool and that bit.

goals.hint: Measures distances between blocks and bits.
goals.why: Lets you plan a carved build to the bit.
steps: Right-click two points to read the distance.

goals.hint: A tank block that stores bits in bulk.
goals.why: Holds far more bits than a bag and feeds large builds.
steps: Place it and fill it with bits.

goals.hint: The Decomposer turns blocks into clay; the Decobench crafts decorations from it.
goals.why: Decocraft adds thousands of furniture and decoration models.
steps: Craft a Decomposer and a Decobench.
Put blocks in the Decomposer: they become decoration clay.
Spend the clay at the Decobench on furniture.

goals.hint: Wool over a Decobench over a stick.
goals.why: Picks up and rotates props you already placed.
steps: Craft the tool: wool, Decobench, stick in a column.
Use it on a placed prop to move it.

goals.text: Hang Fairy Lights between two fences
goals.hint: Right-click a fence with the lights, then another fence.
goals.why: String lights for paths, trees, markets and parties.
steps: Right-click a fence post, walk to another fence and right-click it.
Right-click the string with dyes or lights to change it.

obtain.fairylights:hanging_lights: Craft hanging lights from string, lights and a pattern of dye; JEI shows the pattern.

goals.hint: Iron ingots around a torch, with a glass pane, make the bulb.
goals.why: The bulb that every light string needs.
steps: Craft the light from iron ingots, a torch and a glass pane.

goals.hint: An iron ingot, vines and an iron ingot in a row make 2 garlands.
goals.why: Hangs leafy decoration along the same fence strings.
steps: Craft the garland: iron ingot, vines, iron ingot in a row.

goals.hint: A paper lantern hangs from a string like the other lights.
goals.why: Adds a soft shaded light to a string.
steps: Attach it to a string between two fences.

goals.text: Mix colors with Flat Colored Blocks
goals.hint: The paint mixer makes solid colored blocks.
goals.why: Exact colors for pixel art, signs and modern builds.
steps: Combine dyes and blocks (JEI lists every color).

goals.text: Build ramps and floors with the Platformer
goals.hint: The platformer makes ramps, floors and railings from planks.
goals.why: Wooden ramps, floors and railings for bridges, docks and stairs.
steps: Put planks in, pick a shape (ramp, floor, railing) and take the result.

goals.hint: Iron ingots, iron bars and red dye make the adjusting tool.
goals.why: Rotates and adjusts platforms you already placed.
steps: Craft the Wrench from iron ingots, iron bars and red dye.
Right-click a placed platform with it.

goals.text: Decorate with Reliquia lanterns, candles and sword plinths
goals.hint: Colored iron and gold lanterns, candle holders and sword plinths.
goals.why: Colored lighting, and a plinth to display your best sword.
steps: Craft lanterns, candle holders or plinths.
Right-click a plinth with a sword to display it.

goals.hint: An iron ingot over 2 black stained glass and a torch makes the lantern.
goals.why: A dark hanging light that matches the black-iron candle holders.
steps: Craft the lantern: iron ingot, 2 black stained glass, 1 torch.

goals.text: Fire Porcelain and build with Porcelain Bricks
goals.hint: Smelt unfired porcelain; dye it or make bricks.
goals.why: White or dyed bricks; porcelain also makes buckets and faucets.
steps: Craft porcelain bricks (dye them if you like).

goals.hint: Porcelain bricks in a faucet pattern.
goals.why: Pours from the porcelain and clay barrels.
steps: Craft the faucet from 3 porcelain bricks.

goals.hint: Particle blocks give off fire, smoke, hearts, notes or sparkles.
goals.why: Decoration for fountains, fireplaces, shops and parties.
steps: Right-click it to cycle through the effects.

goals.text: Write a checklist on a Clipboard
goals.hint: A clipboard holds a to-do list you can tick off.
goals.why: Plans and shopping lists in-game.
steps: Right-click to open it and type a list.
Click a line to tick it off.

goals.text: Break glass without Silk Touch and collect Charset Glass Shards
goals.hint: Glass broken without Silk Touch drops shards.
goals.why: The shards craft back into glass.
steps: Break a glass block with your hand or a normal tool.
Pick up the shards that drop.

obtain.sf3extras:charset_glass_shard: Break a glass block without Silk Touch.

goals.text: Craft a Glass Block from three Glass Shards
goals.hint: 3 shards in a row = 1 glass block.
goals.why: Rebuilding windows never loses glass.
steps: Put three glass shards in a row in the crafting grid.

obtain.sf3extras:charset_glass_shard: Break a glass block without Silk Touch.

goals.text: Place a Charset Poster on a wall
goals.hint: Posters hang flat on a wall and show an item or map.
goals.why: Maps, items and art on a wall, without a frame.
steps: Place it on a solid wall and right-click it with an item or a map.

goals.text: Dye a minecart with a dye or Graphite
goals.hint: Right-click a minecart with a dye; the dye is not used up.
goals.why: Color-code minecarts by route.
steps: Place a minecart on a rail.
Right-click it with a dye or graphite; the dye is not used up.

goals.text: Knock back primed TNT without resetting its fuse
goals.hint: Hit lit TNT to push it away; the fuse keeps counting.
goals.why: A Charset tweak: hit lit TNT away from your walls.
steps: Far from your base, light a TNT block.
Hit the primed TNT: it flies away and the fuse keeps counting.

goals.text: Trigger the Zorro boost while falling toward a saddled horse
goals.hint: Fall more than two blocks onto a saddled horse and right-click it.
goals.why: A Charset stunt: land on your horse and it gets a speed boost.
steps: Tame and saddle a horse (saddles come from chests or fishing).
Jump from more than two blocks above it and right-click it while falling.

goals.hint: Craft a minecart with a Charset Barrel.
goals.why: A minecart that carries a whole barrel along a rail line.
steps: Craft a Barrel Cart: minecart + Charset Barrel.
Place it on a rail and load the barrel.

goals.hint: Craft the Lexica (book + sapling): Botania's full manual. Mystical flowers give the petals.
goals.why: Botania is flower magic: mana, automation, tools and the Gaia Guardian boss.
steps: Find mystical flowers (glowing flowers in forests and plains) for petals.
Craft the Lexica from a book and a sapling.

goals.hint: Fill it with water, throw in petals and a seed: a special flower pops out.
goals.why: Every Botania flower, generating or functional, is made here.
steps: Fill it with a water bucket.
Throw in a recipe's petals, then a seed.

goals.hint: Brew a magical flower in the Petal Apothecary and plant it beside a Pool.
goals.why: A generating flower fills your Pool without hand-feeding.
steps: Brew a flower in the Petal Apothecary (see the Lexica Botania)
Plant it within range of a Mana Pool

goals.text: Pure Daisy turns stone to living rock
goals.hint: Petal Apothecary: 4 white petals + a seed; stone in the 8 blocks around it slowly turns into livingrock.
goals.why: Link 1 of 3 of the Orechid: Ore from Stone route; next: Orechid grows ore from stone with mana.

goals.text: Orechid grows ore from stone with mana
goals.hint: Petal Apothecary: 2 gray + yellow + green + red petals, Pride and Greed Runes, Redstone Root and Pixie Dust; plant it by stone near a mana spreader.
goals.why: Link 2 of 3 of the Orechid: Ore from Stone route; next: Feed the ore to Tinkers or Create for rare metals.

goals.text: Create Livingwood and Livingrock with a Pure Daisy
goals.hint: Place logs or stone around a Pure Daisy and wait about a minute.
goals.why: Livingwood and livingrock build mana spreaders, pools and the runic altar.
steps: Make a Pure Daisy in the apothecary (4 white petals + seed).
Place it with logs or stone in the 8 blocks around it.

diagram.title: Pure Daisy
diagram.view: Top view
diagram.note: Any mix of logs and stone works.

obtain.minecraft:oak_log: Chop any tree; every kind of log works.
obtain.minecraft:stone: Smelt cobblestone in a furnace, or mine stone with a Silk Touch pickaxe.
obtain.botania:special_flower: A functional flower is made by putting its petals and a mystical flower into a Petal Apothecary (see the Lexica Botania for the petal colors).
obtain.botania:special_flower|type=puredaisy: A functional flower is made by putting its petals and a mystical flower into a Petal Apothecary (see the Lexica Botania for the petal colors).

goals.hint: Grind herbs in the Roots mortar into petal dust for spells.
goals.why: Petal dust is the spell ingredient of Roots.
goals.tip: Old Root, Verdant Sprig, Infernal Stem and Dragon's Eye drop from tall grass, crops, nether wart and chorus.
steps: Craft the Mortar (stone) and the Pestle.
Right-click the mortar with up to 8 ingredients of a spell (JEI or the Runic Tablet).
Right-click it with the pestle: they become petal dust.

goals.text: Burn incense in a Roots Brazier
goals.hint: A Brazier holds one incense item; light it with flint and steel and it burns for two minutes.
goals.why: Rituals bring rain, speed up crops, heal, repel monsters and more for a few minutes.
steps: Right-click it with the incense a ritual needs (JEI or the Runic Tablet).
Light it with flint and steel: it burns two minutes, long enough for a ritual next to it.

goals.hint: Runestone and its brick, tile and symbol variants.
goals.why: The Altar and other Roots structures are built from runestone.

goals.text: Perform a ritual at the Roots Casting Altar
goals.hint: Three offerings on the altar, burning incense around it, then sneak-right-click the altar with an empty hand.
goals.why: Rituals change weather, heal, grow crops, summon creatures and make Roots items. The Runic Tablet (Roots guide) lists them.
steps: Craft the Casting Altar (verdant sprigs, poppy, rune stones, gold block) and the Runic Tablet.
Pick a ritual (JEI or the tablet): it lists three offerings, the incense and any standing stones.
Put the offerings on the altar, light braziers with the incense, build the standing stones if needed.
Sneak-right-click the altar with an empty hand: the ritual takes 10 seconds.

goals.hint: The Imbuer adds spells to your staff.
goals.why: More spells on the same staff.
steps: Imbuer: Craft: 4 Wooden (any) + 1 Chiseled stone bricks
Runic Tablet: Craft: 1 Old Root + 3 Wheat seeds + 1 Stone

goals.text: Imbue a Roots staff with a spell
goals.hint: Stick + petal dust in the Imbuer = a staff that casts that spell.
goals.why: Spells heal, attack, grow plants and more at range. A staff has limited casts; the Crystal Staff holds several spells.
goals.tip: SkyFactory 3 Roots: no spell library, one spell per staff.
steps: Make a petal dust in the Mortar.
Craft the Imbuer (sticks, chiseled stone bricks); right-click a stick and the dust onto it.
After two seconds take the staff; right-click to cast. Terra (the bar above the hotbar) pays for it.

obtain.roots:staff: Made in the Imbuer: a stick and a petal dust become a one-spell staff.

goals.hint: A Roots tool made from living materials.
goals.why: Roots' answer to early metal tools.
steps: The other living tools are in the Living tools family

goals.hint: Spirit blocks, the Font and the Conduit.
goals.why: The Spirit line of Roots structures.
steps: Spirit Font: Craft: 2 Leaves (any) + 1 Otherworld Leaf + 2 Vine + 2 Runestone Brick
Spirit Conduit: Craft: 1 Otherworld Leaf + 2 Runestone Brick + 2 Runestone Stairs
Otherworld Block: Craft: 4 Otherworld Leaf + 1 Otherworld Essence

goals.text: Explore a Trial Chamber and open an ominous vault
goals.hint: Trial chambers are copper-and-tuff rooms underground; ominous trials give Ominous Keys.
goals.why: Vaults hold enchanted books, diamonds and the Heavy Core for the Mace.
steps: Find one underground (copper and tuff rooms, often next to caves).
Beat the trial spawners for Trial Keys and open vaults.
Drink an Ominous Bottle (from raid captains) to start ominous trials for Ominous Keys.

goals.text: Craft a Mace and learn its falling attack
goals.hint: Heavy Core (ominous vaults) + Breeze Rod = Mace.
goals.why: The farther you fall before hitting, the harder it hits: huge damage on bosses.
steps: Open ominous vaults for a Heavy Core.
Kill Breezes in a trial chamber for Breeze Rods.
Craft the mace and jump onto enemies.

goals.hint: Craft a bundle from string and leather, then dye it any of 16 colors.
goals.why: Carry mixed stacks in one slot.

goals.hint: Pale garden: find it by exploring.
goals.why: Pale oak wood and eyeblossoms.
steps: Collect pale oak logs and leaves.

goals.hint: A Warp Stone (emerald, ender pearls, purple dye) under stone bricks and over obsidian makes a Waystone.
goals.why: Link your base, mines and outposts to every village waystone.
steps: Craft a Warp Stone; on its own it also teleports you to a waystone.
Craft the Waystone, place it at your base and right-click to name it.

goals.hint: 4 purple dye + 4 ender pearls + 1 emerald.
goals.why: The core of every Waystone.
steps: Place the emerald in the middle.
Alternate ender pearls and purple dye around it.

goals.hint: 2 ender pearls + 3 paper + 2 purple dye + 2 gold nuggets: makes 3.
goals.why: Warp to a waystone you pick.
steps: Place pearls, paper, dye and nuggets in the scroll shape.
Use the scroll and choose a waystone.

goals.hint: 3 purple dye + 1 ender pearl + 2 gold nuggets + 3 paper: makes 3.
goals.why: A scroll bound to one waystone.
steps: Place dye, nuggets, pearl and paper in the scroll shape.
Use it at a waystone to bind it.

goals.hint: 1 ender pearl + 2 gold nuggets + 3 paper: makes 3.
goals.why: Return to the last waystone you used.
steps: Place nuggets, pearl and paper in the scroll shape.

goals.hint: Iron bow: the second More Bows bow (gold, diamond and elemental come later).
goals.why: More damage than the stone bow, from plain iron.

goals.hint: Craft: 2 Diamond + 3 Strings + 1 Iron Ingot + 1 Bows.
goals.why: High damage for Age 3 fights.
steps: Craft it from 2 diamonds, 3 string, 1 iron ingot and a bow.

goals.hint: Craft: 2 Iron Bow + 3 Strings + 1 Iron Ingot.
goals.why: Two iron bows combine into one that fires several arrows.
steps: Combine them with 3 string and an iron ingot.

goals.text: Block attacks with an Apple Shield
goals.hint: Shields made from apples; golden and enchanted versions block more and last longer.
goals.why: A cheap shield line to upgrade as you go.
steps: Hold it in your off-hand; right-click to block.
Upgrade to golden or enchanted golden apple shields later.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Apple + 1 Iron Ingot + 2 RF White Apple.
goals.why: A shield built around two RF White Apples.
steps: Craft 4 apples, an iron ingot and 2 RF White Apples.

goals.hint: Craft: Egg + Sugar + Apple + Apple.
goals.why: The pie is the heart of the pie shield.
steps: Craft the pie from egg, sugar and 2 apples.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Apple + 1 Gold Ingot + 2 Golden Apple.
goals.why: Rarer apples make stronger shields.
steps: Craft the golden shield from 2 golden apples.
Use enchanted golden apples for the enchanted version.

goals.hint: Iron and gilded Asgard shields block (right-click) and parry.
goals.why: Sturdier than the vanilla shield; a well-timed block (Parry) knocks attackers back.

goals.hint: Craft: 6 Iron Ingot + 1 Wooden Rod.
goals.why: A heavy two-handed style blade; every shield material has a matching sword.
steps: Craft 6 iron ingots and a stick into the sword.

goals.text: Craft a Blowgun, Darts and a Spear
goals.hint: Craft the tribal ranged weapons before the first boss.
goals.why: Ranged damage for the Foliaath and Wroughtnaut fights.
steps: Dart x8: 1 naga fang + 1 wooden rod + 1 feather.

goals.hint: A giant armored knight behind iron bars underground: hit its back after it swings.
goals.why: Drops the Wrought Axe (huge sweeping axe) and Wrought Helm: strong Age 3 gear.
steps: Find its chamber: a stone room with iron bars in caves or deep mineshafts.
Hit it to wake it. Dodge sideways when it raises its axe.
After a big swing its axe sticks in the ground: get behind it and hit the glowing spot on its back.
Pick up the Wrought Axe and the Wrought Helm.

mobs.where: Sleeps in a stone chamber behind iron bars deep underground. It wakes when you hit it; its weak spot is its back.

locate.label: Ferrous Wroughtnaut (if a hall is near)

goals.hint: Find a Naga near water and defeat it.
goals.why: Nagas drop fangs for darts and the Naga Fang Dagger.

goals.hint: A Naga Fang Dagger is 1 naga fang, 1 iron ingot and 1 stick.
goals.why: A light dagger from the Naga line.
steps: Craft: 1 naga fang + 1 iron ingot + 1 stick.

goals.hint: Find a Grottol in caves and kill it.
goals.why: Grottols have their own advancements for fortune and silk touch kills.
steps: Find a Grottol in a cave.
Kill it with a fortune or silk touch pickaxe.

goals.hint: A carnivorous jungle plant: let it snap, then hit it as it pulls back.
goals.why: Its seed grows a baby Foliaath you can plant as a base guard.
steps: Search jungle undergrowth: it hides among leaves.
Stay just out of reach, let it bite, then hit it.
Plant its seed where you want a guard.

obtain.mowziesmobs:foliaath_seed: Dropped by a Foliaath; plant it to grow a baby Foliaath that guards the spot.

mobs.where: A carnivorous plant hidden in jungle undergrowth. It snaps at anything that walks close; hit it when it pulls back.

goals.hint: Barakoa tribe members wear the masks.
goals.why: Each mask is a different face of the tribe.
steps: Find a Barakoa village (sneaking in disguise has its own advancement).
Defeat the Barakoa and collect their masks.

goals.hint: Painted acacia is 2 painted acacia slabs.
goals.why: A decoration block of the tribe.

goals.hint: Upgrade the base crown with hatred shards and an emerald.
goals.why: The crown is the Skeleton King's stage.
steps: Craft: 7 hatred shards + 1 emerald + the base King's Crown.

goals.hint: Fish's Undead Rising crypts and desert tombs, 1,500 to 4,000 blocks out, hide the Skeleton King.
goals.why: A Ring 1 boss: tests your Age 3 gear before the Nether.
steps: Explore crypts and desert tombs in the middle ring.
Clear the undead around it, then fight the king with a shield and healing food.

mobs.where: Rules the crypts and desert tombs of Fish's Undead Rising, 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn.

goals.hint: Eight bandages need 6 curseweave cloth, 2 string and a potion.
goals.why: Bandages heal and cure effects.
steps: Bandage x8: 6 curseweave cloth + 2 string + a potion (ice for the last tier).

goals.hint: Ghost Swarmers drop the items; ingots unpack from an ectoplasm block.
goals.why: Ingots are the ghostly armor material.
steps: Ectoplasm Block: 9 ingots; 1 block gives 9 ingots back.
Spectral Dagger: 1 ectoplasm ingot + 1 wooden rod.

goals.hint: Bloodtooth, cordy and veil shrooms grow in the mod's worldgen; glow shrooms make cyan dye.
goals.why: Bloodtooth shrooms go into bone stew.

goals.text: Fish for bone trout and lamprey
goals.hint: Fishing loot includes bone trout, cheirolepis, lampreys and mummified cod.
goals.why: Fish for the pan recipes.
steps: Lamprey Kabayaki: 2 wooden rods + a molten or soulforged pan + 1 lamprey.

goals.hint: Vespas drop carapace and stingers for a dagger and shield.
goals.why: A shield and dagger from the wasp mob.
steps: Vespa Dagger: 1 poison stinger + 1 vespa carapace + 1 wooden rod.
Vespa Shield: 6 vespa carapace + 3 poison stingers.

goals.hint: Each piece is chitin plus one weta jaw.
goals.why: Light armor from the first mob drops.

goals.hint: Undead Swine drop the hide; the mask adds glass panes and sharptooth.
goals.why: A disguise set for the swine mobs.
steps: Mask: 2 green glass panes + 4 pigboar hide + 2 sharptooth.

goals.hint: Foul hide and scythe claws make the set; the chest adds an acidic heart and intestine.
goals.why: Heavier armor from the scythe mobs.
steps: Helmet: 4 sharptooth + 3 foul hide + 1 skeleton skull.
Chestplate: 2 scythe claws + 4 foul hide + acidic heart + intestine.

goals.text: Collect parasite, ptera and scarecrow drops
goals.hint: Parasites, jungle Pteras, Scarecrows and Frigids drop these items.
goals.why: Ingredients for later food and relics.
steps: Parasite items: Parasite or cemetery chests.
Frozen Thigh: Frigid or igloo chests.

goals.text: Craft a Scarab or Sludge Wand
goals.hint: Wands use mossy sticks plus amber or sludge.
goals.why: Wands cast the mod's spells.
steps: Scarab Wand: 2 dead bush + 1 ancient amber + 2 mossy sticks.
Sludge Wand: 2 vines + 1 silky sludge + 2 mossy sticks.
Ankh Scepter: combine Midnight Mourne + Ushabti at an anvil.

goals.hint: A halo necklace is 3 cursed fabric, 2 scythe claws and holy sludge.
goals.why: A relic for the sludge line.
steps: Holy Sludge: 1 glowstone dust + 3 sugar + 1 silky sludge.
Necklace: 3 cursed fabric + 2 scythe claws + 1 holy sludge.

goals.hint: Illagers and witches drop it at a 2% chance.
goals.why: Wearing it makes illagers neutral.

goals.text: Break a tombstone in a cemetery
goals.hint: The mod places graves in its cemeteries.
goals.why: Tombstones are part of the grave decor.

goals.text: Craft Basic Bombs and Fang Arrows
goals.hint: Bombs use chitin and gunpowder; arrows use fangs and feathers.
goals.why: Ranged tools and the base of every special bomb.
steps: Basic Bomb x4: 1 string + 3 chitin + 1 gunpowder.
Fang Arrow x4: 1 sharptooth + 1 wooden rod + 1 black feather.
Ghoul Arrow x4: 1 ghoul claw + 1 wooden rod + 1 black feather.

goals.hint: The staff needs hatred shards, an emblem of the king and bones.
goals.why: A staff built from the Forsaken hatred shards and the emblem of the king.
steps: Craft: 2 hatred shards + 1 emblem of the king + 2 bones.

goals.text: Craft a Raven Whistle, Thorn Shooter or Weta Hoe
goals.hint: Three field tools from common drops.
goals.why: A tame raven, a cactus gun and a hoe.
steps: Raven Whistle: 2 black feathers + 1 tripwire hook + 1 sharptooth.
Thorn Shooter: 3 cactus thorns + 3 cactus + 1 dispenser.
Weta Hoe: 1 weta jaw + 1 chitin + 2 wooden rods.

goals.text: Make the Frozen Grip and Fungal Rod
goals.hint: Combine the Midnight Mourne with a Frozen Thigh or Poisonous Spore at an anvil.
goals.why: Two relic weapons from the same upgrade.
steps: Frozen Dagger: 2 shattered ice + 1 wooden rod.
Frozen Grip: Midnight Mourne + Frozen Thigh at an anvil.
Fungal Rod: Midnight Mourne + Poisonous Spore at an anvil.

goals.hint: Find the Undertaker and defeat it.
goals.why: Ticks the mod advancement for knocking out an Undertaker.

goals.hint: Find a Sludge Lord and defeat it.
goals.why: Sludge Lords drop silky sludge and mossy sticks for the sludge wand.
steps: Take its silky sludge and mossy sticks.

goals.hint: Find an Amber Lord and defeat it.
goals.why: Amber Lords drop ancient amber, mossy sticks and acidic hearts.

goals.text: Defeat a Chocolate Quest boss in the middle ring
goals.hint: Pirate ships and necromancer towers 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn end in a boss.
goals.why: CQR dungeons scale with distance: the middle ring gives Age 3-4 loot. The Pirate Captain drops his revolver, the Necromancer cursed bones.
steps: Go 1,500 to 4,000 blocks out (Ring Map page) and find a pirate ship or a tower.
Fight through the crew: CQR mobs use shields, potions and ranged attacks.
Defeat the captain on his ship or the necromancer at the top of his tower.

obtain.cqrepoured:captain_revolver: Dropped by the CQR Pirate Captain.

mobs.where: Commands a CQR pirate ship off the coast, 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn.

goals.hint: Equipment and treasure chests hold diamond great swords, spears and dyeable diamond armor.
goals.why: Stronger gear before the middle-ring bosses.
