steps: Take the diamond great sword, spear and dyeable diamond armor.

goals.hint: Equipment chests hold heavy iron helmets, chestplates, leggings and boots.
goals.why: Heavy plate for tougher dungeons.
steps: Open equipment chests in mid-game dungeons.
Collect all four heavy iron pieces.

goals.hint: Equipment chests hold rusted, goblin, pirate, zombie, spider and other themed shields; treasure chests hold the rare ones.
goals.why: Each shield has its own look; the rare ones come from treasure chests.
steps: Open equipment chests for common shields.
Open treasure chests for the Sun, Moon, Fire and Walker shields.

goals.hint: Find a Lich dungeon and defeat the Lich in it.
goals.why: Clearing a Lich dungeon opens its boss chest.
steps: Find a dungeon with a Lich.

goals.hint: Find a spider nest dungeon and defeat the Giant Spider.
goals.why: Giant Spiders drop spider poison and guard a boss chest.

goals.hint: Cactus Broth is cooked chicken, 2 cactus, a baked potato and a bowl.
goals.why: A desert meal for the road.
steps: Craft: 1 cooked chicken + 2 cactus + 1 baked potato + 1 bowl.

goals.text: Craft a Pokey and a Skewer
goals.hint: A Pokey is 7 cobblestone, iron bars and redstone; the Skewer adds a tripwire hook.
goals.why: The Skewer is the first beast weapon you craft.

goals.text: Defeat a Giant from Ancient Beasts
goals.hint: Giants (294 HP) walk the plains and ruins of the middle ring.
goals.why: A big damage check for Age 3 gear; drops the Tough Glove.
steps: Look for a towering zombie in the middle ring.
Keep moving and hit its legs; bring food and a bow for when it gets close.

obtain.ancientbeasts:tough_glove: Dropped by the Ancient Beasts Giant.

mobs.where: A Giant (294 HP) that walks the plains and ruins 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn.

goals.text: Take a Tough Glove from a Giant
goals.hint: Giant Zombies drop the Tough Glove.
goals.why: The glove is the Giant's trophy.

goals.text: Age 3 boss: Elder Guardian, Ferrous Wroughtnaut or Skeleton King
goals.hint: An Elder Guardian opens Age 4 (Nether & Power) for everyone on the server.
goals.why: When anyone on the server defeats one of these bosses, Age 4 opens for every player at once: its guide chapter, the reward bag and the decree of the age you finished. Age 4 brings the Nether, Immersive Engineering steel, Ender IO, Actually Additions, Extra Utilities 2 generators, Refined Storage, RFTools, Steve's Carts, Blood Magic, Industrial Foregoing and the first TaCZ guns.
goals.tip: The killer, or anyone within 64 blocks when it dies, opens the age for the whole server. Nothing to craft or hand in. /sf3ages lists every gate.
steps: Elder Guardian: inside an ocean monument. A cartographer villager sells an Ocean Explorer Map to one.
Ferrous Wroughtnaut: an underground hall closed with iron bars, found while caving.
Skeleton King: Fish's Undead Rising crypts and desert tombs, 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn.
Bring: a Tinkers or diamond weapon, good armor and food. Elder Guardian: milk against Mining Fatigue and a Water Breathing potion. Wroughtnaut: hit it from behind after it swings.
Defeat one. Chat announces the new age and this goal ticks itself (ages open in order).
Drops: Elder Guardian: wet sponges. Wroughtnaut: its axe and helmet. Skeleton King: its crown.

goals.hint: 4 Nugget o' Experience + 4 string.
goals.why: The Chicken Wing Ring, Squid Ring and Chunk Loading Ward all use a Golden Lasso.
steps: Golden Lasso: 4 Nugget o' Experience + 4 string.
Cursed Lasso: Golden Lasso + Drop Of Evil.

goals.why: Lasso and fire axe: Golden Lasso, Golden Lasso, Golden Lasso and 5 more.

goals.hint: Pipes connect Transfer Nodes.
goals.why: Nodes only move items between blocks the pipes link.
steps: Transfer Pipe: 6 Smooth Stone Slab + 2 glass block + Redstone.

goals.hint: 3 gold ingots + 2 Magical Wood; the Builders Wand uses 1 gold ingot.
goals.why: Wands place or break many blocks at once.
steps: Destruction Wand: 3 gold ingot + 2 Magical Wood.
Builders Wand: gold ingot + 2 Magical Wood.

goals.why: Magical wood and apples: Scanner, Sun Crystal, Biome Marker and 18 more.

goals.hint: 3 glass blocks + an iron ingot.
goals.why: Panels, cells and upgrades are all built from mirrors.
steps: First Cable: 6 glass block + 3 redstone dust.

goals.hint: Machine Frame: 4 iron ingots + 2 blue dye + 2 gold nuggets.
goals.why: Almost every RFTools machine is a Machine Frame plus parts.
steps: Machine Frame: 4 Iron Ingot + 2 blue dye + 2 Gold Nugget.

goals.why: Manuals and parts: Generic Module, Machine Base, Modifier Module and 4 more.

goals.text: Make Restonia Crystals with the Reconstructor
goals.hint: Put redstone in front of the Atomic Reconstructor and power it to get Restonia Crystal.
goals.why: Crystals are the base material of coils, tools and the later machines.
steps: Craft an Atomic Reconstructor: 4 Iron Ingot + 4 Redstone Dust around an Iron Casing.
Put redstone in front of it and power it.
Collect the Restonia Crystals it makes.

goals.hint: 4 Restonia Crystal + 1 Black Quartz.
goals.why: Needed for the Crusher, Battery Box and most early machines in this mod.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Restonia Crystal | empty; Middle row: Restonia Crystal | Black Quartz | Restonia Crystal; Bottom row: empty | Restonia Crystal | empty.
Craft two or three before building machines.

goals.hint: 6 Cobblestone + 2 Coal + 1 Iron Casing; burns coal into FE for the first machines.
goals.why: The first power source for this mod's machines: burns coal into FE.
steps: Craft an Iron Casing (4 Iron Ingots + 4 Wooden Rods around a Black Quartz).
Craft the Coal Generator: cobblestone in the left and right columns, coal above and below the casing, Iron Casing in the center.
Put coal in it and cable it to a machine.

goals.hint: 6 Cobblestone + 1 Enori Crystal + 1 Canola + 1 Advanced Coil.
goals.why: Canola oil fuels the Oil Generator, a cheap renewable power source.
steps: Gather 6 Cobblestone, 1 Enori Crystal, 1 Canola, 1 Advanced Coil.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Cobblestone | Enori Crystal | Cobblestone.
Bottom row: Cobblestone | Advanced Coil | Cobblestone.
Plant canola and press it in the Canola Press.

goals.hint: 3 Restonia Crystal + 2 Stick.
goals.why: A tier set per crystal: Restonia, Palis, Diamatine, Emeradic, Void and Enori, plus Obsidian, Emerald and Black Quartz.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Restonia Crystal | Restonia Crystal | Restonia Crystal; Middle row: empty | Stick | empty; Bottom row: empty | Stick | empty.
Craft the pickaxe, then the other tools and armor from the same crystal.

goals.hint: 1 Knife Blade + 1 Knife Handle.
goals.why: Food with stronger hunger and saturation than vanilla bread.
steps: Combine them in the crafting grid to get Knife.
Combine dough, cheese, knife and fillings into pizza or a sandwich.

goals.hint: 4 Glowstone Block + 2 Palis Crystal + 2 White Dye + 1 Black Quartz (makes 6).
goals.why: Light blocks in dye colors for finished builds and well-lit rooms.
steps: Gather 4 Glowstone Block, 2 Palis Crystal, 2 White Dye, 1 Black Quartz.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Glowstone Block | Palis Crystal | Glowstone Block.
Middle row: White Dye | Black Quartz | White Dye.
Bottom row: Glowstone Block | Palis Crystal | Glowstone Block.
Place the lamps to light your base.

goals.hint: 2 Iron Ingot + 1 Strings + 2 Wooden Rod.
goals.why: The Engineer's Hammer builds every multiblock and rotates blocks.
steps: Gather 2 Iron Ingot, 1 Strings, 2 Wooden Rod.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Iron Ingot | Strings; Middle row: empty | Wooden Rod | Iron Ingot; Bottom row: Wooden Rod | empty | empty.
Hold it and right-click a multiblock form.

goals.hint: 2 Wooden Rod + 1 Iron Ingot.
goals.why: Strips insulation and cuts wire, needed when you build the power network.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Wooden Rod | Iron Ingot; Bottom row: empty | Wooden Rod.
Hold it when making wire coils.

goals.hint: 4 Redstone + 3 Iron Ingot + 2 Component Simple Pcb.
goals.why: Circuit boards that every assembler and advanced module recipe needs.
steps: Gather 4 Redstone, 3 Iron Ingot, 2 Component Simple Pcb.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Redstone | Iron Ingot | Redstone.
Middle row: Component Simple Pcb | Iron Ingot | Component Simple Pcb.
Bottom row: Redstone | Iron Ingot | Redstone.

goals.hint: 4 Stone + 4 Component Simple Pcb + 1 Redstone.
goals.why: Sorts cart cargo into chests and managers beside the track.
steps: Gather 4 Stone, 4 Component Simple Pcb, 1 Redstone.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Stone | Component Simple Pcb | Stone.
Middle row: Component Simple Pcb | Redstone | Component Simple Pcb.
Bottom row: Stone | Component Simple Pcb | Stone.

goals.hint: Filters limit what a collector or redirector handles.
goals.why: Needed for sorted item logistics.

goals.hint: Breaks the block in front of it.
goals.why: Breaks blocks automatically, which is the base of simple mining machines.
steps: Block Breaker: Craft: 7 Cobblestones (any) + 1 Iron pickaxe + 1 Redstone torch
Place it facing the block you want broken

goals.hint: A crafting table that copies its wood type.
goals.why: Decoration that still crafts.
steps: Oak Crafting Table: Craft: 8 Oak planks + 1 Crafting table
Place it and use it like a crafting table

goals.text: Get silicon and quartz enriched iron
goals.hint: Silicon and quartz enriched iron feed every processor and part.
goals.why: The base materials of Refined Storage.
steps: Get silicon from the pack silicon source.
Make quartz enriched iron: 3 iron ingots + 1 quartz.
Both are needed for processors and the controller.

goals.hint: 4 Iron Ingot + 5 Glass.
goals.why: Stores the liquid XP that mob grinders produce until you tap it.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Iron Ingot | Glass | Iron Ingot; Middle row: Glass | Glass | Glass; Bottom row: Iron Ingot | Glass | Iron Ingot.

goals.hint: 4 Gold Nugget + 4 Lapis + 1 Redstone Block.
goals.why: Raises the drops each kill gives, which makes a mob farm pay more.
steps: Gather 4 Gold Nugget, 4 Lapis, 1 Redstone Block.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Gold Nugget | Lapis | Gold Nugget; Middle row: Lapis | Redstone Block | Lapis; Bottom row: Gold Nugget | Lapis | Gold Nugget.

goals.hint: 4 Stone Slabs + 4 Iron Ingots + 1 Redstone; pushes mobs along a channel.
goals.why: Pushes mobs along a lane to the kill zone without any wiring.
steps: Craft the Fan: stone slabs in the four corners, iron ingots on the four sides, redstone in the center.
Place it facing the lane the mobs walk along.

goals.hint: Combine lapis, redstone and 2 obsidian.
goals.why: Essence is refined into ingots.

goals.hint: 2 Stone + 2 Plank.
goals.why: Every Workshop upgrade and the Workshop Table are built from it.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Stone | Plank; Bottom row: Plank | Stone.

goals.hint: Plant a menril sapling and harvest its logs and berries.
goals.why: Menril logs give the resin that dries into the crystal every part is made of.
steps: Plant it and wait for the tree.
Chop the logs and collect the berries.

goals.hint: Chop a log of a menril tree.
goals.why: Logs are squeezed into menril resin.

goals.hint: Craft a chunk from a Crystalized Menril Block.
goals.why: Cables, variables and the energy battery are all made from chunks.
steps: Craft a Crystalized Menril Chunk: Block of Crystalized Menril.
Dry menril resin in the Drying Basin for blocks.

goals.hint: Craft a disk drive from stone and redstone dust, then put it beside a computer.
goals.why: A drive loads programs from floppy disks.
steps: Craft a Disk Drive: 7 stones + 2 redstone dusts.
Place the drive on any side of a computer and insert a floppy disk.

goals.text: Craft a Wired Modem and Cable
goals.hint: Craft a modem and cable, then link two blocks.
goals.why: Wired modems join computers and peripherals into one network.
steps: Craft a Wired Modem: 8 stones + redstone dust.
Craft Networking Cable: 4 stones + redstone dust.
Place a modem on each block and run cable between them.

goals.hint: Craft a modem with an ender pearl and attach it to a computer.
goals.why: Computers and turtles can talk without cables.
steps: Craft a Wireless Modem: 8 stones + ender pearl.

goals.hint: Craft a speaker from stone, a note block and redstone dust.
goals.why: A program can play notes through it.
steps: Craft a Speaker: 7 stones + note block + redstone dust.
Place the speaker beside a computer and play a note from a program.

goals.hint: Craft one from 7 stones + redstone dust + dye.
goals.why: Prints pages and books from a program.
steps: Craft a Printer: 7 stones + redstone dust + dye.

goals.hint: Craft a gold ingot, clay and a green dye to get 8 Raw Circuit Boards.
goals.why: Smelting a Raw Circuit Board gives the Printed Circuit Board that cards, memory and upgrades use.
steps: Craft: gold ingot + clay + green dye (makes 8).
Smelt a Raw Circuit Board in a furnace to get a Printed Circuit Board.

goals.hint: Craft it from 2 sticks around an iron nugget.
goals.why: A cheap early tool of the mod, made before the chips.
steps: Craft a Cutting Wire: 2 sticks + iron nugget.

goals.hint: Craft it from 8 strings around an ender pearl.
goals.why: The Interweb goes into the Internet Card, the Linked Card and Waypoints.
steps: Craft an Interweb: 8 strings + ender pearl.

goals.hint: Craft a Card Base from redstone dust, green dye and gold nuggets.
goals.why: The base of the processor, the CPU core and every card.
steps: Craft a Card Base: 3 redstone dusts + 3 green dyes + 3 gold nuggets.

goals.hint: Glass and iron in the dagger shape.
goals.why: Draws life essence to fill the Blood Altar.

goals.hint: 2 White Wool + 2 Stick (makes 4).
goals.why: Envelopes are the cloth of a hot air balloon; more envelopes lift more weight.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: White Wool | Stick; Bottom row: Stick | White Wool.
Place them in a closed shape above a burner.

goals.hint: 1 ender pearl + 5 gold ingots + 1 enchanting table.
goals.why: Keeps machines near it running while you are away.
steps: Craft it from 5 gold ingots + 1 ender pearl + 1 enchanting table.
Place it next to the farm.

goals.text: Place a Chunk Loader beside your farm
goals.hint: Place it where the machines are.
goals.why: Farms keep working while you are away.
steps: Place the loader next to the farm.
Open it to set the area.

goals.hint: Craft: 7 Planks + 1 Diamond.
goals.why: Carries ammo and is part of the ammo table recipe.
steps: Craft 7 planks around an iron, gold or diamond ingot.

goals.hint: 4 Dried Kelp + 1 Shaft.
goals.why: Wheels for your first car; the base size for light vehicles.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Dried Kelp | empty; Middle row: Dried Kelp | Shaft | Dried Kelp; Bottom row: empty | Dried Kelp | empty.
Fit two or four to wheel mounts.

goals.hint: 1 Andesite Casing + 1 Spring + 1 Iron Sheet.
goals.why: Attaches a tire to the vehicle body; each wheel needs its own mount.
steps: Gather 1 Andesite Casing, 1 Spring, 1 Iron Sheet.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Andesite Casing; Middle row: Spring; Bottom row: Iron Sheet.
Place one on each side of the body.

goals.hint: Fish in water with a rod.
goals.why: The Esca is the lure of the angler line.

goals.hint: Absorbers feed essence into altar crafting.
goals.why: Absorbers feed reaped essence into the altar so its recipes can run.
steps: Soul Absorber: Craft: 1 Hopper + 2 Soumberglass Ingot + 4 Obsidians (any)
Blood Absorber: Craft: 1 Hopper + 2 Soumberglass Ingot + 4 Netherrack

goals.text: Craft Power IO and an output block
goals.hint: Power IO: 6 iron ingots + 2 pistons + redstone.
goals.why: Gets RF out of the machine through RF, Tesla or Forge output blocks.
steps: Power IO Module: 6 iron ingot + 2 Piston + Redstone.
Flux Generator: 4 Redstone + Power IO Module + 2 Iron Frame + gold ingot + Iron Wiring.
Tesla Generator: 3 Redstone + Power IO Module + 2 Iron Frame + gold ingot + 2 Iron Wiring.
Forge Energy Emitter: 4 Redstone + Power IO Module + 2 Iron Frame + Iron Tubing + Iron Wiring.

goals.why: Output blocks: Forge Energy Emitter, Item Output Port, Power IO Module and 2 more.

goals.text: Craft a Control Circuit and data port
goals.hint: Control Circuit: 4 iron ingots + 4 redstone + quartz.
goals.why: Every controller block needs a circuit.
steps: Control Circuit: 4 iron ingot + 4 Redstone + Quartz.
Machine Data Port: 4 Iron Frame + 4 Cable + Quartz.
Sensor Module: 4 Iron Frame + 4 Redstone + Quartz.
Redstone Control Module: 4 Iron Frame + 2 Quartz + 3 Redstone.

goals.why: Controllers and sensors: Redstone Control Module, Sensor Module, Machine Data Port and 1 more.

goals.text: Craft fluid, item and pressure IO
goals.hint: Input and output blocks for fluids, items, gas and pressure.
goals.why: Feed fuel in and move products out of a multiblock.
steps: Fluid Intake Valve: 3 iron ingot + 2 Iron Frame + Iron Tubing.
Item Input Port: 4 Iron Frame + 3 iron ingot.
Pressure Valve: 2 iron ingot + 3 Iron Tubing.
Gas Intake Valve: 2 steel ingot or Iron Ingot + 2 Iron Frame + Piston + Iron Tubing.

goals.why: IO blocks: Advanced Pressure Valve, Fluid Intake Valve, Fluid Output Valve and 5 more.

goals.hint: 4 iron frames + 5 iron tubing.
goals.why: Part of the heat exchanger multiblock.
steps: Heat Exchanger: 4 Iron Frame + 5 Iron Tubing.
Fuel Tank: 4 Iron Frame + 3 Glass Pane + Iron Tubing.
Mixing Chamber: 4 Iron Frame + 2 Iron Tubing + 2 Pressure Valve.
Heating Chamber: 4 Iron Frame + Pressure Valve + 3 Iron Tubing.

goals.why: Heat parts: Fuel Tank, Heat Exchanger, Heating Chamber and 1 more.

goals.hint: Rotor: 8 blades + an ingot of the same metal.
goals.why: Rotors go into the turbine.
steps: Iron Turbine Rotor: 8 Iron Turbine Blade + iron ingot.
Steel Turbine Rotor: 8 Steel Turbine Blade + steel ingot.
Vibrant Turbine Rotor: 8 Vibrant Turbine Blade + vibrant alloy ingot.

goals.why: Turbine rotors: Advanced Alloy Turbine Rotor, Bronze Turbine Rotor, Enderium Turbine Rotor and 5 more.

goals.text: Craft hardened stone and a machine base
goals.hint: Hardened Stone: 8 stone + clay.
goals.why: The machine bases and cores are made from it.
steps: Hardened Stone Machine Base: 8 Hardened Stone + Redstone Block.
Modifier Core: 4 Hardened Stone + 4 Ceramic Plate + Hardened Stone Machine Base.

goals.why: Hardened stone set: Hardened Stone, Hardened Stone Brick Slab, Hardened Stone Brick Stairs and 11 more.
Basalt set: Basalt, Basalt Brick Slab, Basalt Brick Stairs and 11 more.
Alabaster set: Alabaster, Alabaster Brick Slab, Alabaster Brick Stairs and 11 more.

goals.hint: Laser Core: 4 diamonds + 4 redstone blocks + a Stabilized Ender Pearl.
goals.why: Void miners and lenses are built on the laser core.
steps: Laser Core: 4 Diamond + 4 Redstone Block + Stabilized Ender Pearl.
Stabilized Ender Pearl: 8 Obsidian + Ender Pearl.

goals.why: Cores and stabilizers: Stabilized Ender Pearl, Laser Core, Lightning Rod and 12 more.

goals.hint: Lens: 4 clear glass + a diamond.
goals.why: Lenses go into the Void Miner controllers.
Lenses: Clear Lens, Black Lens, Blue Lens and 15 more.

goals.hint: Wool, redstone and wool on top, iron around a cooked porkchop, iron, planks and iron below.
goals.why: It holds up to 64 of one food and feeds you by itself whenever your hunger can take a full portion.
steps: Craft it, then use it to load that food from your inventory.
Same recipe with another food in the middle: cooked chicken (Cluckinator), cooked beef (Jerkynator), rotten flesh (Darkonator).
Carry it: it eats for you.

goals.hint: Mine in deep caves and fight it when it appears.
goals.why: Removes the stalker from your mine.

goals.hint: Dig or cave until you find a dungeon room.
goals.why: The dungeon holds the spawner and chests.
steps: Dig or cave to find a dungeon room.
Look for a spawner and chests.

goals.hint: Phantom membrane in the 4 corners, amethyst shards on the 4 sides, an Eye of Ender in the center.
goals.why: The key opens a seam in a wall into a Dreamspace.
steps: Get 4 phantom membranes (from phantoms), 4 amethyst shards and an Eye of Ender.
Craft the key at a crafting table.

goals.hint: Rocks, bones, seashells and pinecones lie on the ground; 4 rocks make a block.
goals.why: Free stone and sticks without mining.
steps: Stone Rocks x4 make 1 cobblestone; granite, diorite and andesite rocks do the same.
Twigs of any tree make a stick.

goals.hint: Explore the Overworld; the mod places templates such as shrines, crypts and chests.
goals.why: Their chests use the loot categories the tags control.
steps: Open the chests of a structure.

goals.hint: Meet a Ghost Player and defeat it.
goals.why: Ghost Players are one of the four player-name mobs.
One holder per food family, so each one feeds you its own food.

goals.hint: Spawners come as simple, nest, stream, swarm and brutal.
goals.why: Stronger variants guard better loot.
steps: Fight the mobs a spawner sends.
Open the chest after the spawner is quiet.

goals.text: Open a seam into a Dreamspace
goals.hint: Right-click a solid wall two blocks tall with the Lucid Key, standing on the ground with open space in front.
goals.why: The seam stays open for 30 seconds; step through to slip into a Dreamspace. Your inventory is kept and given back when you wake.
steps: Stand on the ground facing a solid wall two blocks tall.
Right-click the wall with the key and step through the seam within 30 seconds.
The key has 4 uses and a 5 minute cooldown, one open seam at a time; it never works inside a Dreamspace.

goals.text: Make Wet Adobe and Adobe Bricks
goals.hint: Wet adobe is 4 clay balls, 4 sand and 1 dirt.
goals.why: Adobe is the desert-style building set.
steps: Wet Adobe x8: 4 clay balls + 4 sand + 1 dirt.

goals.hint: Inventory, book and artifact tags mark what a chest can hold.
goals.why: Authors use the tags to steer structure loot.
steps: Obtain the inventory, book and artifact generation tags.

goals.hint: An Andesite Casing and a Chisel make the Create machine.
goals.why: Chisels stacks of blocks as part of a Create line.
steps: Craft the Mechanical Chisel from an Andesite Casing and a Chisel.
Place it in a Create contraption and feed it blocks.

goals.text: Defeat an Empty Steve or Alex
goals.hint: Find an Empty Steve or Empty Alex and defeat it.
goals.why: Empty players borrow real player names.
steps: Find an Empty Steve or Empty Alex.

goals.text: Open a trapped or surprise chest
goals.hint: Chests can be infested, mimic, trapped, or surprise (lava, poison gas, TNT).
goals.why: Valuable chests hold the best loot; trapped ones fire an event.
steps: Watch the floor and the chest.

goals.hint: Break gravel deposits until a gold gravel ore appears.
goals.why: Another gold source that needs no cave exploring.

goals.hint: Wild wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroot generate in the world.
goals.why: Free crops without farmland.
steps: Find wild crops in grassy biomes.

goals.hint: Find the White Eye and defeat it.
goals.why: The White Eye is one of the four mobs of the mod.

goals.hint: Infested clay, dirt, mossy cobblestone and sandstone hide silverfish.
goals.why: They generate in veins in the world.

goals.hint: Iron, gold, copper, aluminum, tin, lead, nickel and silver gravel ores.
goals.why: Each smelts or blasts into its ingot.
steps: Smelt or blast each ore into its ingot.

goals.hint: Aspen, baobab, cherry blossom, cottonwood, fir, jacaranda, juniper, mangrove, maple, palm, pine, redwood and willow generate in biomes.
goals.why: Each tree has its own planks, doors, fences, boats and saplings.
steps: Find a tree of each kind.
Craft planks, then slabs, stairs, fences, doors and boats.

goals.text: Leaf litter and twigs of vanilla trees
goals.family: Leaf litter and twigs of vanilla trees

goals.text: Cook Clam Chowder and Cactus Salad
goals.hint: Chowder needs steamed clam meat; salad is cactus and a bowl.
goals.why: Bowl foods from the new critters and plants.
steps: Clam Chowder: 2 steamed clam meat + bowl + potato + carrot.
Coconut Milk: 3 cracked coconuts + glass bottle (cracked coconut: 1 coconut makes 2).
Sugarcane Juice: 2 sugar cane + glass bottle.

goals.text: Collect Goon, Snail and Ghost drops
goals.hint: Goons drop bile, Snails drop slime droplets and Ghosts drop spectral wrappings.
goals.why: Unstable Essence is a blaze-powder potion ingredient.
steps: Unstable Essence x2: 2 blaze powder + 2 spectral wrappings + 1 goon bile.

goals.hint: The grill is 4 diamonds, 4 obsidian and a blaze rod.
goals.why: It makes the mystical foods.
steps: Cook the raw meat and fish on it to make the mystical foods.

goals.hint: Carry a pet in an amulet.
goals.why: Move tame pets around in your pocket.
steps: Pet Amulet: 4 gold nuggets + diamond gem
Fairy Amulet: 4 gold nuggets + 4 Blaze Powders + Unicorn Horn

goals.hint: Chitin and stings from cave scorpions.
goals.why: Chitin and stings of cave scorpions make armor, a sword, an axe and a mattock.
steps: Dark Scorpion Chestplate: 8 Dark Chitins + Golden Chestplate
Dark Scorpion Blade: Dark Scorpion Stinger + Golden Sword + Dark Chitin

goals.hint: Wood, iron and diamond tusks.
goals.why: Wood, iron and diamond tusks give your elephant three armor tiers.

goals.hint: Harness, garment, chest and howdah.
goals.why: Turns an elephant into a transport and storage mount.
steps: Elephant Harness: 4 Hides + 3 wool (any color) + 2 iron ingots
Elephant Howdah: 4 planks (any wood) + gold ingot + 4 wool (any color)
Elephant Chest: 2 wool (any color) + 2 wooden chest + Hide

goals.hint: The top horse armor.
goals.why: The top horse armor, a protection upgrade for a tamed horse.
steps: Crystal Horse Armor: 4 diamond gems + 3 quartz gems

goals.hint: Chitin and stings from frost scorpions.
goals.why: Chitin and stings of frost scorpions make armor, a sword, an axe and a mattock.
steps: Frost Scorpion Chestplate: 8 Frost Chitins + Golden Chestplate
Frost Scorpion Blade: Frost Scorpion Stinger + Golden Sword + Frost Chitin

goals.hint: Chitin and stings from fire scorpions.
goals.why: Chitin and stings of fire scorpions make armor, a sword, an axe and a mattock.
steps: Fire Scorpion Chestplate: 8 Fire Chitins + Golden Chestplate
Fire Scorpion Blade: Fire Scorpion Stinger + Golden Sword + Fire Chitin

goals.hint: Chitin and stings from undead scorpions.
goals.why: Chitin and stings of undead scorpions make armor, a sword, an axe and a mattock.
steps: Undead Scorpion Chestplate: 8 Undead Chitins + Golden Chestplate
Undead Scorpion Blade: Undead Scorpion Stinger + Golden Sword + Undead Chitin

goals.hint: Hearts and essences from tough mobs.
goals.why: Rare crafting parts that drop from fire, darkness and undead mobs.
steps: Dropped by Fire Manticore, Fire Ogre, Hell Rat

goals.hint: Unicorn horn, medallion, scrolls and mystic pear.
goals.why: Special single-use items.

goals.hint: The Wyvern Lair blocks.
goals.why: Wyvstone, deep wyvstone and wyvern wood.
steps: Mine the stone and chop the wyvwood.

goals.hint: Iron, gold, lapis, emerald and diamond ore.
goals.why: Ores inside the Wyvern Lair.
steps: Mine the ores in the Wyvern Lair.

goals.hint: 1 chainmail helmet + 2 chainmail boots + 2 iron nuggets.
goals.why: Chainmail armor lets a wolf survive early skeleton fights.
steps: Put the chainmail helmet in the top slot.
Put one chainmail boot in the middle and one in the bottom slot.
Put the iron nuggets on both sides of the middle boot.

goals.hint: Daylight detector hidden in a wall.
goals.why: A daylight sensor that no one sees on your roof wall.
steps: Find a secret light detector in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the Secret Light Detector on a wall.
Right-click the Secret Light Detector with camouflage paste to disguise it as the block it touches.

goals.text: Craft a Secret Inverted Light Detector
goals.hint: Inverted daylight detector hidden in a wall.
goals.why: A night sensor that hides in your wall and triggers at dark.
steps: Find a secret inverted light detector in the recipe book and craft it.
Place the Secret Inverted Light Detector on a wall.
Right-click the Secret Inverted Light Detector with camouflage paste to disguise it as the block it touches.

goals.hint: Probe you set to a switch signal.
goals.why: One probe controls many hidden switches.
steps: Right-click hidden switches to program it.

goals.hint: Jelly and bread make a sandwich.
goals.why: A quick portable food that needs no cooking tool.
steps: Apple Jelly Sandwich: Cutting Board + any nutbutter + Apple Jelly + Bread

goals.hint: A Juicer, fruit and a snowball make a smoothie.
goals.why: Smoothies are the drink step of the fruit chain.

goals.hint: Fruit and plain yogurt make flavored yogurt.
goals.why: Yogurt is also an ingredient in curries and desserts.

goals.hint: Pot, vegetables, butter and stock make a soup.
goals.why: Soups are the simplest hot meals to cook in bulk.
steps: Asparagus Soup: Pot + Asparagus + Onion + Butter + Stock

goals.hint: Bakeware, fruit, sugar and dough make a pie.
goals.why: Pies use dough, the base of the baking families.
steps: Apple Pie: Bakeware + Apple + any sugar + Dough

goals.hint: Eggs, bacon, oatmeal and toast dishes.
goals.why: Breakfast dishes only need a skillet and farm basics.

goals.hint: A skillet, raw beef and toast make a hamburger.
goals.why: Sandwiches and burgers are the quickest full meals.
steps: Hamburger: Skillet + any raw beef + Toast

goals.hint: Chicken Curry takes a pot and about nine ingredients.
goals.why: Main courses are the long tail of the mod: meat, vegetable, seafood and noodle dishes.
steps: Chicken Curry: Pot + Coconut + Plain Yogurt + any raw chicken + any spice + Chili Pepper + any rice + Ground Cinnamon + Garlic
Grow rice, chili pepper and garlic first.
Buy coconut at a Market or grow it.

goals.hint: Plant a bush on dirt in dim light.
goals.why: Renewable iron without mining.
steps: Take a bush or berry from a cave.
Plant it in a dark area.

goals.hint: Pick tin berries from a bush.
goals.why: Tin is the second metal for bronze and other alloys.
steps: Find or grow a tin bush.

goals.hint: Pick the berry from an Essence Oreberry bush.
goals.why: Gives essence without a Mystical Agriculture farm.

goals.hint: Smelt an Iron or Gold Oreberry to get a nugget.
goals.why: Nuggets stack into ingots without mining.

goals.hint: Smelt a Copper or Tin Oreberry to get a nugget.
goals.why: Nuggets stack into ingots without mining.

goals.hint: Smelt an Aluminum Oreberry to get a nugget.
goals.why: Aluminum nuggets craft into ingots for alloys and machines.
steps: Smelt it in a furnace for a nugget.

goals.hint: 8 diamonds + 1 basic to gold tier upgrade (8 diamonds + the gold upgrade).
goals.why: Diamond tier has the second-largest inventory.
steps: Craft it from 8 diamonds + the gold tier upgrade.
Right-click a gold chest or barrel with it.

goals.why: Collect the shulker boxes and packing tape as you unlock them.

goals.hint: 7 gold ingots + 1 wooden chest + 1 iron backpack storage emphasis.
goals.why: A bigger inventory than the iron backpack, with room for upgrades.
steps: Craft it from 7 gold ingots + 1 wooden chest + the iron storage backpack.

goals.text: Combine filters into an Advanced Filter Upgrade
goals.hint: Needs basic, void, fuzzy, ore-dictionary and mod-specific filters + 2 button upgrades + a core.
goals.why: One filter that does every filtering type.
steps: Craft the basic, void, fuzzy, ore-dictionary and mod-specific filters.
Combine all with an Upgrade Core in the grid.

goals.hint: 2 pistons + 2 sticky pistons + 1 upgrade core.
goals.why: Refills your hotbar stacks from the backpack.
steps: Craft it from 2 pistons + 2 sticky pistons + 1 Upgrade Core.
Add it, then hold a stack in your hotbar to test it.

goals.hint: 1 white dye or bone meal + 1 piston + 1 bone block + 5 crafting tables + 1 upgrade core.
goals.why: A crafting grid inside the backpack; small and tiny versions are cheaper.
steps: Craft it from 5 crafting tables + 1 bone block + 1 piston + 1 bone meal + 1 Upgrade Core.
Open the backpack to use the grid.

goals.text: Craft a Precise Quick Deposit Upgrade
goals.hint: 4 sticky pistons + 1 quick deposit upgrade.
goals.why: Deposits only items the chest already holds.
steps: Craft it from 4 sticky pistons + the Quick Deposit Upgrade.

goals.hint: 8 copper ingots + 1 backpack.
goals.why: The first tier above the base backpack.
steps: Craft it from 8 copper ingots + the base backpack.

goals.hint: 4 iron ingots + 1 copper backpack (4 iron ingots + the copper backpack).
goals.why: More slots and upgrade slots.
steps: Craft it from 4 iron ingots + the copper backpack.

goals.why: Collect the stack downgrades as you unlock them.

goals.hint: 8 gold ingots + 1 iron backpack.
goals.why: The step between iron and diamond.
steps: Craft it from 8 gold ingots + the iron backpack.

goals.hint: The detector points at fallen meteors.
goals.why: Finding fallen meteors is how you reach the rock that smelts into Nyx metals.
steps: Meteor Detector: Craft: 4 Starglass (any) + 4 Tektite Gem Cluster + 1 Compass
Starglass and Tektite gem clusters come from the Nyx gear line

goals.hint: Smelt meteorite rock in a furnace.
goals.why: Meteorite is the first Nyx metal and the base of the Nyx tool and armor line.
steps: Mine the rock and smelt it

goals.hint: Meteorite ingots and sticks.
goals.why: A Meteorite pickaxe mines the harder Nyx rocks that come after it.
steps: Meteorite Pickaxe: Craft: 3 Meteorite Ingot + 2 Iron (any)
Use it on the meteor rocks you find with the detector

goals.hint: A heavy Nyx weapon.
goals.why: A heavy Age 4 weapon built from cyber crystals and a celestial emblem.
steps: Celestial Warhammer: Craft: 2 Cyber Crystal + 1 Celestial Emblem + 2 Star blocks (any) + 2 Starsteel (any)
Cyber crystals come from meteors (see the Nyx meteor steps)

goals.text: Craft the Geo, Pyro and Aero amulets
goals.hint: Each amulet is 3 gold ingots + the matching medallion.
goals.why: Elemental amulets for mining, fire and wind.

goals.hint: Rock candy is a bucket of water, a wooden rod, 3 sugar and a gem or dust.
goals.why: Candies give short buffs from cheap ingredients.
steps: Combine a water bucket + wooden rod + 3 sugar.
Add a diamond, emerald, lapis, quartz, redstone, glowstone or popped chorus fruit.

goals.text: Cut Emeralds into Pieces and Shards
goals.hint: An emerald makes 8 pieces; 8 pieces make a shard.
goals.why: Pieces and shards are the small change of the emerald trade.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Gold Ingot + 2 Wool (any) + 1 Hexical Diamond + 1 Book.
goals.why: A cloth set with gold trim and a Book.
steps: Craft the chestpiece from gold, wool, a Hexical Diamond and a Book.

goals.hint: Ancient armor has no crafting recipe in the pack data; check JEI for how to get it.
goals.why: Ancient pieces are the strongest forms of the Tribal, Thief and Scale sets.
steps: Look up the Ancient pieces in JEI.

goals.hint: Engineer's Compact: handed out when Age 3 opens; with paper, an ink sac and a gold nugget it crafts the Engineer Decree.
goals.why: Keeps the Engineer Decree craftable, and one right-click pays the Age 3 reward.
steps: Open Iron and Tinkering by defeating its boss.
Right-click the Engineer's Compact once for the reward.
Craft the Engineer Decree: Engineer's Compact + paper + ink sac + gold nugget.

goals.hint: Drop sand into a barrel of witch water.
goals.why: Soul sand grows nether wart and feeds the Nether crops.
steps: Fill a barrel with witch water.

goals.text: Make netherrack and end stone from lava
goals.hint: Redstone in a lava barrel makes netherrack; glowstone dust makes end stone.
goals.why: Nether and End blocks without leaving the Overworld.
steps: Fill a stone barrel with lava.
Add glowstone dust for end stone.

goals.hint: Same shape as the Iron Scythe with diamonds.
goals.why: A bigger harvest area per swing.

goals.hint: 6 iron ingots + 2 heavy weighted plates + a Diamond Hammer.
goals.why: Breaks cobblestone and gravel without your hands.
steps: Craft the Auto Hammer (IPI / IHI / IPI).

goals.hint: Both ores generate in the Nether.
goals.why: Cobalt and Ardite are the two metals of the strongest tool alloy.
steps: Mine Cobalt Ore and Ardite Ore.

goals.hint: Smelt Cobalt Ore in a furnace, or melt it in the smeltery and cast an ingot.
goals.why: Cobalt is the first hard tool metal and half of Manyullyn.
steps: Smelt Cobalt Ore for an ingot.
Or melt it in the smeltery for the fluid.

goals.hint: Craft: 3 Seared Bricks + 4 Tool Forge Blocks + 1 Tool Station.
goals.why: Builds the large tools (broadswords, hammers, scythes, lumber axes) that a Tool Station cannot.
steps: Craft the forge from 3 Seared Bricks, 4 Tool Forge Blocks and a Tool Station.
Place it next to your Tool Station.

goals.hint: Scythe head + tough tool rod + binding at the Tool Forge.
goals.why: Cuts wide areas of crops and leaves.
steps: Make the scythe head and a tough tool rod.

goals.text: Dry food on a Drying Rack
goals.hint: Craft: 3 Wooden Slabs.
goals.why: Jerky, bacon and dried bricks keep and need no fuel.
steps: Craft a Drying Rack from 3 wooden slabs and place it.
Put raw meat on it and wait for the result.

goals.hint: Slime islands hold slime grass, trees and slimes whose drops tint the slime blocks.
goals.why: Slime blocks, balls and drops feed slime boots, slimeslings and special tool materials.
steps: Find a sky, ender or blood slime island.
Kill slimes for drops and chop slime trees for balls.

goals.text: Craft slime boots and a slimesling
goals.hint: Craft: 2 String + 1 Congealed Slime (any) + 3 Slime Balls.
goals.why: Bounce, launch and fall without damage.
steps: Collect slime blocks and balls of one island type.
Craft the boots or the sling.

goals.hint: Spawns in the Nether in flocks of 3-5.
goals.why: Lays 1 quartz; drops 1 quartz when killed. Parent of Aluminium Chicken, Glass Chicken, Glowstone Chicken, Lava Chicken and more.
steps: Look for a Nether Quartz Chicken in the Nether.
Lead the Nether Quartz Chicken to the portal with wheat seeds and bring it home.

goals.hint: Spawns in the Nether in flocks of 3-5.
goals.why: Lays 1 soul sand; drops 1 soul sand when killed. Parent of Soularium Chicken.
steps: Look for a Soul Sand Chicken in the Nether.
Lead the Soul Sand Chicken to the portal with wheat seeds and bring it home.

goals.hint: Parents: Flint Chicken + Nether Quartz Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 ingot aluminum; drops 1 ingot aluminum when killed.
steps: Pen a Flint Chicken and a Nether Quartz Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or an Aluminium Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Nether Quartz Chicken + Yellow Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 glowstone dust; drops 1 glowstone dust when killed. Parent of Energetic Alloy Chicken, Nether Wart Chicken, Yellorium Chicken.
steps: Pen a Nether Quartz Chicken and a Yellow Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Glowstone Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Redstone Chicken + Iron Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 conductive alloy ingot; drops 1 conductive alloy ingot when killed.
steps: Pen a Redstone Chicken and an Iron Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Conductive Iron Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Nether Quartz Chicken + Redstone Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 glass; drops 1 glass when killed. Parent of Diamond Chicken.
steps: Pen a Nether Quartz Chicken and a Redstone Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Glass Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Coal Chicken + Nether Quartz Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 liquid egg; drops 1 liquid egg when killed. Parent of Blaze Rod Chicken, Obsidian Chicken, Steel Chicken.
steps: Pen a Coal Chicken and a Nether Quartz Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Lava Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Iron Chicken + Nether Quartz Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 ingot lead; drops 1 ingot lead when killed. Parent of Bullet Chicken.
steps: Pen an Iron Chicken and a Nether Quartz Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Lead Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Cocoa Brown Chicken + Glowstone Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 nether wart; drops 1 nether wart when killed. Parent of Cobalt Chicken, Ender Pearl Chicken.
steps: Pen a Cocoa Brown Chicken and a Glowstone Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Nether Wart Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Gunpowder Chicken + Nether Quartz Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 sulfur powder; drops 1 sulfur powder when killed.
steps: Pen a Gunpowder Chicken and a Nether Quartz Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Sulfur Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Gold Chicken + Lava Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 blaze rod; drops 1 blaze rod when killed. Parent of Ardite Chicken, Ghast Tear Chicken, Magma Cream Chicken.
steps: Pen a Gold Chicken and a Lava Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Blaze Rod Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Gunpowder Chicken + Lead Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 3 bullet potion; drops 3 bullet potion when killed.
steps: Pen a Gunpowder Chicken and a Lead Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Bullet Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Copper Chicken + Nickel Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 ingot constantan; drops 1 ingot constantan when killed.
steps: Pen a Copper Chicken and a Nickel Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Constantan Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Glass Chicken + Gold Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 diamond; drops 1 diamond when killed. Parent of Emerald Chicken, Ender Pearl Chicken.
steps: Pen a Glass Chicken and a Gold Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Diamond Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Gold Chicken + Glowstone Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 energetic alloy ingot; drops 1 energetic alloy ingot when killed. Parent of Vibrant Alloy Chicken.
steps: Pen a Gold Chicken and a Glowstone Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or an Energetic Alloy Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Water Chicken + Lava Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 obsidian; drops 1 obsidian when killed. Parent of Dark Steel Chicken.
steps: Pen a Water Chicken and a Lava Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or an Obsidian Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Clay Chicken + Sand Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 silicon; drops 1 silicon when killed. Parent of Electrical Steel Chicken, Redstone Alloy Chicken.
steps: Pen a Clay Chicken and a Sand Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Silicon Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Gold Chicken + Nether Quartz Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 ingot silver; drops 1 ingot silver when killed. Parent of Electrum Chicken.
steps: Pen a Gold Chicken and a Nether Quartz Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Silver Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Soul Sand Chicken + Gold Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 soularium ingot; drops 1 soularium ingot when killed.
steps: Pen a Soul Sand Chicken and a Gold Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Soularium Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Iron Chicken + Lava Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 ingot steel; drops 1 ingot steel when killed.
steps: Pen an Iron Chicken and a Lava Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Steel Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Iron Chicken + Obsidian Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 dark steel ingot; drops 1 dark steel ingot when killed.
steps: Pen an Iron Chicken and an Obsidian Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Dark Steel Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Silver Chicken + Gold Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 ingot electrum; drops 1 ingot electrum when killed.
steps: Pen a Silver Chicken and a Gold Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or an Electrum Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Diamond Chicken + Cactus Green Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 emerald; drops 1 emerald when killed. Parent of Prismarine Crystal Chicken, Xp Chicken.
steps: Pen a Diamond Chicken and a Cactus Green Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or an Emerald Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: 5 seeds + 4 feather meal in a checker pattern.
goals.why: Feed for the chicken machine.
steps: Craft 5 wheat, pumpkin or melon seeds with 4 feather meal.

goals.hint: A hopper over a piston, iron ingots and a bucket.
goals.why: Mixes manure into liquid fertilizer.

goals.hint: 5 iron ingots, a stone button and a bucket of liquid fertilizer.
goals.why: Sprays fertilizer on farmland.

goals.hint: 5 iron ingots, a piston, a redstone block and a bucket.
goals.why: Turns chicken manure into power for your machines.

goals.hint: Parents: Diamond Chicken + Nether Wart Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 ender pearl; drops 1 ender pearl when killed. Parent of Pulsating Iron Chicken, Terrasteel Chicken, Uranium Chicken, Vibrant Alloy Chicken and more.
steps: Pen a Diamond Chicken and a Nether Wart Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or an Ender Pearl Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Bone White Chicken + Blaze Rod Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 ghast tear; drops 1 ghast tear when killed. Parent of Cobalt Chicken, Manasteel Chicken.
steps: Pen a Bone White Chicken and a Blaze Rod Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Ghast Tear Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Slime Chicken + Blaze Rod Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 magma cream; drops 1 magma cream when killed. Parent of Ardite Chicken, Magma Slime Chicken.
steps: Pen a Slime Chicken and a Blaze Rod Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Magma Cream Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Redstone Chicken + Silicon Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 redstone alloy ingot; drops 1 redstone alloy ingot when killed.
steps: Pen a Redstone Chicken and a Silicon Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Redstone Alloy Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Nether Wart Chicken + Ghast Tear Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 cobalt ingot; drops 1 cobalt ingot when killed. Parent of Manyullyn Chicken.
steps: Pen a Nether Wart Chicken and a Ghast Tear Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Cobalt Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Slime Chicken + Magma Cream Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 magma slime ball; drops 1 magma slime ball when killed.
steps: Pen a Slime Chicken and a Magma Cream Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Magma Slime Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Iron Chicken + Ghast Tear Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 mana resource; drops 1 mana resource when killed. Parent of Elementium Chicken.
steps: Pen an Iron Chicken and a Ghast Tear Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Manasteel Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Water Chicken + Emerald Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 prismarine crystals; drops 1 prismarine crystals when killed. Parent of Terrasteel Chicken.
steps: Pen a Water Chicken and an Emerald Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Prismarine Crystal Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Iron Chicken + Ender Pearl Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 pulsating alloy ingot; drops 1 pulsating alloy ingot when killed.
steps: Pen an Iron Chicken and an Ender Pearl Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Pulsating Iron Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Redstone Chicken + Ender Pearl Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 ingot uranium; drops 1 ingot uranium when killed.
steps: Pen a Redstone Chicken and an Ender Pearl Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or an Uranium Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Emerald Chicken + Cactus Green Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 solidxp; drops 1 solidxp when killed.
steps: Pen an Emerald Chicken and a Cactus Green Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Xp Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Ender Pearl Chicken + Prismarine Crystal Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 nothing. Parent of Elementium Chicken.
steps: Pen an Ender Pearl Chicken and a Prismarine Crystal Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Terrasteel Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Manasteel Chicken + Terrasteel Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 elementium nugget; drops 1 elementium nugget when killed.
steps: Pen a Manasteel Chicken and a Terrasteel Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or an Elementium Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: 3 iron ingots over a water bucket and 5 logs.
goals.why: Water inside the kitchen network.
steps: Sink: 3 iron ingots + 5 logs (any wood) + Water Bucket

goals.hint: 3 black stained glass, 5 iron ingots and a furnace.
goals.why: Cooks and smelts for the Cooking Table.
steps: Oven: 3 Black Stained Glass + 5 iron ingots + Furnace

goals.hint: A stone button over an iron trapdoor, 4 iron ingots and a lava bucket.
goals.why: Toasts bread right in the kitchen.
steps: Toaster: Stone Button + 4 iron ingots + Iron Trapdoor + Lava Bucket

goals.hint: 6 cobblestones + 1 glass pane + 1 compass + 1 torch.
goals.why: Mark an area to capture with a Capsule.
steps: Craft markers from 6 cobblestone + 1 glass pane + 1 compass + 1 torch.
Place them at the corners of the area.

goals.hint: 5 stones + 2 pistons + 1 basic drawers + 1 iron ingot.
goals.why: Ingots, blocks and nuggets of one material share one drawer set.
steps: Craft it from 5 stones + 2 pistons + 1 basic drawer + 1 iron ingot.
Put in a block of a metal; the nuggets and ingots appear.

goals.hint: 1 stone button + 1 personal key.
goals.why: Ties the lock button of a drawer to your own key.
steps: Craft the personal key, then 1 stone button + the key.
Apply the button to a drawer.

goals.hint: 8 silver ingots around a copper chest.
goals.why: Silver is an alternate branch; upgrade it on to gold.
steps: Craft it from 8 silver ingots + 1 copper chest.
Silver ingots come from the pack ore setup.

goals.hint: 8 glass blocks around a diamond chest.
goals.why: The largest chest of the mod.
steps: Craft it from 8 glass blocks + 1 diamond chest.

goals.text: Build silver and obsidian Colossal Chests
goals.hint: 1 chest wall silver + 1 iron ingot.
goals.why: The last non-netherite tiers.
steps: Craft silver walls and the chest (1 wall + 1 iron ingot).
Obsidian walls use 8 obsidian around a diamond wall.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Gold Nugget + 3 Blaze Rod.
goals.why: Every wand uses a Wand Core.
steps: Craft 4 gold nuggets around 3 blaze rods.

goals.hint: Not Enough Wands: places a layer of blocks on a wall or floor in one click.
goals.why: Places a whole layer of blocks in one click, so walls and floors go up fast.
steps: Right-click the face of a wall: it adds a layer from your inventory. Costs a little XP.

goals.hint: Copies a chiseled design so you can place it again.
goals.why: Repeats a carving without redoing it bit by bit.
steps: Use it on a chiseled block.

goals.hint: Livingrock around a slot gives a portable mana store.
goals.why: Charge tools away from the Pool.
steps: Place it in a mana pool to charge it

goals.hint: Wear the ring to refill mana tools from its stored mana.
goals.why: Keeps tablets and tools topped up while you work.
steps: Wear it in a Curios slot

goals.hint: Terrasteel ingots with a Mana Tablet and a Manasteel pickaxe.
goals.why: Mines wide areas using mana.

goals.hint: Craft: 2 Ice or Packed Ice or Blue Ice + 3 Strings + 1 Snowball + 1 Iron Bow.
goals.why: Arrows that chill their target.
steps: Craft it from an Iron Bow, 2 ice blocks, 3 string and a snowball.

goals.hint: Craft: 6 Diamond + 1 Leathers.
goals.why: The strongest plain shield before the special materials.
steps: Craft 6 diamonds and 1 leather into a shield.

goals.hint: Ender: 5 Obsidian + Ender Eye + leather. Skull: 5 Bones + Skeleton Skull + leather. Blessed Golden: 4 Ghast Tears + a Golden Shield.
goals.why: Each special material adds its own look and stats on top of the plain tiers.
steps: Pick a material you can farm.
Craft the shield from its recipe.

goals.hint: Craft: 6 Gold Ingot + 1 Iron Shield.
goals.why: A gilded shield is the base shield plus 6 gold ingots.
steps: Combine it with 6 gold ingots in a crafting grid.

goals.hint: The Ferrous Wroughtnaut drops its axe and helmet.
goals.why: A heavy axe and helmet from the boss.
steps: Pick up the axe and helmet.

goals.hint: Foliaaths drop seeds.
goals.why: Seeds grow your own Foliaath.

goals.hint: Find Ithaqua and defeat it.
goals.why: Ticks the mod advancement for slaying an Ithaqua.

goals.text: Win a bull great sword or battle axe
goals.hint: Treasure chests hold the bull great sword and battle axe.
goals.why: Heavy two-handed weapons.
steps: Take the bull great sword or battle axe.

goals.text: Apply the Engineer Decree to a Bounty Board
goals.hint: Open a Bounty Board, click the Engineer tab on the left and place the decree in the empty slot: the page opens for good with Age 3 jobs.
goals.why: Opens the Engineer page: Age 3 jobs (items and kills) that pay one notch ahead. Optional: bounties never gate progression.
goals.tip: Right-clicking the board with the decree also works. Breaking the board returns it and every decree on it. The goal ticks when anyone opens the page.
steps: You get the Engineer Decree when Age 4 opens (every player gets one).
Right-click a Bounty Board to open it and click the Engineer tab (left edge).
Place the Engineer Decree in the empty slot on that page. The page opens for good and gets 3 jobs at once, then a new one about every 3 minutes (up to 9).

goals.hint: Bounties are side jobs, never a gate. Use the Engineer Decree on a Bounty Board and hand in three jobs.
goals.why: Every player gets the Engineer Decree when Age 4 opens. On a board it offers Age 3 jobs (items and kills from every strand) that pay one notch ahead, never a skip. Skip a job you don't like and the board offers a new one. Bounties count for this decree until the next decree arrives.
steps: For the Engineer page, craft a Bounty Board (6 planks + 3 paper) or use one in a village, and place it. The Bounty Boards page explains how jobs work.
Apply the Engineer Decree to its page on the board (the goal before this one).
Hand in three Engineer bounties; this goal counts them for you.
goals.tip: Lost your decree? Craft a copy: decree + paper (you keep the original). Old capstones still make their decree.

goals.hint: Build a 4x5 obsidian frame and light it with flint and steel.
goals.why: Blaze rods, quartz, glowstone, nether wart, wither skeletons and ancient debris: many mods need Nether materials.
goals.tip: Beds explode in the Nether: respawn with your Overworld bed.
steps: Get 10 obsidian and build the upright portal frame.
Light the inside with Flint and Steel.
Bring blocks, food and fire resistance if you have it. Mark the portal when you arrive.
Secure the return portal before exploring.

diagram.title: Nether portal
diagram.view: Side view (stand it upright)
diagram.note: The corners are optional. Light the empty middle with flint and steel.

obtain.minecraft:obsidian: Pour water onto still lava and mine it with a diamond pickaxe, or pour water into a Stone Barrel full of lava.

goals.hint: Melt equal parts Cobalt and Ardite in the smeltery; they alloy into Manyullyn.
goals.why: Manyullyn is the top tier tool metal.
steps: Melt Cobalt and Ardite into the same smeltery.
Pour the Manyullyn into an ingot cast.

goals.text: Find a Nether Fortress and collect Blaze Rods
goals.hint: Fortresses are long dark-brick bridges; blazes spawn at their spawners.
goals.why: Blaze rods make brewing stands, blaze powder, eyes of ender and many machines. Wither skeletons (for the Wither) live in fortresses too.
steps: Travel along one axis (east or west) until you find dark red brick bridges.
Find a blaze spawner (a cage with fire) and fight blazes with a shield or bow.
Snowballs hurt blazes; fire resistance makes it much safer.

mobs.where: Blazes live in Nether Fortresses, around blaze spawners (a cage with a tiny spinning blaze inside). Bring fire resistance; snowballs hurt them. Carry a spawner home with a Diamond Chest Transporter for a blaze farm.

goals.text: Craft a Brewing Stand and brew a potion
goals.hint: Brewing stand needs a blaze rod; fuel it with blaze powder.
goals.why: Potions give fire resistance, strength and healing for the Nether and bosses.
steps: Take a blaze rod from a Nether fortress.
Craft the brewing stand and set it on a table.
Brew water bottles with Nether wart.

goals.hint: 4 prismarine shards + 2 nautilus shells + 2 gold ingots + an Eye of Ender; it summons an Elder Guardian in deep water.
goals.why: An ocean monument has only three Elder Guardians and they never come back: the lure lets you take the Elder Guardian bounty (worth 220) again.
steps: Craft it: prismarine shards in the corners, nautilus shells top and bottom center, gold ingots left and right, the Eye of Ender in the middle.
Prismarine shards drop from guardians at an ocean monument; nautilus shells come from fishing, drowned and wandering traders.
Stand within 8 blocks of water at least 2 blocks deep and right-click it; water with seagrass or kelp in it counts.
It works only once Age 4 is open (/sf3ages) and no summoned Elder Guardian is alive within 64 blocks; the lure is used up.
Bring milk for Mining Fatigue and a Water Breathing potion.

goals.text: Brew a Potion of Fire Resistance
goals.hint: Brewing stand: nether wart in water bottles, then magma cream.
goals.why: Immunity to fire and lava: for the Nether, blaze farms, the Twilight Fire Swamp and the Hydra.
steps: Craft a brewing stand (blaze rod + cobblestone) and fuel it with blaze powder.
Brew nether wart (from a fortress) into water bottles: Awkward Potion.
Add magma cream (slime + blaze powder) for Fire Resistance; redstone makes it last longer.

mobs.where: Blazes live in Nether Fortresses, around blaze spawners (a cage with a tiny spinning blaze inside). Bring fire resistance; snowballs hurt them. Carry a spawner home with a Diamond Chest Transporter for a blaze farm.

goals.hint: Invisible block you can stand on.
goals.why: Hidden bridges and floors.
steps: Place it where you need a hidden floor.

goals.text: Find a Bastion and trade with Piglins
goals.hint: Wear one gold armor piece and throw gold ingots to piglins to barter.
goals.why: Piglins trade ender pearls, obsidian, fire resistance potions, quartz and more for gold. Bastions hold netherite and gold loot.
steps: Wear at least one gold armor piece so piglins stay calm.
Throw a gold ingot to a piglin (Q) and pick up what it gives back.

mobs.where: Piglins live in Crimson Forests and the Nether Wastes and guard Bastions. Wear at least one piece of gold armor so they stay calm, then throw them gold ingots to barter.

goals.text: Ride a Strider across a lava ocean
goals.hint: Saddle a Strider and steer it with warped fungus on a stick.
goals.why: Striders carry you safely across lava.
goals.tip: Boats don't cross lava. Keep a marked way back.
steps: Bring a saddle, warped fungus on a stick, spare blocks and fire resistance.
Find a Strider by a lava sea, saddle it and mount it.
Steer with the warped fungus on a stick and get off on solid ground.

goals.text: Bring a Blaze Spawner home with a Diamond Chest Transporter
goals.hint: Only the diamond Chest Transporter picks up spawners (SF3 setting); the spawner keeps its mob.
goals.why: A blaze spawner at home is an endless blaze rod farm (brewing, eyes of ender, Create brass).
steps: Clear the blazes around a fortress spawner and right-click the spawner with the transporter.
Place it at home in a dark, enclosed room with a kill spot.

goals.text: Grow Natura Nether trees and berries
goals.hint: Sift soul sand for Natura Nether saplings and berries.
goals.why: Natura trees don't generate in this pack; sieving is how you get them.
steps: Collect soul sand in the Nether.
Pick the soul-sand sieve recipe and mesh in JEI for the sapling or berry you want.
Plant it on its soil with clear space around it, then harvest and replant.

goals.hint: One Barley in the grid gives Barley Flour.
goals.why: Flour feeds the baking recipes.
steps: Put Barley in the crafting grid.

goals.hint: A Bloodwood log in the crafting grid makes planks.
goals.why: Planks unlock the Nether furniture and tools.
steps: Chop a Bloodwood tree in the Nether.

goals.hint: 4 iron plates + 3 iron ingots + a furnace + a redstone block (aluminium plates and ingots also work).
goals.why: Burns furnace fuel for RF.
steps: Furnace Generator MK.I: 4 Immersive Engineering iron plates + 3 iron ingots + furnace + redstone block.
Furnace Generator MK.II: 8 Furnace Generator MK.I around 1 Vibrant Crystal.
Furnace Generator MK.III: 4 Dragon Breath + 4 Diamond Block + Furnace Generator MK.II.

goals.why: Furnace Generator upgrades: Furnace Generator MK.II, Furnace Generator MK.III.

goals.text: Craft and power a generator of some kind
goals.hint: Simple Generators burn fuel, food or lava and charge machines next to them.
goals.why: Most tech machines run on FE/RF: a generator starts every tech path.
steps: Craft a Furnace Generator or any other generator.
Fuel it with coal or charcoal.
Put a machine next to it, or connect conduits or cables.

goals.hint: 4 iron plates + flint and steel + iron hoe + fishing rod + an RFTools Machine Frame + a redstone block.
goals.why: Turns spare food into steady RF.
steps: Culinary Generator MK.I: 4 iron plates + flint and steel + iron hoe + fishing rod + RFTools Machine Frame + redstone block.
Culinary Generator MK.II: 8 Culinary Generator MK.I around 1 Vibrant Crystal.
Culinary Generator MK.III: 4 Dragon Breath + 4 Diamond Block + Culinary Generator MK.II.

goals.why: Culinary Generator upgrades: Culinary Generator MK.II, Culinary Generator MK.III.

goals.hint: Fuel a Survival or Furnace Generator for FE.
goals.why: Machine power. Grid Power (GP), used by mills and some utility blocks, is separate.
steps: Craft a Survival or Furnace Generator.
Fuel it and connect an FE cable or a machine next to it.
Check power reaches the machine (GP mills don't supply FE).

goals.hint: Ender Shard + 4 redstone dust.
goals.why: The crystal is in the Machine Block, Crafter, User, Miner and Resonator recipes.
steps: Resonating Redstone Crystal: Ender Shard + 4 redstone dust.
Ender Shard: Glass Cutter + Ender Pearl.
Machine Block: 4 iron ingot + 3 redstone dust + Resonating Redstone Crystal + wooden chest.

goals.why: Chests and small parts: Eye Of Redstone, Glass Cutter, Mini Chest and 6 more.
Crystal and block parts: Coal n' Iron, Ender Shard, Machine Block and 2 more.

goals.text: Build an Extra Utilities 2 Magmatic Generator
goals.hint: Lava in, power out. Built around a Furnace Generator.
goals.why: The second SF3 generator: steady power from crucible or pumped lava.
steps: Craft it from gold, a lava bucket, redstone and an Extra Utilities 2 Furnace Generator.
Pipe or bucket lava in; connect a machine or cable.

goals.hint: First Cable: 6 glass blocks + 3 redstone dust.
goals.why: Wires carry panel power to a machine.
steps: First Cable: 6 glass block + 3 redstone dust.
Second Cable: 6 iron ingot + 3 redstone dust.

goals.why: Wires: First Cable, Second Cable, The Last Cable.

goals.text: Build Solar Panels from Solar Flux
goals.hint: Panels make power in daylight; touching panels share it.
goals.why: Free daytime power, no fuel. Higher tiers make much more.
steps: Place them under open sky, touching each other.
Connect one panel to a battery or machines; a battery covers the night.

goals.hint: Photovoltaic cell I: 3 glass blocks + 3 lapis + 3 mirrors.
goals.why: Cells step each panel tier up.
steps: Photovoltaic cell I: 3 glass block + 3 lapis + 3 Mirror.
Photovoltaic cell II: 3 Clay Ball + 3 lapis + 2 Mirror + Photovoltaic cell I.
Photovoltaic cell III: 3 glass block + 3 glowstone dust + 2 Obsidian + Photovoltaic cell II.

goals.why: Solar cells: Photovoltaic cell I, Photovoltaic cell II, Photovoltaic cell III and 1 more.

goals.hint: 3 Photovoltaic cell I + 4 Solar Panel II + a repeater + an iron block.
goals.why: More RF per panel than the first two tiers.
steps: Solar Panel I: 3 Mirror + 5 plank + redstone dust.
Solar Panel II: 8 Solar Panel I + Piston.
Solar Panel III: 3 Photovoltaic cell I + 4 Solar Panel II + Repeater + iron block.

goals.why: Solar panels: Solar Panel I, Solar Panel II, Solar Panel III and 7 more.

goals.hint: 4 cobblestone + a mirror.
goals.why: Every panel upgrade starts from a blank.
steps: Capacity upgrade: 5 redstone dust + Blank upgrade + diamond block.
Transfer rate upgrade: 6 redstone dust + 2 gold ingot + Blank upgrade.

goals.why: Panel upgrades: Blank upgrade, Capacity upgrade, Efficiency upgrade and 4 more.

goals.hint: 6 coal + 2 redstone torches + a Machine Frame.
goals.why: Early RF for the machines below, from plain coal.
steps: Coal Generator: 6 Coal + 2 Redstone Torch + Machine Frame.
Powercell Simple: 4 Redstone Block + 2 Diamond + 2 Quartz + Machine Frame.
Powercell: 4 Redstone Block + Diamond + 2 Prismarine Shard + Machine Frame + Emerald.

goals.why: Power parts: Booster, Pearl Injector, Powercell Advanced and 5 more.

goals.text: Store power in an RFTools Power Cell
goals.hint: Power cells store energy. Every side starts off: set them with a wrench.
goals.why: Stores generator overflow and keeps machines running at night or while generators refuel.
goals.tip: A new cell stays empty until its sides are set.
steps: Craft a power cell and place it between generators and machines.
Hit a side with a wrench (RFTools Smart Wrench or any wrench) to cycle it: input, output, off.
Sides at generators or cables: input. Sides feeding machines: output.

goals.hint: 5 Stone Bricks + 1 Furnace + 2 Stone Gear + 1 Piston.
goals.why: First Ender IO power source: burns fuel for FE with no capacitors needed.
steps: Gather 5 Stone Bricks, 1 Furnace, 2 Stone Gear, 1 Piston.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Stone Bricks | Stone Bricks | Stone Bricks; Middle row: Stone Bricks | Furnace | Stone Bricks; Bottom row: Stone Gear | Piston | Stone Gear.
Put fuel in it and run an Energy Conduit to a machine.

goals.text: Make a basic Ender IO capacitor and a Machine Chassis
goals.hint: Basic capacitor: copper, redstone, gold nuggets. Machine Chassis: iron bars and iron around a capacitor.
goals.why: Core ingredients of every Ender IO machine.
steps: Craft a Basic Capacitor (copper ingots, redstone, gold nuggets).
Craft the Machine Chassis: iron bars and iron ingots around the capacitor.
Build an Ender IO machine with it (the Alloy Smelter first) and power it.

goals.text: Make alloys in an Alloy Smelter
goals.hint: The alloy smelter makes electrical steel and the other Ender IO alloys.
goals.why: Ender IO machines, capacitors and conduits need its alloys (electrical steel, energetic alloy, conductive iron...).
steps: Power it; fill its three input slots (JEI lists every alloy).

goals.hint: Iron Ingot + Copper Ingot, smelted in an Alloy Smelter.
goals.why: Alloy for chargers and early conduits; it is the first alloy made in the Alloy Smelter.
steps: Insert one Iron Ingot and one Copper Ingot with fuel.

goals.hint: Mine Create's zinc ore: it drops raw zinc to smelt or crush into zinc.
goals.why: Link 1 of 3 of the Zinc for Create brass route; next: Silk-touch the ore and double it in the Ender IO SAG mill: 2 crushed zinc per ore.

goals.text: Automate cobblestone into gravel (SAG Mill or Auto Hammer)
goals.hint: The SAG Mill crushes cobblestone into gravel and doubles ore; the Auto Hammer is a powered hammer.
goals.why: Ore crushed into two dusts doubles your metal; gravel feeds the sieves.
steps: Craft a SAG Mill or an Auto Hammer.
Power it and feed cobblestone or ore; take output with a hopper or conduit.

goals.text: Use Ender IO Conduits to power several machines at once
goals.hint: One conduit block carries power, items, fluids and redstone.
goals.why: A tidy workshop: one line for everything.
steps: Run a line from a generator past your machines; it connects to each.
Add item and fluid conduits into the same blocks later.

goals.hint: 4 Iron Ingot + 4 Basic Capacitor + 1 Redstone Block.
goals.why: Stores energy for a whole conduit network so machines run through gaps.
steps: Gather 4 Iron Ingot, 4 Basic Capacitor, 1 Redstone Block.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Iron Ingot | Basic Capacitor | Iron Ingot.
Middle row: Basic Capacitor | Redstone Block | Basic Capacitor.
Bottom row: Iron Ingot | Basic Capacitor | Iron Ingot.
Place it next to your generators and conduits.

goals.hint: 4 Paper + 1 Hopper.
goals.why: Sets what an item conduit moves, so a mixed chest feeds the right machines.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Paper | empty; Middle row: Paper | Hopper | Paper; Bottom row: empty | Paper | empty.
Put the filter in a conduit's filter slot.

goals.hint: 3 Electrical Steel Ingot + 5 Fused Quartz + 1 Zombie Electrode.
goals.why: Adds another generator type to the network; its recipe centers on the Zombie Electrode.
steps: Gather 3 Electrical Steel Ingot, 5 Fused Quartz, 1 Zombie Electrode.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Electrical Steel Ingot | Electrical Steel Ingot | Electrical Steel Ingot.
Middle row: Fused Quartz | Zombie Electrode | Fused Quartz.
Bottom row: Fused Quartz | Fused Quartz | Fused Quartz.
Place it beside a conduit and feed it its fuel.

goals.hint: 2 Energetic Alloy Ingot + 2 Fused Quartz + 2 Vibrant Alloy Ingot + 2 Basic Capacitor + 1 Daylight Detector.
goals.why: Makes power from sunlight at no fuel cost.
steps: Gather 2 Energetic Alloy Ingot, 2 Fused Quartz, 2 Vibrant Alloy Ingot, 2 Basic Capacitor, 1 Daylight Detector.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Energetic Alloy Ingot | Fused Quartz | Energetic Alloy Ingot.
Middle row: Vibrant Alloy Ingot | Fused Quartz | Vibrant Alloy Ingot.
Bottom row: Basic Capacitor | Daylight Detector | Basic Capacitor.
Place it in direct daylight with a conduit to your network.

goals.hint: 4 Dark Steel Ingot + 1 Remote Awareness Upgrade + 2 Pulsating Crystal + 1 Sentient Ender + 1 Fluid Tank.
goals.why: Shows every connected chest on one screen, so you find items without walking.
steps: Gather 4 Dark Steel Ingot, 1 Remote Awareness Upgrade, 2 Pulsating Crystal, 1 Sentient Ender, 1 Fluid Tank.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Dark Steel Ingot | Remote Awareness Upgrade | Dark Steel Ingot.
Middle row: Pulsating Crystal | Sentient Ender | Pulsating Crystal.
Bottom row: Dark Steel Ingot | Fluid Tank | Dark Steel Ingot.
Attach Inventory Chests to it with conduits.

goals.hint: 6 Conduit Binder + 3 Fused Quartz or Clear Glass (a row of three glass between two rows of binder).
goals.why: Moves fluids between tanks and machines without buckets.
steps: Craft the Fluid Conduit: binders in the top and bottom rows, glass in the middle.
Run it between a tank and a machine.

goals.hint: 3 Dark Steel Ingot + 5 Fused Quartz + 1 Frank'N'Zombie.
goals.why: A player-like mob killer for farms: mobs die in front of it and drop loot.
steps: Gather 3 Dark Steel Ingot, 5 Fused Quartz, 1 Frank'N'Zombie.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Dark Steel Ingot | Dark Steel Ingot | Dark Steel Ingot.
Middle row: Fused Quartz | Frank'N'Zombie | Fused Quartz.
Bottom row: Fused Quartz | Fused Quartz | Fused Quartz.

goals.text: Paint a block with the Painting Machine
goals.hint: Painting Machine copies a block's look onto conduits and walls.
goals.why: Copies the look of any block onto conduits and machines to hide them in your base.
steps: Insert the block and paint source.
Insert the block to copy and the block to paint.

goals.hint: 2 Pulsating Crystal + 1 Ender Crystal + 2 Electrical Steel Ingot.
goals.why: A recall item that brings you back from the field without a bed trip.
steps: Gather 2 Pulsating Crystal, 1 Ender Crystal, 2 Electrical Steel Ingot.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Pulsating Crystal | Ender Crystal.
Middle row: empty | Electrical Steel Ingot | Pulsating Crystal.
Bottom row: Electrical Steel Ingot | empty | empty.
Hold it and use it while standing still.

goals.text: Automate a Sieve with a Mechanical Sieve
goals.hint: A powered sieve: hopper gravel in, drops out to storage.
goals.why: Sifting without clicking.
steps: Craft and power the mechanical sieve.
Feed gravel with a hopper; pull the output into storage.

goals.text: Automate a resource with an Auto Heavy Sieve
goals.hint: The Auto Heavy Sieve sifts compressed blocks on power.
goals.why: Nine times the drops per sift.
steps: Craft and power it; insert a mesh.
Feed it compressed gravel, sand or dust.

goals.text: Auto-compress a renewable material into compressed blocks
goals.hint: Packs 9 items into 1 compressed block automatically.
goals.why: Feeds heavy sieves and saves storage.
steps: Craft and power the auto compressor.
Feed it cobblestone, gravel or sand from a generator line.

goals.hint: 6 steel ingots + 2 heavy plates + a Compressed Diamond Hammer.
goals.why: Hammers compressed blocks automatically.
steps: Craft the machine around it (IPI / IHI / IPI).

goals.text: Process an ore piece into ingots with an Actually Additions Crusher
goals.hint: Crush ore in an Actually Additions Crusher, then smelt the dust.
goals.why: Ore doubling: one raw ore gives two dusts, two ingots.
goals.tip: Yields vary by recipe: not every input doubles.
steps: Craft the Crusher and connect FE.
Check your ore's recipe and yield in JEI.
Feed it, collect the dust and smelt it.

goals.hint: Iron Ingot + Coal Dust + Obsidian, smelted in an Alloy Smelter.
goals.why: Dark steel is the tool and armor tier, and the base of the later machines.
steps: Grind coal into dust in a SAG Mill.
Insert the iron ingot, coal dust and obsidian into the Alloy Smelter.

goals.text: Convert blocks with an Atomic Reconstructor
goals.hint: Its laser converts the block in front of it; lenses change the effect.
goals.why: Makes Actually Additions crystals (for its machines) and converts many items.
steps: Put a block in front of it or throw items into the beam.

goals.hint: 6 Planks + 2 Wood Casing + 1 Enori Crystal; stores a stack of items for quick access.
goals.why: Stores a stack of items you can reach from your inventory without opening a chest.
steps: Craft or build it as the hint says.
Place it and set its filter.

goals.hint: A Porcelain Doll in a ring of blaze powder (Blazing) or black dye (Creeping).
goals.why: The two dolls are the rare crafted items of the mod.
steps: Craft a Porcelain Doll: 5 porcelain clay and a diamond make 4 dolls.
Surround a doll with 4 dye or blaze powder, redstone, 2 glowstone dust and nether wart.

goals.hint: 8 Gold Nugget + 1 Basic Coil.
goals.why: A stronger coil needed for the Display Stand, Laser Relay and Farmer.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Gold Nugget | Gold Nugget | Gold Nugget.
Middle row: Gold Nugget | Basic Coil | Gold Nugget.
Bottom row: Gold Nugget | Gold Nugget | Gold Nugget.
Craft one from a Basic Coil and gold nuggets.

goals.hint: Energizer + Enervator + Basic Coil.
goals.why: Charges tools and items from your power network so they work without cell swaps.
steps: Craft or build it as the hint says.
Place it by a generator and put a tool in it.

goals.hint: 4 Enori Crystal Block + 4 Wheat Seeds + 1 Iron Casing.
goals.why: Plants and harvests a field of seeds on its own once powered.
steps: Gather 4 Enori Crystal Block, 4 Wheat Seeds, 1 Iron Casing.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Enori Crystal Block | Wheat Seeds | Enori Crystal Block.
Middle row: Wheat Seeds | Iron Casing | Wheat Seeds.
Bottom row: Enori Crystal Block | Wheat Seeds | Enori Crystal Block.
Place it above farmland and feed it seeds.

goals.hint: 4 Obsidian + 2 Redstone Block + 2 Restonia Crystal + 1 Advanced Coil (makes 4).
goals.why: Carries power across long distances without a cable run.
steps: Gather 4 Obsidian, 2 Redstone Block, 2 Restonia Crystal, 1 Advanced Coil.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Obsidian | Redstone Block | Obsidian.
Middle row: Restonia Crystal | Advanced Coil | Restonia Crystal.
Bottom row: Obsidian | Redstone Block | Obsidian.
Place two relays and link them with the wrench.

goals.hint: 1 ESD + 1 Advanced Coil + 1 Black Quartz + 1 Restonia Crystal.
goals.why: Holds more than the plain ESD, for a bigger quick-access stack.
steps: Gather 1 ESD, 1 Advanced Coil, 1 Black Quartz, 1 Restonia Crystal.
Combine them in the crafting grid to get Advanced Esd.
Upgrade an ESD in the crafting grid.

goals.hint: 4 Basic Coil + 2 Redstone + 2 Restonia Crystal + 1 Wooden Chest.
goals.why: Pull from and push into chests next to the relay network.
steps: Gather 4 Basic Coil, 2 Redstone, 2 Restonia Crystal, 1 Wooden Chest.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Basic Coil | Redstone | Basic Coil.
Middle row: Restonia Crystal | Wooden Chest | Restonia Crystal.
Bottom row: Basic Coil | Redstone | Basic Coil.
Set its filter in the GUI.

goals.hint: 4 Enori Crystal Block + 4 Basic Coil + 1 Restonia Crystal.
goals.why: The center of the Engineer's drill; every drill head and upgrade is added to it.
steps: Gather 4 Enori Crystal Block, 4 Basic Coil, 1 Restonia Crystal.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Enori Crystal Block | Basic Coil | Enori Crystal Block.
Middle row: Basic Coil | Restonia Crystal | Basic Coil.
Bottom row: Enori Crystal Block | Basic Coil | Enori Crystal Block.
Combine it with a drill head and a battery.

goals.hint: 4 Repeater + 1 Diamatine Crystal Block + 1 Nether Wart + 1 Potion + 1 Ring.
goals.why: Gives a passive buff while worn; every ring uses this recipe with a different potion.
steps: Gather 4 Repeater, 1 Diamatine Crystal Block, 1 Nether Wart, 1 Potion, 1 Ring.
Combine them in the crafting grid to get Ring Of Haste.

goals.text: Make Steel with a Coke Oven and Blast Furnace
goals.hint: Coke oven: coal into coal coke. Blast furnace: iron + coke into steel.
goals.why: Immersive Engineering and many other machines need steel; coal coke is a strong fuel.
steps: Craft the Engineer's Hammer and read the Engineer's Manual.
Build a 3x3x3 cube of 27 Coke Bricks and hit the middle of a side with the hammer.
Burn coal into coke. Build a 3x3x3 Blast Furnace (27 blast bricks) and smelt iron with coke into steel.

diagram.title: Coke Oven
diagram.view: A solid 3x3x3 cube of Coke Bricks; hit the middle of one side with the hammer.
diagram.note: The Blast Furnace is the same cube made of Blast Bricks.

goals.hint: 4 Waterwheel Segment + 1 Steel Ingot.
goals.why: Turns flowing water into rotation for a Dynamo, so power needs no fuel and no open sky.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Waterwheel Segment | empty.
Middle row: Waterwheel Segment | Steel Ingot | Waterwheel Segment.
Bottom row: empty | Waterwheel Segment | empty.
Place it where flowing water turns it, then attach a Dynamo.

goals.hint: 8 Windmill Blade + 1 Iron Ingot.
goals.why: Free power that needs only open sky and a Dynamo beside it.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Windmill Blade | Windmill Blade | Windmill Blade.
Middle row: Windmill Blade | Iron Ingot | Windmill Blade.
Bottom row: Windmill Blade | Windmill Blade | Windmill Blade.
Place it with an unobstructed spot and attach a Dynamo.

goals.text: Run a first LV power line
goals.hint: 3 Copper Ingot + 4 Connector Insulator (makes 4).
