goals.why: Wires join the Dynamo to machines; the capacitor smooths the supply so crushers do not stall.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Copper Ingot | empty.
Middle row: Connector Insulator | Copper Ingot | Connector Insulator.
Bottom row: Connector Insulator | Copper Ingot | Connector Insulator.
Craft a Wirecoil Copper and join Dynamo, capacitor and machine with connectors.

goals.text: Build and power an Immersive Engineering Crusher
goals.hint: Build the multiblock from the Engineer's Manual, form it with the hammer and power it.
goals.why: Crushes ores and other materials (metal equipment recycling is the Arc Furnace's job).
steps: Build the Crusher multiblock shown in the Engineer's Manual.
Hit the marked trigger block with the Engineer's Hammer.
Connect FE and put storage at the output.
Feed items into the top and collect the result. Stay out of the machinery.

obtain.immersiveengineering:crusher: Not crafted: build the multiblock shown in the Engineer's Manual and hit it with the Engineer's Hammer.

goals.hint: Presses ingots into plates, rods and gears; the Plate Mold is 3 Steel Plates + a Wirecutter at the Engineer's Workbench.
goals.why: Plates and rods are the base of steel components, wires and most later recipes.
steps: Craft the Molds blueprint and an Engineer's Workbench.
At the workbench make a Plate Mold from 3 Steel Plates and a Wirecutter.
Build the Metal Press multiblock with the Hammer, power it, load the mold and feed ingots.

goals.hint: Reinforced Blast Bricks (Blast Brick + Steel Plate) upgrade the Blast Furnace into the Improved one.
goals.why: Steel, plates and crushing for the rest of the mod.
steps: Craft Steel Plates with the Hammer.
Craft Reinforced Blast Bricks from a Blast Brick and a Steel Plate.
Build the Improved Blast Furnace multiblock with the Hammer.

goals.hint: 4 Iron Sheetmetal + 4 Component Iron + 1 Copper Ingot (makes 4).
goals.why: Used in Windmills, Dynamos and the first machines of the mod.
steps: Gather 4 Iron Sheetmetal, 4 Component Iron, 1 Copper Ingot.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Iron Sheetmetal | Component Iron | Iron Sheetmetal.
Middle row: Component Iron | Copper Ingot | Component Iron.
Bottom row: Iron Sheetmetal | Component Iron | Iron Sheetmetal.

goals.text: Grow crops in a Garden Cloche
goals.hint: 4 Glass + 1 Light Bulb + 1 Component Iron + 1 Basic Engineering.
goals.why: Grows crops, saplings and seeds under glass on power, a farm that needs no field.
steps: Gather 4 Glass, 1 Light Bulb, 1 Component Iron, 1 Basic Engineering.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Glass | Light Bulb | Glass; Middle row: Glass | Component Iron | Glass; Bottom row: empty | Basic Engineering | empty.
Pull the harvest with a hopper or conveyor.

goals.hint: Shader Bags give cosmetic shaders for gear.
goals.why: Cosmetic skins for IE gear; they do not change any stats.
steps: Open a bag and apply the shader.

goals.hint: Alloy 1 gold + 1 silver ingot into 2 electrum in the IE Alloy Kiln or the Ender IO Alloy Smelter (2,000 RF).
goals.why: Link 1 of 3 of the Electrum to Brass route; next: Create brass.

goals.hint: 3 Electrum Ingot + 4 Connector Insulator (makes 4).
goals.why: Medium voltage runs the Arc Furnace and larger machines over one line without overload.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Electrum Ingot | empty.
Middle row: Connector Insulator | Electrum Ingot | Connector Insulator.
Bottom row: Connector Insulator | Electrum Ingot | Connector Insulator.
Craft a Wirecoil Electrum and replace the main LV run.

goals.hint: 4 electrum plates + 3 copper ingots + an RFTools Machine Frame + a redstone block.
goals.why: Turns lava buckets into steady RF.
steps: Lava Generator MK.I: 4 electrum plates + 3 copper ingots + RFTools Machine Frame + redstone block.
Lava Generator MK.II: 8 Lava Generator MK.I around 1 Vibrant Crystal.
Lava Generator MK.III: 4 Dragon Breath + 4 Diamond Block + Lava Generator MK.II.

goals.why: Lava Generator upgrades: Lava Generator MK.II, Lava Generator MK.III.

goals.text: Make Brass using a Blaze-heated Mechanical Mixer
goals.hint: Catch a blaze in an empty blaze burner and put it under the basin.
goals.why: Brass unlocks Create's advanced parts: brass funnels, mechanical arms, precision mechanisms, trains.
steps: Craft an empty blaze burner and right-click a blaze with it (or catch one at a spawner).
Place it under the basin and fuel it.
Copper ingot + zinc ingot + IE electrum nugget in the basin under a running mixer = 2 brass ingots.

goals.hint: Apply a Brass Ingot to a stripped log.
goals.why: Brass casing is needed for the Mechanical Arm, the Smart Chute and every brass-tier machine.
steps: Right-click the log with a Brass Ingot.
Make a stack of casings before starting the brass machines.

goals.hint: Electron Tube over Brass Casing over Crafting Table; place a grid of them and power each.
goals.why: Crafts big grid recipes by machine, including Create's mechanical-crafting items.
steps: Place a grid of Crafters and power them.
Place a grid of crafters, power each, and set their direction.

goals.hint: Mechanical Crafting (5x5): 16 andesite alloy + 4 planks + 1 IE steel ingot makes 2; place them as a pair.
goals.why: Link 2 of 3 of the IE steel opens Create and guns route; next: first TaCZ pistols.

goals.hint: 1 Lever + 2 Andesite Alloy + 1 Brass Casing.
goals.why: Turns a glued block structure into a moving physics body, the heart of the add-on.
steps: Gather 1 Lever, 2 Andesite Alloy, 1 Brass Casing.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Lever | empty; Bottom row: Andesite Alloy | Brass Casing | Andesite Alloy.
Place it on a glued structure and power it.

goals.hint: Fill an Iron Sheet with honey using a Spout.
goals.why: Joins blocks into one body so the Assembler treats them as a single vehicle.
steps: Fill an Iron Sheet with honey.
Fill an Iron Sheet with honey from a Spout, then glue your build.

goals.text: Assemble a Simulated Contraption with a Physics Assembler
goals.hint: Glue blocks together, put a Physics Assembler on them and pull its lever: they become a physics object.
goals.why: Create Aeronautics builds real vehicles with weight and momentum; you can stand on them, and chests and machines on board keep working.
goals.tip: Every block has a mass (F3+H shows Sable Mass): wood is light, iron and stone heavy. A slime ball merges two contraptions.
steps: Craft a Physics Assembler: lever over brass casing, andesite alloy on both sides.
Build a small platform and put the assembler on top (it grabs the block under it).
Use Super Glue (or Honey Glue) on two corners to select every block of the contraption.
Hold right-click on the assembler and pull the lever: the blocks lift off and get physics.
Use any Physics Assembler on it again to turn it back into blocks.

diagram.title: A first contraption
diagram.view: Layers from the bottom: a plank platform with the assembler on top
diagram.note: Glue the whole platform before you pull the lever. Pieces that are not connected split off as their own contraption.

goals.hint: 1 Wooden Slab + 1 Industrial Iron Block + 1 Cogwheel.
goals.why: Adds a rotating part to a physics body, such as a turret or a wheel hub.
steps: Gather 1 Wooden Slab, 1 Industrial Iron Block, 1 Cogwheel.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Wooden Slab | empty; Middle row: empty | Industrial Iron Block | empty; Bottom row: empty | Cogwheel | empty.
Attach it to the body and put the moving part on top.

goals.hint: 1 Large Cogwheel + 1 Andesite Casing + 1 Shaft.
goals.why: Lets a rider steer a physics vehicle by hand.
steps: Gather 1 Large Cogwheel, 1 Andesite Casing, 1 Shaft.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Large Cogwheel; Middle row: Andesite Casing; Bottom row: Shaft.
Mount it on the vehicle and sit down to drive.

goals.hint: 1 Iron Sheet + 1 Shaft + 1 Industrial Iron Block.
goals.why: Hauls and lifts physics bodies on a rope for cranes and towed loads.
steps: Gather 1 Iron Sheet, 1 Shaft, 1 Industrial Iron Block.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Iron Sheet; Middle row: Shaft; Bottom row: Industrial Iron Block.
Mount it and run the rope to the load.

goals.hint: Build modular carts in the Cart Assembler.
goals.why: Carts that mine tunnels, lay rails, farm and chop trees.
steps: Add a hull, an engine and tool modules.
Assemble the cart and put it on rails.

goals.hint: 5 Iron Ingot + 1 Furnace + 2 Piston.
goals.why: Powers your cart so it moves without a push or a powered rail.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Iron Ingot | Iron Ingot | Iron Ingot; Middle row: Iron Ingot | Furnace | Iron Ingot; Bottom row: Piston | empty | Piston.

goals.hint: 3 Diamond + 1 Iron Ingot + 2 Component Simple Pcb + 1 Gold Ingot.
goals.why: Farms a field as the cart rolls past, planting and harvesting crops.
steps: Gather 3 Diamond, 1 Iron Ingot, 2 Component Simple Pcb, 1 Gold Ingot.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Diamond | Diamond | Diamond; Middle row: empty | Iron Ingot | empty; Bottom row: Component Simple Pcb | Gold Ingot | Component Simple Pcb.
Fit it to a cart on a rail past farmland.

goals.hint: 5 Component Saw Blade + 1 Iron Ingot + 1 Component Wood Cutting Core.
goals.why: Cuts trees as the cart passes for wood without stopping to chop.
steps: Gather 5 Component Saw Blade, 1 Iron Ingot, 1 Component Wood Cutting Core.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Component Saw Blade | Component Saw Blade | Component Saw Blade.
Middle row: Component Saw Blade | Iron Ingot | Component Saw Blade.
Bottom row: empty | Component Wood Cutting Core | empty.
Fit it to a cart on a rail past trees.

goals.hint: 3 Gold Ingot + 2 Iron Ingot + 3 Component Advanced Pcb + 1 Redstone.
goals.why: Lets a cart dig tunnels on its own along the rails.
steps: Gather 3 Gold Ingot, 2 Iron Ingot, 3 Component Advanced Pcb, 1 Redstone.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Gold Ingot | Gold Ingot | Gold Ingot.
Middle row: Iron Ingot | Component Advanced Pcb | Iron Ingot.
Bottom row: Component Advanced Pcb | Redstone | Component Advanced Pcb.
Fit it with a drill module.

goals.text: Move items with Extra Utilities 2 Transfer Nodes
goals.hint: A Transfer Node on a chest pulls items out into transfer pipes.
goals.why: Cheap SF3 item transport: one node per source, pipes to any inventory; upgrades add speed and stack size.
steps: Craft transfer pipes (smooth stone slabs, glass, redstone) and an Item Transfer Node.
Place the node on the side of the source chest.
Run pipes to the destination: items travel on their own.

goals.hint: Same layout as the item node, with a bucket instead of a chest.
goals.why: Moves fluids between tanks and machines.
steps: Transfer Node (Fluids): 2 redstone dust + Transfer Pipe + 2 Stone + Bucket.
Retrieval Node (Items): 2 Ender Pearl + 2 Transfer Node (Items) + emerald.
Retrieval Node (Fluids): 2 Ender Pearl + 2 Transfer Node (Fluids) + diamond.

goals.hint: Build a Resonator, then a Crusher and later an Enchanter.
goals.why: Grid Power is a separate budget from FE; these machines need it, and generators and mills make it.
steps: Resonator: 2 redstone dust + obsidian + 5 iron ingot + Resonating Redstone Crystal.
Crusher: 6 iron ingot + 2 piston + Machine Block.
Enchanter: Enchanted Book + 2 diamond + Machine Block + 2 iron ingot + Redstone Gear.
Power Manager: Resonating Redstone Crystal + 4 stone.

goals.why: Machine upgrades: Magical Speed Upgrade, Speed Upgrade, Ultimate Speed Upgrade and 2 more.
Grid Power machines: Crusher, Electric Furnace, Enchanter and 6 more.

goals.text: Lay spikes as a mob trap
goals.hint: Spikes in wood, stone, iron, gold and diamond; drums hold fluid.
goals.why: A spike floor kills mobs without a weapon.
steps: Wooden Spikes: 3 Wooden Sword + 3 Oak Planks + Oak Log.
Iron Spike: 3 Iron Sword + 3 iron ingot + iron block.
Diamond Spikes: 3 Diamond Sword + 3 diamond + diamond block.

goals.why: Spikes and drums: Diamond Spike, Golden Spike, Iron Drum and 22 more.

goals.text: Blast Coal and Iron into Steel
goals.hint: Blast Coal and Iron in a Blast Furnace; 9 steel nuggets also make an ingot.
goals.why: Steel ingots become Steel Blocks and nuggets for the heavier recipes.
steps: Coal n' Iron: 3 iron nugget + iron ingot + coal.

goals.hint: Ender Lilly plants generate in the world.
goals.why: A plant source tied to the ender line.

goals.hint: Every fuel generator is a Furnace Generator plus its own fuel parts.
goals.why: Each type burns something different, so pick one that fits what your base makes.
steps: Ender Generator: 4 ender pearl + Ender Eye + Gilded Obsidian + 2 redstone dust + Furnace Generator.
Culinary Generator: 5 crop + cooked meat food + 2 redstone dust + Furnace Generator.
Death Generator: 5 rotten + Spider Eye + 2 redstone dust + Furnace Generator.
Explosive Generator: 5 gunpowder + Tnt + 2 redstone dust + Furnace Generator.

goals.why: Generators: Culinary Generator, Death Generator, Disenchantment Generator and 16 more.

goals.hint: Dropper + Resonating Redstone Crystal + Lever.
goals.why: Uses items on the block in front of it; pair it with a Mechanical Miner for automatic farms.
steps: Mechanical User: Dropper + Resonating Redstone Crystal + Lever.
Mechanical Miner: Dropper + Resonating Redstone Crystal + Iron Pickaxe.
Mechanical Crafter: Dropper + Resonating Redstone Crystal + Crafting Table.

goals.why: Mechanical machines: Mechanical Crafter, Mechanical Miner, Mechanical User.

goals.text: Move items with a Hopper Duct
goals.hint: A duct carries items like a hopper but doesn't pull from the container above.
goals.why: A cheap item pipe that moves items like a hopper in the direction you aim it.
goals.tip: A duct only carries what is fed in; it doesn't pull from chests.
steps: Place a hopper pulling from the source.
Point it into a duct route ending at the destination.
Check the duct direction, then send a few test items.

goals.hint: 1 iron bars + 1 hopper.
goals.why: A hopper variant in the Hopper Ducts group.
steps: Craft it from 1 iron bars + 1 hopper.
Place it under a chest or machine.

goals.text: Catch dropped items with a Funnel
goals.hint: A funnel on a chest collects items that fall into it.
goals.why: Drops from mob farms and broken blocks go straight into a chest.
steps: Place it on top of a chest where items fall.

goals.text: Craft a Charset Pipe and Shifter
goals.hint: Shifters push items or fluids into pipes; pipes carry them to inventories.
goals.why: Cheap item and fluid transport before power-hungry networks.

goals.text: Power a Shifter and move items through connected pipes
goals.hint: A redstone signal runs a Shifter; a held redstone torch changes its mode.
goals.why: Your first automated item line: items move between chests on their own.
steps: Place a Shifter between the source and a Charset Pipe, facing the pipe.
Connect the pipe to the destination.
Use a held redstone torch on the Shifter to cycle Auto, Extract and Shift; rotate it with a stick or Charset Wrench.
Power it with redstone and check items move.

goals.text: Use a Shifter to transfer fluid through a Charset Pipe
goals.hint: Put a tank behind the shifter instead of a chest.
goals.why: Move water or lava between tanks without buckets.
steps: Put a tank behind the shifter.
End the pipe at another tank and power the shifter.

goals.text: Set and clear an item or fluid filter on a Shifter
goals.hint: Click a side with an item to filter it; empty hand clears it.
goals.why: Move only what you want: one pipe line can sort.
steps: Use a sample item on a non-output face of the Shifter to set its filter.
For fluids, use a filled bucket or fluid container as the sample.
Right-click the face with an empty hand to clear the filter.
Run a small transfer to check it.

goals.hint: Two Item Translocators in the one-block gap between two inventories.
goals.why: Very fast item transfer between nearby inventories.
goals.tip: Basic transfer needs no redstone; redstone control is an upgrade.
steps: Leave one air block between the inventories and put an Item Translocator on each inward face.
Use their center controls: source to eject, destination to insert.
Send a small test stack to check the direction.
Add upgrades only for speed, filters or redstone control.

goals.text: Place a Translocator between two inventories
goals.hint: 4 redstone + 1 ender pearl + 2 iron ingots + 1 piston + 1 gold ingot.
goals.why: Moves items without pipes.
steps: Craft it from 4 redstone + 1 ender pearl + 2 iron ingots + 1 piston + 1 gold ingot.
Put a second inventory on the other side.

goals.text: Move fluid with a Fluid Translocator
goals.hint: 4 redstone + 1 ender pearl + 2 iron ingots + 1 piston + 1 lapis lazuli.
goals.why: Moves fluid between tanks.
steps: Craft it from 4 redstone + 1 ender pearl + 2 iron ingots + 1 piston + 1 lapis lazuli.

goals.hint: 4 blaze rods + 1 black wool + 2 obsidian + 1 chest + 1 ender pearl.
goals.why: Chests with the same three colors share their contents.
steps: Craft it from 4 blaze rods + 1 wool + 2 obsidian + 1 chest + 1 ender pearl.
Place it and set the three colors.
Place a second one with the same colors.

goals.text: Link an Ender Pouch to an Ender Chest
goals.hint: Ender chests and pouches with the same three-color code share one inventory.
goals.why: The same inventory from anywhere, even other dimensions.
goals.tip: Anyone with the same public code shares the contents: check the owner controls before storing valuables.
steps: Place an EnderStorage chest and set its three-color code with dyes.
Sneak-right-click the chest with an Ender Pouch to copy its code.
Open the pouch and check a test item shows in both.

goals.hint: 4 blaze powder + 3 leather + 1 ender pearl + 1 black wool.
goals.why: Carry a link to an Ender Chest in your pocket.
steps: Craft it from 4 blaze powder + 3 leather + 1 ender pearl + 1 black wool.
Set it to the chest colors.

goals.text: Collect nearby drops with a Random Things Item Collector
goals.hint: An Item Collector on storage picks up drops within 3 blocks.
goals.why: Collects farm drops automatically.
steps: Craft the Item Collector and attach it to an inventory.
Drop a test item within 3 blocks and check it goes in.
Keep space free; the Advanced Collector has adjustable range and filters.

goals.hint: A collector with filter slots.
goals.why: Pulls only the items you choose.
steps: Advanced Item Collector: Craft: 1 Redstone torch + 2 Glowstone dust + 1 Item Collector
Place it where drops fall and set its filter

goals.text: Redirect a dropped item into connected storage
goals.hint: An Item Redirector steers dropped items moving across it.
goals.why: Steer item streams into the right chest.
goals.tip: It steers dropped items; it is not a pipe into a chest.
steps: Place an Item Redirector in the path of moving dropped items.
Use a stick on its output side to set where items go; sneak-use the stick to set the input side.
Send a test item from the input side and check its new path.
End the path at a hopper or Item Collector on storage.

goals.hint: 6 quartz enriched irons + 2 sticky pistons.
goals.why: Prints processors and builds the bigger parts and upgrades.
steps: Craft it from 6 quartz enriched iron + 2 sticky pistons.
Place it and feed the recipe inputs.

goals.why: Collect the network basics as you unlock them.

goals.hint: Solder it; the Disk Drive and the Crafter each need two.
goals.why: Needed for the Disk Drive, Crafter and grids.
steps: Make printed processors in the Solderer.
Assemble the Basic, Improved and Advanced Processors.

goals.text: Create a Refined Storage system to store your things
goals.hint: Controller + cables + disk drive + storage disks make one searchable network.
goals.why: Every item in one searchable terminal; it also runs autocrafting later.
steps: Craft and power a Solderer (quartz-enriched iron, sticky pistons): it makes the processors (printed processor, redstone, printed silicon).
Craft a Controller, cables, a Disk Drive, a Grid and storage disks.
Power the controller and connect everything with cables.
Put disks in the drive and open the grid.

goals.hint: 2 glass blocks + 3 redstone + 1 1k storage part + 3 quartz enriched irons.
goals.why: The disk where network items are stored.
steps: Craft the 1k Storage Part (4 silicon + 1 quartz enriched iron + 3 glass + 1 redstone).
Put it in the Disk Drive.

goals.hint: 4 quartz enriched irons + 1 construction core + 2 improved processors + 1 machine casing + 1 destruction core.
goals.why: The window onto the network: look and take items.
steps: Craft it from 4 quartz enriched iron + construction and destruction cores + 2 improved processors + a machine casing.

goals.hint: 1 construction core + 3 quartz enriched irons + 1 destruction core + 2 chests + 1 cable + 1 improved processor.
goals.why: Chests, barrels and drawers count as network storage.
steps: Craft it from 2 chests + a cable + cores + an improved processor.

goals.hint: 1 cable + 1 destruction core + 1 improved processor.
goals.why: Pulls items from a machine or chest into the network.
steps: Craft it from 1 cable + 1 destruction core + 1 improved processor.

goals.why: Collect the network machines and storage blocks as you unlock them.

goals.hint: 1 cable + 1 construction core + 1 improved processor.
goals.why: Pushes network items into a machine on a filter.
steps: Craft it from 1 cable + 1 construction core + 1 improved processor.
Place it on the machine and set the filter.

goals.hint: 4 quartz enriched irons + 4 papers + 1 hopper.
goals.why: Filter what a grid shows.
steps: Craft it from 4 quartz enriched iron + 4 paper + 1 hopper.

goals.hint: Pair with a Reader to link two networks.
goals.why: Shares items across two networks.
steps: Craft a Reader and link them.

goals.text: Autocraft with a Refined Storage Crafter
goals.hint: Encode patterns in the Pattern Grid and put them in a Crafter.
goals.why: Request 64 of anything and the network crafts it from stored ingredients.
goals.tip: Only processing patterns need an outside machine.
steps: Connect a Crafter to the powered network.
Encode a crafting pattern in the Pattern Grid and put it in the Crafter.
Store the ingredients in the network and request the item from a Crafting Grid.
Processing patterns: face the Crafter at the machine and send its output back to the network.

goals.hint: Holds billions of one item. Needs four Obsidian Chests and an Ender IO Machine Chassis.
goals.why: Perfect for cobblestone, dirt or ores from automation.
steps: Make four Obsidian Chests and an Ender IO Machine Chassis.
Pipe items in from any side.

goals.hint: 3 obsidian + 5 iron ingots + 1 item frame.
goals.why: Shows the stored item on the front of the DSU.
steps: Craft it from 3 obsidian + 5 iron ingots + 1 item frame.
Put it in the DSU upgrade slot.

goals.text: Convert storage safely between a DSU and a Vast Storage Unit
goals.hint: A DSU alone in the center of the grid becomes a VSU, and back. Empty it first.
goals.why: The VSU shows its contents on a Simple Labels label.
steps: Empty the DSU first: converting deletes the stored items.
Put it alone in the center of the crafting grid.

goals.text: Fill a Quantum DSU with a renewable resource
goals.hint: Pipe a renewable resource into a DSU until it is full.
goals.why: An optional long-term stockpile challenge.
goals.tip: A huge endgame number, not needed for normal storage.
steps: Connect a renewable source to a DSU with enough transport.
Keep the source and storage loaded while you play.
Watch the count and plan for overflow (stop or void).
Tick this when the DSU is full.

goals.hint: 2 ender pearls + 4 obsidian chests + 1 Reinforced Large Drum + 2 iron ingots.
goals.why: Stores a huge amount of one fluid.
steps: Craft the Reinforced Large Drum (Extra Utilities 2).
Craft the tank from 2 ender pearls + 4 obsidian chests + the drum + 2 iron ingots.

goals.hint: Storage modules hold items; a Storage Scanner searches them.
goals.why: Carryable storage modules with a searchable interface.
steps: Craft the modular storage block and a storage module.
Insert the module and store items.

goals.text: Store Chisels & Bits bits in a Bit Drawer
goals.hint: A Bit Drawer (Drawers & Bits) stores bits by block type.
goals.why: Holds Chisels & Bits bits by type, so your sculpting stock stays sorted.

goals.hint: 4 iron ingots + 4 intermedium essence around a tier 3 crafting seed = Iron Seeds.
goals.why: An endless iron farm with no mining.
steps: Upgrade essence around an Infusion Crystal: 4 inferium = prudentium; 4 prudentium = intermedium (the crystal is reused).
Craft a crafting seed and upgrade it to tier 3 with prudentium, then intermedium (JEI shows each step).
Craft Iron Seeds: 4 iron ingots and 4 intermedium essence around the tier 3 crafting seed.
Plant them on farmland; 8 iron essence craft into iron ingots.

goals.text: Use Growth Crystals or Growth Accelerators to speed up crops
goals.hint: Growth accelerators under the farmland (or a growth crystal nearby) speed up crops.
goals.why: Resource crops are slow; accelerators make them much faster.
steps: Craft growth accelerators (stone, inferium blocks, diamond) or a growth crystal.
Stack accelerators under the farmland (a taller column = faster), or place the crystal near the crops.

goals.text: Craft a Soulium Dagger and collect mob chunks
goals.hint: Kill mobs for mob chunks; chunk + essence around a crafting seed = mob seed.
goals.why: Mob seeds grow bones, string, gunpowder, ender pearls and blaze rods without a mob farm.
steps: Craft the Soulium Dagger (soulium ingots on a mystical tool rod) and kill mobs with it.
Collect mob chunks. Smelting a chunk gives a blank chunk; a blank chunk ringed with the mob's item (8 rotten flesh = Zombie Chunk) makes a chunk on purpose.
Craft the mob seed: the chunk and the matching essence around a crafting seed.

goals.text: Collect a chunk from every mob
goals.hint: Kill each mob type with the Soulium Dagger.
goals.why: Chunks make the mob seeds.
steps: Craft the Soulium Dagger: golden sword + 2 soulium ingots + 2 soulium dust.
Kill pigs, cows, chickens, sheep, rabbits, creepers and the rest.

goals.hint: Infuse the chicken seed base with 4 chicken materials and 4 chicken essence.
goals.why: A chicken crop gives eggs and feathers from a field.
steps: Gather 4 chicken materials and 4 chicken essence.
Infuse them around the seed base, materials and essence alternating.

goals.hint: Infuse the coal seed base with 4 coal and 4 coal essence.
goals.why: A coal crop grows fuel without mining.
steps: Infuse them around the seed base, coal and essence alternating.

goals.hint: Infuse the aluminum seed base with 4 aluminum and 4 aluminum essence.
goals.why: An aluminum crop makes aluminum without mining.
steps: Gather 4 aluminum ingots and 4 aluminum essence.
Infuse them around the seed base, ingots and essence alternating.

goals.text: Upgrade your mob farm to kill monsters automatically
goals.hint: Spikes or a Mob Masher saw kill mobs; an Absorption Hopper collects drops and XP.
goals.why: Drops and XP while you do other things.
steps: Put spikes or a saw at the kill spot.
Add an absorption hopper for drops and XP.

goals.hint: 3 Iron Sword + 1 Iron Block (makes 4).
goals.why: Damages mobs that walk over them, the passive kill in a mob farm.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Iron Sword | empty; Bottom row: Iron Sword | Iron Block | Iron Sword.
Place them in the kill room.

goals.hint: 1 Ender Eye + 3 Obsidian + 1 Hopper.
goals.why: Pulls item drops from the kill zone into a chest or hopper line.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Ender Eye | empty; Middle row: empty | Obsidian | empty; Bottom row: Obsidian | Hopper | Obsidian.

goals.hint: 6 Sound Muffler + 2 Dragon Breath + 1 Dragon Egg.
goals.why: Quiets the Ender Dragon's roar so a long fight is easier on the ears.
steps: Gather 6 Sound Muffler, 2 Dragon Breath, 1 Dragon Egg.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Sound Muffler | Sound Muffler | Sound Muffler.
Middle row: Dragon Breath | Dragon Egg | Dragon Breath.
Bottom row: Sound Muffler | Sound Muffler | Sound Muffler.

goals.text: Stop mob spawns around your base with a Mega Torch
goals.hint: A Mega Torch stops normal hostile spawns in its range.
goals.why: Fewer night spawns around your builds.
goals.tip: It doesn't remove existing mobs or stop spawners, raids or special modded spawns.
steps: Craft the Mega Torch and place it in the area to protect.
Check its range display or settings and cover gaps.
Seal entrances and deal with mobs already there.

goals.hint: Obsidian and glass panes make the stronger spawn blocker.
goals.why: Stops hostile spawns in a larger radius than the Mega Torch.
steps: Craft the Dread Lamp from obsidian and glass panes.
Place it in the middle of your base.

goals.hint: Craft: 1 Nether Star + 2 Ghast Tear + 1 Wand Core + 1 Diamond.
goals.why: The capturing and potion wands need an advanced core.
steps: Kill the Wither for a Nether Star.
Craft the core around a Wand Core.

goals.text: Pick up a mob with a Capturing Wand
goals.hint: Right-click a mob to capture it; right-click a block to release it.
goals.why: Move animals and mobs to your farms without leads.
steps: Right-click a mob to capture it.
Right-click a block to release it.

goals.hint: Combine 4 corrupted essence, 4 vile dust and 1 iron ingot.
goals.why: The ingot is the shard-line material for the Cage and the Vile Sword.
steps: Craft: 4 corrupted essence + 4 vile dust + 1 iron ingot.

goals.hint: The pattern file asks for obsidian corners, quartz blocks on the sides and glowstone in the middle, with a diamond as catalyst.
goals.why: A new shard starts unbound; killing a mob type with it in your inventory binds and raises it.
steps: Place obsidian at the four corners of a 3x3.
Place quartz blocks on the four sides.
Use a diamond as catalyst on the pattern to receive a shard.

goals.hint: A Vile Sword is 2 corrupted ingots and a wooden rod.
goals.why: Kills with the sword count toward a bound shard; the Soul Stealer enchantment adds souls per kill.
steps: Add Soul Stealer for +1 soul per level per kill.

goals.text: Craft a Soul Cage for Soul Shards
goals.hint: Diamond on an obsidian-quartz-glowstone square = Soul Shard; kills fill it; a Soul Cage spawns that mob.
goals.why: Soul shards and Ender IO soul vials are one system: both feed the powered spawner.
steps: Build a flat 3x3: obsidian corners, quartz blocks on the edges, glowstone in the middle.
Right-click the glowstone with a diamond for an unbound Soul Shard.
Kill one kind of mob with the shard in your inventory: it binds and levels up.
Craft the Soul Cage (corrupted ingots + iron bars; corrupted ingots = vile dust from smelted soul sand, corrupted essence and iron) and put the shard in.

goals.hint: Engineer's Workshop: put a furnace or crafting table in a module slot and add fuel.
goals.why: One table runs several crafting and smelting modules from one fuel slot.
steps: Craft the workshop table and place it.

goals.text: Add a crafting or furnace module to the Workshop
goals.hint: Each module slot runs one machine.
goals.why: One table smelts and crafts at once.
steps: Put a furnace or crafting table item into a module slot.

goals.hint: 4 Iron Ingot + 2 Redstone + 2 Lapis Lazuli + 1 Workshop Upgrade Blank.
goals.why: Raises the Workshop crafting speed so big batches finish sooner.
steps: Gather 4 Iron Ingot, 2 Redstone, 2 Lapis Lazuli, 1 Workshop Upgrade Blank.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Iron Ingot | Redstone | Iron Ingot.
Middle row: Lapis Lazuli | Workshop Upgrade Blank | Lapis Lazuli.
Bottom row: Iron Ingot | Redstone | Iron Ingot.
Insert it in an upgrade slot.

goals.text: Automate a Workshop recipe with an Auto Crafter upgrade
goals.hint: The Auto Crafter upgrade makes the crafting module craft by itself.
goals.why: Crafts whenever the ingredients are there.
steps: Craft the Auto Crafter upgrade and put it in an upgrade slot.
Set the recipe in a crafting module and feed ingredients.

goals.text: Expand the Workshop with a storage upgrade
goals.hint: A storage upgrade gives the workshop more inventory.
goals.why: Automation runs longer between emptying.
steps: Craft the storage upgrade and put it in an upgrade slot.

goals.text: Pack items into blocks with an AutoPackager
goals.hint: Packs 4 or 9 items into their block automatically.
goals.why: Compacts ingots, nuggets and gems to save storage.
steps: Craft the AutoPackager and connect FE.
Feed it with a hopper or pipe; put storage on its output side.
Right-click with an empty hand to cycle the crafting mode.
Feed enough identical items for a 2x2 or 3x3 recipe and check the output.

goals.hint: Needs 1000 FE per cycle; the buffer holds 20000 FE and takes up to 2000 FE per tick.
goals.why: Without power it packs nothing.
steps: Run an energy cable into it from any generator.

goals.hint: Five modes: Hybrid (3x3, then 2x2), Small (2x2), Large (3x3), Hollow (8 around) and Unpackage.
goals.why: Hybrid packs every compressible item with no setup.

goals.text: Make hollow crafts with Hollow mode
goals.hint: Hollow mode fills 8 slots around the center for recipes with a ring shape.
goals.why: Automates ring recipes such as frames.
steps: Put the ring item and the center item in.

goals.hint: Unpackage mode reverses a compression recipe.
goals.why: Reclaims ingots or nuggets from storage blocks.

goals.text: Craft automatically with an RFTools Crafter
goals.hint: A powered crafter runs recipes by itself.
goals.why: Crafts components from ingredients piped in.
steps: Set a recipe in its grid.
Pipe ingredients in and results out.

goals.text: Show live information on an RFTools Screen
goals.hint: Screens show power, inventories and more.
goals.why: Power, storage and machine status at a glance.
steps: Craft a screen and a screen controller; place them near each other.
Add modules (energy, inventory, clock) to the screen.

goals.text: Quarry or copy an area with the RFTools Builder
goals.hint: The Builder quarries or copies an area set by a card.
goals.why: Quarry huge areas or copy builds automatically.
steps: Craft the Builder and the card: quarry card to mine, shape card to build.
Set the area with the card and preview the bounds.
Connect FE and storage for mined blocks or building materials.
Test on a small area first.

goals.text: Infuse a machine to 100% with the Machine Infuser
goals.hint: Infuse an RFTools machine with dimensional shards: it uses less power.
goals.why: Infused RFTools machines use less power and work better.
steps: Craft and power the Machine Infuser.
Put an RFTools machine and dimensional shards in.

goals.hint: The ore drops dimensional shards.
goals.why: 8 shards and a diamond make an Infused Diamond, used by the Scanner, Projector and Machine Infuser.
steps: Machine Infuser: 4 Dimensional Shard + 2 Redstone + 2 Diamond + Machine Frame.

goals.why: Shard and infusion parts: Dimensional Shard, Dimensional Shard Ore, Infused Diamond and 2 more.
Infused machines: Machine Infuser.

goals.hint: 4 diamonds + 4 ender pearls + a Machine Frame.
goals.why: A pearl-fed generator; the Pearl Injector feeds it.
steps: Endergenic: 4 Diamond + 4 Ender Pearl + Machine Frame.
Pearl Injector: chest + 2 Redstone + Machine Frame + Hopper.

goals.hint: Screen Controller: 4 redstone + ender pearl + 3 glass + Machine Frame.
goals.why: Each module puts one live readout or button on the Screen.
steps: Screen Controller: 4 Redstone + Ender Pearl + 3 Glass + Machine Frame.
Text Module: Paper + 2 Redstone + Iron Ingot + black dye.
Energy Module: 3 Redstone + Iron Ingot + black dye.

goals.why: Screen modules: Button Module, Clock Module, Computer Module and 16 more.

goals.text: Add a Storage Terminal and Scanner
goals.hint: Storage Terminal: 2 paper + 4 glass + 2 ender pearls + Machine Base.
goals.why: Browse every Modular Storage module from one screen.
steps: Storage Module: chest + 2 Gold Nugget + Iron Ingot + 2 Quartz + Redstone.
Storage Terminal: 2 Paper + 4 Glass + 2 Ender Pearl + Machine Base.
Storage Scanner: 4 Redstone Torch + 2 Ender Pearl + 2 Gold Ingot + Machine Frame.

goals.why: Storage parts: Remote Scanner, Remote Storage, Storage Module and 2 more.

goals.text: Link a Matter Transmitter to a Receiver
goals.hint: Build a Transmitter and a Receiver, then dial it with the Dialing Device.
goals.why: Moves you between bases without carrying anything.
steps: Matter Transmitter: 3 Ender Pearl + 2 Redstone + Machine Frame + 3 Iron Ingot.
Matter Receiver: 3 Iron Ingot + 2 Redstone + Machine Frame + 3 Ender Pearl.
Dialing Device: 6 Redstone + 2 Redstone Torch + Machine Frame.
Matter Booster: 4 Redstone Block + Destination Analyzer.

goals.why: Porters and security cards: Advanced Charged Porter, Charged Porter, Orphaning Card and 3 more.
Teleport parts: Destination Analyzer, Dialing Device, Matter Beamer and 4 more.

goals.hint: Crafter tiers 2 and 3 are upgrades of the first Crafter.
goals.why: More recipe slots per crafter.
steps: Crafter1: 2 Redstone Torch + 2 Crafting Table + Machine Frame.

goals.why: Crafter tiers: Crafter3.

goals.hint: Shape Card: 4 paper + 2 bricks + 2 redstone + iron ingot. Composer: 4 paper + 4 bricks + Machine Frame.
goals.why: Shapes set what the Builder quarries, copies or moves.
steps: Shape Card: 4 Paper + 2 Brick + 2 Redstone + Iron Ingot.
Scanner: 4 Infused Diamond + Ender Pearl + 2 Quartz + Machine Frame + Redstone.
Space Chamber: 4 blue dye + 4 Glass + Machine Frame.

goals.why: Builder tools: Composer, Locator, Projector and 5 more.

goals.hint: 4 ender pearls + a diamond block + gold block + iron block + emerald block around a Machine Frame.
goals.why: Applies its modules (speed, flight, regeneration and more) to a zone.
steps: Environmental Controller: 4 Ender Pearl + Diamond Block + Gold Block + Machine Frame + Iron Block + Emerald Block.
Speed Module: Syringe + 2 Redstone + Gold Ingot + Ink Sac.
Flight Module: Syringe + 2 Redstone + Gold Ingot + Ink Sac.

goals.why: Environmental modules: Blindness Module, Featherfalling Module, Featherfallingplus Module and 19 more.

goals.hint: Sequencer: 4 redstone + 4 redstone torches + Machine Base.
goals.why: Timed redstone for doors, farms and machines.
steps: Sequencer Block: 4 Redstone + 4 Redstone Torch + Machine Base.
Timer Block: 4 Redstone + Clock + 3 Redstone Torch + Machine Base.
Level Emitter: 2 Paper + Comparator + 2 Ender Pearl + 3 Glass + Machine Base.

goals.why: Logic blocks: Counter Block, Elevator, Ender Monitor and 11 more.

goals.hint: Shield Block: 2 gold ingots + redstone torch + 2 redstone + Machine Frame + 3 obsidian.
goals.why: A shield wall around a base; the Projector shapes it.
steps: Shield Block1: 2 Gold Ingot + Redstone Torch + 2 Redstone + Machine Frame + 3 Obsidian.
Projector: 4 Infused Diamond + Glass + 2 Glowstone Dust + Machine Frame + Redstone.
Shield Template Block: 6 White Wool + 2 blue dye + Glass.

goals.why: Shield blocks: Block Protector, Camo Shield Block, Invisible Shield Block and 9 more.

goals.hint: 6 Conduit Binder + 3 Redstone Alloy Ingot (makes 8).
goals.why: Carries a redstone signal along the network, so machines switch on and off remotely.
steps: Gather 6 Conduit Binder, 3 Redstone Alloy Ingot.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Conduit Binder | Conduit Binder | Conduit Binder.
Middle row: Redstone Alloy Ingot | Redstone Alloy Ingot | Redstone Alloy Ingot.
Bottom row: Conduit Binder | Conduit Binder | Conduit Binder.
Run it between a switch and a machine.

goals.hint: Craft: 2 Conductive Iron Ingot + 2 Basic Capacitor + 2 Insulated Redstone Conduit + 2 Basic Gear + 1 Redstone Dust.
goals.why: A jetpack needs two thrusters of its tier.
steps: Craft two thrusters; they use conductive iron, basic capacitors and conduits from Ender IO.

goals.hint: Tier 1 jetpack: conductive iron, basic capacitor, leather strap, two thrusters.
goals.why: Your first flight: short hops and climbs on RF. Higher tiers fly longer and faster.
steps: Make conductive iron in the Ender IO alloy smelter and craft two tier 1 thrusters.
Craft the jetpack and charge it in an energy cell or charger.
Wear it and hold jump to fly. Jetpack keys (Controls) toggle it and hover mode.

goals.hint: Craft: 5 Silicon (any) + 4 Iron Ingot.
goals.why: Plating turns a jetpack or flux pack into its armored version.
steps: Craft plating 1 from silicon and iron ingots.
Plates 2-4 come from an Ender IO alloy smelter.

goals.hint: Craft a particle item and apply it to your jetpack.
goals.why: A trail you can see; choose smoke, none, default or rainbow.
steps: Apply it to your jetpack in a crafting grid.

goals.text: Take flight with a ring or jetpack
goals.hint: Fly with a Simply Jetpack (Age 4), the Angel Ring (Age 5) or Draconic flight (Age 6).
goals.why: Building and exploring get much easier.
steps: Craft a flight item and meet the power or gear needs in its tooltip.
Equip or carry it and turn its flight on.
Fly a short test near the ground and check its energy use first.

goals.hint: Craft: 6 Logs + 2 Ender Eye + 1 Exchanger Core (Tier 1).
goals.why: The first exchanger; each later one is crafted from the one before.
steps: Craft it from 6 logs, 2 ender eyes and the core.

goals.hint: An Exchanger swaps blocks in place for the block you pick.
goals.why: Turn a cobblestone wall into bricks in seconds.
steps: Craft an Exchanger Core (logs, red dye, ender pearl) and the wooden exchanger (logs, eyes of ender, core).
Sneak-right-click a block to pick it as the new material.
Right-click blocks to swap them; higher tiers swap a bigger area.

goals.hint: Craft: 5 Stones + 1 Exchanger Core (Tier 1) + 2 Ender Eye + 1 Wooden Exchanger.
goals.why: Swaps a larger area than wood.
steps: Craft it around a Wooden Exchanger.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Iron Ingot + 2 Lapis + 2 Ender Eye + 1 Exchanger Core (Tier 1).
goals.why: Golden and iron exchangers need a tier 2 core.
steps: Craft it around a Tier 1 core.

goals.hint: Craft: 5 Gold Ingot + 1 Exchanger Core (Tier 2) + 2 Ender Eye + 1 Stone Exchanger.
goals.why: The next rung of the exchanger ladder, after stone.
steps: Craft it around a Stone Exchanger.

goals.hint: Craft: 5 Iron Ingot + 1 Exchanger Core (Tier 2) + 2 Ender Eye + 1 Golden Exchanger.
goals.why: The exchanger the first goal calls for in its mid tier.
steps: Craft it around a Golden Exchanger.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Diamond + 2 Emerald (any) + 2 Diamond Block + 1 Exchanger Core (Tier 2).
goals.why: Diamond, emerald, obsidian and end exchangers need a tier 3 core.
steps: Craft it around a Tier 2 core.

goals.hint: Long Fall Boots stop all fall damage.
goals.why: No more fall damage while worn.
goals.tip: They don't protect from lava, the void or every modded damage.
steps: Craft the boots and wear them.
Check they are still on before working at height.

goals.text: Store experience in an XP Ring
goals.hint: An XP Ring soaks up nearby XP orbs; right-click to take the XP back.
goals.why: Keep XP safe until you enchant or repair.
goals.tip: It stores orbs you pick up, not levels you already have.
steps: Craft an XP Ring and keep it in your inventory.
Collect XP near it; its tooltip shows Internal Experience.
Right-click while holding it to get all stored XP back.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Experience Bottle + 4 Ring O' Experience + 1 Iron Block.
goals.why: Stores the most experience of the three rings.
steps: Craft the Ring O' Experience first, then the greater ring around 4 of them.

goals.text: Upgrade to a Diamond Backpack with a Magnet Upgrade
goals.hint: Upgrade the backpack tier by tier in the grid; a magnet upgrade pulls items to you.
goals.why: Far more space, and drops fly to you.
steps: Upgrade the backpack in the crafting grid: iron, gold, diamond.
Craft a magnet upgrade and put it in an upgrade slot.

goals.hint: 5 obsidian + 2 ender pearls + 2 blaze rods.
goals.why: A Sophisticated Core item that links storage across a distance.
steps: Craft it from 5 obsidian + 2 ender pearls + 2 blaze rods.

goals.hint: 4 Log + 4 Iron Ingot + 1 Redstone Block.
goals.why: The base of the first machines.
steps: Gather 4 Log, 4 Iron Ingot, 1 Redstone Block.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Log | Iron Ingot | Log; Middle row: Iron Ingot | Redstone Block | Iron Ingot; Bottom row: Log | Iron Ingot | Log.
Craft a few before other machines.

goals.text: Make Plastic for Industrial Foregoing machines
goals.hint: Tree latex -> Tiny Dry Rubber -> Dry Rubber -> smelt into Plastic.
goals.why: Plastic builds Industrial Foregoing machines (plant gatherer, mob crusher...).
steps: Place a Tree Fluid Extractor facing a log to make latex.
Pipe latex and water into a powered Latex Processing Unit.
Craft 9 Tiny Dry Rubber into Dry Rubber.

goals.text: Build an Industrial Foregoing Simple Machine Frame
goals.hint: Dissolve plastic, a pity frame, nether brick, gold gear and IE steel into a Simple Machine Frame.
goals.why: Industrial Foregoing frames follow the SF3 tiers: steel, dark steel, then draconium plus a Twilight trophy.
steps: Make steel in the IE blast furnace.
Craft a pity frame, plastic and latex, then dissolve a Simple Machine Frame in the Dissolution Chamber.

goals.hint: 4 Cobblestone + 1 Gold Ingot + 2 Iron Bars + 1 Machine Frame Pity + 1 Furnace.
goals.why: The first power source for Industrial Foregoing machines, so frames can run.
steps: Gather 4 Cobblestone, 1 Gold Ingot, 2 Iron Bars, 1 Machine Frame Pity, 1 Furnace.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Cobblestone | Gold Ingot | Cobblestone.
Middle row: Iron Bars | Machine Frame Pity | Iron Bars.
Burn fuel in it and cable to a machine.

goals.hint: 2 Plastics + 1 Diamond Gear + 2 Slimeballs + 1 Machine Frame Pity + 2 Brick + 1 Sugar.
goals.why: Turns crops into biofuel that feeds generators.
steps: Gather 2 Plastics, 1 Diamond Gear, 2 Slimeballs, 1 Machine Frame Pity, 2 Brick, 1 Sugar.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Plastics | Diamond Gear | Plastics; Middle row: Slimeballs | Machine Frame Pity | Slimeballs; Bottom row: Brick | Sugar | Brick.
Feed it crops and pipe the fuel to a generator.

goals.hint: 3 Plastics + 2 Shears + 1 Bucket + 2 Gold Gear + 1 Machine Frame Pity.
goals.why: Milks cows and shears sheep automatically for a steady supply of milk and wool.
steps: Gather 3 Plastics, 2 Shears, 1 Bucket, 2 Gold Gear, 1 Machine Frame Pity.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Plastics | Plastics | Plastics; Middle row: Shears | Bucket | Shears; Bottom row: Gold Gear | Machine Frame Pity | Gold Gear.
Place it by a pen and give it buckets.

goals.hint: 2 Plastics + 1 Gold Gear + 2 Iron Sword + 1 Machine Frame Pity + 2 Iron Axe + 1 Redstone.
goals.why: Kills the mobs in front of it, so a spawner room pays out loot.
steps: Gather 2 Plastics, 1 Gold Gear, 2 Iron Sword, 1 Machine Frame Pity, 2 Iron Axe, 1 Redstone.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Plastics | Gold Gear | Plastics; Middle row: Iron Sword | Machine Frame Pity | Iron Sword; Bottom row: Iron Axe | Redstone | Iron Axe.
Place it over a mob spawner room.

goals.hint: 2 Plastics + 1 Diamond Gear + 2 Piston + 1 Machine Frame Simple + 2 Gold Gear + 1 Redstone.
goals.why: Mines ore from below it with a laser, a big step up from hand mining.
steps: Gather 2 Plastics, 1 Diamond Gear, 2 Piston, 1 Machine Frame Simple, 2 Gold Gear, 1 Redstone.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Plastics | Diamond Gear | Plastics; Middle row: Piston | Machine Frame Simple | Piston; Bottom row: Gold Gear | Redstone | Gold Gear.
Place it over ore and power it.

goals.text: Make Menril Resin with a Squeezer
goals.hint: Squeeze menril logs (blue trees in meadows) for resin.
goals.why: Menril resin makes Integrated Dynamics cables, readers and logic cards.
steps: Find menril trees and collect logs and saplings.
Place the squeezer, put menril logs in and jump on it.
Collect the resin in a tank or bucket.

goals.hint: Craft logic cable from menril chunks, sticks and redstone dust.
goals.why: The cable carries the network between parts.
steps: Craft Logic Cable: 6 Crystalized Menril Chunks + 2 sticks + redstone dust.
Place a run between the parts.

goals.hint: Craft a Crystalized Menril Block with a crafting table.
goals.why: Writes the variables that tell parts what to do.
steps: Craft a Logic Programmer: Block of Crystalized Menril + crafting table.
Open it and build a first variable.

goals.text: Build an Integrated Dynamics logic network
goals.hint: Logic Cables, readers and Variable Cards (made in the Logic Programmer).
goals.why: Read machines, inventories and blocks and act on them with logic, no redstone.
steps: Connect Logic Cables and attach a reader to the block to inspect.
Open the reader, pick an aspect and write it to a Variable Card.
Put the card in a Display Panel on the same network to show the value.
Logic Programmer: constants and expressions. Variable Store: holds referenced cards.

goals.hint: Craft a variable card from 8 menril chunks and paper.
goals.why: A variable card holds a value or a formula.
steps: Craft a Variable Card: 8 Crystalized Menril Chunks + paper.
Craft a Variable Store: 6 Crystalized Menril Chunks + 2 Block of Crystalized Menril + wooden chest.
Craft a Variable Transformer: 2 Variable Cards + 2 Crystalized Menril Chunks + piston.

goals.text: Move items with Integrated Tunnels importers and exporters
goals.hint: Item Interface on the source, Item Exporter with a valid Variable Card on the target.
goals.why: Moves items and fluids on your logic cables, with filters and rates.
goals.tip: Blank cards do nothing: exporters and importers need a valid aspect card.
steps: Put an Item Interface on a source chest and connect it with Logic Cable.
Put an Item Exporter on the destination on the same network.
Make a Boolean true Variable Card in a Logic Programmer.
Insert it in the exporter's Export All Items aspect and check items arrive.
Add item filters before connecting valuable mixed storage.

goals.text: Craft a Fluid Importer or Exporter
goals.hint: Attach a fluid importer or exporter.
goals.why: Moves fluids by logic rule.
steps: Craft a Fluid Exporter: Fluid Interface + Input/Output Variable Transformers.
Craft a Fluid Importer: Fluid Interface + Input/Output Variable Transformers.

goals.hint: Attach a reader to a chest on the cable.
goals.why: Reads item counts and slots into variables.
steps: Craft an Inventory Reader: 3 chests + Input/Output Variable Transformers.
Attach it to the cable beside a chest.

goals.hint: Attach it to the cable to read weather, time and biome.
goals.why: Lets a network react to the day, the weather and the biome.
steps: Craft a World Reader: 4 dirts + 4 obsidians + Input/Output Variable Transformers.

goals.hint: Craft an Inventory Writer and attach it beside a chest.
goals.why: Writes items into an inventory from a variable.
steps: Craft an Inventory Writer: 3 chests + Input/Output Variable Transformers.

goals.text: Craft a Wrench and a Labeller
goals.hint: Craft a Wrench from 4 menril chunks and redstone dust, and a Labeller from a writable book.
goals.why: The Wrench removes cable parts; the Labeller names variables.
steps: Craft a Wrench: 4 Crystalized Menril Chunks + redstone dust.
Craft a Labeller: 4 Crystalized Menril Chunks + writable book.

goals.hint: Craft a Proxy and a Portable Logic Programmer.
goals.why: The Proxy holds a variable for the network; the Portable Logic Programmer works anywhere.
steps: Craft a Proxy: 4 Variable Cards + 4 Crystalized Menril Chunks + Variable Store.
Craft a Portable Logic Programmer: Logic Programmer.

goals.hint: Craft an Energy Battery from menril chunks and blocks.
goals.why: Stores the power a network and its parts use.
steps: Craft an Energy Battery: 6 Crystalized Menril Chunks + 2 Block of Crystalized Menril + redstone block.

goals.hint: Craft a Generator from an Energy Battery and a furnace.
goals.why: Burns coal to fill an Energy Battery.
steps: Craft a Generator: Energy Battery + furnace.
Place it next to a battery and feed it coal.

goals.hint: Craft a Materializer from menril chunks and variables.
goals.why: Turns a variable value into an item on the network.
steps: Craft a Materializer: 6 Crystalized Menril Chunks + Variable Card + Variable Store + redstone dust.

goals.text: Craft a Charset Tape Drive and Audio Cable
goals.hint: Craft a tape drive, a tape and audio cable (tapes: ingots, tape reels, smooth stone slabs).
goals.why: Records and plays back note-block music.
steps: Craft a tape drive, a tape and audio cable.

obtain.sf3extras:charset_audio_tape: Crafting table: three iron or gold ingots (or gems) on top, a Tape Reel left and right in the middle, three smooth stone slabs at the bottom. The reels must have tape on them.

goals.text: Record a short note-block melody onto a Charset Audio Tape
goals.hint: Connect note blocks to the drive with audio cable and press Record.
goals.why: Saves your music to play anywhere.
steps: Connect your note blocks to the drive with audio cable.
Insert a tape and press Record.
Play the melody on the note blocks, then press Stop.

obtain.sf3extras:charset_audio_tape: Crafting table: three iron or gold ingots (or gems) on top, a Tape Reel left and right in the middle, three smooth stone slabs at the bottom. The reels must have tape on them.

goals.hint: Right-click the drive with an empty hand and press Play.
goals.why: Plays back what you recorded.
steps: Rewind the tape in the drive.
Right-click the drive with an empty hand and press Play.

goals.text: Place a SuperCircuitMaker component on a circuit board
goals.hint: Right-click components onto a Circuit board in the world.
goals.why: Complex redstone in one block: a 7x7 board with four layers.
goals.tip: This port has no component picker: build on the board itself.
steps: Place a Circuit board with its top reachable.
Hold a component and right-click a cell on the board.
Empty hand: inspect or activate the component you aim at.
A Squeegee removes a component and returns its item.

goals.hint: Craft a plate from a Redstone Circuit.
goals.why: Plates are the base for every component, so craft them before the adder.
steps: Craft a Tiny Plate: Redstone Circuit.
Craft a Tiny Segmented Lamp: Miniature Lamp + obsidian + Tiny Pile of Glowstone.

goals.text: Build a powered circuit that controls a lamp
goals.hint: Route a signal across the board to its edge.
goals.why: The tiny circuit drives real redstone outside the board.
steps: Wire an input edge of the board to an output edge.
Power the input side; put a lamp next to the output side.

goals.text: Set a component's value or delay with the screwdriver
goals.hint: The screwdriver changes component settings.
goals.why: Timers, counters and repeaters need settings.
steps: Right-click a Constant, Timer or Delay with the Screwdriver to raise its setting.
Hold a stick in your offhand to rotate those components instead.
Sneak-use the Screwdriver on an empty cell to change the editing layer.

goals.hint: Craft an adder from 6 Tiny Plates + 3 Tiny Pile of Redstone.
goals.why: Number components count and compare; the Constant is made from an Adder.
steps: Craft an Adder: 6 Tiny Plates + 3 Tiny Pile of Redstone.
Craft a Constant: Adder + redstone torch.

goals.hint: Craft one from redstone block + piston.
goals.why: A sensor that reacts to a neighboring block changing.
steps: Craft a Block Update Detector: redstone block + piston.
Craft an Inventory Scanner: 2 Tiny Pile of Redstone + wooden chest + 3 Tiny Plates.

goals.hint: Craft it from 3 eyes of ender and 3 obsidian.
goals.why: A pulse source for timed signals on a board.
steps: Craft an Ender Pulsar: 3 ender eyes + 3 obsidians.

goals.text: Record and place a paid circuit blueprint
goals.hint: Record a finished board on a Blueprint, then build copies on empty boards.
goals.why: Copy a working design instead of rebuilding it.
goals.tip: Copying uses up components; a missing component means no copy, not a partial one.
steps: Use a Blueprint or Redprint on a finished Circuit board to record it.
Carry every component the copy needs and place an empty board.
Sneak-use the recorded design on the empty board.
Check the copy with a Multimeter and a test signal.

goals.hint: Craft it from 8 blue dyes + map.
goals.why: A Blueprint records a finished circuit so it can be placed again.
steps: Craft a Blueprint: 8 blue dyes + map.
Craft a Redprint: 4 red dyes + 4 redstone dusts + map.

goals.hint: Craft a transistor, then microchips of tier 1, 2 and 3.
goals.why: Chips go into every card, memory, CPU and upgrade.
steps: Craft a Transistor: 3 iron ingots + 2 gold nuggets + paper + redstone dust.
Craft a Tier 1 Microchip: 6 iron nuggets + 2 redstone dusts + Transistor.
Craft a Tier 2 Microchip: 6 gold nuggets + 2 redstone dusts + Transistor.
Craft a Tier 3 Microchip: 6 Chip Diamonds + 2 redstone dusts + Transistor.

goals.hint: Computers run Lua: type help to start.
goals.why: CC: Tweaked comes after OpenComputers: the computer needs an OC microchip (tier 1; tier 2 for the advanced computer).
steps: Place a Computer and right-click it.
Type edit startup.lua and write a small program, e.g. print("Hello, Otto!").
Save and exit, then run startup.lua.
Reboot and check the program runs on startup.

goals.text: Program a Turtle to mine for you
goals.hint: Craft a turtle with a pickaxe, fuel it and run excavate 8.
goals.why: A robot that digs a quarry while you do other things.
steps: Place a Mining Turtle facing a small test area and put fuel in its selected slot.
Run refuel all and check its fuel.
Run excavate 3 for a small first quarry; leave room and storage for the blocks.
Scale up once fuel, storage and the return path work.

goals.hint: Craft monitors from stone around a glass pane and place several side by side.
goals.why: A big display for program output.
steps: Craft a Monitor: 8 stones + glass pane.
Place several touching, with a computer next to them.

goals.hint: Craft one from 4 stones + 4 redstone dusts + Wired Modem.
goals.why: Gives a computer extra redstone sides over a modem.
steps: Craft a Redstone Relay: 4 stones + 4 redstone dusts + Wired Modem.
Connect it to the computer with a Wired Modem.

goals.text: Print a page and bind a book
goals.hint: Print a page, then bind pages into a book.
goals.why: Programs can leave a record on paper.
steps: Run a program that prints to the Printer.
Bind the pages into a book.

goals.hint: Craft one from 7 gold ingots + command block + glass pane.
goals.why: Runs commands the way a command block does; the recipe needs a command block.
steps: Craft a Command Computer: 7 gold ingots + command block + glass pane.

goals.hint: Smelt a Raw Circuit Board, then craft a Card and a Control Unit.
goals.why: The board is the base of cards and most parts; the Control Unit is part of every CPU.
steps: Smelt a Raw Circuit Board in a furnace.
Craft a Card: 3 iron nuggets + Printed Circuit Board (PCB) + gold nugget.
Craft a Control Unit: 4 gold nuggets + redstone dust + 3 Transistors + clock.

goals.hint: Craft an ALU from 4 iron nuggets, redstone dust, 3 transistors and a microchip.
goals.why: Every CPU and graphics card needs one.
steps: Craft an ALU: 4 iron nuggets + redstone dust + 3 Transistors + Chip1.

goals.hint: Build a computer with a CPU, memory, graphics card and a hard drive.
goals.why: A full computer in Minecraft for advanced automation.
goals.tip: Right-click the manual: it explains every part.
steps: Craft a Computer Case, CPU, memory stick, graphics card, screen and keyboard.
Craft the OC manual (book + microchip), a Lua BIOS (EEPROM + manual) and an OpenOS floppy (floppy + manual).
Put CPU, memory, graphics card and BIOS in the case; place the screen with the keyboard on it and a disk drive with the floppy.
Power the case (RF cable or Power Converter), press its power button and type install to copy OpenOS to a hard drive.

obtain.opencomputers:case1: OpenComputers parts use the mod's own recipes (circuit boards, microchips, iron); open JEI or the OpenComputers manual.
obtain.opencomputers:cpu1: OpenComputers parts use the mod's own recipes (circuit boards, microchips, iron); open JEI or the OpenComputers manual.
obtain.opencomputers:screen1: OpenComputers parts use the mod's own recipes; open JEI or the OpenComputers manual.
obtain.opencomputers:keyboard: OpenComputers parts use the mod's own recipes; open JEI or the OpenComputers manual.

goals.hint: Craft cable and run it between a computer and its screen.
goals.why: Cable joins computers, screens and other parts into one network.
steps: Craft Cable: 4 iron nuggets + redstone dust.
Place a run between a computer and a screen.

goals.hint: Craft an Analyzer to read a component.
goals.why: Shows the address and state of a component.
steps: Craft an Analyzer: redstone torch + Transistor + 2 gold nuggets + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).

goals.hint: Craft a disk, then a floppy disk to carry programs.
goals.why: Floppies carry programs; the Manual explains the API in game.
steps: Craft a Floppy Disk: 4 iron nuggets + lever + 3 papers + Disk Platter.

goals.hint: Visual programs that control machines and items.
goals.why: Control machines and item flow without writing code.
steps: Craft a Processor, a Programmer and a Program Card, plus the CPU and memory your program needs.
Power the Processor with FE and install the hardware.
In the Programmer, build a small event-driven program and save it to the Program Card.
Put the card in the Processor, trigger the event and check its log.
Add inventory and machine control once the simple program works.

goals.hint: Craft a CPU Core B500 and insert it in the processor.
goals.why: Sets how fast the processor runs; faster cores cost diamonds and emeralds.
steps: Craft a CPU Core B500: 4 redstone dusts + 2 gold nuggets + 2 papers + Card Base.
Put the core in the CPU slot of the processor.

goals.hint: Craft a RAM chip and insert it in the processor.
goals.why: Holds the variables of a running program.
steps: Craft a RAM Chip: 6 redstone dusts + 2 papers + Card Base.
Put the chip in a RAM slot of the processor.

goals.hint: Craft a Program Card from paper and a Card Base.
goals.why: Stores a program you wrote in the Programmer.
steps: Craft a Program Card: 3 papers + Card Base.
Write a program in the Programmer, then insert the card in the processor.

goals.hint: Craft a Node and place it next to the machines to control.
goals.why: Lets a program reach blocks in the world.
steps: Craft a Node: 6 redstone dusts + ender pearl + Machine Frame + Card Base.
Place it next to the machines to control.

goals.hint: Craft a Network Card and insert it in the processor.
goals.why: Connects the processor to its nodes.
steps: Craft a Network Card: 5 redstone dusts + ender pearl + 2 gold nuggets + Card Base.
Put the card in a card slot of the processor.

goals.hint: Craft a Crafting Station and link it to the network.
goals.why: Lets a program craft items.
steps: Craft a Crafting Station: 4 redstone dusts + 2 Card Bases + 2 crafting tables + Machine Frame.

goals.hint: Craft a Workbench and a Tank.
goals.why: Where programs and crafting cards are stored; the Tank holds fluid.
steps: Craft a Workbench: crafting table + Machine Frame + chest.
Craft a Tank: Machine Frame + 4 iron ingots + 4 glass.

goals.hint: Craft a Console Module and insert it in the processor.
goals.why: Shows what a program prints.
steps: Craft a Console Module: 4 glass panes + Card Base + 2 redstone dusts + iron ingot + ink sac.
Put the module in a module slot of the processor.

goals.text: Craft a Mana Pool and a Mana Spreader
goals.hint: Generating flowers make mana; spreaders send it to pools.
goals.why: Mana powers all of Botania: manasteel, mana diamonds, runes, Terrasteel and the Gaia ritual.
steps: Make a generating flower (Endoflame burns fuel, Hydroangeas uses water).
Place a mana spreader near it and bind the flower to it with the Wand of the Forest.
Bind the spreader to a mana pool with the wand.

diagram.title: First mana setup
diagram.view: Top view
diagram.note: Flowers within 6 blocks of the spreader. Feed Endoflames coal or logs by dropping them next to them.

obtain.botania:special_flower: A functional flower is made by putting its petals and a mystical flower into a Petal Apothecary (see the Lexica Botania for the petal colors).
obtain.botania:special_flower|type=endoflame: A functional flower is made by putting its petals and a mystical flower into a Petal Apothecary (see the Lexica Botania for the petal colors).

goals.text: Infuse Manasteel in a Mana Pool
goals.hint: Drop an iron ingot into a Mana Pool with enough mana for the recipe.
goals.why: Manasteel makes Botania tools and armor. Manasteel, mana diamonds and mana pearls make Terrasteel.
goals.tip: Each conversion only uses its recipe cost.
steps: Send mana from flowers to a Mana Pool through a bound spreader.
Check the pool has enough mana for the recipe (it needn't be full).
Drop an iron ingot in and collect the manasteel.

goals.hint: Manasteel ingots and sticks in the pickaxe shape.
goals.why: A faster pickaxe that also feeds on mana.
steps: Infuse an iron ingot in a Mana Pool to get Manasteel
Craft the pickaxe from Manasteel ingots and sticks

goals.text: Craft a Wand of the Forest
goals.hint: The wand binds flowers, spreaders and pools and shows mana.
goals.why: Links mana blocks and activates many Botania blocks.
steps: Craft the Wand of the Forest.
Switch it to Bind Mode (see its tooltip).
Sneak-right-click the spreader, then the pool, to bind them.
Use the wand on them to check the connection and mana.

goals.hint: 5 Livingrock around a Mana Pearl, placed next to a Pool.
goals.why: The Runic Altar crafts every rune that the later recipes need.
steps: Craft: 5 Livingrock + 1 Mana Pearl (or 5 Livingrock + 1 Mana Diamond for the second recipe)
Place it next to a mana pool

goals.hint: Terrasteel ingots in the helmet shape.
goals.why: Armor that boosts mana regeneration.
steps: Make Terrasteel ingots on the plate

goals.hint: Water, Fire, Earth and Air runes from Mana Powder and Manasteel.
goals.why: Runes gate the Terrasteel-era flowers and gear.
steps: Water: Mana Powder + Manasteel Ingot + Bone Meal + Sugar Cane + Fishing Rod
Fire: Mana Powder + Manasteel Ingot + Nether Brick + Gunpowder + Nether Wart
Earth: Mana Powder + Manasteel Ingot + Stone + Coal Block + a mushroom (brown or red)
Air: Mana Powder + Manasteel Ingot + White Carpet + Feather + String
Seasons and sins: 2 base runes + extras (Mana Diamond for the sins); see the Lexica Botania

goals.hint: A Petal Apothecary flower that turns stone into ore using mana.
goals.why: Mana-powered ore generation.
steps: Craft in the Petal Apothecary: 2 Gray + Yellow + Green + Red petals + Pride Rune + Greed Rune + Redstone Root + Pixie Dust
Plant it on a stone area near a spreader

goals.hint: A flower that turns stone into biome stone.
goals.why: The source of biome stone and its variants.
steps: Plant a Marimorphosis flower on stone with mana
Pick up the biome stone it makes

goals.text: Infuse Terrasteel on a Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate
goals.hint: Manasteel + mana diamond + mana pearl on the plate, plus a lot of mana.
goals.why: Terrasteel makes the Terra Blade and Terra Shatterer and starts the Gaia ritual.
goals.tip: It needs a lot of mana. Picking up the ingredients early stops the craft.
steps: Build the livingrock and lapis platform exactly as the Lexica shows and put the plate on top.
Link mana to the plate with Sparks and store plenty before starting.
Drop one Manasteel Ingot, one Mana Diamond and one Mana Pearl on the plate.
Wait until the Terrasteel is finished, then pick it up.

goals.hint: Sparks carry mana from a generating flower to Pools and machines.
goals.why: Moves mana without hand-feeding.
steps: Spark: Craft: 2 Petal White + 2 Blaze powder + 1 Gold Nugget
Spark upgrade: Craft: Pixie Dust + Manasteel Ingot + Rune of Water B
Spark changer: Craft: 2 Elementium Ingot + 3 Livingrock + 1 Redstone Dust

goals.text: Turn mana into FE with a Fluxfield
goals.hint: The Mana Fluxfield converts mana into FE for other mods.
goals.why: Powers FE machines from your flower farm.
steps: Mana Fluxfield: Craft: 4 Livingrock + 4 Redstone Block + 1 Manasteel Ingot
Feed it mana from a Mana Spreader pointed at it
Connect its FE output to another mod's machines

goals.text: Craft and Place a Blood Altar
goals.hint: Altar: stone, furnace, gold and one Demonic Will. Fill it with your blood using a Sacrificial Dagger.
goals.why: Blood Magic turns your health (Life Points) into sigils, rituals and armor.
steps: Get a Demonic Will: throw a Soul Snare (string, iron, redstone) at a monster and kill it while snared.
Craft the Blood Altar (stone, furnace, gold ingots, the will) and a Sacrificial Dagger.
Right-click the dagger next to the altar to add blood (costs health: eat well).
Put items in the altar to transmute them with LP.

goals.hint: A diamond in the filled altar becomes a Weak Blood Orb; right-click it to bind it.
goals.why: The orb holds your LP network. Sigils and rituals use it; each altar tier needs a better orb.
steps: Fill the altar with at least 2000 LP.
Put a diamond in: it becomes a Weak Blood Orb.
Right-click the orb to bind it, then leave it in the altar to fill.

goals.text: Make Blank Slates in the Blood Altar
goals.hint: Stone in a filled altar becomes a blank slate.
goals.why: Slates craft blood runes; runes raise the altar tier for better orbs, sigils and armor.
steps: Put stone in the filled altar.
Keep the altar filled until the stone turns into a blank slate.
Craft blood runes from slates and stone.

diagram.title: Tier 2 altar
diagram.view: Eight runes one block below the altar, all around it.
diagram.note: The 8 runes go one level lower than the altar, all around it. Higher tiers need more runes and pillars (see the Blood Magic guide).

goals.hint: Stone and other parts: place it to start alchemy.
goals.why: Crafts runes and reagents.

goals.text: Craft a Sigil in an Alchemy Array
goals.hint: Draw an alchemy array with Arcane Ashes, then add redstone and a Blank Slate: Divination Sigil.
goals.why: Sigils are reusable LP-powered tools: Divination shows your LP; others give water, lava, air jumps, an item magnet and more.
goals.tip: The Air Sigil needs a ghast-tear reagent (128 will) and a Reinforced Slate: it comes after the first Tartaric Gems.
steps: Build a Hellfire Forge and make Arcane Ashes in it (redstone, white dye, gunpowder, coal; no will needed).
Right-click the ground with the ashes to draw an alchemy circle.
Right-click the circle with redstone, then a Blank Slate: it spins up and leaves a Divination Sigil.
Later sigils need a Hellfire Forge reagent and a better slate (JEI: Alchemy Array). Right-click a sigil to bind it.

goals.hint: Snares catch mobs so they drop Demon Will.
goals.why: The first source of Demon Will for your Tartaric Gem.
steps: Rudimentary Snare: Craft: 4 Strings (any) + 4 Iron (any) + 1 Redstone (any)
Use it to get your first Demon Will for the Petty Tartaric Gem

goals.hint: The forge crafts Tartaric Gems and Demon Will tools.
goals.why: Opens the Demon Will line.
steps: Hellfire Forge: Craft: 2 Iron (any) + 4 Stones (any) + 1 Gold (any) + 1 Iron (any)
Lesser Tartaric Gem: Craft: Lesser Tartaric Gem + Demon Will Crystal

goals.text: Collect Demonic Will in a Petty Tartaric Gem
goals.hint: Snared monsters drop Demonic Will; a Tartaric Gem in your inventory stores it.
goals.why: Will powers the Hellfire Forge and Will tools, armor and rituals.
goals.tip: Without a snare or sentient weapon, monsters drop no will.
steps: Throw a Soul Snare (string, iron, redstone) at a monster and kill it while snared: it drops will.
Hellfire Forge: will + redstone, gold, glass and lapis = Petty Tartaric Gem.
Forge a Sentient Sword (iron sword + gem): its kills drop will, and the gem picks it up.
Spend stored will on later Hellfire Forge recipes (reagents, better gems).

goals.hint: Hellfire Forge: a Petty Tartaric Gem + an iron sword (no will needed); kills with it drop demonic will.
goals.why: Link 2 of 3 of the Mob drops to Blood Magic route; next: Blood Magic turns the will into soul gems and alchemy.

goals.hint: Stone and a Blank Slate in the Alchemy Table.
goals.why: Runes raise the altar's tier and speed.
steps: Combine them in the alchemy table

goals.text: Raise the altar to tier 2 and fill an Apprentice Orb
goals.hint: The Apprentice Orb is made at a tier 2 altar.
goals.why: A bigger LP store than the Weak Orb, and the rune lines open up.
steps: Speed Rune: Craft: 4 Stones (any) + 2 Blank Slate + 2 Sugar + 1 Blank Rune
Rune of Sacrifice: Craft: 4 Stones (any) + 1 Reinforced Slate + 2 Gold (any) + 1 Blank Rune + 1 Blood Orb (tier 2 or higher)
Apprentice Orb: Blood Altar tier 2 or higher, a Redstone Block, 5000 LP

goals.hint: A Blank Slate in the Blood Altar costs 2000 LP.
goals.why: Needed for higher altar tiers.
steps: Fill the altar with life essence
Place a Blank Slate on it

goals.text: Raise the altar to tier 3 and fill a Magician Orb
goals.hint: The Magician Orb is made at a tier 3 altar.
goals.why: A larger LP store, and the Weak Activation Crystal is made at the same tier.
steps: Rune of Capacity: Craft: 4 Stones (any) + 3 Bucket + 1 Blank Rune + 1 Imbued Slate
Magician Orb: Blood Altar tier 3 or higher, a Gold Block, 25000 LP
Weak Activation Crystal: tier 3 altar, a Lava Crystal, 10000 LP

goals.text: Set up a Master Ritual Stone
goals.hint: The Master Ritual Stone with ritual stones around it starts a ritual.
goals.why: Rituals automate farming, mining and LP.
steps: Master Ritual Stone: Craft: Master Ritual Stone
Ritual Stone: Craft: 4 Obsidian + 4 Reinforced Slate + 1 Blood Orb (tier 2 or higher)
Ritual Diviner: Craft: 4 Diamond (any) + 1 Elemental Inscription Tool: Fire + 1 Elemental Inscription Tool: Air + 1 Wooden (any) + 1 Elemental Inscrip
Ritual Tinkerer: Craft: 2 Glass blocks (any) + 1 Blood Orb (tier 4 or higher) + 2 Gold (any) + 2 Demonic Slate

goals.hint: A Reinforced Slate in the Blood Altar costs 5000 LP.
goals.why: Needed for the next altar tier.
steps: Add the runes your altar tier needs
Place a Reinforced Slate on it

goals.text: Build a CAD and cast a Psi spell
goals.hint: Craft Psidust (3 redstone + ender pearl), build a CAD in the CAD Assembler and program spells.
goals.why: Program your own spells: mining lasers, flight, platforms, healing.
steps: Craft Psidust: 3 redstone + an ender pearl = 3 (pack recipe; later Psi spells make it too).
Craft a CAD Assembler (iron + piston) and the CAD parts: assembly, core (psidust in iron), socket, battery.
Assemble the CAD, write a spell in the Spell Programmer, put it on a spell bullet and load the bullet.

goals.hint: Iron ingots and Psidust in the programmer shape.
goals.why: Where spells are programmed.

goals.hint: Bullets carry a spell into a CAD.
goals.why: A bullet is the container that carries your programmed spell into the CAD.
steps: Projectile Spell Bullet: Craft: 1 Arrow + 1 Iron (any) + 1 Psidust (any)

goals.hint: Ebony substance in the Psimetal recipe.
goals.why: Used for Psimetal CAD assemblies.

goals.hint: Ivory substance in the Psimetal recipe.
goals.why: Pairs with Ebony Psimetal.

goals.hint: Elementary staves cast fire, ice, wind and more from elemental essences.
goals.why: Ranged magic for Age 4 combat.
steps: Charge it with an essence and right-click.

goals.hint: A staff attuned to fire.
goals.why: A ranged fire attack that needs no ammunition.

goals.hint: A staff attuned to life.
goals.why: A staff that heals you and nearby allies between fights.

goals.hint: Craft: Staff + Dark Essence.
goals.why: Adds the dark element to your staff set.
steps: Dark Staff: Craft: Staff + Dark Essence
Collect the Dark Essence first (see the Elemental essences family)

goals.hint: Craft: Staff + Electric Essence.
goals.why: Adds the electric element to your staff set.
steps: Electric Staff: Craft: Staff + Electric Essence
Collect the Electric Essence first (see the Elemental essences family)

goals.hint: Craft: Staff + Ice Essence.
goals.why: Adds the ice element to your staff set.
steps: Ice Staff: Craft: Staff + Ice Essence
Collect the Ice Essence first (see the Elemental essences family)

goals.hint: Craft: Staff + Poison Essence.
goals.why: Adds the poison element to your staff set.
steps: Poison Staff: Craft: Staff + Poison Essence
Collect the Poison Essence first (see the Elemental essences family)

goals.hint: Craft: Staff + Water Essence.
goals.why: Adds the water element to your staff set.
steps: Water Staff: Craft: Staff + Water Essence
Collect the Water Essence first (see the Elemental essences family)

goals.hint: Craft: Staff + Wind Essence.
goals.why: Adds the wind element to your staff set.
steps: Wind Staff: Craft: Staff + Wind Essence
Collect the Wind Essence first (see the Elemental essences family)

goals.hint: 1 Electron Tube + 1 Andesite Casing + 1 Brass Hand.
goals.why: Acts like a player at a fixed point, applying items to blocks and starting sequenced assemblies.
steps: Gather 1 Electron Tube, 1 Andesite Casing, 1 Brass Hand.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Electron Tube; Middle row: Andesite Casing; Bottom row: Brass Hand.
Place it above a Depot and give it the item to apply.

goals.text: Assemble a Precision Mechanism with Create machinery
goals.hint: Sequenced assembly on a gold sheet with deployers (JEI shows the sequence).
goals.why: Needed for Create's advanced machines, arms and train parts.
goals.tip: The press only makes the starting gold sheet; it is not a step in the sequence.
steps: Open Precision Mechanism in JEI (Sequenced Assembly).
Feed a gold sheet through deployers that add a cogwheel, a large cogwheel and an IE electrum nugget, in that order.
Repeat the sequence as many times as JEI shows (loop or by hand).
Collect it; assembly can also give a byproduct.

goals.hint: 1 Wooden Slab + 1 Andesite Casing + 1 Shaft.
goals.why: Spins a whole contraption glued to it: windmills, drills and moving doors.
steps: Gather 1 Wooden Slab, 1 Andesite Casing, 1 Shaft.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Wooden Slab; Middle row: Andesite Casing; Bottom row: Shaft.
Attach blocks on top of the bearing and power it with a shaft.

goals.text: Encase a Shaft or Cogwheel in Brass
goals.hint: Right-click a Shaft or Cogwheel with Brass Casing.
goals.why: Brass-encased parts split or merge rotation with gearshifts.
steps: Right-click a placed Shaft or Cogwheel.

goals.hint: 1 Brass Sheet + 1 Chute + 1 Electron Tube.
goals.why: Moves only the items that match its filter, so mixed belts sort into clean lanes.
steps: Gather 1 Brass Sheet, 1 Chute, 1 Electron Tube.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Brass Sheet; Middle row: Chute; Bottom row: Electron Tube.
Place it in a chute line and set its filter.

goals.text: Run a Create production line that feeds and empties itself
goals.hint: Feed inputs with funnels and belts; send outputs to storage.
goals.why: A hands-off line keeps making what you need.
steps: Supply inputs with funnels, chutes or mechanical arms.

goals.hint: Put an Empty Schematic in a Schematic Table to save a build.
goals.why: Saves a build as a file the Schematicannon can place elsewhere.
steps: Put an Empty Schematic in it.
Put an Empty Schematic in the table and name your save.

goals.hint: 2 Iron Block + 2 Log + 2 Smooth Stone + 1 Dispenser.
goals.why: Builds saved schematics block by block, so large bases go up without hand placement.
steps: Gather 2 Iron Block, 2 Log, 2 Smooth Stone, 1 Dispenser.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Iron Block | empty; Middle row: Log | Iron Block | Log; Bottom row: Smooth Stone | Dispenser | Smooth Stone.
Load a schematic, give it gunpowder and the building blocks.

goals.hint: 4 Steel Plate + 1 Burner Fire + 2 Andesite Alloy + 1 Redstone Dust.
goals.why: The burner's flame heats the envelope and decides how high the balloon climbs.
steps: Gather 4 Steel Plate, 1 Burner Fire, 2 Andesite Alloy, 1 Redstone Dust.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Steel Plate | empty | Steel Plate.
Middle row: Steel Plate | Burner Fire | Steel Plate.
Bottom row: Andesite Alloy | Redstone Dust | Andesite Alloy.
Place it under the envelopes and light it.
