goals.text: Fly a propeller airship you can steer
goals.hint: Propeller Bearings push a contraption; a Steering Wheel and Throttle Lever control it.
goals.why: A steerable flying base. Propeller bearings need Ender IO electrical steel (Age 4); smart propellers need vibrant alloy (Age 5).
goals.tip: Aviator's Goggles (leather + Engineer's Goggles) show thrust and stress. Gyroscopic Propeller Bearings stay level (helicopters). Thrust weakens high up; an Altitude Sensor reads air pressure.
steps: Start from a hot air balloon (or Levitite later) that holds its own weight.
Craft Propeller Bearings (wooden slab, electrical steel, brass casing). Put sails or an Andesite Propeller on each bearing's front (at least two sail blocks).
Give the bearings rotation, e.g. an on-board Portable Engine (burns fuel like a furnace).
Add a Steering Wheel and a Throttle Lever, glue everything and assemble it.
Reverse thrust by reversing rotation, or with a wrench on the bearing.

goals.text: Process a renewable material into storage hands-free
goals.hint: Connect source -> processing -> storage with pipes, ducts or a network.
goals.why: A material made, processed and stored without you.
steps: Pick a source (cobble generator), a processor (hammer, sieve) and storage.

goals.text: Add an overflow plan so your resource factory can run safely
goals.hint: Void the excess (trash can, void upgrade) or stop the machine when storage is full.
goals.why: A full factory stalls or floods the ground with items.
goals.tip: Never put an unfiltered void on valuable mixed storage.
steps: Decide: stop when full, or void only a specific renewable excess.
Add filtered overflow storage and a void at lower priority, or a storage-full signal that stops production.
Fill a test destination and check the machine stops or voids only that excess.

goals.text: Drain a lake with a Ranged Pump
goals.hint: The Ranged Pump drains fluid in a large area into its tank.
goals.why: Clear water for underwater builds, or collect lava as fuel.
goals.tip: Empty its internal tank as it fills.
steps: Place the pump above the fluid to clear.
Power it (FE) and pipe it into an empty tank.
Check its range and let it drain; keep the area loaded.

goals.text: Place a Ranged Pump on a lake
goals.hint: 4 obsidian + 2 iron pickaxes + 1 lava bucket + 1 diamond block + 1 water bucket.
goals.why: Empties a lake into your tanks.
steps: Craft it from 4 obsidian + 2 iron pickaxes + 1 lava bucket + 1 water bucket + 1 diamond block.
Pipe the fluid to a tank.

goals.text: Keep a remote factory running with a Chunk Loader
goals.hint: A ChickenChunks loader keeps chunks loaded while you are away.
goals.why: Machines only run in loaded chunks.
steps: Right-click it to set the radius.

goals.hint: 8 ender pearls + 1 chunk loader.
goals.why: Keeps a single chunk loaded.
steps: Craft it from 8 ender pearls + 1 chunk loader.
Place it in the chunk to keep.

goals.hint: Blaze powder + ender pearl; throw one to find the stronghold.
goals.why: Eyes of Ender point to the stronghold and open the End portal.
steps: Grind blaze rods into blaze powder.
Combine blaze powder with an ender pearl.
Throw the eye and follow it.

goals.text: Link machines wirelessly with Flux Networks
goals.hint: Flux plugs and points on one network send power anywhere.
goals.why: Power across your base, or across dimensions, with no cables.
steps: Craft a flux controller, flux plugs and flux points.
Plugs on generators, points on machines.
Put them all on the same network.

goals.hint: 4 Flux Dust + 4 obsidian + an Eye of Ender.
goals.why: Plugs, points, storage and the controller are built from cores.
steps: Flux Core: 4 Flux + 4 Obsidian + Ender Eye.

goals.why: Flux blocks: Flux Block.

goals.hint: 2 Flux Cores + Ender Pearl + 2 Obsidian.
goals.why: Copies a network onto each plug and point you place.
steps: Flux Configurator: 2 Flux Core + Ender Pearl + 2 Obsidian.

goals.text: Craft a Flux Plug and a Flux Point
goals.hint: Plug: 4 Flux Cores + a Flux Block. Point: 4 Flux Cores + a block of redstone.
goals.why: Plugs put power into the network, points take it out.
steps: Flux Plug: 4 Flux Core + Flux Block.
Flux Point: 4 Flux Core + Redstone Block.

goals.hint: The first storage tier.
goals.why: Buffers power so the network keeps running when generators pause.

goals.hint: Basic Flux Storages + glass panes.
goals.why: A mid-size power buffer for the network.
steps: Herculean Flux Storage: 6 Basic Flux Storage + 2 glass pane.

goals.hint: 3 Herculean Flux Storages + glass panes.
goals.why: The largest buffer in the mod.
steps: Gargantuan Flux Storage: 6 Herculean Flux Storage + 2 glass pane.

goals.hint: Craft: 2 Copper Ingot + 1 Steel Ingot + 1 Ammo Box.
goals.why: Where ammo and ammo boxes are handled.
steps: Craft 2 copper ingots, 1 Immersive Engineering steel ingot and an Ammo Box.

goals.hint: Craft the attachment bench (needs Ender IO electrical steel) for scopes, grips and muzzles.
goals.why: Gun attachments are an Age 4 upgrade.
steps: Alloy electrical steel (iron, silicon, redstone) in the alloy smelter.

goals.text: Craft a TaCZ Gun Smith Table
goals.hint: Gun Smith Table: IE steel ingots, logs and an iron block.
goals.why: Guns follow a supply chain: the table needs IE steel (pistols, SMGs); rifles, shotguns and snipers need Ender IO electrical steel; heavy weapons need Twilight and Aether materials (Age 5). Ammo needs pressed copper plates and the ammo workbench.
steps: Make steel in the IE blast furnace.
Press copper plates (IE Metal Press or Create press) for ammo.

goals.hint: 95 attachments: 32 scopes, 19 muzzles, 17 extended mags, 14 stocks, 12 grips, 5 lasers.
goals.why: Scopes, muzzles, magazines and grips change a gun's range, recoil and capacity.
steps: Craft an attachment and fit it on a gun.

goals.hint: 13 pistols: cheapest Glock 17 (16 iron), costliest Taurus \"Raging Hunter\" Hand Cannon (8 diamond + 65 gold + 85 iron + 4 blaze).
goals.why: Picks the pistol role for your loadout.
steps: Pick a pistol in the list of the Gun Smith Table.

goals.hint: 5 submachine guns: cheapest UZI (32 iron), costliest Vector SMG (60 iron + 8 lapis + 12 gold + 10 diamond).
goals.why: Picks the smg role for your loadout.
steps: Pick a smg in the list of the Gun Smith Table.

goals.hint: 17 rifles: cheapest Type 81-1 Service Rifle (28 iron + 10 minecraft:logs), costliest FN FAL Battle Rifle (64 iron + 20 lapis + 30 minecraft:logs + 10 gold).
goals.why: Picks the rifle role for your loadout.
steps: Pick a rifle in the list of the Gun Smith Table.
Start with the cheapest: Type 81-1 Service Rifle.

goals.hint: 6 shotguns: cheapest DB-2 Durin (8 iron + 6 minecraft:logs), costliest SPAS-12 Multi-purpose Shotgun (110 iron + 20 gold + 2 diamond + 5 lapis).
goals.why: Picks the shotgun role for your loadout.
steps: Pick a shotgun in the list of the Gun Smith Table.
Start with the cheapest: DB-2 Durin.

goals.hint: 6 sniper rifles: cheapest Springfield 1873 Trapdoor Rifle (10 minecraft:logs + 3 iron), costliest M107 Sniper Rifle (18 diamond + 64 gold + 3 netherite + 320 iron + 5 blaze).
goals.why: Picks the sniper role for your loadout.
steps: Pick a sniper in the list of the Gun Smith Table.
Start with the cheapest: Springfield 1873 Trapdoor Rifle.

goals.hint: 4 machine guns: cheapest RPK (56 iron + 8 gold + 8 quartz + 12 minecraft:logs), costliest M134 Minigun (40 diamond + 80 gold + 10 netherite + 320 iron + 10 blaze).
goals.why: Picks the mg role for your loadout.
steps: Pick a mg in the list of the Gun Smith Table.

goals.hint: 2 launchers: cheapest M320 Grenade Launcher (15 gold + 50 iron + 6 lapis), costliest RPG-7 (8 gold + 70 iron + 4 lapis + 10 minecraft:logs).
goals.why: Picks the rpg role for your loadout.
steps: Pick a rpg in the list of the Gun Smith Table.
Start with the cheapest: M320 Grenade Launcher.

goals.hint: Place targets, the target minecart and the Stone Statue to test guns.
goals.why: Test damage and recoil without risking a fight.

goals.text: Lift off in a hot air balloon
goals.hint: A Hot Air Burner under a closed envelope of balloon blocks lifts a contraption.
goals.why: Your first flying machine: you, friends and cargo over mountains and oceans.
goals.tip: Hold W over the burner or an envelope to Ponder balloons. Dye colors envelopes. Torches and glowstone on board light the ground below.
steps: Craft a Hot Air Burner (IE steel plates, block of coal, redstone, andesite alloy) and about 54 Hot Air Envelopes (wool + sticks).
Build a closed envelope, put the burner under it and light it.

diagram.title: Small hot air balloon
diagram.view: Layers from the bottom: deck, burner, posts and a 5x5 balloon
diagram.note: A bigger balloon lifts more. Lift gets weaker the higher you fly, so the balloon settles where lift equals weight.

goals.hint: 1 Andesite Propeller.
goals.why: The cheapest propeller; it pushes a light airship through the air.
steps: Combine them in the crafting grid to get Wooden Propeller.
Mount it on a propeller bearing.

goals.hint: 1 Gold Sheet + 1 Copper Block.
goals.why: Turns boiler steam into lift for a contraption that needs more than a burner gives.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Gold Sheet; Bottom row: Copper Block.
Connect it to a steam source below the envelope.

goals.hint: 1 Leather + 1 Goggles.
goals.why: Worn while flying; the goggles give the aviator a proper flight view.
steps: Combine them in the crafting grid to get Aviators Goggles.
Wear them in the helmet slot.

goals.text: Encase a Shaft in an Envelope
goals.hint: Right-click a Shaft with an Envelope.
goals.why: Lets an envelope turn with a shaft, for spinning balloons and sails.
steps: Right-click a placed shaft while holding an envelope.

goals.text: Drive a car on Offroad wheels
goals.hint: Wheel Mounts with Tires turn a contraption into a ground vehicle.
goals.why: Fast travel with cargo over land. Later, Rock Cutting Wheels on a Borehead Bearing make tunnel borers.
goals.tip: Hold W over a Wheel Mount to Ponder it. Heavy cars need more rotation: check stress with Engineer's Goggles.
steps: Craft Springs (iron sheets + iron nugget), then four Wheel Mounts (andesite casing, spring, iron sheet).
Craft four Tires (dried kelp around a shaft) and right-click one onto each mount.
Build a chassis with the mounts, a seat and a rotation source (e.g. a Portable Engine); glue it and assemble it with a Physics Assembler.
Rotation into the mounts drives the wheels. Redstone into a mount from the side steers it; from the top it brakes.

goals.hint: 4 Belt Connector + 1 Shaft.
goals.why: Heavier trucks need wider tires to carry the load.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Belt Connector | empty; Middle row: Belt Connector | Shaft | Belt Connector; Bottom row: empty | Belt Connector | empty.
Swap it onto a wheel mount in place of a small tire.

goals.hint: 4 Dried Kelp Block + 1 Shaft.
goals.why: The biggest tire, for rock crawlers that cross rough ground.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Dried Kelp Block | empty; Middle row: Dried Kelp Block | Shaft | Dried Kelp Block; Bottom row: empty | Dried Kelp Block | empty.
Mount it on a wheel mount.

goals.hint: 1 Wooden Slab + 1 Gearbox + 1 Industrial Iron Block.
goals.why: Drives a drill head on a vehicle for tunnelling rigs.
steps: Gather 1 Wooden Slab, 1 Gearbox, 1 Industrial Iron Block.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Wooden Slab; Middle row: Gearbox; Bottom row: Industrial Iron Block.
Attach it to the front of the body.

goals.text: Shape blocks with Extra Bit Manipulation sculpting tools
goals.hint: Sculpting tools add or remove Chisels & Bits bits in spheres and cubes.
goals.why: Big curved shapes in Chisels & Bits blocks, fast.
steps: Use it on blocks to add or remove bits.

goals.hint: A curved spade head and an iron ingot make the rounded-cut tool.
goals.why: Carves rounded shapes into chiseled blocks in one stroke.
steps: Craft a Curved Sculpting Spade Head from diamond nuggets.
Combine the head with an iron ingot.

goals.hint: A straight wire head and an iron ingot make the flat-cut tool.
goals.why: Shaves straight, flat cuts across several bits at once.
steps: Craft a Straight Sculpting Wire Head from diamond nuggets.
Combine the head with an iron ingot.

goals.text: Project a hologram with the Voxel Projector
goals.hint: The Voxel Projector shows a large hologram of an item.
goals.why: Big holograms for decoration and shops.
steps: Place the projector and use an item on it to project that item.
Stick = rotation, redstone = rotation speed, quartz = scale.
Sneak while using them to lower the value.
Glowstone dust toggles lighting; an ender pearl toggles random mode.

goals.text: Project a prepared VOX model with the Voxel Projector
goals.hint: Load a .vox model into the projector with a server command.
goals.why: Your own 3D models as holograms.
goals.tip: Needs a server-side file and command access; the item projection goal needs neither.
steps: The server owner puts the approved .vox file in config/randomthings/models/.
Stand at the projector and run /sf3voxel <model>.
Adjust rotation, speed and scale with the item controls.

goals.hint: Keeps nearby chunks loaded.
goals.why: Lets machines run while you are away.
steps: Ender Anchor: Craft: 8 Obsidian + 1 Stable Ender Pearl
Place it where chunks should stay loaded

goals.hint: Imbue items with fire, poison, wither, experience or collapse.
goals.why: Powers up tools and weapons.
steps: Imbuing Station: Craft: 1 Water bucket + 2 Vine + 1 Terracotta + 2 Lily pad + 1 Emerald
Imbue items with fire, poison, wither, experience or collapse effects

goals.hint: The Spectre line: core, ingot, block, key and sword.
goals.why: Spectre items add ghostly blocks and gear to Random Things.
steps: Spectre items have no recipe in the Random Things jar yet
Check the Spectre items family for what the mod registers

goals.hint: Reads and sends redstone to a linked block.
goals.why: Redstone control over distance.
steps: Basic Redstone Interface: Craft: 4 Iron (any) + 4 Redstone + 1 Stable Ender Pearl
Advanced Redstone Interface: Craft: 4 Redstone (any) + 4 Obsidian + 1 Basic Redstone Interface

goals.text: Open a Chance Cube - if you dare
goals.hint: Breaking a Chance Cube does something random: good or very bad.
goals.why: A gamble: diamonds, mobs, explosions or something silly.
steps: Craft or find a chance cube.
Break it far from your base.

goals.hint: Combine 4 gold blocks, 4 lapis blocks and 1 diamond block.
goals.why: The pendant is the base of every upgrade.
steps: Craft: 4 gold blocks + 4 lapis blocks + 1 diamond block.

goals.hint: A scanner is 4 iron ingots, 4 glass and a Tier 1 pendant.
goals.why: The scanner finds cubes nearby.
steps: Craft: 4 iron ingots + 4 glass + 1 Tier 1 pendant.

goals.hint: Combine 6 string, 2 lapis blocks and a Tier 1 pendant.
goals.why: Lets you pick cubes up instead of breaking them.
steps: Craft: 6 string + 2 lapis blocks + 1 Tier 1 pendant.

goals.text: Upgrade to a Tier 2 Chance Pendant
goals.hint: Combine 4 gold blocks, 4 lapis blocks and the Tier 1 pendant.
goals.why: Tier 2 is the middle step of the pendant ladder.
steps: Craft: 4 gold blocks + 4 lapis blocks + 1 Tier 1 pendant.

goals.text: Upgrade to a Tier 3 Chance Pendant
goals.hint: Combine 4 gold blocks, 4 lapis blocks and the Tier 2 pendant.
goals.why: Tier 3 is the top step of the pendant ladder.
steps: Craft: 4 gold blocks + 4 lapis blocks + 1 Tier 2 pendant.

goals.hint: The Lunkertooth (Deep Below) is an ambush fish in ocean-floor ruins.
goals.why: Ruins hold a loot chest; one chest in three hides a Lunkertooth egg. Its Esca (rare drop) gives Greedy Eye (chest outlines) for the next ruins.
steps: Open the chests carefully: one may hide an ambusher.

obtain.mimicfish:esca: Esca sometimes drops from the Lunkertooth; eat it for about a minute of Greedy Eye, which outlines nearby chests.

mobs.where: Lunkertooth lives in the ocean-floor ruins of the Deep Below mod (it is not a dimension): it hides in the ruin chests and ambushes divers.

goals.text: Take an Anglerfish Egg from a Lunkertooth
goals.hint: The Lunkertooth drops the egg.
goals.why: The egg is the line's trophy.

goals.text: Open a portal to the Wyvern Lair
goals.hint: Craft the Wyvern Portal Staff (Mo' Creatures) and use it to reach the Wyvern Lair.
goals.why: A dimension of wyverns, ores and floating islands; wyvern eggs hatch into flying mounts.
steps: Collect three hearts: fire (fire ogres, fire manticores, Nether hell rats), darkness (werewolves, dark manticores), undead (frost or toxic manticores).
Bottle each into an essence; combine the three with glowstone into an Essence of Light.
Craft the Wyvern Portal Staff (eye of ender, Essence of Light, blaze rod) and right-click with it.
Bring blocks: the lair is islands over a void. Use the staff again to return.

goals.hint: Barako rules a masked Barakoa village in the savanna.
goals.why: Drops the Sol Visage, a mask that calls down sun strikes.
steps: Find a savanna village of masked Barakoa (huts and a throne).
Defeat the guards, then Barako. Move when the ground glows: his sun strikes follow you.

obtain.mowziesmobs:barako_mask: Dropped by Barako, the Sun Chief.

mobs.where: The Sun Chief sits on his throne in a Barakoa village in the savanna, guarded by masked Barakoa.

goals.hint: Barako drops his mask.
goals.why: The mask carries the sun chief's power.

goals.hint: A huge ice ape asleep in snowy biomes; its breath freezes you.
goals.why: Drops the Ice Crystal, which breathes frost on enemies.
steps: Search snowy plains and ice spikes for a sleeping giant ape.
Bring a bow and good armor; stay out of its breath cone.

mobs.where: Sleeps in snowy biomes (snowy plains, ice spikes). Its icy breath freezes you; fight it with fire resistance or from range.

goals.hint: The Frostmaw holds an ice crystal.
goals.why: The crystal is a weapon from the snow boss.
steps: Steal the crystal (it has its own advancement).

goals.hint: The king waits at the top of an Abyss Walker castle, 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn.
goals.why: A CQR tier 2 boss with Age 4 loot: the Walker sword and shield.
steps: Go 1,500 to 4,000 blocks out (Ring Map page) and find a dark castle.
Clear its floors, then fight the king. It teleports: stay in the open.

obtain.cqrepoured:sword_walker: Dropped by the Abyss Walker King.

mobs.where: Rules the Abyss Walker castles (CQR tier 2) in the middle ring, 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn.

goals.hint: Equipment chests hold revolvers and muskets; treasure chests hold the captain revolver and bubble guns.
goals.why: Ranged damage for dungeons.
steps: Open an equipment chest for a revolver or musket.
Take bullets from the same chests.

goals.hint: Equipment chests hold the hookshot; treasure chests hold the longshot.
goals.why: Fast travel and climbing.
steps: Open equipment chests for the hookshot.
The spider hook and longshot are variants.

goals.hint: Treasure chests hold the king's crown.
goals.why: A rare trophy and equipment piece.
steps: Open treasure chests in boss rooms.

goals.text: Win a golden feather, bell or bull horn
goals.hint: Treasure chests hold the golden feather and spiked glove; the magic bell and bull horn sit in dungeon structures.
goals.why: Mobility and utility items from boss rooms.
steps: Open treasure chests for the golden feather and spiked glove.
Break the magic bell or bull horn in a dungeon.

goals.hint: Treasure chests hold inquisition, spider, turtle and cloud armor; equipment chests hold bull and slime armor.
goals.why: Mid-game armor sets with their own looks.
steps: Collect four pieces of one set.

goals.hint: The Vessel haunts ruined temples in the middle ring and summons copies of itself.
goals.why: Drops ectoplasm and its vessel.
steps: Explore ruined temples 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn.
Find the real Vessel among its copies and focus it.

mobs.where: Haunts ruined temples in the middle ring, 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn (84 HP), and summons copies of itself.

goals.text: Get a Protection Talisman or Agility Talon
goals.hint: Both come from the mod witchcraft loot tables and treasure trades.
goals.why: Resistance or speed while you carry it.

goals.hint: Found in the witchcraft loot tables.
goals.why: Your pets gain resistance and damage.
steps: Carry the charm while pets fight.

goals.hint: Relics come from witchcraft loot tables and treasure trades.
goals.why: Each relic adds one passive power.
steps: Wisp Locket: spawns a wisp when a foe dies.
Blast Skull: foes may explode on death.
Hunter's Eye: shows mobs through walls.

goals.hint: Find the Nekros and defeat it.
goals.why: The Nekros drops dark goop, a material of the mod.

goals.hint: Hunt a Netherhound in the Nether and defeat it.
goals.why: Netherhounds drop the charred fur of the Charred Cloak.

goals.hint: A Charred Cloak is 1 bone and 5 charred fur.
goals.why: The cloak is the Netherhound line's gear.

goals.text: Take a Kunai or a Spike
goals.hint: Bonepiles drop kunai; Damcells drop spikes.
goals.why: Throwing and melee extras from the bone and spike mobs.
steps: Kill a Bonepile for a Kunai.
Kill a Damcell for a Spike.

goals.text: Collect Ectoplasm from Ghosts and the Vessel
goals.hint: Ghosts and the Vessel drop ectoplasm.
goals.why: Ectoplasm is the ghost line's material.

goals.hint: Cursed trees grow in the beasts' land; craft planks, doors, fences and gates from the logs.
goals.why: A full wood set for building.

goals.hint: Place it to craft with souls.
goals.why: The soul crafting station.
steps: Altar of Souls: Craft: 1 Book of Shadows + 2 Soumberglass Ingot + 4 Obsidians (any)
Use it to turn wool, glass, a cake or a cookie into soul items

goals.hint: Place it to craft with blood.
goals.why: The blood crafting station.
steps: Altar of Blood: Craft: 1 Book of Carnage + 2 Soumberglass Ingot + 4 Netherrack
Use it to turn wool into Bloodweave Cloth and other blood items

goals.hint: The Harbinger appears at night 1,500+ blocks from spawn and drops the Reaper Scythe.
goals.why: The Reaper Scythe and Necronomicon pages open Harken Scythe soul crafting: essence keepers and the soul tools.
steps: Go 1,500 or more blocks from spawn at night, well armored.
Defeat it and pick up the Reaper Scythe and the pages.

mobs.where: Appears in the Overworld at night from the middle ring (1,500 blocks) outward. It carries the Reaper Scythe.

goals.hint: Craft: 5 Obsidians + 1 Ender Eye + 1 Blaze Rod.
goals.why: The end-of-Age-4 sword in the giant sword line.

goals.hint: 4 electrum plates + 3 ender eyes + an RFTools Machine Frame + a redstone block.
goals.why: Turns ender pearls into steady RF.
steps: Ender Generator MK.I: 4 electrum plates + 3 Eyes of Ender + RFTools Machine Frame + redstone block.
Ender Generator MK.II: 8 Ender Generator MK.I around 1 Vibrant Crystal.
Ender Generator MK.III: 4 Dragon Breath + 4 Diamond Block + Ender Generator MK.II.

goals.why: Ender Generator upgrades: Ender Generator MK.II, Ender Generator MK.III.

goals.hint: Plant creepballs on soul sand, till with a glaive, and germinate seeds.
goals.why: Biomass gives a renewable material line for tools and armor.
steps: Biomass Seed: Craft: Fermented spider eye + Nether wart (any) + Netherrack
Creepball: Craft: 4 Rotten flesh + 4 Spider eye + 1 Slime balls (any)

goals.text: Age 4 boss: defeat the Frostmaw (or Barako or the Abyss Walker King)
goals.hint: The Frostmaw opens Age 5 (New Worlds) for everyone on the server. The Twilight Forest and Aether portals open with it.
goals.why: When anyone on the server defeats one of these bosses, Age 5 opens for every player at once: its guide chapter, the reward bag and the decree of the age you finished. The Twilight Forest and Aether portals work for everyone from then on. Age 5 also brings terrasteel, Extreme Reactors, Draconic Evolution, the End and the Wither.
goals.tip: The killer, or anyone within 64 blocks when it dies, opens the age for the whole server. Nothing to craft or hand in. /sf3ages lists every gate.
steps: Frostmaw: snowy biomes, asleep in the open; it wakes when hit.
Barako the Sun Chief: chief of a Barakoa village in a savanna.
Abyss Walker King: the top of an Abyss Walker castle, 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn.
Bring: your best Age 4 gear (dark steel or Tinkers weapons), a bow or gun, healing and fire resistance. Use ranged damage on Barako and the Frostmaw.
Defeat one. Chat announces the new age and this goal ticks itself (ages open in order).
Drops: Frostmaw: Ice Crystal. Barako: Sol Visage. Walker King: diamonds, emeralds, his sword and shield.

goals.hint: Yellorite Ore generates underground.
goals.why: Smelting it gives yellorium, the reactor fuel.
Yellorite ore: Yellorite Ore.
Ores and crystals: Anglesite (PbSO4), Anglesite Ore, Benitoite (BaTiSi3O9) and 3 more.

goals.hint: Casing: 4 iron ingots + 4 graphite ingots + a casing core.
goals.why: The walls of the reactor.
steps: Reactor Casing: 4 iron ingot + 4 graphite ingot + Reactor Casing Core.
Reactor Glass: 2 colorless glass block + Reactor Casing.
Reactor Access Port: 4 Reactor Casing + Chest + Piston.

goals.why: Storage blocks and casing cores: Blutonium Block, Cyanite Block, Graphite Block and 5 more.

goals.hint: Power taps and ports sit in the casing wall.
goals.why: Take power out and feed fuel in.
steps: Reactor Redstone Flux Power Tap: 4 Reactor Casing + 4 Redstone.
Reactor Coolant Port: 4 Reactor Casing + 2 iron ingot + Bucket + Piston.
Reactor Access Port: 4 Reactor Casing + Chest + Piston.
Reactor Redstone Port: 4 Reactor Casing + 4 Redstone + Gold Ingot.

goals.why: Reactor ports: Reactor Access Port, Reactor Computer Port, Reactor Coolant Port and 4 more.

goals.hint: Turbine: 4 iron frames + 2 iron tubing + 2 iron wiring + a rotor.
goals.why: One turbine per metal tier.
steps: Iron Turbine: 4 Iron Frame + 2 Iron Tubing + 2 Iron Wiring + Iron Turbine Rotor.
Steel Turbine: 4 Iron Frame + 2 Iron Tubing + 2 Iron Wiring + Steel Turbine Rotor.
Gold Plated Turbine: 4 Iron Frame + 2 Iron Tubing + 2 Iron Wiring + Gold Plated Turbine Rotor.
Manyullyn Turbine: 4 Iron Frame + 2 Iron Tubing + 2 Iron Wiring + Manyullyn Turbine Rotor.
Vibrant Turbine: 4 Iron Frame + 2 Iron Tubing + 2 Iron Wiring + Vibrant Turbine Rotor.

goals.why: Turbines: Advanced Alloy Turbine, Bronze Turbine, Enderium Turbine and 5 more.

goals.hint: Kit: a rotor of that metal + an upgrade kit.
goals.why: Upgrade a placed turbine without rebuilding.
steps: Steel Turbine Upgrade Kit: Steel Turbine Rotor + Upgrade Kit.
Gold Plated Turbine Upgrade Kit: Gold Plated Turbine Rotor + Upgrade Kit.
Vibrant Turbine Upgrade Kit: Vibrant Turbine Rotor + Upgrade Kit.

goals.why: Turbine kits: Advanced Alloy Turbine Upgrade Kit, Bronze Turbine Upgrade Kit, Enderium Turbine Upgrade Kit and 4 more.

goals.hint: Upgrades improve a built generator.
goals.why: Raises how much power each fuel unit gives.
steps: Upgrade Kit: 2 iron ingot + 2 wooden rod.
Fuel/Air Mixer: 4 Iron Frame + 2 Piston + Pressure Valve + Iron Bars + Iron Tubing.
Advanced Capacitor Upgrade Kit: 4 Iron Wiring + 4 Double Layer Capacitor + Upgrade Kit.

goals.why: Upgrade kits: Advanced Capacitor Upgrade Kit, High Density Capacitor Upgrade Kit, Fuel/Air Mixer and 2 more.
Power capacitors: Advanced Power Capacitor, High Density Power Capacitor, Basic Power Capacitor.

goals.hint: Emitter: Power IO + 2 iron frames + a metal + iron wiring.
goals.why: Pick one of five voltage levels per emitter.
steps: Low Voltage Emitter: Power IO Module + 2 Iron Frame + Copper Ingot + Iron Wiring.
Medium Voltage Emitter: Power IO Module + 2 Iron Frame + Gold Ingot + Iron Wiring.
High Voltage Emitter: Power IO Module + 2 Iron Frame + Diamond + Iron Wiring.
Extreme Voltage Emitter: Power IO Module + 2 Iron Frame + Emerald + Iron Wiring.
Insane Voltage Emitter: 3 Power IO Module + 2 Iron Frame + Netherite Ingot + Iron Wiring.

goals.why: Voltage emitters: Extreme Voltage Emitter, High Voltage Emitter, Insane Voltage Emitter and 2 more.

goals.text: Make kneaded clay and ceramic plates
goals.hint: Kneaded Clay: 2 clay balls + a water bucket.
goals.why: Ceramic plates and cells are made from clay.
steps: Kneaded Clay: 2 Clay Ball + Water Bucket.

goals.why: Clay and glass: Ceramic Plate, Dry Clay Dust, Kneaded Clay and 3 more.

goals.hint: Controller Tier 1: 4 iron blocks + 4 lightning rods + a basalt machine base.
goals.why: The first multiblock of the mod.
steps: Lightning Rod Controller Tier 1: 4 Iron Block + 4 Lightning Rod + Basalt Machine Base.
Lightning Rod: 2 Iron Bars + Iron Block.

goals.why: Lightning controllers: Lightning Rod Controller Tier 1, Lightning Rod Controller Tier 2, Lightning Rod Controller Tier 3 and 1 more.

goals.text: Build a Void Resource Miner Controller
goals.hint: Tier 1: 4 gold blocks + a quartz block + a clear lens + 2 stone + a laser core.
goals.why: Pulls resources out of the void itself.
steps: Void Resource Miner Controller Tier 1: 4 Gold Block + Quartz Block + Clear Lens + 2 Stone + Laser Core.

goals.why: Void Resource Miner controllers: Void Resource Miner Controller Tier 1, Void Resource Miner Controller Tier 2, Void Resource Miner Controller Tier 3 a.

goals.hint: The cauldron brews relic potions.
goals.why: Needed for potions and essence.
steps: Apothecary Cauldron: Craft: 2 Catalyzing Gland + 3 Nebulous Heart + 2 Infernal Claw + 1 Cauldron + 1 Molten Core
Apothecary Mortar: Craft: 3 Catalyzing Gland + 6 Quartz block
Grind ingredients in the mortar, then brew in the cauldron

goals.hint: The Handgun fires bullets from magazines.
goals.why: A ranged weapon that uses the bullets and magazines of the Reliquary line.
steps: Hunter's Handgun: Craft: 1 Barrel Assembly + 5 Iron ingot + 1 Hammer Assembly + 1 Slime Pearl + 1 Grip Assembly
Empty Magazine: Craft: 5 Iron ingot + 1 Glass + 2 Stone

goals.hint: Generate 1,000 FE/t into a load and keep it stable.
goals.why: Enough for a full early workshop.
goals.tip: Production, not stored energy or nameplate capacity.
steps: Add generators until they make 1,000 FE/t together; keep their fuel, cooling or daylight supplied.
Connect storage or a load that takes all 1,000 FE/t (check cable and port limits).
Measure the 1,000 FE/t actually delivered (don't count power twice as it passes through).
Hold 1,000 FE/t long enough to be stable, then tick the goal.

goals.hint: Biome Absorber: 2 dirt + 4 white wool + 2 oak saplings + Machine Frame.
goals.why: Absorbers soak up a biome or block for your dimension.
steps: Biome Absorber: 2 Dirt + 4 White Wool + 2 Oak Sapling + Machine Frame.
Feature Absorber: 2 Diamond + 4 White Wool + 2 Emerald + Machine Frame.
Liquid Absorber: 4 Bucket + 4 White Wool + Machine Frame.

goals.why: Absorbers and probes: Activity Probe, Biome Absorber, Dimension Monitor and 6 more.

goals.hint: Cast a line into lava or Nether pools.
goals.why: Lava and Nether fishing give the fiery fish.
steps: Fish in lava or Nether liquid with a fishing rod.
Bone Fish comes from lava fishing.

goals.hint: copper plates.
goals.why: Link 1 of 3 of the Copper to ammo route; next: IE or Create press.

goals.hint: Craft a Basic Biome Scanner from maps, a screen and a Machine Frame.
goals.why: Shows the biomes around you.
steps: Craft a Basic Biome Scanner: 2 maps + Screen + 5 iron ingots + Machine Frame.
Use it to read the nearby biomes.

goals.hint: Fished in the Nether or dropped by zombified piglins.
goals.why: The explosive fish and the mod's signature item.
steps: Fish in the Nether, or kill zombified piglins.

goals.hint: Craft an Advanced Biome Scanner from the Basic one and 8 gold ingots.
goals.why: Second tier, made from the Basic scanner.
steps: Craft an Advanced Biome Scanner: 8 gold ingots + Biome Scanner (Basic).

goals.hint: Gun Smith Table, ammo: 10 copper + 2 gunpowder makes 50 rounds of 9mm.
goals.why: The end of the Copper to ammo route.

goals.hint: Fished in the Nether or dropped by zombified piglins.
goals.why: A burning swordfish that works as a weapon.
steps: Fish in the Nether, or kill zombified piglins.

goals.hint: Magma cream and string make it.
goals.why: String that resists lava; the rod needs it.

goals.hint: 3 gold ingots and 2 pieces of Magma String.
goals.why: A fishing rod that can cast into lava, built from gold and Magma String.
steps: Golden Rod: 3 gold ingots + 2 Magma String

goals.hint: Cooled and tempered fish are the safe forms.
goals.why: Harmless versions of the explosive catches.
steps: Cooled Cod is the cooled form of the Combustive Cod.
Tempered Swordfish is the tempered form of the Searing Swordfish.

goals.text: Mine the gem and dust gravel ores
goals.hint: Coal, lapis, redstone, diamond and emerald gravel ores.
goals.why: Each gives the same result as the stone ore.

goals.hint: A brewing stand, slabs and a crafting table make the potion-themed bench.
goals.why: Variants of amethyst, lapis, gold, diamond and other gem blocks.
steps: Craft the Alchemy Bench from a brewing stand, wooden slabs and a crafting table.
Place it and put a gem block in the input.

goals.hint: Chocolate Bar uses a saucepan, cocoa powder, butter and milk.
goals.why: Sweets and ice cream use their own ingredients, and chocolate unlocks many of them.
steps: Chocolate Bar: Saucepan + Cocoa Powder + Butter + any milk
Make butter and cocoa powder in the pantry first.

goals.hint: String and grain, fruit or veggies make bait in batches of 4.
goals.why: Every trap needs bait, and the type picks what it catches.

goals.hint: Load bait to collect meat, leather and feathers over time.
goals.why: Passive animal drops without hunting.
steps: Ground Trap: 4 sticks + Oak Trapdoor + 3 string + Chest
Load grain, veggie or fruit bait.

goals.hint: Load bait in water to catch fish over time.
goals.why: Passive fish for the seafood dishes.
steps: Water Trap: 4 sticks + Fishing Rod + 3 string + Chest

goals.hint: Pam fish are added to normal fishing loot.
goals.why: Raw fish and shellfish feed the seafood dishes.
steps: Fish with a rod in any water.
Cook raw catches in a furnace.

goals.hint: Wild beehives generate in the Overworld and give a Queen Bee.
goals.why: The Queen Bee is what the Apiary needs to run.
steps: Look for beehives in the Overworld.
Break one and pick up the Queen Bee.

goals.hint: Put a Queen Bee in it to make honeycomb, wax comb and grubs.
goals.why: Flowers, crops and gardens nearby speed it up; the queen wears out.

goals.hint: Presses honeycomb, wax comb and other items into honey, wax and oils.
goals.why: Honey, wax and cooking oil feed dozens of recipes.
steps: Place it and load an item to press.

goals.hint: Sell crops and food for emeralds.
goals.why: Surplus harvests turn into emeralds for Market trades.
steps: Shipping Bin: 4 planks (any wood) + 4 logs (any wood) + emerald gem

goals.hint: Wells hold water for recipes.
goals.why: A permanent water source for the kitchen.

goals.hint: Six biome gardens generate in the world.
goals.why: Gardens grow crops without planting.
steps: Look for gardens in their matching biomes.

goals.hint: Pressed Wax and string make sixteen candle blocks.
goals.why: Candles are the mod's decoration set.

goals.hint: Pressed Wax and leather make hardened leather.
goals.why: A craftable early armor set from the mod.

goals.hint: Chili plus chili pepper makes the hottest dish.
goals.why: The last dish of the original cooking ladder.

goals.hint: 1 basic to diamond tier upgrade + 1 netherite ingot.
goals.why: The largest chest and barrel tier.
steps: Craft it from the diamond tier upgrade + 1 netherite ingot.
Right-click a diamond chest or barrel with it.

goals.hint: Smelt Kreknorite rock.
goals.why: Kreknorite is the next metal tier and unlocks its tool and armor set.
steps: Kreknorite Ingot: Craft: Starsteel (any) + Kreknorite Shard + Dimensional catalyst
Kreknorite shards come from Kreknorite rock that falls as a meteor

goals.hint: Smelt Frezarite rock.
goals.why: Frezarite is the next metal tier and unlocks its tool and armor set.
steps: Combine it with a Starsteel ingot and a Dimensional Catalyst in the crafting grid.

goals.hint: Tektite is the top Nyx tier.
goals.why: The strongest Nyx weapon.

goals.hint: Craft Dimensional Catalysts, then forge Starsteel or Starglass with a Fallen Star.
goals.why: The star metals make the spotting scope and sword.
steps: Dimensional Catalyst: 1 fallen star + 1 ender pearl makes 16.
Starsteel Ingot: catalyst + iron + fallen star.
Starglass Ingot: catalyst + glass block + fallen star.

goals.text: Craft the Spotting Scope and Starglass Sword
goals.hint: Use the star ingots for a scope and a sword.
goals.why: Late weapons from the star line.

goals.hint: Craft a Phoenix Feather, then the charm from the feather, string and a catalyst.
goals.why: The top charm of the mod.
steps: Phoenix Feather: 4 ghast tears + 4 blaze powder + 1 feather.
Phoenix Charm: Phoenix Feather + string + Dimensional Catalyst.

goals.hint: Elixirs of Life, Health, Star and Eye come from late structure loot.
goals.why: Elixirs give lasting buffs.

goals.hint: Speed, capacity, tank and RF upgrades come in three tiers each.
goals.why: Faster and bigger machines.
steps: Craft tier 1 first, then tiers 2 and 3.

goals.hint: Parents: Iron Chicken + Silicon Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 electrical steel ingot; drops 1 electrical steel ingot when killed.
steps: Pen an Iron Chicken and a Silicon Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or an Electrical Steel Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Energetic Alloy Chicken + Ender Pearl Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 vibrant alloy ingot; drops 1 vibrant alloy ingot when killed.
steps: Pen an Energetic Alloy Chicken and an Ender Pearl Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Vibrant Alloy Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Glowstone Chicken + Ender Pearl Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 yellorium ingot; drops 1 yellorium ingot when killed. Parent of Cyanite Chicken.
steps: Pen a Glowstone Chicken and an Ender Pearl Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Yellorium Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Yellorium Chicken + Sand Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 cyanite ingot; drops 1 cyanite ingot when killed. Parent of Blutonium Chicken.
steps: Pen a Yellorium Chicken and a Sand Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Cyanite Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Cyanite Chicken + Water Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 blutonium ingot; drops 1 blutonium ingot when killed.
steps: Pen a Cyanite Chicken and a Water Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Blutonium Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Netherite walls and a netherite core.
goals.why: The top tier of the chest.
steps: Build the box from netherite walls.
Place the netherite chest on it.

goals.text: Take a Burnt Ovipositor and Imp Horn
goals.hint: Warmanders drop burnt ovipositors, which make molten beef; Flame Imps drop horns.
goals.why: The start of the molten line.
steps: Imp Horn: kill a Flame Imp; 1 horn makes 2 blaze powder.

goals.text: Craft a Reaper's Scythe and special bombs
goals.hint: The scythe needs claws and a hatred shard; special bombs add ectoplasm or a vocal cord.
goals.why: A late scythe and two bombs.
steps: Reaper's Scythe: 3 scythe claws + 1 hatred shard + 2 wooden rods.
Ghost Bomb x4: 4 basic bombs + 1 ectoplasm mass.
Sonic Bomb x4: 4 basic bombs + 1 banshee vocal cord.

goals.text: Take the Skeleton King's Crown and Mace
goals.hint: The Skeleton King drops the crown, mace, emblem and beast claw.
goals.why: His crown and mace are the mod's top gear.
steps: Pick up the crown and mace.

goals.hint: Alloy needs molten beef, a fire charge and a diamond.
goals.why: Alloy is the molten line's base.
steps: Molten Alloy: 2 molten beef + 1 fire charge + 1 diamond.
War: 4 molten beef + 1 burnt ovipositor + 1 dispenser.

goals.hint: Axe, hammer and pan use alloy and blaze rods.
goals.why: The pan unlocks the molten recipes in the food section.
steps: Anvil: a molten tool + Soulforged Heart makes its soulforged version.

goals.text: Craft the Molten Heart and Soulforged Heart
goals.hint: Molten Heart first, then the Soulforged Heart from ectoplasm ingots.
goals.why: Soulforged gear needs the heart.
steps: Molten Heart: 4 blaze powder + 1 lava bucket + 3 molten beef + 1 undying heart.
Soulforged Heart: 8 ectoplasm ingots + 1 molten heart.

goals.hint: Molten alloy makes all four pieces; the chest adds a molten heart.
goals.why: Molten armor is the base for Soulforged armor at the anvil.

goals.hint: Combine a Soulforged Heart with a molten armor piece at an anvil.
goals.why: The top armor of the mod.
steps: Anvil: Molten Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings or Boots + Soulforged Heart.

goals.hint: Ectoplasm ingots make the pieces; the chestplate adds a Soulforged Heart.
goals.why: The ectoplasm armor line, with a Soulforged Heart in the chestplate.

goals.hint: Gold, a nether star and a Soulforged Heart.
goals.why: A relic of the molten line.
steps: Craft: 7 gold ingots + 1 nether star + 1 Soulforged Heart.

goals.text: Cook Bone Stew, Crabcakes and Baobing
goals.hint: These meals use a molten or soulforged pan.
goals.why: Pan meals need a molten or soulforged pan and cook stews, cakes and ices.
steps: Bone Stew: bowl + pan + bones + bloodtooth shroom.
Crabcake x2: mousse + mimic claw + pan.
Baobing: bowl + pan + shattered ice + cactus fruit.

goals.hint: Pan meals with sugar cane, nether wart and chicken.
goals.why: Sugar cane, nether wart and imp horn meals that need the pan.
steps: Cane Beef x2: sugar cane + beef + pan.
Cane Pork x2: sugar cane + porkchop + pan.
Kung Pao Chicken: bowl + pan + chicken + imp horn.

goals.hint: Nether Accord: handed out when Age 4 opens; with paper, an ink sac and a gold nugget it crafts the Nether Decree.
goals.why: Keeps the Nether Decree craftable, and one right-click pays the Age 4 reward.
steps: Open Nether and Power by defeating its boss.
Right-click the Nether Accord once for the reward.
Craft the Nether Decree: Nether Accord + paper + ink sac + gold nugget.

goals.text: Build a Nether Star Generator MK.I
goals.hint: MK.II: 4 vibrant crystals + 4 iron blocks + the MK.I.
goals.why: The top generator family of the mod.
steps: Nether Star Generator MK.I: 4 Stone + Diamond Block + 2 Nether Star + Furnace + Redstone Block.
Nether Star Generator MK.II: 4 Vibrant Crystal + 4 Iron Block + Nether Star Generator MK.I.
Nether Star Generator MK.III: 4 Dragon Breath + 4 Diamond Block + Nether Star Generator MK.II.

goals.why: Nether Star Generator upgrades: Nether Star Generator MK.II, Nether Star Generator MK.III.

goals.hint: Applied to a placed panel.
goals.why: More output from one panel without more space.
steps: Efficiency upgrade: 3 Photovoltaic cell I + Blank upgrade + Photovoltaic cell II.
Low light upgrade: 6 glass block + 2 glowstone dust + Blank upgrade.
Machine traversal upgrade: 4 iron ingot + 2 redstone dust + Blank upgrade.
Furnace upgrade: 7 Coal + Blank upgrade + Furnace.

goals.hint: Energetic Alloy Ingot + Ender Pearl, smelted in an Alloy Smelter (10,000 energy).
goals.why: Vibrant Alloy is needed for the Octadic Capacitor, the Powered Spawner and the farming upgrades.
steps: Smelt an Energetic Alloy Ingot: redstone, gold ingot and glowstone dust in the Alloy Smelter.
Put that ingot and an Ender Pearl in the Alloy Smelter.
Take the Vibrant Alloy Ingot; the essence recipes are a slower alternative.

goals.hint: 2 Energetic Alloy Ingot + 2 Basic Capacitor + 1 Coal Dust.
goals.why: Step up from the Basic Capacitor; needed for capacitor banks and the Octadic Capacitor.
steps: Gather 2 Energetic Alloy Ingot, 2 Basic Capacitor, 1 Coal Dust.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Energetic Alloy Ingot | empty.
Middle row: Basic Capacitor | Coal Dust | Basic Capacitor.
Bottom row: empty | Energetic Alloy Ingot | empty.
Place the alloy above and below, capacitors left and right, coal dust in the center.

goals.hint: 3 Dark Steel Ingot + 2 Wooden Rod.
goals.why: The first dark steel tool and the start of the dark steel tool line.
steps: Gather 3 Dark Steel Ingot, 2 Wooden Rod.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Dark Steel Ingot | Dark Steel Ingot | Dark Steel Ingot; Middle row: empty | Wooden Rod | empty; Bottom row: empty | Wooden Rod | empty.
Mine with it and repair it with dark steel.

goals.hint: 3 Electrical Steel Ingot + 2 Fluid Tank + 1 Machine Chassis + 2 Stone Gear + 1 Piston.
goals.why: Burns fluid fuel for steady power once the Stirling Generator is too small.
steps: Gather 3 Electrical Steel Ingot, 2 Fluid Tank, 1 Machine Chassis, 2 Stone Gear, 1 Piston.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Electrical Steel Ingot | Electrical Steel Ingot | Electrical Steel Ingot.
Middle row: Fluid Tank | Machine Chassis | Fluid Tank.
Bottom row: Stone Gear | Piston | Stone Gear.
Pipe fuel in and attach a conduit.

goals.hint: 8 Dark Steel Ingot.
goals.why: Armor tier above iron, with the same shape of recipe as vanilla.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Dark Steel Ingot | empty | Dark Steel Ingot.
Middle row: Dark Steel Ingot | Dark Steel Ingot | Dark Steel Ingot.
Bottom row: Dark Steel Ingot | Dark Steel Ingot | Dark Steel Ingot.
Craft the chestplate first, then the other pieces.

goals.hint: 7 Iron Ingot + 1 Wooden Chest + 1 Pulsating Crystal.
goals.why: Pulls dropped items from the ground into itself so mob farms need no hoppers.
steps: Gather 7 Iron Ingot, 1 Wooden Chest, 1 Pulsating Crystal.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Iron Ingot | Iron Ingot | Iron Ingot.
Middle row: Iron Ingot | Wooden Chest | Iron Ingot.
Bottom row: Iron Ingot | Pulsating Crystal | Iron Ingot.
Place it where a farm drops items.

goals.hint: 1 Restonia Crystal + 1 Double Battery + 2 Iron Casing + 1 Display Stand.
goals.why: Upgrades crystals into empowered ones for the late tools and machines.
steps: Gather 1 Restonia Crystal, 1 Double Battery, 2 Iron Casing, 1 Display Stand.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Restonia Crystal | empty; Middle row: empty | Double Battery | empty; Bottom row: Iron Casing | Display Stand | Iron Casing.
Place Display Stands around it with the base item in the center.

goals.hint: first TaCZ pistols.
goals.why: The end of the IE steel opens Create and guns route.

goals.hint: 2 Redstone Dust + 1 Component Iron + 2 Iron Ingot + 1 Coil Lv.
goals.why: Turns windmill rotation into power for the wire network.
steps: Gather 2 Redstone Dust, 1 Component Iron, 2 Iron Ingot, 1 Coil Lv.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Redstone Dust | Component Iron | Redstone Dust; Bottom row: Iron Ingot | Coil Lv | Iron Ingot.
Attach it to a Windmill and run a wire.

goals.hint: 4 Steel Sheetmetal + 4 Component Steel + 1 Electrum Ingot (makes 4).
goals.why: Core block for the big multiblocks such as the Arc Furnace and Refinery.
steps: Gather 4 Steel Sheetmetal, 4 Component Steel, 1 Electrum Ingot.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Steel Sheetmetal | Component Steel | Steel Sheetmetal.
Middle row: Component Steel | Electrum Ingot | Component Steel.
Bottom row: Steel Sheetmetal | Component Steel | Steel Sheetmetal.
Craft a few before the Arc Furnace and Refinery.

goals.hint: 2 Electrum Ingot + 1 Redstone Acid + 1 Nickel Plate + 1 Basic Engineering + 1 Iron Plate.
goals.why: Stores power for machines so they run through gaps in generation.
steps: Gather 2 Electrum Ingot, 1 Redstone Acid, 1 Nickel Plate, 1 Basic Engineering, 1 Iron Plate.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Electrum Ingot | Redstone Acid | Electrum Ingot; Bottom row: Nickel Plate | Basic Engineering | Iron Plate.
Place it next to your generators.

goals.hint: Both are Hammer-built multiblocks that turn crops into ethanol and plant oil.
goals.why: Ethanol and plant oil are the fuel feed for the Refinery and the Diesel Generator.
steps: Build the Squeezer and the Fermenter with the Hammer.
Power both and feed them crops.
Pipe the plant oil and ethanol to the Refinery.

goals.hint: 3 Aluminum Plate + 1 Coil Mv + 1 Component Electronic Adv + 1 Capacitor Hv + 1 Component Iron.
goals.why: Zaps nearby mobs when powered, a defense that needs no ammunition.
steps: Gather 3 Aluminum Plate, 1 Coil Mv, 1 Component Electronic Adv, 1 Capacitor Hv, 1 Component Iron.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Aluminum Plate | Aluminum Plate | Aluminum Plate.
Middle row: empty | Coil Mv | empty.
Bottom row: Component Electronic Adv | Capacitor Hv | Component Iron.

goals.hint: 1 Gunpart Hammer + 1 Wooden Grip + 1 Gunpart Drum + 1 Component Steel + 1 Gunpart Barrel.
goals.why: A ranged weapon with several bullet types for different mobs.
steps: Gather 1 Gunpart Hammer, 1 Wooden Grip, 1 Gunpart Drum, 1 Component Steel, 1 Gunpart Barrel.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Gunpart Hammer | Wooden Grip; Middle row: empty | Gunpart Drum | Component Steel; Bottom row: Gunpart Barrel | empty | empty.
Craft the parts, assemble, then load bullets.

goals.hint: 1 Iron Sheet + 1 Engine Assembly + 1 Blast Furnace.
goals.why: Gives a vehicle its own thrust without an outside power source.
steps: Gather 1 Iron Sheet, 1 Engine Assembly, 1 Blast Furnace.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Iron Sheet; Middle row: Engine Assembly; Bottom row: Blast Furnace.
Mount it at the rear of the body and fuel it.

goals.hint: 1 Brass Sheet + 1 Precision Mechanism + 1 Brass Casing.
goals.why: Plans a route for a vehicle so it can follow a path on its own.
steps: Gather 1 Brass Sheet, 1 Precision Mechanism, 1 Brass Casing.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Brass Sheet; Middle row: Precision Mechanism; Bottom row: Brass Casing.
Place it near the vehicle and set waypoints.

goals.hint: Craft the red engine, then dye it any of the 16 colors.
goals.why: Color-codes engines on a large build so each thruster is easy to find.
steps: Dye each engine with the dye of your choice.

goals.hint: 1 Ender Pearl + 2 Component Simple Pcb + 1 Iron Ingot + 2 Component Reinforced Metal + 1 Component Advanced Pcb.
goals.why: Keeps the chunks around a cart loaded while it runs far from you.
steps: Gather 1 Ender Pearl, 2 Component Simple Pcb, 1 Iron Ingot, 2 Component Reinforced Metal, 1 Component Advanced Pcb.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Ender Pearl | empty.
Middle row: Component Simple Pcb | Iron Ingot | Component Simple Pcb.
Bottom row: Component Reinforced Metal | Component Advanced Pcb | Component Reinforced Metal.
Fit it to the cart and power it.

goals.hint: 9 Component Galgadorian Metal.
goals.why: Galgadorian metal makes the top-tier cart modules and hulls.
steps: Lay out the grid. Top row: Component Galgadorian Metal | Component Galgadorian Metal | Component Galgadorian Metal.
Middle row: Component Galgadorian Metal | Component Galgadorian Metal | Component Galgadorian Metal.
Bottom row: Component Galgadorian Metal | Component Galgadorian Metal | Component Galgadorian Metal.
Find a Lump of Galgador and smelt it.

goals.hint: Iron ingot + wooden rod + diamond.
goals.why: Unstable parts lead to the Opinium cores and the Kikoku.
steps: Unstable Ingot: iron ingot + wooden rod + diamond.

goals.why: Evil and unstable materials: Block Of Evil Infused Ingot, Drop Of Evil, Enchanted Apple and 10 more.

goals.hint: Needs a Ring of the Flying Squid, a Golden Lasso and a Cursed Lasso.
goals.why: Gives flight without armor.
steps: Angel Ring: 2 glass block + 4 Enchanted Ingot + Ring of the Flying Squid + Golden Lasso + Cursed Lasso.
Ring of the Flying Squid: 4 inksac + 2 diamond + Golden Lasso + Chicken Wing Ring + Ender Eye.
Chicken Wing Ring: 2 feather + 3 Enchanted Ingot + Golden Lasso + 2 Resonating Redstone Crystal + iron ingot.

goals.why: Rings and carry gear: Bag Of Holding, Chicken Wing Ring, Chunk Loading Ward and 3 more.

goals.hint: Mills use Stoneburnt, a Resonating Redstone Crystal and a Redstone Gear.
goals.why: Mills are cheap Grid Power; the Dragon Egg Mill is the late one.
steps: Manual Mill: Redstone Gear + 2 Smooth Stone + Resonating Redstone Crystal.
Water Mill: 6 Stoneburnt + 2 Redstone Gear + Resonating Redstone Crystal.
Wind Mill: 6 Stoneburnt + Redstone Gear + Resonating Redstone Crystal.
Lava Mill: 7 Stoneburnt + Resonating Redstone Crystal + gold ingot.
Fire Mill: 6 Stoneburnt + Resonating Redstone Crystal + Redstone Gear + Nether Brick Fence.

goals.why: Mills: Creative Mill, Dragon Egg Mill, Fire Mill and 4 more.

goals.hint: A Climograph Base Unit + 2 Enchanting Tables.
goals.why: Adds Magic Infuser processing to your base.
steps: Magic Infuser: Climograph Base Unit + 2 Enchanting Table.

goals.why: Magic parts: Magic Absorbtion, Magic Infuser.

goals.text: Build with ethereal glass and polished stone
goals.hint: Glass types, stone types, compressed blocks and metal blocks.
goals.why: Decoration blocks, plus the stoneburnt material used by the machine recipes.
steps: Ethereal Glass: 8 colorless glass block + Moon Stone.

goals.why: Glass and decor blocks: Gilded Obsidian, Block of Demon Metal, Block of Enchanted Metal and 17 more.
Compressed cobblestone: Compressed Cobblestone, Double Compressed Cobblestone, Octuple Compressed Cobblestone and 5 more.

goals.hint: Resonating Redstone Crystal + Stoneburnt; a Wireless RF Battery stores the power.
goals.why: Sends RF between places with no cable run.
steps: Wireless RF Transmitter: Resonating Redstone Crystal + Stoneburnt.
Wireless RF Battery: 6 Stoneburnt + 2 redstone block + Resonating Redstone Crystal.
Wireless Battery: 6 Stoneburnt + 2 redstone block + Resonating Redstone Crystal.

goals.why: Wireless parts: Wireless Battery, Heating Resonator, Wireless RF Battery and 1 more.

goals.hint: 6 Stoneburnt + 2 Resonating Redstone Crystals + a Screen.
goals.why: Searches your storage from one block.
steps: Indexer: 6 Stoneburnt + 2 Resonating Redstone Crystal + Screen.
Screen: 3 Stoneburnt + 2 Ender Shard + Resonating Redstone Crystal.
Player Chest: 7 Stoneburnt + Ender Chest + Resonating Redstone Crystal.

goals.why: Network machines: Indexer Remote, Player Chest, Power Manager and 2 more.

goals.text: Reshape a biome with the Terraformer
goals.hint: Terraformer: 2 ender pearls + a Climograph Base Unit + 2 redstone + a Comparator.
goals.why: Changes the biome of the land around it.
steps: Terraformer: 2 ender pearl + Climograph Base Unit + 2 redstone dust + Comparator.
Climograph Base Unit: 4 iron ingot + 2 diamond + 2 sapling + Machine Block.
Antenna: 2 End Rod + 3 iron ingot + sapling.

goals.why: Climate parts: Climograph Base Unit, Sun Crystal, Antenna.

goals.hint: Redstone dust around a block of redstone and a Magmatic Generator.
goals.why: Burns redstone for more output than the Magmatic Generator.
steps: Heated Redstone Generator: 7 redstone dust + redstone block + Magmatic Generator.
Magmatic Generator: 5 gold ingot + Lava Bucket + 2 redstone dust + Furnace Generator.
Potion Generator: 5 Blaze Rod + Brewing Stand + 2 redstone dust + Furnace Generator.

goals.hint: 4 blaze rods + 1 black wool + 2 obsidian + 1 cauldron + 1 ender pearl.
goals.why: The same linking for fluids.
steps: Craft it from 4 blaze rods + 1 wool + 2 obsidian + 1 cauldron + 1 ender pearl.
Place it and set the colors.

goals.hint: 2 glass blocks + 3 redstone + 1 16k storage part + 3 quartz enriched irons.
goals.why: Disks grow without extra slots.
steps: Craft the 16k part, then the disk around it.
Put it in the Disk Drive.

goals.hint: 4 quartz enriched irons + 1 crafting table + 2 patterns + 1 machine casing + 1 furnace.
goals.why: Encode patterns for machines as well as crafting tables.
steps: Craft it from 4 quartz enriched iron + 1 crafting table + 2 patterns + 1 machine casing + 1 furnace.
Encode a machine recipe and put it in a Crafter.

goals.hint: 4 quartz enriched irons + 3 glass blocks + 1 machine casing + 1 improved processor.
goals.why: See and cancel autocrafting jobs.
steps: Craft it from 4 quartz enriched iron + 3 glass + machine casing + improved processor.

goals.hint: 4 quartz enriched irons + 2 storage housings + 1 construction core + 1 machine casing + 1 destruction core.
goals.why: Moves items between disks and the network.
steps: Craft it from 4 quartz enriched iron + 2 storage housings + 2 cores + a machine casing.
Place it with disks in its slots.

goals.hint: 4 quartz enriched irons + 2 quartz + 2 glowstone dust + 1 basic processor.
goals.why: A multiblock that crafts many patterns at once.
steps: Craft the CPU from 4 quartz enriched iron + 2 quartz + 2 glowstone dust + a basic processor.
Build it with frames, heat and storage blocks.

goals.hint: Frame: 4 quartz enriched iron, 4 gold ingots, improved processor. Storage: crafting table, cores, 1k part.
goals.why: The blocks that build the Multicrafter.
steps: Craft the frame and the storage block.
Craft the heat block (4 quartz enriched iron + 4 iron bars + basic processor).

goals.why: Collect the multicrafter heat block as you unlock them.

goals.hint: 2 glass blocks + 3 redstone + 1 64k fluid storage part + 3 quartz enriched irons.
goals.why: Disks that store fluids; they go on to 512k.
steps: Craft the part from 4 silicon + 1 quartz enriched iron + 3 glass + 1 bucket.
Put it in the Disk Drive.

goals.why: Collect the fluid storage parts as you unlock them.

goals.hint: Crafting, Fortune and Interdimensional upgrades and the Fluid Interface.
goals.why: Upgrades for exporters, importers and the network.
steps: Put upgrades in a machine upgrade slot.

goals.hint: Craft: 3 Ender Pearl + 2 Wand Core.
goals.why: Teleportation is the first utility wand; the other five follow the same pattern with Wand Cores.
steps: Swapping wand: 1 Redstone Block + 2 Gold Ingot + 2 Wand Core
Moving wand: 1 Redstone + 2 Ender Pearl + 2 Wand Core
Displacement wand: 1 Ender Pearl + 2 Brick + 2 Wand Core
Acceleration wand: 3 Bone Meal + 2 Wand Core
Illumination wand: 3 Glowstone Dust + 2 Wand Core

goals.hint: Spawner: 4 redstone + rotten flesh + ender pearl + Machine Frame + blaze rod + bone.
goals.why: Spawns the mobs you feed it; the dragon goal below builds on it.
steps: Spawner: 4 Redstone + Rotten Flesh + Ender Pearl + Machine Frame + Blaze Rod + Bone.

goals.hint: Craft or upgrade: 2 Basic Capacitor + 1 Basic Capacitor Bank + 4 Conductive Iron Ingot + 1 Leather Strap + 1 Coal Dust.
goals.why: A wearable battery that charges your tools and armor.
steps: Craft it from two basic capacitors, a capacitor bank and a strap.
Wear it in the chest slot.

goals.hint: Craft: 5 Diamond + 1 Exchanger Core (Tier 3) + 2 Ender Eye + 1 Iron Exchanger.
goals.why: Swaps a wider area than the iron exchanger can.
steps: Craft it around an Iron Exchanger.

goals.hint: Craft: 5 Emerald (any) + 1 Exchanger Core (Tier 3) + 2 Ender Eye + 1 Diamond Exchanger.
goals.why: The next rung of the exchanger ladder, after diamond.
steps: Craft it around a Diamond Exchanger.

goals.hint: Craft: 5 Obsidians + 1 Exchanger Core (Tier 3) + 2 Ender Eye + 1 Emerald Exchanger.
goals.why: Last rung before the End.
steps: Craft it around an Emerald Exchanger.

goals.hint: Smithing table: netherite upgrade template + the diamond backpack + a netherite ingot.
goals.why: The largest backpack tier.
steps: Put the template, the diamond backpack and a netherite ingot in a smithing table.

goals.hint: 4 end crystals + 4 nether stars + 1 upgrade base.
goals.why: The backpack survives fire, lava and the void.
steps: Craft it from 4 end crystals + 4 nether stars + 1 upgrade base.
Put it in an upgrade slot.

goals.hint: Craft a Delay from variables, clocks and a variable store.
goals.why: Spaces out logic updates so parts react one after another.
steps: Craft a Delay: 4 Variable Cards + 2 Crystalized Menril Chunks + 2 clocks + Variable Store.

goals.hint: Craft a Display Panel from menril berries, light panels and a transformer.
goals.why: Shows a variable on a wall; light panels glow with it.
steps: Craft a Display Panel: 2 Menril Berries + 2 Static Light Panels + Input/Output Variable Transformers.

goals.text: Craft an Energy Importer or Exporter
goals.hint: Attach an energy part.
goals.why: Moves power by logic rule.
steps: Craft an Energy Exporter: Energy Interface + Input/Output Variable Transformers.
Craft an Energy Importer: Energy Interface + Input/Output Variable Transformers.

goals.hint: Craft one from 7 gold ingots + redstone dust + glass pane.
goals.why: Adds color support and clickable monitors.
steps: Craft an Advanced Computer: 7 gold ingots + redstone dust + glass pane.

goals.hint: Craft one from 7 gold ingots + Advanced Computer + wooden chest.
goals.why: A sturdier turtle with a color screen.
steps: Craft an Advanced Turtle: 7 gold ingots + Advanced Computer + wooden chest.

goals.hint: Craft one from 7 stones + golden apple + glass pane.
goals.why: A computer you carry in a hand.
steps: Craft a Pocket Computer: 7 stones + golden apple + glass pane.
Craft an Advanced Pocket Computer: 7 gold ingots + golden apple + glass pane.

goals.hint: Craft an Assembler and power it.
goals.why: Builds robots, drones, tablets and microcontrollers from parts.
steps: Craft an Assembler: 4 iron ingots + crafting table + 2 pistons + Chip2 + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).
Power it, then put a case and parts into it.

goals.hint: Craft a Disassembler to take built items apart.
goals.why: Takes a built item apart and returns parts.
steps: Craft a Disassembler: Cu + glass pane + Analyzer + piston + obsidian + 2 iron ingots + lava bucket.

goals.hint: Put a robot case, CPU, memory and parts into an Assembler.
goals.why: A programmable worker that moves, mines and crafts.
steps: Open the Assembler and choose Robot.
Insert a case, a CPU, RAM and a hard drive or EEPROM.
Start assembly and wait for it to finish.

goals.hint: Craft tier 1 RAM from 2 microchips, an iron nugget and a board.
goals.why: More RAM lets bigger programs run.
steps: Craft Tier 1 RAM: 2 Chip1s + iron nugget + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).
Craft Tier 2 RAM: 2 Chip2s + iron nugget + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).
Craft Tier 3 RAM: 2 Chip3s + iron nugget + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).

goals.hint: Craft an EEPROM and insert it in the computer case.
goals.why: Holds the boot code a computer runs first.
steps: Craft an EEPROM: 4 gold nuggets + Transistor + 2 papers + Chip1 + redstone torch.
Insert the EEPROM in the computer case.

goals.hint: Craft a tier 1 graphics card and insert it in the case.
goals.why: A screen shows nothing without one.
steps: Craft a Tier 1 Graphics Card: Chip1 + Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) + Ram1 + Card.
Put the graphics card in a card slot of the case.

goals.hint: Craft a tier 1 hard disk drive and insert it in the case.
goals.why: Storage for the operating system and your programs.
steps: Craft a Tier 1 Hard Disk Drive: 2 Chip1s + 3 Disk Platters + 2 iron ingots + Printed Circuit Board (PCB) + piston.
Put the drive in a disk slot of the case.

goals.hint: Craft a disk drive to read floppy disks.
goals.why: Reads floppies; the mountable one sits inside a case or server.
steps: Craft a Disk Drive: 4 iron ingots + Chip1 + piston + stick + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).
Craft a Mountable Disk Drive: 4 obsidians + Chip1 + 2 iron bars + Disk Drive + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).

goals.hint: Craft an Internet Card and insert it in the case.
goals.why: Lets a program reach the web.
steps: Craft an Internet Card: Interweb + Chip2 + redstone torch + Card + obsidian.
Put the card in a card slot of the case.

goals.hint: Craft a Geolyzer and place it next to a computer.
goals.why: Scans the terrain around a computer.
steps: Craft a Geolyzer: 4 gold ingots + compass + 2 ender eyes + Chip2 + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).
Place it next to a computer.

goals.hint: Craft an Adapter and place it against a machine.
goals.why: Connects a computer to machines from other mods.
steps: Craft an Adapter: 4 iron ingots + 3 Cables + Chip1 + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).

goals.hint: Craft a redstone card and a data card for a computer.
goals.why: The redstone card reads and sets redstone; the data card handles hashes and encryption.
steps: Craft a Tier 1 Redstone Card: redstone torch + Chip1 + Card.
Craft a Tier 1 Data Card: iron nugget + Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) + Chip2 + Card.

goals.hint: Craft a network card and insert it in the case.
goals.why: Links computers over cable; the wireless cards link without it.
steps: Craft a Network Card: Cable + Chip1 + Card.
Craft a Wireless Network Card: 2 redstone torchs + Chip1 + Card.

goals.hint: Craft a Relay to join two networks.
goals.why: Joins networks; the Net Splitter cuts a side with redstone.
steps: Craft a Relay: 4 iron ingots + 3 Cables + Lan Card + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).
Craft a Net Splitter: 4 iron ingots + 3 Cables + piston + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).
Craft a Terminal Server: 4 obsidians + 3 Wlan Card2s + Chip2 + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).

goals.hint: Craft a capacitor for the network.
goals.why: Stores energy for the machines on a network.
steps: Craft a Capacitor: 4 iron ingots + Transistor + 2 gold nuggets + paper + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).
Craft a Power Converter: 4 iron ingots + Cable + 2 gold ingots + Chip1 + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).
Craft a Power Distributor: 4 iron ingots + gold ingot + 2 Cables + Chip1 + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).

goals.hint: Craft a Transposer and place it between two inventories.
goals.why: Moves items and fluids between neighbouring inventories and tanks.
steps: Craft a Transposer: 4 iron ingots + Inventory Controller Upgrade + 2 hoppers + bucket + Tank Controller Upgrade.

goals.hint: Craft a tier 1 Hologram Projector.
goals.why: Draws a 3D picture a program makes.
steps: Craft a Tier 1 Hologram Projector: 2 Chip2s + glass pane + 2 Printed Circuit Board (PCB) + Chip Diamond + 2 obsidians + glowstone dust.
Craft a Tier 2 Hologram Projector: 2 Chip3s + glass + 2 Printed Circuit Board (PCB) + diamond + 2 obsidians + blaze powder.

goals.hint: Craft a 3D Printer and an ink cartridge.
goals.why: Prints shaped blocks from ink and chamelium.
steps: Craft a 3D Printer: 4 iron ingots + hopper + 2 pistons + Chip3 + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).
Craft an Empty Ink Cartridge: 4 iron nuggets + dispenser + 2 Transistors + bucket + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).
Craft an Ink Cartridge: cyan dye + magenta dye + yellow dye + black dye + Ink Cartridge (Empty).

goals.hint: Craft chamelium, then a Chamelium Block.
goals.why: Chamelium feeds the 3D printer; the Endstone item is a drone and hover-upgrade ingredient.
steps: Craft Chamelium: 4 gravels + 3 redstone dusts + charcoal + water bucket.
Craft Endstone: 5 ender pearls + 4 Block of Chamelium.

goals.hint: Put a microcontroller case and parts into an Assembler.
goals.why: A tiny computer without a screen or keyboard that runs one program.
steps: Put the case and its parts into the Assembler.
Start the build and take the microcontroller.

goals.hint: Livingwood slabs around an Air Rune and Leather.
goals.why: Speeds up a Botania burning-flower setup.
steps: Craft: 6 Livingwood Slab + 1 Air Rune + 1 Leather
Place it next to a furnace-type block

goals.hint: A mirror that stores mana and pulls from Pools.
goals.why: Mana storage without swapping tablets.

goals.hint: Build the portal frame and feed it mana.
goals.why: Opens elven trade for Elementium and Dragonstone.
steps: Light it with an Elven Gateway Core

goals.text: Raise the altar to tier 4 and make a Demonic Slate
goals.hint: A Demonic Slate is made from an Imbued Slate on a tier 4 altar.
goals.why: The Demonic Slate is the catalyst for the Sigil of the Phantom Bridge.
steps: Rune of the Orb: Craft: 4 Stones (any) + 2 Blood Orb (tier 1 or higher) + 2 Blank Rune + 1 Blood Orb (tier 4 or higher)
Demonic Slate: Blood Altar tier 4 or higher, an Imbued Slate, 15000 LP

goals.hint: Better cores, sockets and batteries raise speed and capacity.
goals.why: Faster cores and bigger batteries and sockets let you cast heavier spells.
steps: Overclocked CAD Core: Craft: 4 Psimetal (any) + 1 Redstone (any)
Large CAD Socket: Craft: 1 Glowstone (any) + 2 Psimetal (any)
Extended CAD Battery: Craft: 1 Iron (any) + 1 Psimetal (any) + 1 Gold (any)

goals.hint: A diamond used with a Psimetal CAD assembly.
goals.why: Psigem is the top Psi material and the gate for the end-tier Psi gear.

goals.hint: Psimetal pickaxe, axe, shovel and sword.
goals.why: Tools that run on your CAD.
steps: Psimetal Pickaxe: Craft: 2 Psimetal (any) + 1 Psigem (any) + 2 Iron (any)
Psimetal Axe: Craft: 1 Psigem (any) + 2 Psimetal (any) + 2 Iron (any)
Psimetal Shovel: Craft: 1 Psigem (any) + 1 Psimetal (any) + 2 Iron (any)
Psimetal Sword: Craft: 1 Psimetal (any) + 1 Psigem (any) + 1 Iron (any)

goals.hint: Redstone dust, glass, Psimetal in a column.
goals.why: Powers the Psimetal exosuit.

goals.hint: 3 Brass Sheet + 1 Andesite Alloy + 1 Precision Mechanism + 1 Brass Casing.
goals.why: Moves items between many machines without belts and runs a full production line from one spot.
steps: Gather 3 Brass Sheet, 1 Andesite Alloy, 1 Precision Mechanism, 1 Brass Casing.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Brass Sheet | Brass Sheet | Andesite Alloy; Middle row: Brass Sheet | empty | empty; Bottom row: Precision Mechanism | Brass Casing | empty.
Link its input and output blocks, then power it.

goals.hint: 1 Wooden Slab + 1 Electrical Steel Ingot + 1 Brass Casing.
goals.why: Spins propellers on a physics body, the core of any steerable airship.
steps: Gather 1 Wooden Slab, 1 Electrical Steel Ingot, 1 Brass Casing.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Wooden Slab | empty; Middle row: empty | Electrical Steel Ingot | empty; Bottom row: empty | Brass Casing | empty.
Attach propellers to the bearing and power it.

goals.hint: 1 Propeller + 1 Gyroscopic Mechanism + 1 Vibrant Alloy Ingot (makes 2).
goals.why: Corrects its own angle in flight, so large airships hold their heading.
steps: Gather 1 Propeller, 1 Gyroscopic Mechanism, 1 Vibrant Alloy Ingot.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Propeller; Middle row: Gyroscopic Mechanism; Bottom row: Vibrant Alloy Ingot.
Mount it on a propeller bearing.

goals.hint: 1 Crushing Wheel + 1 Industrial Iron Block + 1 Iron Sheet.
goals.why: Cuts stone as the vehicle moves, a mining head without a Create drill.
steps: Gather 1 Crushing Wheel, 1 Industrial Iron Block, 1 Iron Sheet.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Crushing Wheel; Middle row: Industrial Iron Block; Bottom row: Iron Sheet.
Mount it on a borehead bearing.

goals.hint: Seals dropped items against pickup.
goals.why: Sealed items cannot be picked up, so drops stay where you want them.
steps: Item Sealer: Craft: 2 Lapis (any) + 1 Super Lubricent Ice + 6 Cobblestones (any)
Item Corrector: Craft: 2 Iron (any) + 1 Super Lubricent Ice + 6 Cobblestones (any)

goals.text: Walk on lava with Lava Waders
goals.hint: Anvil: Obsidian Water Walking Boots + Lava Charm.
goals.why: Lets you walk across lava safely while exploring the Nether.
steps: Lava Waders: Anvil: Obsidian Water Walking Boots + Lava Charm
Make the Obsidian Water Walking Boots first (Water Walking Boots + Obsidian Skull)

goals.text: Win a Thunder or Vampiric Staff
goals.hint: Treasure chests hold the thunder staff and vampiric staff.
goals.why: Magic attacks and healing without a spell mod.

goals.hint: Find the tortoise dungeon and defeat the Giant Tortoise.
goals.why: Clearing the tortoise dungeon opens its boss chest.

goals.hint: Find a spectre dungeon and defeat the Spectre Lord.
goals.why: Clearing a spectre dungeon opens its boss chest.
steps: Find a dungeon with a Spectre Lord.

goals.hint: Find the Nether dragon dungeon and defeat the Nether Dragon.
goals.why: Clearing the dragon dungeon opens its boss chest.

goals.hint: Livingmetal is the end-tier material.
goals.why: Livingmetal tools and armor.

goals.hint: The top-tier scythe.
goals.why: Best soul-reaping weapon.

goals.text: Apply the Nether Decree to a Bounty Board
goals.hint: Open a Bounty Board, click the Nether tab on the left and place the decree in the empty slot: the page opens for good with Age 4 jobs.
goals.why: Opens the Nether page: Age 4 jobs (items and kills) that pay one notch ahead. Optional: bounties never gate progression.
goals.tip: Right-clicking the board with the decree also works. Breaking the board returns it and every decree on it. The goal ticks when anyone opens the page.
steps: You get the Nether Decree when Age 5 opens (every player gets one).
Right-click a Bounty Board to open it and click the Nether tab (left edge).
Place the Nether Decree in the empty slot on that page. The page opens for good and gets 3 jobs at once, then a new one about every 3 minutes (up to 9).

goals.hint: Bounties are side jobs, never a gate. Use the Nether Decree on a Bounty Board and hand in three jobs.
goals.why: Every player gets the Nether Decree when Age 5 opens. On a board it offers Age 4 jobs (items and kills from every strand) that pay one notch ahead, never a skip. Skip a job you don't like and the board offers a new one. Bounties count for this decree until the next decree arrives.
steps: For the Nether page, craft a Bounty Board (6 planks + 3 paper) or use one in a village, and place it. The Bounty Boards page explains how jobs work.
Apply the Nether Decree to its page on the board (the goal before this one).
Hand in three Nether bounties; this goal counts them for you.
goals.tip: Lost your decree? Craft a copy: decree + paper (you keep the original). Old capstones still make their decree.

goals.hint: Throw a diamond into a pool of water surrounded by flowers.
goals.why: The portal is the only way into the dimension that holds every Twilight boss and set.
steps: Throw a diamond into the pool.
Step into the portal when it forms.

goals.text: Enter the Twilight Forest and secure a safe arrival point
goals.hint: Ring a 2x2 water pool with flowers and throw in a diamond to open the portal.
goals.why: A dimension of bosses that unlock each other in order, with unique loot (Naga scales, Lich scepters, fiery tools).
goals.tip: The Magic Map (Twilight) shows the boss structures; each boss unlocks the next area.
steps: Dig a 2x2 pool one block deep and fill it with water.
Ring the whole pool, corners included, with dirt or grass and plants.
Throw in a diamond and stand clear of the lightning.
Enter, secure the arrival point and mark the return portal on your map.

diagram.title: Twilight portal
diagram.view: A 2x2 pool ringed by grass, with a flower on every ring block.
diagram.note: Any flower or tall grass works, on grass or dirt. Corners can stay empty. Two water buckets fill the pool.

obtain.minecraft:poppy: Pick flowers in grassy biomes, or use bone meal on grass to grow some. Any flower or tall grass works.
obtain.minecraft:grass_block: Mine grass with a Silk Touch tool, or place dirt next to grass in the light and wait for it to spread.
obtain.minecraft:water_bucket: Right-click any water with an empty bucket. A 2x2 pool refills itself.

goals.text: Banisters, drying racks and hollow logs
goals.family: Banisters, drying racks and hollow logs

goals.hint: 6 Empowered Enori Crystal + 2 Iron Casing + 1 Sapling.
goals.why: Burns crops into power, a renewable source from a field.
steps: Gather 6 Empowered Enori Crystal, 2 Iron Casing, 1 Sapling.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Empowered Enori Crystal | Iron Casing | Empowered Enori Crystal.
Middle row: Empowered Enori Crystal | Sapling | Empowered Enori Crystal.
Bottom row: Empowered Enori Crystal | Iron Casing | Empowered Enori Crystal.
Fill it with crops and attach a cable.

goals.hint: 4 Empowered Enori Crystal + 1 Iron Casing + 2 Advanced Coil + 1 Diamatine Crystal + 1 Iron Bars.
goals.why: Free power in daylight with no fuel to supply.
steps: Gather 4 Empowered Enori Crystal, 1 Iron Casing, 2 Advanced Coil, 1 Diamatine Crystal, 1 Iron Bars.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Empowered Enori Crystal | Iron Casing | Empowered Enori Crystal.
Middle row: Advanced Coil | Diamatine Crystal | Advanced Coil.
Bottom row: Empowered Enori Crystal | Iron Bars | Empowered Enori Crystal.
Place it in sunlight and run a cable.

goals.hint: 4 Diamatine Crystal + 4 Empowered Enori Crystal + 1 Advanced Coil.
goals.why: Mines a wide area at once, the top Engineer's drill upgrade.
steps: Gather 4 Diamatine Crystal, 4 Empowered Enori Crystal, 1 Advanced Coil.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Diamatine Crystal | Empowered Enori Crystal | Diamatine Crystal.
Middle row: Empowered Enori Crystal | Advanced Coil | Empowered Enori Crystal.
Bottom row: Diamatine Crystal | Empowered Enori Crystal | Diamatine Crystal.

goals.text: Collect Ironwood and Steeleaf in the Twilight Forest
goals.hint: Craft and smelt Raw Ironwood; Steeleaf comes from Twilight dungeon chests.
goals.why: Twilight gear and the dimension's crafting recipes need them.
steps: Collect Liveroot and the other Raw Ironwood ingredients (JEI) and craft Raw Ironwood.
Loot Twilight dungeon chests for Steeleaf (it doesn't grow on trees).

goals.hint: Blast Raw Ironwood, or craft a Block of Ironwood into 9 ingots.
goals.why: Ironwood is the metal of the first Twilight tools and armor.
steps: Collect Raw Ironwood or a Block of Ironwood.
Blast Raw Ironwood in a blast furnace.
Or craft a Block of Ironwood into 9 ingots.

goals.hint: Ironwood pickaxe: 3 Ironwood ingots over 2 sticks.
goals.why: Starter Twilight tools and armor before the first boss.
steps: Pickaxe: 3 ingots across the top, 2 sticks below.
Craft the sword from the recipe panel.
Craft the helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.

goals.hint: Steeleaf chestplate: 8 Steeleaf ingots in a ring.
goals.why: A second armor metal for the bosses ahead.
steps: Craft 9 ingots from a Block of Steeleaf.
Craft the helmet, leggings and boots.

goals.text: Ironwood and Steeleaf tools and armor
goals.family: Ironwood and Steeleaf tools and armor

goals.hint: Magic Map: 8 paper around a Magic Map Focus.
goals.why: Magic Maps locate structures, so each boss area is easy to find.
steps: Craft the focus: Raven Feather + Torchberries + glowstone dust.
Craft the map: 8 paper around the focus.
Use the map in the Twilight Forest to fill it.

goals.text: Defeat the Naga and obtain its progression reward
goals.hint: The Naga lives in a mossy stone courtyard; its scales open the Lich Tower.
goals.why: Opens the way to the Lich.
goals.tip: Pick up the drops yourself so the advancement triggers. Area still protected? Check the Twilight advancement tree.
steps: Find the Naga Courtyard (mossy stone walls).
Fight in the open: dodge its charges, hit its head.
Pick up the Naga scales and trophy.

mobs.where: Lives in the Naga Courtyard, a mossy stone-walled arena in the Twilight Forest. A Magic Map shows where.

goals.hint: Naga chestplate: 8 Naga Scales in a ring; leggings: 7.
goals.why: Armor made from the first boss's scales.
steps: Chestplate: 8 Naga Scales in a ring.

goals.text: Defeat the Twilight Lich after completing Naga progression
goals.hint: Hit the Lich's pearl projectiles back to break its shields, then beat its later phases.
goals.why: The Lich unlocks the Labyrinth, Dark Forest and Snowy Forest, and drops the Zombie, Lifedrain and Twilight scepters.
steps: Finish the Naga advancement and find a Lich Tower.
At the top, find the real Lich among its invulnerable copies.
Hit its pearls back at it to break the shields; dodge the explosive fireballs.
Beat its later phases and take the scepter.

mobs.where: Waits at the top of the Lich Tower, a tall stone tower in the Twilight Forest. Defeat the Naga first or the tower stays sealed.

goals.hint: The Lich drops the Twilight, Lifedrain, Zombie and Fortification scepters.
goals.why: Four special items, each with its own effect.
steps: Defeat the Naga first, then reach the Lich Tower.
Pick up the scepters it drops.

goals.text: Bring a trophy from a defeated Twilight Forest boss back to your base
goals.hint: Every Twilight boss drops a trophy.
goals.why: A decoration that plays the boss sound when powered.
steps: Pick up the trophy the boss drops.
Place it at home; redstone power makes it play the boss sound.
