mobs.where: Lives in the Naga Courtyard, a mossy stone-walled arena in the Twilight Forest. A Magic Map shows where.

goals.text: Craft a Charm of Life or Keeping
goals.hint: Charm of Life I and Keeping I sit in tower, aurora and well chests; level II is crafted.
goals.why: Life saves you from death; Keeping holds your items.
steps: Open chests in the Dark Tower and the Aurora Palace for level I charms.
Craft Charm of Life II or Keeping II from the level I charm.

goals.hint: Feed the Questing Ram wool in its grove for its reward.
goals.why: The reward holds the Crumble Horn, the Ram's trophy and a bundle.
steps: Give it the wool it asks for.
Take the Crumble Horn and the trophy.

goals.hint: Walk the hedge maze structure and open its chests.
goals.why: A landmark that the Magic Map shows early.
steps: Find the maze with the Magic Map.

goals.hint: Chop Canopy logs in the dense Canopy biome.
goals.why: Canopy wood opens the canopy set: planks, boats and chests.

goals.hint: Maze Map: 8 paper around a Maze Map Focus, used inside the Labyrinth.
goals.why: Charts the Labyrinth so you reach the Minoshroom.
steps: Take a Maze Map Focus from the Minotaur or Labyrinth rooms.
Craft the map: 8 paper around the focus.

goals.text: Defeat the Minoshroom in the Labyrinth and eat its Meef Stroganoff
goals.hint: The Labyrinth is under the swamp (opens after the Lich). Its Minoshroom drops Meef Stroganoff, which lifts the Fire Swamp curse.
goals.why: The Fire Swamp burns you until you eat it; it leads to the Hydra.
steps: Find the Labyrinth under the swamp.

obtain.twilightforest:meef_stroganoff: Dropped by the Minoshroom in the Labyrinth.

mobs.where: Guards the deepest room of the Labyrinth, under the Swamp biome. Opens after the Lich; a Maze Map helps you find the way.

goals.hint: The Mazebreaker Pickaxe sits in the Labyrinth vault jackpot.
goals.why: Breaks maze stone quickly.

goals.hint: Arctic armor: 8 Arctic Fur per chestplate, dropped by yetis and winter wolves.
goals.why: Cold-weather armor for the Snowy Forest.
steps: Kill yetis and winter wolves for Arctic Fur.
Craft the helmet, leggings and boots.

goals.hint: Uncrafting Table: 8 crafting tables around a Maze Map Focus.
goals.why: Recycles items back into parts, recrafts, repairs and moves enchantments.
steps: Take a Maze Map Focus from the Labyrinth.
Craft the table: 8 crafting tables around the focus.

goals.hint: Hollow hill chests can hold an Ore Magnet.
goals.why: Pulls ore veins up to the surface.

goals.hint: Build a glowstone frame and fill it with water.
goals.why: The portal takes you to the Aether, where entering also grants a Golden Parachute.
steps: Pour water into the frame to light it.

goals.text: Enter the Aether and secure your return route
goals.hint: Build a glowstone portal frame and pour water inside.
goals.why: A sky dimension with Zanite, Gravitite and three dungeon bosses that drop strong accessories.
steps: Collect 10 glowstone blocks (Nether) and build the frame.
Pour a water bucket inside it.
Step in. Bring blocks: don't fall off the islands.

diagram.title: Aether portal
diagram.view: Side view (stand it upright)
diagram.note: Corners optional. Pour water into the middle.

obtain.minecraft:glowstone: Glowstone hangs from Nether ceilings. Mining it drops dust; 4 dust make a block. Sifting dust also gives glowstone dust.

goals.text: Chop Skyroot and make Skyroot tools
goals.hint: Skyroot tools double Aether wood drops and mine Holystone.
goals.why: The first Aether tools; Holystone gives the next tier.
steps: Chop skyroot trees on the islands.
Mine Holystone with the skyroot pickaxe for holystone tools.

goals.text: Skyroot, golden oak and holiday wood
goals.family: Skyroot, golden oak and holiday wood

goals.text: Read the Aether Book of Lore
goals.hint: Put any Aether item in the Book of Lore to read about it.
goals.why: Explains every Aether item and block.
steps: Right-click it and put an item in the slot.

goals.hint: Holystone pickaxe: 3 Holystone over 2 skyroot sticks.
goals.why: Holystone tools occasionally generate Ambrosium Shards.
steps: Craft the axe, shovel, hoe and sword.

goals.hint: Ambrosium shard + skyroot stick makes 4 Ambrosium Torches.
goals.why: Shards fuel the Altar, and the torch is part of the Incubator.
steps: Torches: 1 shard over 1 skyroot stick, makes 4.

goals.hint: bring Aether dirt home.
goals.why: Link 1 of 3 of the Dimension soil to sieve route; next: sieve it (diamond mesh).

goals.text: Collect Zanite and improve your Aether equipment
goals.hint: Zanite tools get stronger as they wear down.
goals.why: Zanite is Aether iron, and gravitite mining needs a zanite pickaxe.
steps: Mine zanite ore (purple gems in holystone) with a holystone pickaxe.

goals.hint: Zanite chestplate: 8 Zanite gemstones in a ring.
goals.why: Zanite gear gets stronger the more it is used.
steps: Craft the helmet, leggings, boots and gloves.

goals.hint: The altar enchants items, fueled by ambrosium shards.
goals.why: Enchants gravitite and repairs Aether tools.
steps: Craft the altar from holystone and zanite.
Fuel it with ambrosium shards and put an item in.

goals.text: Use the Altar to obtain Enchanted Gravitite
goals.hint: Enchant gravitite ore in the Aether Altar.
goals.why: Enchanted gravitite makes the strongest Aether tools and armor.
goals.tip: Gravitite ore floats up when disturbed: keep track of it.
steps: Mine Gravitite Ore with a Zanite Pickaxe or better.
Put it in an Aether Altar fueled with Ambrosium Shards.

goals.hint: Freezer: 5 Holystone + 1 Icestone + 3 Skyroot Planks.
goals.why: Freezes rings and items into their ice versions.
steps: Icestone drops from Mimics and sits in dungeon chests.
Craft the Freezer: 5 Holystone + 1 Icestone + 3 Skyroot Planks.

goals.hint: Gravitite pickaxe: 3 Enchanted Gravitite over 2 skyroot sticks.
goals.why: Gravitite gear gives higher jumps and levitates blocks.
steps: Enchant Gravitite Ore at the Altar.
Pickaxe: 3 Enchanted Gravitite over 2 skyroot sticks.
Chestplate: 8 Enchanted Gravitite in a ring.

goals.hint: Zanite ring: 4 gemstones in a ring; Iron pendant: 5 string around an iron ingot.
goals.why: Passive bonuses in the accessory slots.
steps: Craft a Zanite ring from 4 gemstones.
Craft an Iron pendant: 5 string around an iron ingot.
Freeze a ring in the Freezer for an Ice ring.

goals.hint: Dart shooter: 2 Skyroot Planks + 1 Golden Amber.
goals.why: Golden, poison and enchanted darts are not affected by gravity.
steps: Take Golden Amber from golden oak logs or dungeon chests.

goals.hint: Zephyrs drop cold aerclouds.
goals.why: Cloud blocks for building and parachutes.

goals.hint: Cold Parachute: 4 Cold Aercloud blocks.
goals.why: Slows a fall; parachutes auto-activate when you drop off an island.
steps: Craft the parachute: 4 Cold Aercloud blocks.

goals.hint: Bronze dungeons are holystone rooms hidden inside big Aether islands.
goals.why: Dungeons hold the bosses and the keys to treasure chests.
steps: Find a bronze dungeon inside a big island.

goals.text: Defeat the Slider in the Bronze Dungeon
goals.hint: Hit the Slider with a pickaxe; dodge its charges.
goals.why: Drops the bronze key: treasure room with gloves and the Hammer of Notch.
steps: Use a pickaxe: swords barely hurt it.
Dodge its slides and hit it when it stops.

mobs.where: Sits in the boss room of a Bronze Dungeon, hidden inside Aether islands. Only pickaxes hurt it.

goals.hint: The Bronze Dungeon reward chest holds the Shield of Repulsion.
goals.why: Blocks projectiles while you fight the dungeon bosses.

goals.hint: Neptune armor is in the Bronze Dungeon; Phoenix armor is in the Gold Dungeon.
goals.why: Neptune and Phoenix armor protect against water and fire.
steps: Clear the Bronze Dungeon for Neptune armor.
Clear the Gold Dungeon for Phoenix armor.

goals.hint: Sentries drop carved stone and sentry stone.
goals.why: Carved and sentry stone for dungeon-style building.
steps: Find a Sentry in a dungeon.

goals.hint: Some dungeon chests are Mimics that drop Ambrosium, Zanite, rings and darts.
goals.why: Treasure from a trap chest.

goals.hint: Cockatrices drop feathers.
goals.why: Clears a dangerous Aether mob.

goals.text: Defeat the Valkyrie Queen in a Silver Dungeon
goals.hint: Silver dungeons are large white temples on clouds.
goals.why: Drops the silver key: valkyrie lance, armor and more.
steps: Defeat 10 valkyries in the dungeon for medals.
Give the medals to the queen to start the fight.

mobs.where: Rules a Silver Dungeon, a white temple on the clouds. Defeat 10 Valkyries there to earn medals before she will fight.

goals.hint: The Silver Dungeon's Valkyrie chest holds Valkyrie tools and armor.
goals.why: Top Aether tools and armor.

goals.hint: Bronze rewards hold the Phoenix Bow and Hammer; Silver holds the Holy and Lightning Swords.
goals.why: The Aether's special weapons.
steps: Clear the Bronze Dungeon for the Phoenix Bow and Hammer of Kingbdogz.
Clear the Silver Dungeon for the Holy Sword and Lightning Sword.

goals.hint: Incubator: 8 Holystone around an Ambrosium Torch.
goals.why: Hatches moa eggs into baby moas.
steps: Craft the Incubator: 8 Holystone around the torch.

goals.hint: Moa eggs sit in Silver Dungeon loot and hatch in the Incubator.
goals.why: A moa is a mount with extra jumps.
steps: Take a moa egg from the Silver Dungeon loot.

goals.hint: Phygs are flying pigs that drop porkchop and feathers; saddle one to ride.
goals.why: A flying mount once you place a saddle on it.

goals.hint: Aerwhales are huge cloud mobs that drift through the sky.
goals.why: A landmark of the Aether sky.

goals.text: Defeat the Sun Spirit in a Gold Dungeon
goals.hint: In a Gold Dungeon, hit the Sun Spirit's ice projectiles back at it.
goals.why: The final Aether boss: treasure includes phoenix armor and the vampire blade.
steps: Bring good gear, food and fire protection; enter a Gold Dungeon.
Start the fight through its dialogue.
Dodge the fire and hit the ice projectiles back.
Defeat it and use the key on its treasure.

mobs.where: Rules a Gold Dungeon inside the largest floating islands of the Aether.

goals.hint: The Gold Dungeon reward chest holds a Life Shard.
goals.why: Permanently raises your maximum health.

goals.text: Visit an Ancient City and escape the Warden
goals.hint: Ancient cities are in the deep dark: sneak and avoid sculk shriekers.
goals.why: Enchanted books, echo shards (recovery compasses) and rare loot.
goals.tip: Sneaking doesn't silence everything. You don't have to fight the Warden.
steps: Search the Deep Dark with wool, food and an escape route.
Walk on wool and avoid sensors and shriekers; opening chests can make noise.
Loot carefully; leave if the warning rises or the Warden appears.

obtain.minecraft:echo_shard: Echo shards are found only in Ancient City chests deep below the surface (sneak, the Warden hears you).

goals.hint: Craft the Beneath Teleporter and use it. Bring torches: it is very dark.
goals.why: A dark SkyFactory underworld with its own resources.

goals.hint: The teleporter item that belongs to The Beneath.
goals.why: Opens the way to The Beneath.

goals.hint: 4 soul sand in a T with 3 wither skeleton skulls on top. Fight it underground.
goals.why: The nether star makes beacons, the Nether Star Generator and many endgame recipes.
steps: Kill wither skeletons in fortresses for 3 skulls.
Build the soul sand T deep underground or in the End.
Fight with a strong sword, healing potions and milk (cures wither).

diagram.title: Summon the Wither
diagram.view: Side view
diagram.note: Soul soil works too. The last skull you place starts the fight.

obtain.minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull: Dropped (rarely) by wither skeletons in Nether fortresses. Looting helps.
obtain.minecraft:soul_sand: Found in Nether soul sand valleys and around fortresses. Soul soil works for the Wither too.

mobs.where: Never spawns on its own: you build it. Put 4 soul sand (or soul soil) in a T and place 3 wither skeleton skulls on top, the last skull starts the fight. Do it deep underground or in the End, away from your base.
Wither skeletons spawn only in Nether Fortresses: tall black skeletons with stone swords. A Looting sword raises the skull chance.

goals.hint: Craft: 1 Nether Star + 2 Wooden Rod.
goals.why: This wand never wears out, so one is enough for good.
steps: Defeat the Wither for a Nether Star.
Craft the Nether Star on two sticks.

goals.text: Build a Beacon on a pyramid
goals.hint: Beacon (nether star, glass, obsidian) on a 3x3 or bigger metal pyramid.
goals.why: Speed and haste at your base; the Gaia Guardian ritual starts at a beacon.
steps: Craft a Beacon and build a solid 3x3 base of mineral blocks (iron, gold, diamond, emerald...).
Place the Beacon in the center on top with a clear view of the sky.
Open it, pick an effect and pay with an ingot or gem.
Add full pyramid layers later for more effects and range.

diagram.title: Beacon base
diagram.view: A beacon on a 3x3 layer of metal blocks.
diagram.note: Gold, diamond, emerald or netherite blocks work too.

goals.hint: Trap a Wither in an unbreakable cage, kill it automatically and collect the star.
goals.why: Endless nether stars for beacons, generators and endgame recipes.
steps: Build a cage the Wither can't break.
Add automated damage (spikes, mob masher) and a collector for the star.

goals.hint: Smelt ancient debris (deep Nether) into scrap; 4 scrap + 4 gold = 1 ingot.
goals.why: Netherite is the strongest vanilla gear and doesn't burn.
goals.tip: Templates are used up. Beds explode in the Nether: tunnel-mine instead.
steps: Mine Ancient Debris deep in the Nether with a diamond pickaxe or better.
Smelt it into Netherite Scrap; craft 4 scrap + 4 gold ingots into a Netherite Ingot.
Get a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template from a bastion; duplicate it before using your last one.
Smithing Table: template + diamond gear + ingot.

goals.hint: The top essence tier; the Master Infusion Crystal needs 4 of it.
goals.why: Unlocks the Master Infusion Crystal and all Supremium gear.
steps: Craft the recipe around an Infusion Crystal.

goals.hint: 4 diamonds + 4 supremium essence around a tier 5 crafting seed = Diamond Seeds.
goals.why: Diamond seeds grow diamond essence: renewable diamonds from a farm plot.
goals.tip: Farmland and growth devices give the bonuses in their tooltips; higher-tier farmland is not a flat speed boost.
steps: Upgrade essence through every tier to supremium (4 of one tier + an Infusion Crystal make the next).
Upgrade a crafting seed to tier 5.
Craft Diamond Seeds: 4 diamonds and 4 supremium essence around the tier 5 seed.
Plant them and craft the harvested essence into diamonds.

goals.hint: Infuse the blaze seed base with 4 blaze materials and 4 blaze essence.
goals.why: A blaze crop gives blaze essence without entering the Nether.
steps: Gather 4 blaze materials and 4 blaze essence.
Infuse them around the seed base, materials and essence alternating.

goals.hint: Infuse the cobalt seed base with 4 cobalt and 4 cobalt essence.
goals.why: A cobalt crop feeds Tinkers tools without Nether mining.
steps: Gather 4 cobalt ingots and 4 cobalt essence.
Infuse them around the seed base, ingots and essence alternating.

goals.hint: A charm gives an effect while it is in your inventory.
goals.why: A passive speed buff with no potion to drink or armor slot used.

goals.hint: 6 iron ingots, a Prudentium seed, a Mystical Machine Frame and a Soulium Block: ABA / ACA / ADA.
goals.why: Turns spare seeds into essence.
steps: Craft the Mystical Machine Frame and a Soulium Block.
Put a Prudentium seed on top, the frame in the middle and the block at the bottom, with iron ingots on both sides.

goals.hint: Craft a Supremium Apple from supremium essence.
goals.why: Strong effects (regeneration, resistance and more) for boss fights.

goals.hint: The Ender IO Farming Station or the Industrial Foregoing Plant Gatherer harvests for you.
goals.why: Crops are harvested and collected for you, so food and crop materials pile up.
steps: Pick a Farming Station or a Plant Gatherer for your crop.
Power it (FE) and check its working area.
Farming Station: give it tools, seeds and a capacitor. Industrial Foregoing: add a Plant Sower to replant.
Send the harvest into storage, keeping enough seeds to replant.

goals.hint: 4 Soularium Ingot + 1 Enderman Head + 1 Creeper Head + 1 Machine Chassis + 1 Zombie Head + 1 Skeleton Skull.
goals.why: Binds a soul into a Soul Vial, the key to the spawner and farming machines.
steps: Gather 4 Soularium Ingot, 1 Enderman Head, 1 Creeper Head, 1 Machine Chassis, 1 Zombie Head, 1 Skeleton Skull.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Soularium Ingot | Enderman Head | Soularium Ingot.
Middle row: Creeper Head | Machine Chassis | Zombie Head.
Bottom row: Soularium Ingot | Skeleton Skull | Soularium Ingot.
Insert a filled Soul Vial and the item to bind.

goals.hint: 4 Iron Ingot + 4 Electrical Steel Ingot + 1 Wooden Chest.
goals.why: Buffers a stack of items so a conduit line has a slack store.
steps: Gather 4 Iron Ingot, 4 Electrical Steel Ingot, 1 Wooden Chest.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Iron Ingot | Electrical Steel Ingot | Iron Ingot.
Middle row: Electrical Steel Ingot | Wooden Chest | Electrical Steel Ingot.
Bottom row: Iron Ingot | Electrical Steel Ingot | Iron Ingot.
Place it between a producer and a consumer.

goals.hint: 2 Chassis Plates + 1 Remote Awareness Upgrade + 3 Wooden Chest + 1 Machine Chassis + 2 Dark Steel Bars.
goals.why: A chest that shares its items with the Inventory Panel.
steps: Gather 2 Chassis Plates, 1 Remote Awareness Upgrade, 3 Wooden Chest, 1 Machine Chassis, 2 Dark Steel Bars.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Chassis Plates | Remote Awareness Upgrade | Chassis Plates.
Middle row: Wooden Chest | Machine Chassis | Wooden Chest.
Bottom row: Dark Steel Bars | Wooden Chest | Dark Steel Bars.
Place it within conduit range of a panel.

goals.hint: 6 Conduit Binder + 3 Energetic Alloy Ingot (makes 8).
goals.why: Carries more power than a basic conduit, so big machines run at full speed.
steps: Gather 6 Conduit Binder, 3 Energetic Alloy Ingot.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Conduit Binder | Conduit Binder | Conduit Binder.
Middle row: Energetic Alloy Ingot | Energetic Alloy Ingot | Energetic Alloy Ingot.
Bottom row: Conduit Binder | Conduit Binder | Conduit Binder.
Upgrade the main trunk of your network.

goals.text: Build a Vat for fuels and fluids
goals.hint: 4 Electrical Steel Ingot + 1 Cauldron + 2 Fluid Tank + 1 Machine Chassis + 1 Furnace.
goals.why: Ferments and brews the fluids that fuel Ender IO generators.
steps: Gather 4 Electrical Steel Ingot, 1 Cauldron, 2 Fluid Tank, 1 Machine Chassis, 1 Furnace.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Electrical Steel Ingot | Cauldron | Electrical Steel Ingot.
Middle row: Fluid Tank | Machine Chassis | Fluid Tank.
Bottom row: Electrical Steel Ingot | Furnace | Electrical Steel Ingot.
Power it and feed it the input fluid and item.

goals.text: Store XP in an Experience Obelisk
goals.hint: 1 Experience Rod + 3 Soularium Ingot + 1 Machine Chassis.
goals.why: Banks XP from tanks and mob grinders for enchanting.
steps: Gather 1 Experience Rod, 3 Soularium Ingot, 1 Machine Chassis.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Experience Rod | empty; Middle row: empty | Soularium Ingot | empty; Bottom row: Soularium Ingot | Machine Chassis | Soularium Ingot.

goals.hint: 2 Dark Steel Ingot + 2 Glider Wing.
goals.why: Wear them to glide, a travel upgrade in the dark steel line.
steps: Gather 2 Dark Steel Ingot, 2 Glider Wing.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Dark Steel Ingot | empty; Bottom row: Glider Wing | Dark Steel Ingot | Glider Wing.
Wear them as the chest accessory.

goals.hint: 4 Iron Ingot + 4 Conduit Binder + 1 Pulsating Crystal.
goals.why: Anchors are the teleport points for the Staff of Travelling and the Telepad.
steps: Gather 4 Iron Ingot, 4 Conduit Binder, 1 Pulsating Crystal.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Iron Ingot | Conduit Binder | Iron Ingot.
Middle row: Conduit Binder | Pulsating Crystal | Conduit Binder.
Bottom row: Iron Ingot | Conduit Binder | Iron Ingot.
Place two and sneak-use the Staff of Travelling to jump between them.

goals.text: Build an Industrial Foregoing Advanced Machine Frame
goals.hint: Advanced frames need Ender IO dark steel and pink slime.
goals.why: Unlocks mid-tier Industrial Foregoing machines (laser drill, enchantment machines).
steps: Alloy dark steel in an Ender IO alloy smelter.
Dissolve plastic, a Simple frame, netherite scrap and dark steel with pink slime.

goals.hint: 2 Plastics + 1 Iron Hoe + 2 Iron Axe + 1 Machine Frame Pity + 2 Gold Gear + 1 Redstone.
goals.why: Harvests mature crops and saplings in its range without a player.
steps: Gather 2 Plastics, 1 Iron Hoe, 2 Iron Axe, 1 Machine Frame Pity, 2 Gold Gear, 1 Redstone.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Plastics | Iron Hoe | Plastics; Middle row: Iron Axe | Machine Frame Pity | Iron Axe; Bottom row: Gold Gear | Redstone | Gold Gear.
Place it by a farm and cable it.

goals.hint: 2 Plastics + 1 Iron Sword + 2 Book + 1 Machine Frame Advanced + 2 Gold Gear + 1 Redstone.
goals.why: Breaks mobs into usable drops, the processing end of a mob farm.
steps: Gather 2 Plastics, 1 Iron Sword, 2 Book, 1 Machine Frame Advanced, 2 Gold Gear, 1 Redstone.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Plastics | Iron Sword | Plastics; Middle row: Book | Machine Frame Advanced | Book; Bottom row: Gold Gear | Redstone | Gold Gear.

goals.hint: 2 Plastics + 1 Diamond Pickaxe + 2 Iron Ore + 1 Machine Frame Advanced + 2 Diamond Gear + 1 Redstone Dust.
goals.why: Pulls ore from the ground when paired with a laser drill and lenses.
steps: Gather 2 Plastics, 1 Diamond Pickaxe, 2 Iron Ore, 1 Machine Frame Advanced, 2 Diamond Gear, 1 Redstone Dust.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Plastics | Diamond Pickaxe | Plastics.
Middle row: Iron Ore | Machine Frame Advanced | Iron Ore.
Bottom row: Diamond Gear | Redstone Dust | Diamond Gear.
Pair it with a laser drill and lenses.

goals.hint: Smelt Ardite Ore in a furnace, or melt it in the smeltery.
goals.why: Ardite is the other half of Manyullyn.
steps: Smelt Ardite Ore for an ingot.
Or melt it in the smeltery for the fluid.

goals.text: Open a portal to Alfheim with an Elven Gateway Core
goals.hint: Livingwood frame with glimmering livingwood, Natura Pylons on mana pools, then the wand on the core.
goals.why: Elves trade Elementium, Pixie Dust and Dragonstone.
steps: Put two Natura pylons on mana pools next to it.
Use the wand on the core.

goals.hint: Red String blocks extend a chest, hopper or dispenser from a distance.
goals.why: Automation without wiring, made from Alfheim materials.
steps: Red string container: Craft: 7 Livingrock + 1 Chest Wood + 1 Red String
Red string relay: Craft: 7 Livingrock + 1 Spreader + 1 Red String
Red string dispenser: Craft: 7 Livingrock + 1 Dispenser + 1 Red String
Red string fertilizer: Craft: 7 Livingrock + 1 Fertilizer + 1 Red String

goals.text: Craft the Alchemy and Conjuration catalysts
goals.hint: Catalysts let the Mana Pool run Alchemy and Conjuration recipes.
goals.why: Mana-powered block and item duplication.
steps: Alchemy catalyst: Craft: 4 Livingrock + 2 Gold Ingot + 2 Brewing stand + 1 Mana Pearl
Conjuration catalyst: Craft: 4 Livingrock + 1 Pixie Dust + 3 Elementium Ingot + 1 Alchemy catalyst

goals.hint: Query linked inventories by chat.
goals.why: Botania's own storage network, built with Alfheim sparks.

goals.hint: Elementium ingots in the helmet shape.
goals.why: Elven armor from the Alfheim trade line, a step above Terrasteel for defense.
steps: Trade Manasteel for Elementium at the portal

goals.hint: Pylons around a Beacon summon the Guardian ritual.
goals.why: The setup for the final Botania boss.
steps: Pylon: Craft: 2 Gold Ingot + 2 Manasteel Ingot + 1 Mana Diamond
Place pylons around a Beacon in the layout shown in the Lexica Botania

goals.text: Walk on air with a Sigil of the Phantom Bridge
goals.hint: This sigil builds a short-lived path under your feet: the classic SkyFactory 3 way to cross the void.
goals.why: A safe walkway anywhere, paid for with LP instead of blocks.
steps: Upgrade your Blood Altar and orb until the sigil can be made (press G on it to see the recipe).
Craft the sigil and bind it to yourself.
Switch it on and walk off a ledge: a phantom path forms under you while your LP lasts.

goals.text: Craft a Bound Blade or Bound tool
goals.hint: Bound tools run on LP from your soul network instead of durability.
goals.why: SkyFactory 3 asked for the Bound Blade, Pickaxe, Axe and Shovel; one is enough to learn how they work.
steps: Press G on a Bound tool to see its recipe and the gem it needs.
Craft it and bind it to yourself, then switch it on.
It drains LP while it is on, so keep your altar running.

goals.hint: Altar building block for the upper tiers.
goals.why: Bloodstone builds the upper altar tiers that larger orbs need.

goals.hint: Routing nodes move items between inventories.
goals.why: Item logistics powered by Blood Magic.
steps: Item Routing Node: Soul forge: Glowstone (any) + Redstone (any) + Glass blocks (any) + Stones (any)
Master Routing Node: Soul forge: Iron (any) + Diamond (any) + Imbued Slate
Input Routing Node: Soul forge: Glowstone (any) + Redstone (any) + Gold (any) + Item Routing Node
Output Routing Node: Soul forge: Glowstone (any) + Redstone (any) + Iron (any) + Item Routing Node

goals.hint: The Teleposer swaps blocks between two linked foci.
goals.why: Moves blocks and chests across distance.
steps: Teleposer: Craft: 6 Gold (any) + 2 Ender pearl + 1 Teleposition Focus
Reinforced Teleposition Focus: Craft: Enhanced Teleposition Focus + Weak Blood Shard

goals.hint: Smelt yellorite ore (Overworld, underground) into yellorium.
goals.why: Yellorium fuels Extreme Reactors.

obtain.bigreactors:yellorium_ingot: Smelt yellorite ore (or raw yellorium), found underground in the Overworld.

goals.text: Sift sand on an iron or diamond mesh for yellorium dust
goals.hint: Sift sand on an iron or diamond mesh; the IE Crusher, SAG Mill or AA Crusher also grinds yellorium ingots into dust.
goals.why: Link 1 of 3 of the Reactor fuel loop route; next: Smelt it into fuel for an Extreme Reactor; spent fuel comes out as cyanite.

goals.text: Create a passively cooled reactor from Extreme Reactors
goals.hint: Casing, controller, yellorium fuel rods, control rods, access port and a power tap.
goals.why: Huge power from a little fuel.
steps: Build the hollow casing with room for fuel-rod columns.
Top each fuel column with a Reactor Control Rod in the roof.
Add the Controller, a solid Access Port and a passive FE Power Tap (all the same reactor tier).
Check the Controller for errors, insert fuel through the Access Port and connect energy storage.
Start at low demand; watch fuel and heat and adjust control rods before scaling up.

diagram.title: Smallest reactor (3x3x3)
diagram.view: One fuel rod in the middle, a control rod on top of it, the rest casing with the ports on the sides.
diagram.note: Bigger reactors: more fuel rod columns, each with a control rod on top. Reactor glass can replace casing on the faces.

goals.hint: Controller: 4 casing + 2 yellorium ingots + a diamond + redstone.
goals.why: Forms the reactor when the shell is closed.
steps: Reactor Controller: 4 Reactor Casing + 2 yellorium ingot + Diamond + Redstone.

goals.why: Reactor tools: Extreme Wrench.

goals.text: Craft Fuel Rods and Control Rods
goals.hint: Fuel rods hold yellorium; control rods set the reaction.
goals.why: Output is set by the rods inside the reactor.
steps: Reactor Fuel Rod: 6 iron ingot + 2 graphite ingot + yellorium ingot.
Reactor Control Rod: 4 Reactor Casing + 3 graphite ingot + Redstone + yellorium ingot.

goals.hint: The spent-fuel product.
goals.why: Feeds the blutonium fuel and ludicrite.
Dusts: Blutonium Dust, Cyanite Dust, Graphite Dust and 3 more.

goals.hint: Stronger reactor fuel.
goals.why: Raises the power each fuel rod gives.

goals.hint: Blade: cyanite ingot + 2 iron ingots. Bearing: 4 housing + 2 rotor shafts + 3 diamonds.
goals.why: Build the turbine around the bearing.
steps: Turbine Rotor Blade: cyanite ingot + 2 iron ingot.
Turbine Housing: 4 iron ingot + 4 graphite ingot + Turbine Housing Core.
Turbine Rotor Bearing: 4 Turbine Housing + 2 Turbine Rotor Shaft + 3 Diamond.

goals.why: Turbine casing parts: Bucket of Steam, Turbine Rotor Bearing, Turbine Computer Port and 10 more.

goals.hint: Steel for the turbine parts; a Steel Block is 9 ingots.
goals.why: Needed before the turbine.

goals.text: Assemble an Advanced Generators gas turbine
goals.hint: Connect a Gas Turbine Controller to its modules; right-click it for status.
goals.why: Advanced Generators turn fuels and steam into large amounts of power.
steps: Place a Gas Turbine Controller and connect at least one turbine module.
Attach a Fuel Input and an RF Output module to the same structure.
Right-click the Controller and fix any missing-module or limit messages.
Check its turbine capacity before adding fuel.

goals.text: Fuel a gas turbine and send its power to a machine
goals.hint: Pipe fuel into the Fuel Input; take power from the RF Output.
goals.why: Burns fuels (fire water, rocket fuel...) for power.
steps: Pipe it into the Fuel Input of the built turbine.
Connect the RF Output to a machine or storage.
Check the Controller shows fuel use and power out.

goals.text: Form a steam turbine and produce power from steam
goals.hint: Steam Turbine Controller + turbine module + steam input + RF Output.
goals.why: Power from heat-exchanger or boiler steam.
steps: Connect a Steam Turbine Controller, turbine module, steam input and RF Output.
Connect a load and watch the Controller while the rotor spins up.

goals.text: Use a heat exchanger or syngas machine to produce a useful fluid
goals.hint: Heat exchangers make steam; syngas machines make fuel gas.
goals.why: Makes the fuel your turbines and generators burn, from heat or syngas.
steps: Pick the Heat Exchanger or Syngas machine and get its controller and modules.
Connect the modules; right-click the Controller to see what is missing.
Supply the inputs and connect empty output storage.
Check the Controller's readings, then pipe the product to a turbine.

goals.text: Craft the turbine and syngas controllers
goals.hint: Gas Turbine Controller: 4 iron frames + 2 iron tubing + 2 iron wiring + a Control Circuit.
goals.why: Each controller closes its multiblock.
steps: Gas Turbine Controller: 4 Iron Frame + 2 Iron Tubing + 2 Iron Wiring + Control Circuit.
Steam Turbine Controller: 4 Iron Frame + Control Circuit + 3 Iron Tubing + Iron Wiring.
Heat Exchanger Controller: 4 Iron Frame + Iron Wiring + 3 Iron Tubing + Control Circuit.
Syngas Producer Controller: 4 Iron Frame + Pressure Valve + 2 Iron Tubing + Control Circuit + Iron Wiring.

goals.why: Turbine controllers: Heat Exchanger Controller, Steam Turbine Controller, Syngas Producer Controller and 1 more.

goals.text: Build a Solar Array Tier 1 Multiblock Structure
goals.hint: Environmental Tech solar array: a controller and structure blocks (JEI).
goals.why: Lots of daytime power from one controller.
steps: Craft the controller, 16 tier-1 structure blocks, 9 solar cells and 4 modifiers (any modifier block).
Build the layers around the controller.
Right-click the controller: it lists what is missing until the structure is complete.

diagram.title: Solar Array tier 1
diagram.view: K is the controller. Any tier 1-or-higher structure block works.
diagram.note: K = controller. The 9 solar cells sit on top in the middle.

goals.text: Harness the power of Lightning with a Lightning Rod
goals.hint: A lightning rod structure turns storms into power.
goals.why: Large power bursts from thunderstorms.
steps: Build the lightning rod structure high up under open sky.
Right-click the controller to check it.

diagram.title: Lightning Rod tier 1
diagram.view: K is the controller. Any tier 1-or-higher structure block works.
diagram.note: Stack the rod straight up above the controller.

goals.hint: Tier 1: 4 conductive alloy ingots + 4 gold blocks + a solar cell.
goals.why: Solar power from a multiblock.
steps: Solar Panel Controller Tier 1: 4 Conductive Alloy Ingot + 4 Gold Block + Solar Cell.
Solar Cell: 3 Photovoltaic Cell + 2 Alabaster + Redstone.
Photovoltaic Cell: 3 Clear Glass + 2 Lapis Lazuli + Silicon + 3 Ceramic Plate.

goals.why: Solar controllers: Solar Panel Controller Tier 1, Solar Panel Controller Tier 2, Solar Panel Controller Tier 3 and 1 more.
Cells and modifiers: Lunar Cell, Lunarvoltaic Cell, Mica and 19 more.

goals.text: Fly and use Angel Blocks to build an outpost above a landmark
goals.hint: Angel blocks can be placed in mid-air.
goals.why: Start a sky build anywhere.
steps: Place one in the air and build on it.

goals.text: Assemble a Create Train between your base and an outpost
goals.hint: Lay track, place stations and assemble a train with controls.
goals.why: Fast travel and cargo between bases, farms and mines.
steps: Build a train on the track with controls and bogeys.

goals.text: Keep a contraption afloat with Levitite
goals.hint: Crystallize Levitite Blend into Levitite: enough of it floats a contraption without a balloon.
goals.why: The blend needs 2 Aether ambrosium shards per batch, so lift comes with the Aether (Age 5).
goals.tip: Crystallized Levitite can't be scooped up again, and mould blocks inside the pool are destroyed. Pearlescent Levitite is decorative.
steps: Crush End Stone with Crushing Wheels into End Stone Powder.
Heated Mechanical Mixer (Blaze Burner under the basin): 4 End Stone Powder + 2 zinc nuggets + 2 ambrosium shards + 500 mB water = Levitite Blend.
Pour the blend into a block mould where you want it, then heat it (lit Blaze Burner, campfire or lava next to it): the whole pool crystallizes.
Build the Levitite into your ship and assemble it. Levitite holds it up; propellers move it and make it climb.

obtain.aeronautics:end_stone_powder: Put End Stone through Create Crushing Wheels (each block gives one powder, sometimes the end stone back too).
obtain.aeronautics:levitite_blend_bucket: Mix 4 End Stone Powder, 2 zinc nuggets, 2 ambrosium shards and 500 mB of water in a heated Mechanical Mixer, then take the Levitite Blend out of the basin with a bucket (or a spout or pipe).
obtain.aeronautics:levitite: Not crafted: pour Levitite Blend into place and heat it (a lit Blaze Burner, campfire or lava next to it). The fluid crystallizes into Levitite where it stands; once crystallized it cannot be scooped back up.

goals.hint: 1 Wooden Slab + 1 Gyroscopic Mechanism + 1 Brass Casing.
goals.why: Keeps a propeller steady under load, for the biggest airships.
steps: Gather 1 Wooden Slab, 1 Gyroscopic Mechanism, 1 Brass Casing.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Wooden Slab | empty; Middle row: empty | Gyroscopic Mechanism | empty; Bottom row: empty | Brass Casing | empty.
Use it in place of a plain propeller bearing.

goals.hint: Levitite Blend turns into Levitite; pearlescent is the stronger form.
goals.why: Levitite gives lift with no burner or fuel, the end of the airship line.
steps: Build levitite into the hull of a contraption.

goals.text: Locate a Stronghold and travel to the End
goals.hint: Throw eyes of ender to find the stronghold, then fill the portal frame.
goals.why: The Ender Dragon, End cities, shulkers and elytra; Draconic Evolution starts here.
steps: Craft about 14 eyes of ender (ender pearl + blaze powder).
Throw one up and walk where it flies.
Dig down where it falls to the portal room.
Fill the 12 frames with eyes and jump in.

diagram.title: End portal
diagram.view: Top view (already built in the stronghold)
diagram.note: Put an Eye of Ender in every frame that is missing one.

obtain.minecraft:end_portal_frame: Cannot be crafted or picked up: the frame is already built in the stronghold portal room. You only add Eyes of Ender.

goals.hint: Destroy the end crystals on the pillars first.
goals.why: Opens the End gateways (End cities) and gives the dragon egg and dragon's breath.
steps: Bring a bow, many arrows, blocks and slow falling or water.
Shoot the end crystals on the pillars.
Hit the dragon when it perches.

obtain.minecraft:dragon_head: Found on ships in End Cities; a Dragon Head is not dropped by the dragon.

mobs.where: Lives on the main End island; reach it through the End portal in a stronghold. After the first fight, summon it again by placing 4 End Crystals around the exit portal.

goals.hint: Use empty bottles on the dragon's purple breath cloud.
goals.why: For lingering potions and some mod recipes.
steps: During the dragon fight, use empty bottles on the purple cloud.

obtain.minecraft:dragon_breath: Use empty glass bottles on the purple breath clouds of the Ender Dragon.

mobs.where: Lives on the main End island; reach it through the End portal in a stronghold. After the first fight, summon it again by placing 4 End Crystals around the exit portal.

goals.text: Resurrect the Ender Dragon with End Crystals
goals.hint: Place an end crystal on each of the four sides of the exit portal.
goals.why: Fight it again for more XP (the egg drops only once).
steps: Place one on each side of the exit portal.

goals.text: Travel to an End City and obtain Elytra
goals.hint: End cities are on the outer End islands; elytra hang inside their ships.
goals.why: Glide, and fly fast with fireworks.
steps: Throw an ender pearl into a small End gateway.
Search the outer islands for an End city with a ship.
Take the elytra from the item frame in the ship.

obtain.minecraft:elytra: Hangs in an item frame inside the ships of End cities.

goals.hint: Two shulker shells around a chest. A shulker box keeps its contents when broken.
goals.why: A chest that keeps its contents when broken: carry a whole chest with you.
steps: Kill shulkers in End cities for shells.
Craft the box: two shells around a chest.
Break it with items inside: they stay inside.

goals.text: Eat an End Cake to visit the End
goals.hint: Each End Cake slice teleports you to the End.
goals.why: A quick trip back to the End.
steps: Craft the End Cake and place it.

goals.hint: The egg hatches into one of eight breeds.
goals.why: The start of every dragon.
steps: Keep it safe until it hatches.

goals.text: Hatch a Dragon Egg and train it
goals.hint: Dragon Mounts: hatch an egg (its biome decides the type), tame and saddle it.
goals.why: Your own rideable dragon.
steps: Place the egg in the biome you want.
Right-click it and wait for it to hatch.
Feed it fish to tame it; saddle it to ride.

mobs.where: Right-click a dragon egg (the vanilla one from the Ender Dragon, or a Dragon Mounts breed egg) to start hatching; keep it warm and wait for the dragon.

goals.hint: One of the eight dragon breeds: Aether.
goals.why: Adds the Aether Dragon to the eight breeds you can collect.
steps: Hatch eggs until an Aether Dragon emerges.

goals.hint: One of the eight dragon breeds: Ender.
goals.why: Adds the Ender Dragon to the eight breeds you can collect.
steps: Hatch eggs until an Ender Dragon emerges.

goals.hint: One of the eight dragon breeds: Fire.
goals.why: Adds the Fire Dragon to the eight breeds you can collect.
steps: Hatch eggs until a Fire Dragon emerges.

goals.hint: One of the eight dragon breeds: Forest.
goals.why: Adds the Forest Dragon to the eight breeds you can collect.
steps: Hatch eggs until a Forest Dragon emerges.

goals.hint: One of the eight dragon breeds: Ghost.
goals.why: Adds the Ghost Dragon to the eight breeds you can collect.
steps: Hatch eggs until a Ghost Dragon emerges.

goals.hint: One of the eight dragon breeds: Ice.
goals.why: Adds the Ice Dragon to the eight breeds you can collect.
steps: Hatch eggs until an Ice Dragon emerges.

goals.hint: One of the eight dragon breeds: Nether.
goals.why: Adds the Nether Dragon to the eight breeds you can collect.
steps: Hatch eggs until a Nether Dragon emerges.

goals.hint: One of the eight dragon breeds: Water.
goals.why: Adds the Water Dragon to the eight breeds you can collect.
steps: Hatch eggs until a Water Dragon emerges.

goals.hint: A CQR boss in its End arena, reachable after the Dragon.
goals.why: The hardest Chocolate Quest boss: a test of your Age 5 gear.
steps: Kill the Ender Dragon, then explore the End islands.
Destroy its crystals, keep moving and fight from range when it throws blocks.

mobs.where: A CQR boss in its own arena in the End; meet it after the Ender Dragon.

goals.hint: Equipment chests hold heavy diamond armor.
goals.why: The top armor tier of the mod.
steps: Open its equipment chests for the heavy diamond pieces.

goals.hint: Treasure chests hold the monking great sword and daggers; equipment chests hold the monking shield.
goals.why: Late weapons and a shield from dungeon chests.
steps: Open treasure chests in late dungeons for the great sword and daggers.
Open equipment chests for the shield.

goals.hint: Find the Exterminator lair and defeat the Exterminator.
goals.why: Clearing the Exterminator lair opens its boss chest.

goals.hint: Find the End dungeon and defeat the Ender King.
goals.why: Clearing the End dungeon opens its boss chest.
steps: Find the End dungeon of the Ender King.

goals.hint: Draconium Ore drops Draconium Dust in the Overworld, the Nether and the End; silk touch keeps the ore.
goals.why: Dust smelts into the draconium ingots every Draconic recipe starts from.
steps: Mine Draconium Ore, Nether Draconium Ore or Ender Draconium Ore.
Smelt the dust in a furnace (200 ticks) or a blast furnace (100 ticks).

goals.text: Smelt Draconium Ore into Draconium Ingots
goals.hint: Draconium ore: deep Overworld, the Nether and the End.
goals.why: Draconic Evolution starts with Draconium: cores, fusion crafting, energy storage.
steps: Find draconium ore (deepslate, Nether or End).

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Draconium Ingot + 4 Gold Ingot + 1 Diamond.
goals.why: Almost every Wyvern recipe asks for it: fusion core, pedestals, energy cores, binder and infuser.
steps: Craft 4 Draconium Ingot + 4 Gold Ingot + 1 Diamond.
Make several: the next ten recipes each use one or more.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Lapis Block + 4 Diamond + 1 Draconic Core.
goals.why: The block in the middle of a fusion setup; every fusion recipe is crafted on it.
steps: Craft the core and place it on open ground.
Ring it with crafting pedestals (next step).

goals.hint: Craft: 2 Diamond + 1 Draconic Core + 5 Stones + 1 Iron Block.
goals.why: Injectors hold the ingredients around the core; the basic one handles tier 0 recipes.
steps: Place them around the Fusion Crafting Core.

goals.hint: Craft: 2 Draconium Ingot + 1 Diamond + 1 Blaze Rod + 1 Draconic Core.
goals.why: Links energy crystals to each other and to the machines they feed.
steps: Keep it for the crystal network in the automation phase.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Draconium Ingot + 4 Draconic Core + 1 Nether Star.
goals.why: The heart of every Wyvern tool, armor piece and capacitor.
steps: Craft the core with 4 Draconic Cores and a Nether Star.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Diamond + 1 Particle Generator.
goals.why: Stabilizers wrap the energy core and, with the Particle Generator, show where it is built.
steps: Craft one stabilizer per side of the core.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Draconium Ingot + 1 Energy Core Stabilizer + 3 Draconic Core + 1 Enchanting Table.
goals.why: Charges Wyvern and Draconic tools and armor with RF.
steps: Feed it RF and put a tool on top.

goals.hint: A Fusion Crafting Core with injectors around it crafts Draconic items.
goals.why: Every Draconic tool, armor and upgrade is fusion-crafted.
steps: Craft a Fusion Crafting Core and at least 4 Basic Fusion Crafting Injectors (more for big recipes).
Place the injectors facing the core, in line with it, a few blocks away (left/right or above/below).
Center item in the core, ingredients in the injectors; power the injectors and start the craft.

goals.hint: Bind a Dislocator to a place, then teleport there.
goals.why: Back to home, a farm or a portal from anywhere.
steps: Sneak-right-click to bind a location; right-click to teleport.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Draconium Ingot + 4 Redstone Block + 1 Draconic Core.
goals.why: Powers Wyvern gear and goes into capacitors, crystals and the storage core.
steps: Craft one per Wyvern tool or armor piece, plus extras for the energy core.

goals.hint: Craft: 1 Wyvern Core + 2 Draconium Ingot + 1 Diamond Pickaxe + 1 Wyvern Energy Core.
goals.why: The first powered Draconic tool: it digs wide and fast once charged.
steps: Craft it from a Diamond Pickaxe.
Charge it in the Energy Infuser.

goals.hint: Craft: 6 Draconium Ingot + 1 Wyvern Core + 1 Diamond Chestplate + 1 Wyvern Energy Core.
goals.why: Wyvern armor carries a charged shield and the upgrade slots.
steps: Craft the chestpiece from a Diamond Chestplate.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Lapis Lazuli + 2 Draconic Core + 2 Draconium Ingot + 1 Golden Pickaxe.
goals.why: Upgrades add digging speed, damage, draw speed, jump boost and capacity to Wyvern and Draconic gear.
steps: Craft the upgrade item for the stat you want.
Install it in the tool configuration.

goals.hint: Relics come from rare mob drops: the Fortune Coin pulls nearby items to you.
goals.why: Utility magic: magnets, mob charms that keep a mob type friendly, a handgun with special bullets.
steps: Collect rare drops: nebulous hearts (endermen), slime pearls (slimes), bat wings (bats). JEI shows each relic.
Craft the Fortune Coin (nebulous heart, gold nugget, slime pearl, bat wing); right-click to switch it on.

goals.hint: The coin pulls nearby items toward you.
goals.why: The coin pulls drops toward you so you stop chasing items.
steps: Coin of Fortune: Craft: Nebulous Heart + Gold nugget + Slime Pearl + Bat Wing
Touchstone of Midas: Craft: Anvil + 2 Gold block + 3 Molten Core + 2 Catalyzing Gland + Void Tear

goals.hint: Mob charm fragments combine into a charm.
goals.why: Keeps chosen mobs from attacking you.

goals.hint: Medallion for the relic line.
goals.why: The medallion stores experience for later use.
steps: Hero's Medallion: Craft: Nebulous Heart + Coin of Fortune + Witch Hat + Infernal Tear
Collect the four ingredients from the Reliquary mob drops first

goals.text: Defeat an Infernal elite far from spawn
goals.hint: Infernal elites glow and carry modifiers (Vampire, Ghastly, Sapper...); more modifiers farther out.
goals.why: Elites drop enchanted gear. Rare near spawn; past 4,000 blocks and in the Twilight Forest they have 3 or 4 modifiers.
steps: Read the modifiers above an elite before you fight it.
Defeat one with 3 or more modifiers, then tick this goal.

goals.hint: Ender bow: the top More Bows bow (needs Age 4-5 materials).
goals.why: The best bow of the More Bows line.

goals.hint: Craft: 2 Netherrack + 2 Blaze Rod + 1 Gold Ingot + 1 Iron Bow.
goals.why: Arrows that set their target on fire.
steps: Craft it from an Iron Bow, 2 netherrack, 2 blaze rods and a gold ingot.

goals.text: Age 5 boss: defeat the Ender Dragon (or the Twilight Lich)
goals.hint: The Ender Dragon opens Age 6 (Mastery) for everyone on the server.
goals.why: When anyone on the server defeats one of these bosses, Age 6 opens for every player at once: its guide chapter, the reward bag and the decree of the age you finished. Age 6 brings the Gaia Guardian, the Chaos Guardian, Draconic awakened gear, the late Twilight bosses, big reactors and RFTools dimensions.
goals.tip: The killer, or anyone within 64 blocks when it dies, opens the age for the whole server. Nothing to craft or hand in. /sf3ages lists every gate.
steps: Ender Dragon: the End. Find a stronghold with Eyes of Ender and fill its portal.
Twilight Lich: the Lich Tower in the Twilight Forest, open once the Naga is beaten.
Bring: Age 5 gear, a bow or gun for the crystals and the Lich's clones, a water bucket, and slow falling or ender pearls for the End.
Defeat one. Chat announces the new age and this goal ticks itself (ages open in order).
Drops: Ender Dragon: the egg and lots of XP (dragon's breath with bottles). Lich: its trophy and a scepter.

goals.hint: Generate 10,000 FE/t into a load and keep it stable.
goals.why: Enough for big machine lines.
goals.tip: Production, not stored energy or nameplate capacity.
steps: Add generators until they make 10,000 FE/t together; keep their fuel, cooling or daylight supplied.
Connect storage or a load that takes all 10,000 FE/t (check cable and port limits).
Measure the 10,000 FE/t actually delivered (don't count power twice as it passes through).
Hold 10,000 FE/t long enough to be stable, then tick the goal.

goals.hint: Conduit: heart of the sea plus nautilus shells.
goals.why: Underwater breathing and mining speed near the water.
steps: Find a heart of the sea in ocean treasure.
Craft the conduit and build the frame around it.

goals.hint: Essences and templates are parts of the dimlet chain.
goals.why: They set how good your dimlets are.
steps: Mediocre Efficiency Essence: 3 Ender Eye + Ghast Tear.

goals.why: Dimlet items and tabs: Dimension Module, Dimlet Base, Dimlet Control Circuit and 12 more.

goals.hint: Craft: 1 Glass Blocks + 4 Gold Ingot + 1 Glass Blocks + 1 Ring of the Flying Squid + 1 Golden Lasso + 1 Golden Lasso.
goals.why: Creative-style flight from a ring slot, no fuel.
steps: Craft it from a Ring of the Flying Squid, 2 Golden Lassos, 4 gold ingots and 2 glass blocks.

goals.hint: 24 ammo types; most use copper ingots and gunpowder, e.g. 12-gauge: 15 copper + 6 gunpowder + 18 iron nuggets makes 18 shells.
goals.why: Each gun fires one ammo type.
steps: Open the Gun Smith Table on the ammo tab.
Craft the ammo your gun uses.

goals.hint: Craft: 1 Gold Nugget + 4 Gold Ingot + 1 Gold Nugget + 1 Ring of the Flying Squid + 1 Golden Lasso + 1 Golden Lasso.
goals.why: The same ring with gold nuggets in place of glass.
steps: Craft it with 2 gold nuggets instead of the glass blocks.

goals.hint: 53 guns, from a 16-iron Glock 17 up to the Minigun; open the Gun Smith Table to craft one.
goals.why: Guns are built from raw ingots, gems and rods at the table; there is no gun loot to find.
steps: Pick a gun whose materials you have.
Craft it and hold it in the main hand.

goals.hint: Craft: 1 Coal + 4 Gold Ingot + 1 Charcoal + 1 Ring of the Flying Squid + 1 Golden Lasso + 1 Golden Lasso.
goals.why: Bat, butterfly, demon and feather wings change the look, not the flight.
steps: Craft the ring with the matching material in the corners.

goals.hint: Craft an Elite Biome Scanner from the Advanced one and 8 draconium ingots.
goals.why: Third tier; it needs draconium ingots.
steps: Craft an Elite Biome Scanner: 8 Draconium Ingots + Biome Scanner (Advanced).

goals.hint: A celebrity Wither drops it next to the Nether Star; one Wither in four is a celebrity.
goals.why: A trophy from the Wither fight.
steps: Pick up the star beside the Nether Star.

goals.hint: Craft a Dimensional Core, then a core for the Overworld, Nether or End.
goals.why: The base for the Overworld, Nether and End cores.
steps: Craft a Dimensional Core: 4 iron ingots + Destruction Wand + repeater + Void Chassis + comparator + Building Wand.
Craft an Overworld Core: 4 sticks + grass block + potion + Dimensional Core + leaves + pumpkin.
Craft a Nether Core: 4 blaze rods + quartz block + ghast tear + Dimensional Core + wither skeleton skull + soul sand.
Craft an End Core: 4 end rods + purpur block + end portal frame + Dimensional Core + Ender Air Bottle + end crystal.

goals.hint: Craft: 5 Red Wool + 1 Hexical Diamond.
goals.why: A light set built from red wool and leather.
steps: Craft the hood from 5 Red Wool and a Hexical Diamond.

goals.hint: Craft: 2 Gold Ingot + 3 Obsidian + 1 Hexical Diamond.
goals.why: A heavy set from gold ingots and obsidian.
steps: Craft the helmet from 2 Gold Ingots, 3 Obsidian and a Hexical Diamond.

goals.hint: 6 diamonds + 2 wooden chests + 1 gold backpack storage emphasis.
goals.why: The largest Iron Backpacks tier.
steps: Craft it from 6 diamonds + 2 wooden chests + the gold storage backpack.

goals.hint: The top standard panel.
goals.why: One tile covers a large machine bank.
steps: Solar Panel IV: 3 Photovoltaic cell II + 4 Solar Panel III + Clock + iron block.
Solar Panel V: 3 Photovoltaic cell III + 4 Solar Panel IV + Glowstone + gold block.
Solar Panel VIII: 3 Photovoltaic cell IV + 4 Solar Panel VII + 2 Dragon Egg.

goals.hint: Craft a blade from four boss items of other mods, and a hilt around a Hexical Diamond.
goals.why: The two halves of the signature weapon.
steps: Blade: 1 Sword Walker (CQ Repoured) + 1 Celestial Emblem (Nyx) + 1 Axe of a Thousand Metals (Mowzie's Mobs) + 1 "Death" (Lavacow).
Hilt: 1 Alkahestry Tome (Reliquary) + 2 Gold Ingots + 1 Hexical Diamond + 1 Obsidian.

goals.hint: Assemble a cleaver at the Tool Forge from heavy parts.
goals.why: A heavy weapon for the damage goals below.
steps: Cast the heavy parts (large sword blade, tough rod).

goals.hint: Parents: Blaze Rod Chicken + Magma Cream Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 ardite ingot; drops 1 ardite ingot when killed. Parent of Manyullyn Chicken, Pig Iron Chicken.
steps: Pen a Blaze Rod Chicken and a Magma Cream Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or an Ardite Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Ardite Chicken + Cobalt Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 manyullyn ingot; drops 1 manyullyn ingot when killed. Parent of Knight Slime Chicken.
steps: Pen an Ardite Chicken and a Cobalt Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Manyullyn Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Ardite Chicken + Iron Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 pig iron ingot; drops 1 pig iron ingot when killed. Parent of Knight Slime Chicken.
steps: Pen an Ardite Chicken and an Iron Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Pig Iron Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Parents: Manyullyn Chicken + Pig Iron Chicken.
goals.why: Lays 1 knightslime ingot; drops 1 knightslime ingot when killed.
steps: Pen a Manyullyn Chicken and a Pig Iron Chicken together and feed both wheat seeds.
The chick is one of the parents or a Knight Slime Chicken; keep trying.

goals.hint: Enigmoths drop the gland.
goals.why: Pheromone Glands drop from Enigmoths.

goals.hint: 1 Ring of Haste + 1 Ender Star.
goals.why: A stronger version of any ring, for the same buff at a higher level.
steps: Gather 1 Ring of Haste, 1 Ender Star.
Combine them in the crafting grid to get Advanced Ring Of Haste.
Combine a ring with an Ender Star.

goals.hint: 4 Empowered Diamatine Crystal Block + 2 Empowered Enori Crystal + 2 Basic Coil + 1 Ender Casing.
goals.why: Repairs tools with power so you do not need an anvil and levels.
steps: Gather 4 Empowered Diamatine Crystal Block, 2 Empowered Enori Crystal, 2 Basic Coil, 1 Ender Casing.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Empowered Diamatine Crystal Block | Empowered Enori Crystal | Empowered Diamatine Crystal Block.
Middle row: Basic Coil | Ender Casing | Basic Coil.
Bottom row: Empowered Diamatine Crystal Block | Empowered Enori Crystal | Empowered Diamatine Crystal Block.
Place it and put the tool inside.

goals.text: Build the Refinery and Diesel Generator
goals.hint: The Refinery turns plant oil and ethanol into biodiesel; the Diesel Generator burns it.
goals.why: Biodiesel from the Refinery runs the Diesel Generator, power that needs no sky or water.
steps: Build the Refinery with the Hammer.
Pipe plant oil and ethanol into it.
Build the Diesel Generator and pipe the biodiesel in.

goals.text: Survey ore with the Core Sample Drill
goals.hint: 4 Steel Scaffolding Standard + 3 Steel Fence + 2 Light Engineering.
goals.why: Core samples show which ore lies under a chunk, the survey step before you commit to an Excavator.
steps: Gather 4 Steel Scaffolding Standard, 3 Steel Fence, 2 Light Engineering.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Steel Scaffolding Standard | Steel Fence | Steel Scaffolding Standard.
Middle row: Steel Scaffolding Standard | Steel Fence | Steel Scaffolding Standard.
Bottom row: Light Engineering | Steel Fence | Light Engineering.
Take a core sample and read which ore the chunk holds.

goals.hint: Multiblock built with the Hammer.
goals.why: Fastest ore processing in the mod; it also smelts steel from dust.
steps: Build it with the Hammer and wire it.

goals.hint: 1 grid + 1 crafting table + 1 advanced processor.
goals.why: Craft with the whole network as your inventory.
steps: Craft it from 1 grid + 1 crafting table + 1 advanced processor.

goals.hint: 1 grid + 1 bucket + 1 advanced processor.
goals.why: Look at and move fluids on the network.
steps: Craft it from 1 grid + 1 bucket + 1 advanced processor.

goals.hint: 2 glass blocks + 3 redstone + 1 64k storage part + 3 quartz enriched irons.
goals.why: The biggest basic item disk.
steps: Craft the 64k part, then the disk around it.

goals.hint: Made in the Solderer.
goals.why: The largest fluid storage block, a single block that holds 512k buckets.

goals.hint: Craft: 3 Fermented Spider Eye + 2 Glowstone + 2 Advanced Wand Core.
goals.why: Applies potion effects to the mobs and players you aim at.
steps: Craft it around 2 Advanced Wand Cores.

goals.hint: 2 iron ingots + a glass bottle.
goals.why: Syringes collect mob essence; 9 make a Peace Essence.

goals.hint: Craft: 3 Dark Soularium Ingot + 3 Conductive Iron Armor Plating.
goals.why: Dark Soularium and glider wings go into the top tier.
steps: Alloy Dark Soularium in an Ender IO alloy smelter.

goals.hint: Craft or upgrade: 2 Double-Layer Capacitor + 1 Capacitor Bank + 4 Energetic Alloy Ingot + 1 Basic Capacitor Pack + 1 Pulsating Crystal.
goals.why: More stored energy; tier 3 follows the same pattern.
steps: Craft it around your Tier 1 flux pack.

goals.hint: The Potato Jetpack has no crafting recipe in the pack data; check JEI for how to get it.
goals.why: A cosmetic extra among the jetpack items.

goals.hint: Craft or upgrade: 4 Electrical Steel Ingot + 1 Basic Capacitor + 1 Conductive Iron Jetpack + 2 Electrical Steel Thruster.
goals.why: Faster and longer flight; each tier is crafted from the one before.
steps: Craft the jetpack around your Tier 1 jetpack.

goals.hint: Craft or upgrade: 4 Energetic Alloy Ingot + 1 Double-Layer Capacitor + 1 Electrical Steel Jetpack + 2 Energetic Thruster.
goals.why: Energetic alloy tier, one step before Vibrant.
steps: Craft the jetpack around your Tier 2 jetpack.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Dark Soularium Ingot + 1 Ender Crystal + 1 Vibrant Jetpack (Armored) + 2 Dark Soularium Thruster.
goals.why: The top jetpack tier, with the longest flight time.
steps: Craft the jetpack from an armored Tier 4 jetpack, Dark Soularium and an Ender Crystal.

goals.hint: Craft: 2 End Stones + 1 Exchanger Core (Tier 3) + 2 Purpur Pillar + 2 Ender Eye + 1 Obsidian Exchanger + 1 Purpur Block.
goals.why: The top exchanger: the widest swap area.
steps: Collect End stone, purpur and ender eyes.
Craft it around an Obsidian Exchanger.

goals.hint: Craft a Redstone I/O block and place it next to a computer.
goals.why: A computer reads and sets redstone on every side.
steps: Craft a Redstone I/O: 4 iron ingots + Chip3 + 2 redstone blocks + Redstone Card (Tier 2) + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).

goals.hint: 4 gold nuggets, 2 tier 2 chips, a Control Unit and an ALU around redstone dust.
goals.why: More components per computer, and the base for the tier 3 parts.
steps: Craft a Tier 2 CPU: 4 gold nuggets + redstone dust + 2 Chip2s + Cu + Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU).

goals.hint: Craft a Motion Sensor for a computer.
goals.why: Detects things that move near a computer.
steps: Craft a Motion Sensor: 4 gold ingots + 3 daylight detectors + Central Processing Unit (CPU) (Tier 3) + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).

goals.hint: Put a drone case, CPU, memory and parts into an Assembler.
goals.why: A flying robot you steer with your programs.
steps: Put the case and its parts into the Assembler.
Start the build and take the drone.

goals.hint: Put a tablet case, CPU, memory and parts into an Assembler.
goals.why: A hand-held computer; the MFU links to blocks from afar.
steps: Put the case and its parts into the Assembler.
Start the build and take the tablet.

goals.text: Craft a Rack and a Server
goals.hint: Craft a rack and a tier 1 server, then slot the server in.
goals.why: Runs many computers in one block.
steps: Craft a Rack: 2 diamonds + Wlan Card2 + 2 iron bars + wooden chest + Relay + Printed Circuit Board (PCB) + Power Distributor.
Craft a Tier 1 Server: 2 iron ingots + Ram2 + 2 Chip1s + Component Bus (Tier 2) + 2 obsidians + Printed Circuit Board (PCB).
Slot the server into the rack.

goals.text: Server tiers 2 and 3, RAID and Terminal
goals.family: Server tiers 2 and 3, RAID and Terminal

goals.hint: Craft Hover Boots from a tier 2 hover upgrade and a drone case.
goals.why: Boots that let you hover.
steps: Craft Hover Boots: 4 iron nuggets + Hover Upgrade2 + 2 leathers + Drone Case (Tier 2) + Capacitor.
Craft Nanomachines: 4 Chameliums + Wlan Card2 + Central Processing Unit (CPU) (Tier 3) + Grog + Ram1 + Capacitor.

goals.hint: Realm Key: handed out when Age 5 opens; with paper, an ink sac and a gold nugget it crafts the Realm Decree.
goals.why: Keeps the Realm Decree craftable, and one right-click pays the Age 5 reward.
steps: Open New Worlds by defeating its boss.
Right-click the Realm Key once for the reward.
Craft the Realm Decree: Realm Key + paper + ink sac + gold nugget.

goals.hint: 1 soularium ingot on top of 3 fused quartz; right-click a mob with it to catch the mob.
goals.why: Link 1 of 2 of the Soul vial to Powered Spawner route; next: Bind it in the Soul Binder for a Powered Spawner.

goals.hint: 4 Electrical Steel Ingot + 1 Enderman Head or Skeleton Skull + 1 Machine Chassis + 2 Vibrant Crystal + 1 Z-Logic Controller.
goals.why: Spawns chosen mobs on demand, the core of a mob farm.
steps: Gather 4 Electrical Steel Ingot, 1 Enderman Head or Skeleton Skull, 1 Machine Chassis, 2 Vibrant Crystal, 1 Z-Logic Controller.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Electrical Steel Ingot | Enderman Head or Skeleton Skull | Electrical Steel Ingot.
Middle row: Electrical Steel Ingot | Machine Chassis | Electrical Steel Ingot.
Bottom row: Vibrant Crystal | Z-Logic Controller | Vibrant Crystal.
Insert a soul vial and place it in a dark room.

goals.hint: 6 Electrical Steel Ingot + 1 Conduit Probe + 1 Machine Chassis + 1 Energy Conduit.
goals.why: Reads network power so you can see when to add generators.
steps: Gather 6 Electrical Steel Ingot, 1 Conduit Probe, 1 Machine Chassis, 1 Energy Conduit.
Lay out the grid. Top row: Electrical Steel Ingot | Conduit Probe | Electrical Steel Ingot.
Middle row: Electrical Steel Ingot | Machine Chassis | Electrical Steel Ingot.
Bottom row: Electrical Steel Ingot | Energy Conduit | Electrical Steel Ingot.
Attach it to an energy conduit.

goals.hint: 2 Vibrant Alloy Ingot + 2 Double Layer Capacitor + 1 Glowstone Block.
goals.why: Top capacitor tier: powers the Dialing Device, Wireless Charger and Telepad recipes.
steps: Gather 2 Vibrant Alloy Ingot, 2 Double Layer Capacitor, 1 Glowstone Block.
Lay out the grid. Top row: empty | Vibrant Alloy Ingot | empty.
Middle row: Double Layer Capacitor | Glowstone Block | Double Layer Capacitor.
Bottom row: empty | Vibrant Alloy Ingot | empty.
Place alloy above and below, capacitors left and right, glowstone block in the center.

goals.hint: Craft or upgrade: 4 Vibrant Alloy Ingot + 1 Octadic Capacitor + 1 Energetic Jetpack + 2 Vibrant Thruster.
goals.why: Vibrant alloy tier with an octadic capacitor.
steps: Craft the jetpack around your Tier 3 jetpack.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Nether Brick + 3 Iron Ingot + 1 Furnace + 1 Draconic Core.
goals.why: A first power source for the Energy Infuser and the crystal network.
steps: Connect it to the Energy Infuser or a crystal.

goals.hint: Craft: 6 Draconium Ingot + 2 Wyvern Energy Core + 1 Wyvern Core.
goals.why: The center block of the energy core multiblock.
steps: Craft it from two Wyvern Energy Cores and a Wyvern Core.
Place it where the core will stand.

goals.text: Apply the Realm Decree to a Bounty Board
goals.hint: Open a Bounty Board, click the Realm tab on the left and place the decree in the empty slot: the page opens for good with Age 5 jobs.
goals.why: Opens the Realm page: Age 5 jobs (items and kills) that pay one notch ahead. Optional: bounties never gate progression.
goals.tip: Right-clicking the board with the decree also works. Breaking the board returns it and every decree on it. The goal ticks when anyone opens the page.
steps: You get the Realm Decree when Age 6 opens (every player gets one).
Right-click a Bounty Board to open it and click the Realm tab (left edge).
Place the Realm Decree in the empty slot on that page. The page opens for good and gets 3 jobs at once, then a new one about every 3 minutes (up to 9).

goals.hint: Bounties are side jobs, never a gate. Use the Realm Decree on a Bounty Board and hand in three jobs.
goals.why: Every player gets the Realm Decree when Age 6 opens. On a board it offers Age 5 jobs (items and kills from every strand) that pay one notch ahead, never a skip. Skip a job you don't like and the board offers a new one. Bounties count for this decree until the next decree arrives.
steps: For the Realm page, craft a Bounty Board (6 planks + 3 paper) or use one in a village, and place it. The Bounty Boards page explains how jobs work.
Apply the Realm Decree to its page on the board (the goal before this one).
Hand in three Realm bounties; this goal counts them for you.
goals.tip: Lost your decree? Craft a copy: decree + paper (you keep the original). Old capstones still make their decree.

goals.text: Defeat the Hydra after completing the Fire Swamp prerequisite
goals.hint: Eat Meef Stroganoff first and bring fire resistance.
goals.why: Drops Fiery Blood for Fiery Ingots; one of the three branches to the Highlands.
steps: Find the Hydra lair in the Fire Swamp.
Hit its heads when they open their mouths.

mobs.where: Lives in its lair in the Fire Swamp. Opens after the Minoshroom; eat its Meef Stroganoff first or the swamp sets you on fire.

goals.hint: The Hydra drops Hydra Chop, an eatable heal.
goals.why: Heals when eaten, and proves the Hydra kill.

goals.text: Collect Fiery Blood and Fiery Tears
goals.hint: The Hydra drops Fiery Blood; the Ur-Ghast drops Fiery Tears.
goals.why: Both feed the Fiery metal chain.
steps: Defeat the Hydra for Fiery Blood.
Defeat the Ur-Ghast for Fiery Tears.

goals.hint: Armor shards drop from goblin knights, helmet crabs and chain goblins; smelt a cluster into an ingot.
goals.why: Knightmetal tools, armor and shield.
steps: Clear the Knight Stronghold in the Dark Forest: goblin knights and Block and Chain goblins drop armor shards.
Craft an Armor Shard Cluster from shards.
Smelt or blast the cluster into a Knightmetal Ingot.

goals.hint: Knightmetal pickaxe: 3 ingots over 2 sticks; the shield needs a Knightmetal Loop.
goals.why: Strong mid-game Twilight gear.
steps: Pickaxe: 3 ingots across the top, 2 sticks below.
Shield: 3 ingots + 2 towerwood + a Knightmetal Loop.
Craft the sword, axe and armor from ingots.

goals.hint: Fiery Blood (Hydra) or Fiery Tears (Ur-Ghast) + iron = Fiery Ingot.
goals.why: Fiery Ingots make Twilight gear that burns enemies and auto-smelts.
goals.tip: Fiery gear doesn't replace a Fire Resistance potion.
steps: Get Fiery Blood from the Hydra or Fiery Tears from the Ur-Ghast.
Check the gear's tooltip before relying on its protection.

goals.hint: Fiery pickaxe: 3 Fiery ingots over 2 blaze rods.
goals.why: The strongest Twilight set.
steps: Craft Fiery ingots: a Fiery Vial + an iron ingot.
Pickaxe: 3 ingots across the top, 2 blaze rods below.
Craft the sword and armor from ingots.

goals.text: Complete Knight Phantom progression in the Dark Forest
goals.hint: Six Knight Phantoms guard the Goblin Knight Stronghold (opens after the Lich).
goals.why: Beating them opens the Dark Tower.
steps: Finish the Lich and bring a Twilight boss trophy to the Goblin Knight Stronghold.
Put the trophy on the entrance pedestal to open the shield.
Find and defeat all six Knight Phantoms.
Collect the reward and check the advancement before going to the Dark Tower.

obtain.twilightforest:knight_phantom_trophy: Dropped by the last Knight Phantom.

mobs.where: Six Knight Phantoms guard the trophy room of the Goblin Knight Stronghold in the Dark Forest. Opens after the Lich.

goals.hint: Phantom helmet and chestplate drop from the Knight Phantoms.
goals.why: Armor from the Dark Forest bosses.

goals.text: Complete Ur-Ghast progression in the Dark Tower
goals.hint: Climb the Dark Tower (opens after the Knight Phantoms) and defeat the Ur-Ghast.
goals.why: Drops carminite; one of the three branches to the Highlands.
steps: Climb the Dark Tower (towerwood); careful with carminite reactors.
Defeat the Ur-Ghast at the top.

mobs.where: Floats at the top of the Dark Tower in the Dark Forest. Opens after the Knight Phantoms.

goals.hint: Carminite: Borer Essence + redstone dust + a Ghast Tear.
goals.why: Carminite builds the Carminite Builder and Reactor.
steps: Take Borer Essence from towerwood borers.
Craft Carminite: Borer Essence + redstone dust + Ghast Tear.

goals.text: Complete Alpha Yeti progression in the Snowy Forest
goals.hint: The Alpha Yeti lairs in a snowy cave (opens after the Lich).
goals.why: Opens the Glacier and the Aurora Palace.
steps: Find the Yeti lair (a snowy cave).
Defeat the Alpha Yeti; dodge the falling ice.

obtain.twilightforest:alpha_yeti_fur: Dropped by the Alpha Yeti in its lair in the Snowy Forest.

mobs.where: Lives in a cave lair in the Snowy Forest. Opens after the Lich.

goals.hint: Ice Bombs drop from the Alpha Yeti and sit in Aurora Palace loot.
goals.why: A thrown bomb that freezes enemies.

goals.text: Defeat the Snow Queen in the Aurora Palace
goals.hint: The Aurora Palace is in the Glacier (opens after the Alpha Yeti).
goals.why: One of the three branches to the Highlands.
steps: Defeat the Snow Queen and her ice shields.

mobs.where: Rules the top of the Aurora Palace in the Glacier. Opens after the Alpha Yeti.

goals.hint: Place a boss trophy on the pedestal to unlock later areas.
goals.why: Boss trophies placed here unlock the Highlands path.

goals.hint: Thorn walls fill the Thornlands biome.
goals.why: Reaches the Dark Tower region.

goals.text: Complete all three major branches and enter the Highlands
goals.hint: Defeat the Hydra, the Ur-Ghast and the Snow Queen: the Highlands barrier drops.
goals.why: The last Twilight area: the Troll Caves and the Final Castle.
steps: Defeat the Hydra, the Ur-Ghast and the Snow Queen.
Enter the Highlands; the barrier is gone.

goals.hint: Giant Pickaxe: 3 Giant Cobblestone over 2 Giant Logs; giant miners also drop it.
goals.why: Giant tools are crafted from giant stone and giant logs.
steps: Craft the Giant Pickaxe: 3 Giant Cobblestone over 2 Giant Logs.

goals.text: Recover the Lamp of Cinders from the Troll Caves
goals.hint: The Lamp of Cinders is in the troll vault of the Highlands' Troll Caves.
goals.why: It burns away the thorns blocking the Final Castle.
steps: Finish the Hydra, Ur-Ghast and Snow Queen branches and explore the Highlands.
Find the Troll Caves and the giant cloud above them.
Get the Giant Pickaxe and dig into the protected vault.
Take the Lamp of Cinders and burn the thorns toward the Final Castle.

obtain.twilightforest:lamp_of_cinders: Found in the troll vault deep in the Troll Caves of the Highlands.

goals.hint: Beacon with Gaia Pylons around it: use Terrasteel on the beacon, then defeat the Guardian.
goals.why: Gaia Spirits make Botania's best items: the Gaia ingot, the Ring of the Aesir and endgame flowers.
goals.tip: Gaia Spirits always drop and go into the Mastery Crown. An Elementium Axe kill can also drop its head (1 in 13), a trophy only.
steps: Build the beacon base and Gaia Pylons as shown (compare with the Lexica ritual preview).
Clear and flatten the arena around it.
Use a Terrasteel Ingot on the Beacon to summon the Guardian.
Stay in the arena, defeat it and collect the Gaia Spirits.

diagram.title: Gaia arena
diagram.view: Pylons four blocks out on each diagonal, one block higher than the beacon.
diagram.note: Keep 12 blocks around flat and 5 above clear.

mobs.where: You summon it: build the Gaia arena (a beacon on a 3x3 base and 4 Gaia Pylons) and right-click the beacon with a Terrasteel ingot (a Gaia ingot for the harder fight). It cannot be fought on Peaceful.

goals.text: Complete the Ritual of Gaia II
goals.hint: The harder Gaia fight: use a Gaia Ingot on the beacon.
goals.why: More Gaia spirits and rare loot like the Dice of Fate.
steps: Use a Gaia Ingot on the beacon instead of Terrasteel.

goals.hint: A Weak Blood Shard in a tier 4 altar becomes the Master Blood Orb (25,000 LP).
goals.why: Tier 4 sigils and rituals and a much bigger LP network.
steps: Kill monsters with a Bound Sword (binding array) for Weak Blood Shards.
Build the tier 4 altar (Blood Magic book: Sanguine Scientiem) with Bloodstone capstones.
Put the shard in and keep the altar supplied: the craft takes 25,000 LP.
Right-click the orb to bind it, then leave it in the altar to fill.

obtain.bloodmagic:blood_shard_weak: Dropped by monsters killed with a Bound Sword (more with Looting).

goals.text: Automate LP with a Well of Suffering
goals.hint: The Well of Suffering ritual turns damage to mobs near the altar into LP.
goals.why: No more self-sacrifice: a mob farm next to the ritual fills the altar.
goals.tip: Runes of Sacrifice raise the LP per hit. Keep players out of the ritual area.
steps: Craft a Master Ritual Stone (obsidian, blank ritual stones, Magician's orb), ritual stones and a Weak Activation Crystal.
Set a Ritual Diviner to Well of Suffering and place the stones around the master stone next to the altar.
Right-click the master stone with the activation crystal (uses LP from your network).
Bring mobs into its range: a mob farm or spawner beside the altar keeps it going.

goals.text: Obtain the full Living Armor set
goals.hint: Living Armor levels up as you use it.
goals.why: Gains upgrades like speed and protection from what you do.
steps: Make Reagents of Binding in the Hellfire Forge.
Per piece: draw an array with Arcane Ashes, right-click it with the reagent, then with an iron helmet, chestplate, leggings or boots.

obtain.bloodmagic:living_armour_helmet: Binding array: draw a circle with Arcane Ashes, right-click it with a Reagent of Binding, then with the matching iron armor piece.
obtain.bloodmagic:living_armour_chest: Binding array: draw a circle with Arcane Ashes, right-click it with a Reagent of Binding, then with the matching iron armor piece.
obtain.bloodmagic:living_armour_legs: Binding array: draw a circle with Arcane Ashes, right-click it with a Reagent of Binding, then with the matching iron armor piece.
obtain.bloodmagic:living_armour_boots: Binding array: draw a circle with Arcane Ashes, right-click it with a Reagent of Binding, then with the matching iron armor piece.

goals.hint: Living Armor learns from what you do; a Training Bracelet blocks upgrades you don't want.
goals.why: Each piece levels upgrades (speed, step assist, arrow protection...) within an upgrade-point budget.
goals.tip: This version has no Living Station: upgrades come from use.
steps: Wear the full Living Armor set.
Do the matching activity: sprint for speed, take arrow hits for arrow protection, eat for knockback resistance.
Craft and wear a Training Bracelet to block unwanted upgrades.
Sneak over the chestplate tooltip for upgrades and points used.

goals.text: Automate the creation of Demonic Slates
goals.hint: Imbued slates in a tier 4 altar become demonic slates: automate the feed and output.
goals.why: Tier 5 needs demonic slates in bulk.
steps: Set up a tier 4 altar with enough LP.
Filter the extraction to pull out only Demonic Slates.
Test one craft first, then watch LP and output space.

goals.hint: Build the tier 5 runes and capstones; confirm with a Divination Sigil.
goals.why: Unlocks the Archmage Blood Orb and Ethereal Slates.
steps: Follow the tier 5 rune layout in the Blood Magic guide.
Check with a Divination Sigil that the altar is tier 5.
Have enough LP supply and capacity before tier 5 recipes.

goals.hint: Made at a tier 5 Blood Altar.
goals.why: A far larger LP store than the Magician orb before the Master orb.
steps: Place the orb ingredient on it

goals.hint: A huge multiblock battery with four stabilizers around it.
goals.why: Stores millions to billions of FE.
steps: Place the Energy Core and right-click it: its screen can show a hologram build guide.
Build the required blocks around it.
Place 4 stabilizers in a cross, aimed at the core, then activate it.

goals.hint: Pump power in until the core is full.
goals.why: Enough stored power to ride out any shortage.
goals.tip: Stored FE and production (FE/t) are different numbers.
steps: Build and activate an Energy Core of the tier you want to fill.
Build Energy Pylons with their glass blocks and link them to the core.
Set the feeding pylon to input and connect your generators.
Watch the stored energy rise until the core is full.

goals.hint: Craft: 4 Diamond + 1 Wyvern Energy Core.
goals.why: Moves RF from the energy core to machines and tools; basic, Wyvern and Draconic crystals come in relay, wireless and IO forms.
steps: Craft relay crystals and bind them with the Crystal Binder.
Place an IO crystal at the energy core and another at each machine.

goals.hint: The Ender Dragon drops the Dragon Heart; Draconic gear starts with it.
goals.why: It is the gate between Wyvern and Draconic gear: no heart, no Draconic Block, no awakened ingots.
steps: Use it in the Draconic Block fusion (next step).
It also goes into the Chaos Guardian Beacon and the Dragon Egg recipe.

goals.hint: Fusion craft 6 Draconic Cores + 1 Dragon Heart; catalyst 4 Draconium Blocks, tier 1, 50,000,000 RF.
goals.why: One block splits into 9 Draconic (awakened) ingots, the metal of every Draconic recipe.
steps: Build the fusion setup: core plus injectors.
Put the 4 Draconium Blocks in the core and the cores and Dragon Heart on the injectors.

goals.hint: Fusion craft: 4 Wyvern Core + 5 Draconic Ingot around the core; catalyst Nether Star, tier 1, 1,000,000 RF.
goals.why: The core of all Draconic gear.
steps: Fusion craft it with a Nether Star as catalyst.
Make one per Draconic tool or armor piece.

goals.hint: Fusion-craft Draconic armor: its shield absorbs damage while charged.
goals.why: A large damage shield; upgrades raise shield and energy.
steps: Get the Wyvern chestpiece, awakened draconium, an awakened core and a draconic energy core (JEI).
Fusion-craft the Draconic Chestpiece with Draconic-tier injectors.
Apply shield, recovery and energy upgrades (JEI: Draconic tool upgrades) and charge it.
Check shield and energy before a boss fight.

goals.hint: Fusion craft: 1 Awakened Core + 2 Draconic Ingot + 1 Draconic Energy Core around the core; catalyst Sword of the Wyvern, tier 2, 16,000 RF.
goals.why: Top melee damage once charged.
steps: Fusion craft it with the Sword of the Wyvern as catalyst.

goals.hint: Fusion craft: 1 Awakened Core + 2 Draconic Ingot + 1 Draconic Energy Core around the core; catalyst Bow of the Wyvern, tier 2, 16,000 RF.
goals.why: The strongest ranged weapon of the mod.
steps: Fusion craft it with the Bow of the Wyvern as catalyst.

goals.hint: 4 Solar Panel VIII + 4 Wyvern Cores + a Draconic Energy Core.
goals.why: The strongest panel before the chaotic one.
steps: Draconic Solar Panel: 4 Solar Panel VIII + 4 Wyvern Core + Draconic Energy Core.
Chaotic Solar Panel: 4 Draconic Solar Panel + 4 Awakened Core + Chaos Shard.

goals.text: Craft the Draconic Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel and Hoe
goals.hint: Fusion-craft Wyvern tools with awakened draconium into Draconic tools.
